gtam mdzong| me 'i can ca rte — chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogaswa kyis brtsams mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dpeskrunagasal bshad/ deb 'di'i nang thog maraḥrgyal kha4 phyi nang gi gna' deng mkhas dbang tshos ‘ gtam dpe ’ zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di'i go don la bzhed srol mi 'dra ba yod pa rnams legs btus dang / rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi lta tshul dpyad brjod gang rgyas gnang yod la/ bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe chig stong bdun brgya lhag tsam bsdus bkod kyis de dag so so'i go don dang / spyod stangs/ chags grub 'phel rim/ lo rgyus/sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos sogs 'grel brjod kha gsal gnang yod pas des spyir bod kyi lo rgyus dang / dmangs khrod rtsom rig sogs la sbyong spyod zhib gsum gyi bya bar phan pa bla med yong nges khar sgos bod skad yig sbyong spyod mkhan gyi phyi rabs pa tsho'i rgyun gtan gyi bya spyod/ gtam brjod kha rtsal sogs kyi bya sgo gang ci'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi lam ston sgron me dang legs nyes blang 'dor 'byed pa'i ye shes kyi spyan lta bu zhig tu 'gyur nges la dmigs 'di nas da lam dpe skrun zhus pa lags na mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i klog pa bam̐ lhan rgyas mchog nas lhag bsam dri med sprin gyi chu 'khur las dpe skrun gyi bya sgo gang cir skyon sel bka' yi sbrang char 'bebs gnang yong ba'i re 'dun dang bcas/mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas/
— nga—

— rang mji4— dkarabastan — gleng gzhi/ ༷ rwa (1)gtam dpe dang 'brel yod kyi 'bel gtam 'ga' zhig (1 )le tshan dang po/ dpe khongs ched sdigabashagade brjod don gang yin ོ pa rang shugs kyis gsal bar ston pa'i gtam dpe'i gras/ (24)le tshan gnyis pa/ bod gna' rabs pas dpe mang drangs nas don gcig mtshon par byed pa'i rtsom srol gyi rgyun ltar/dpe nyis rtseg gis brjod don gang yin pa de nan tan du ston pa'i gtam dpe'i gras/ (194)le tshan gsum pa/ tshig sdud che ba'i dpe tshig 'bru bzhi can gyis brjod don ston par byed pa'i gtam dpe'i gras/ (226)le tshan bzhi pa/ dpe sogs 'khyog brjod kyis ma brgyan par phul du byung ba'i tshig sbyor gyis brjod don thad kur ston pa'i gtam dpe'i gras/ (259)le tshan lnga pa/ tshig rkang gcig gis don dang / tshig rkang gcig gis dpe bstan nas dpe don zung du sbrel bas brjod bya'i don snying gsal bar ston pa'i gtam dpe'i gras/ ༷ (345)1

le tshan drug pa/ bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud dam/ lo rgyus bshad tshal sogs dngo 'a brol ba yod pa'i gtam /jiX //rdo/ 1)re/ rwadro//rwa/rdo/da 'ga' cag 'byang khungs sam byung tshal ra rang ring bshad pa/ dzo (392)mjug bsdu ba/ — (430)gtam mdzod la bskyar zhib bgyise pa'i g.ya' sel/ (435)mtha' mjug gi re 'ardun/— ) ༷ — — 4 (456) 2 —

— ri 4 — sna — 4 glengabazhi/ — 4 —〉 — — rang cag bod kyi mi rigs 'de ni 'udzaska gling sa rle go sarje rtse sgror byung zhing 'phel —ba'i las la brtson zhing / dpa' mardzongs —brtul phod ldan la/ shes rig kyang rnam par bku ba'i phul byung gi mi rigase shig yin/ rang re'i yang mes rnams kyis mi rabs nas mi rabs grangs med pa brgyud mtha' yi rgya mtsho chen po'i ngos las spyi khre stong phrag 'ga' zhig gis mngon par 'phags pa'i sa mtho 'dir/ g.yang gzar che ba'i ri brag cha gter chen po'i rlabs kyi phreng ba ji bzhin gcig nas — ra gcig tu 'brel ba'i ri rgyud kyis gang ba'i khrod du/ kha char bu yug 'tshub pa dang sa mtho'i rlung dmar gogs rang byung khams chen po'i 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nyer 'tshe skyi g.ya' ba gang dang gang zhig la'ang ya nga dang bag tsha med par pha tsha bu rabs mi rgyud kyi phreng ba zam mi chad pas dpa' ngar gyi 'thab rtsod drag po mtha' gcig tu byas te rang gi pha yul 'dzugs skrun thog 'brog las dang / zhing las/ nags las/lag shes bzo las sogs thon skyed gsar spel gyi bya rim nang 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus thog ngo mtshar ches che bar bami'os pa'i lag rjes bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig bzhag yod par brten/ deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang gi yul skor ba sogs skye bo rgan gzhon pho mo su zhig rwapen rung /1

rang nyid sa mtho'i gnas mchog 'dir slebs pa tsam la'ang zad mi shes pa'i dga' spro dang spobs nyams tshad —medra skye zhing / yid smon dang ngo mtshar phan tshun 'gran pa bzhine du 4bsngags brjod kyi me tog sil ma ci dag—ra thor bzhin pa 4rtag tu dang re'i mthong thos kyi yāl du gyur dang 'gyur bzhin pa ni rnye mtsha/na med pa zhig ga la gin/ — de ltar mi 4lo khri stong du ma'i ring le rang yul cigasar gtod dang spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed dam 'tsho ba sogs phyogs gang thed nas 'aṅgal rgyas 'gro ba'i bya rim dus yun ha cang ring po de'i— nang / mi rigase rang nyide kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dmangs khrod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal rnam mnge phun sum tshogs pa ji snyed cig gsar skrun dang 'phel rgyas byung yod/ 'on kyang bar skabs mi lo brgya phrag 'ga' zhig —gi ring spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs dang bsam blo'i dbang sgyure gyi phyogs lhung sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshoges la brten nas bod kyi mi rigs 'di la rang brtsi rang bkur byed pa'i snying stobs rim bzhin je zhan du gyur stabs/ mi riges reng nyid kyi srol rgyun shes rig smyo rtsal rnams la skye bo tha mal dza'i spyode yul zhe4mthonge chung khyad gsod dang / 'gog gnon zur 'bud sogs nyams gud tshabs chen phog —yod na yang / rgya che'ishā dmangs mngatshogayotshos rang nor rang gces kyi la rgya ma bor bar rgyun 'dzin mtho' 'khyongs dang ngag thog gi brgyud sprod mi rabs nasi mi rabs la zam mi 'chad par byas stabs/ mtha' ma da lta'i bar du'ang phyogs gang ci'i thad srol rgyun bzang po ji snyed cig 'tshol zhib dang sngog 'don bya rgyu yod/ dper na nye ba'i lo shas 2

nang gong rim gyi mdzub ston gzhir bzung bod rang skyong ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs dang / ljongs rig gnas thing khongs bod kyi sgyu rtsal zhib 'jug khang so so nas 'tshol bsdu dang / phyogs sgrigayig sgyur/ dpe skrun bcas gnang dang gnang bzhin pa'i dmangs khrod kyi rig rtsal 〈〈phyogs bsdus chen po gsum 〉〉dang 〈〈phyogs bsdus chen po bdun 〉〉bcas gang zhig yin rung thams cad la bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan zhing / rang rang so so'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad gshis thun mong ma yin pa'i ngo mtshar gcig las gcig che ba sha stag yin la/ de dag tshang mar rang nyid kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i don snying dang rin thang ldan pa ni smos ci dgos/ 'on kyang kho bo rang gi phyogs re ba'i 'dod tshul ltar na de dag thams cad kyi khrod nas dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe 'di kho na ris su ma chad pa'i bod rigs 'dus sdod kyi sa khul yongs la dar khyab che zhing / spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon pa/ nang don phun sum tshogs la bsam blo'i rang bzhin gson nyams ldan pa/ sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad ha cang mtho ba sogs mdor na 'tshol sgrig dang zhib 'jug byed rin che shos yin pa lta bur mthong / spyi tshogs rig par zhib dpyad gnang mkhan gyi mkhas pa'i gsung las kyang / 66gtam dpe ni mi rnams kyi thon skyed dang / 'tsho ba/ spyi tshogs kyi 'brel gtugs sogs kyi nang rang byung khams dang spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul sna tshogs la blta zhib yun ring dang shes rtog gting zab byas pa'i tha snyad kyi spyi sdom zhig yin la/ de ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi shes rab kyi nying bcud dang 3

shes yon gyi gsog 'jog cig kyang yin/ de'i mtshon byed kyi rnam pani dmangs khrod kyi ngag thog rtsom rig gi khyab khongs su gtogs shing /nang don thad rig pa sna mang gi tshan rig rgyu cha tshud yod ’ ces thos pa'i bsdoms tshig 'di yang don la gnas pa zhig 'dug snyam/ gzhan yang bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe ni tshig nyung la don zab pa dang / go bde la gson shugs ldan pa/ spro ba rgyas la bzhad gad 'phel ba/ spyi tshogs kyi bya dngos phyogs gang thad nas mtshon thub pas bod rig pa zhib 'jug gi dpyad gzhi 'dzad mtha' med pa/ rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs yongs kyis nyan 'dod la shod dga' ba/ blo la nges sla zhing ngag nas 'don bde ba/ tshig rkang res don re ston cing blang 'dor 'byed thabs myur ba la sogs pa'i dge mtshan khyad chos brjod kyis mi lang ba ldan pas dngos 'brel gces su 'os pa'i srol rgyun gyi rig gnas shig yin/ der brten da phan 'brel yod tshan pa khag nas bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i thad la thugs 'khur ma bzhes pa min te gtam dpe phyogs sgrig gi deb 'ga' zhig snga rjes su dpe skrun 'grems spel gnang yod pa ma zad/ bod yig gi dus deb khag cig dang tshags par sogs kyi thog tu'ang dum bu mang po 'don spel gnang bzhin pa rtag tu mthong rgyu yod pa sogs las mtshon thub/ 'on kyang de dag phal che ba gcig nas bskyar bskor yang bskor gyi zlos skyon mang ba dang / gnyis nas legs bshad khag gam/ yang na 〈〈kha che pha lu'i bslab bya〉〉〈〈rdza tsig gtam rgyud 〉〉dang 〈〈bya sprel gtam rgyud 〉〉〈〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉〉4

la sogs pa mkhas pa'i gsung rtsom dang / phyogs sgrig dpe skrun zin pa'i yig rigs nang 'khod pa'i tshig dum mam/ de min gtam dpe ma yin pa'i gzhas tshig sogs kyang gang 'tsham mnyam du 'dres 'dug pa de dag bsdu 'god gnang ba'i kun slong dang 'bad rtsol sogs bzang na yang / 'di rigs kyis dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i dwangs gtsang rang bzhin la bsres lhad zhugs te nam zhig bza' 'phro 'thung 'phro yod tshad mnyam 'dres kyis phag lto lta bu zhig chags mi srid dam/ gal te de ltar gyur tshe sngon byon pha mes kyi shul bzhag gces nor gzhan dring mi 'jog pa 'di lta bu rang re rjes rabs pa tsho'i lag pas/ ‘6dkon gnyer phyi dar mkhas na/ gser sku rag la btang yong ’ zhes pa'i dpe bzhin du 'gyur ba'ang srid snyam pa zhib mo'i blos dpyod par 'os so/ /de yang sngar gyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe da phan yig thog tu ma 'khyol ba tshig gcig yin rung don gnyer chen pos 'tshol bsdu bya rgyu ni dus nam yin yang gal ha cang che ba smos ma dgos mod/ 'on kyang bod du gtam dpe 'tshol sgrig gi bya gzhag 'go tshugs pa nas da bar mi lo bcu phrag gsum tsam song zin pas da lta'i char gtso bo'i las 'gan ni gtam dpe 'tshol bsdu dang phyogs sgrig bgyis rigs la zhib bsher zhu dag dang /lhag par gtam dpe re re bzhin gyi tshig don la dgos nges kyi 'grel bshad mdor bsdus re'am/ yang na so sor bed spyod bya yul dang byed stangs/ lo rgyus sam gtam rgyud dang 'brel yod gtam dpe'i rigs la 'byung khungs dang bshad tshul ji ltar yod pa la sogs pa'i 'grel 5

bshad gang nus bcas cung zad brgyud rim ldan pa zhig gsar rtsom bya dgos pa de ni nar 'gyangs byed thabs med pa'i bya ba kha tsha dgos gtugs shig yin snyam/ gang lags zhe na deng skabs bod rig par zhib 'jug gi bya gzhag de rgyal yongs dang 'dzam gling yul phyogs kun la khyab gdal du 'gro ba'i skabs 'dir rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i mkhas pa mang pos bod kyi dmangs srol rig gnas khag la 'tshol zhib dang / shes rtogs bya rgyur do snang ha cang chen po gnang gi yod/ des na satam dpe lta bur cha mtshon na thog mar khong tshos dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i tshig don rags pa tsam dang / ma mthar yang shes dgos nges kyi 'brel yod gnas lugs tsam gsal rtogs ma thub na de'i don snying dang / khyad nus/ sgyu rtsal sogs shes thabs ma mchis pa ni smos ci dgos/ de bas kyang ya mtshan la yid mug pa zhig ni deng sang gi bod rigs gzhon skyes mang pos rang rigs kyi gtam dpe go mi thub pa'am/ la las shod shes kyang don mi rtogs pa/ la las don shes na yang tshig 'grel rgyag mi thub pa/ tha na dpe don phyin ci log tu spyod pa sogs rtag par mthong thos mi nyung ba zhig 'phrad bzhin pa de yin/ dus mtshungs lo rgyus sam gtam rgyud sogs las 'phros pa'i rgyun spyod gtam dpe'i rigs kyi 'byung khungs dang byung tshul sogs ni rang rigs dar ba'i khrod du'ang gsung rgyu yod pa u dum wa ra'i me tog gi spun zlar 'khums/ gzhi rkang yun ring khyab gdal du gnas pa'i dmangs khrod kyi gtam dper 'grel bshad byed pa la rig gzhung gi 6

myatshad sogs cha rkyen mtho po miyang mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong dang cha rgyus gang 'tsham yod pa'i mi rgan de rigs ni dgun rlung bser bus ded pa'i shing lo ji bzhin gang sar lo re nas lo re lhag med du gyur dang 'gyur bzhin pa las/ sus kyang sgug sdod mi byed pa mthong gsal bcas dgos pa dang rgyu matsan de dag la brten nas kho bos 'dir bod rigs dmangs khrod kyi gtam mdzod thog ma'i deb chung 'di nyid ma 'ongs par rtsa ba tshugs nas lo 'dab rgyas pa dang /me tog phyogs brgyar bzhad nas 'bras bu g.yur za'i sa bon tsam du 'gyur res rtsom 'go btsugs pa lags so/ /7

gtamadape dang 'brelayod kyi 'belagatam 'ga' zhig dang po/ gtam dpe'i tha snyad chags tshul sogs kyi skor/ de yang bod dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe ni ches gna' rabs gdod ma'i dus skabs nas skad brda 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i bya rim ring po'i nang rim bzhin dar 'phel byung ba zhig yin pa gzhir bcas kyang / de la da phan mi lo chig stong lhag gi gong rol du ‘6gtam dpe zhes 'bod pa'i tha snyad 'di da dung byung med par mngon te/ rang rgyal gyi tun hong sa phug nas thon pa'i gna' bo'i bod kyi yig rnying khongs 2 la 1283 phu bos nu bor gdams pa'i bslab bya de'i nang gses don tshan zhe dgu par/66gtam rnying pa dag la yang / nyes pa'i lan legs pas/ glon ba yod gyi/ legs pa'i lan nyes pas glan ba ni/ yongs gyis mya'i srid do zhes dang / don tshan bdun cu par/ 66 gtam rnying pa dag las/ bu gcig bdog na/ gachigi nor gyis phyugs/ gnyis bdog na gnyis gyi nor gyis phyug ches bya'o/ ’ zhes dang / yang don tshan bdun cu don gsum nang / ‘6 gtam rnying pa dag las yid la dran pa las gyang / legs par smras na/ kha ni dpal gyi sgo mo'o/lce ni 'phrul gyi lde myig ches bya'o/ nyes par smras na/ kha ni byur gyi sgo 1

mo/ lce ni bdud gyi ste re zhes bya zhes byang grag go (1)zhes lan gcig tsam ma yin par yang yang 'byung ba la dpags na/ skabs de tsam la'ang ‘6gtam rnying pa ’’zhes 'bod pa gsal por mtshon pa dang /de'i tshig sbyor rnams go bde bar bsgyur na rim bzhin 'di ltar te/⑦ sngar gyi bshad srol la yang / ngan lan bzang gis 'jal mkhan ni yod pa las/ bzang lan ngan gyis 'jal mkhan ni yongs su mi srid do zhes dang / ① snger gyi bshad srol las/ bu gcig yod na mi skal gcig gis phyag gnyis yod na mi skal gnyis kyis phyag ces zer ro //re/ ra pa //bye/ /dro// //// /sde/dro ra pa gas dang / (kye sngar — bshad —la la sa pa las kyang / skad cha shod mkhas pa'i kha de ni dpal yon thams cad 'byung ba'i sgo yin la/lce ni dpal yon gyi sgo brgya 'byed pa'i 'phrul gyi lde mig yin/ skad cha shod mi mkhas pa'i kha ni byur dang chag sgo 'byung ba'i sgo dang / lce ni legs tshogs gcod byed bdud kyi sta re yin zer ba yang thos so zhes pa lta bu'o/ /skabs de'i gtam dpe'i tshig sbyor byed stangs la dpyad na gong ma gnyis ni brjod don thad kur ston pa yin pas go sla zhing /'og ma ni gzugs su 'god pa'i sgyu rtsal longs su spyad yod/ brjod don thad snga ma ni mi dngu mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba byed stangs te bod mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i kun spyod bzang po mtshon pa'i bslab bya ( 1 ) ‘ tun hong nas thon pa'i gna' bo'i bod yig shog dril 'phro maṭwāṃd ’ 2 la 1283

dang / dkyil ma ni skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi thon rdzas bgo bsha'i lam lugs dang 'brel ba yod pa'am/ yang na thon skyed nus shug sa gtso bor smra ba'i mtshon byed tsam yin srid cing / mjug ma de ni skad cha shod mkhas dang mi mkhas kyi dge skyon de bya ba thams cad 'grub thub dang mi thub kyi rag las sa lta bu yin par bstan pa rtogs sla ba bcas las kyang / bod kyi gtam dpe ni spu rgyal btsan po'i dus rabs nas brjod don gyi zab tshad dang / tshig sbyor gyi sgyu rtsal gang thad nas chu tshad mtho tsam du son yod pa gang legs mtshon gyin yod/'o na gtam dpe bya ba'i tha snyad de nges gtan gyi dus rabs 'di la byung zhes kha tshon gcod mi thub mod/ 'on kyang 'dzam gling na ring shos su grags pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus snyan ngag 〈〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉〉glu'i nang / 64gna' mi'i bod kyi gtaXm daXpe la/ mamazhesapa yang yang khyab gdal du 'byung ba la phyir bsam gzhig byed skabs gtam dpe zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di ni ma mthar yang bod sil bu kha thor gyi dus 'go tsam nas byung ngam snyam pa ni re zhig thog ma'i dpyad gzhi tsam lags na da dung mu mthud nas zhib dpyad yong ba zhu/ da ni gtam dpe zhes pa'i ming tshig 'di rang gi go don la cung zad dpyad na/gtam zhes pa ni yig skad ltar na brjod pa dang spyir btang kha skad la skad cha zer ba'i go don dang mtshungs pa rtogs sla yang / gtam rgyud dam/ gtam bshad/ 'bel gtam mam/ bsgrags gtam/rgol gtam/ dpyad gtam sogs tshig grogs dang sbyar skabs rgyun 3

ldan gyi skad cha tsam ma yin par cung brgyud rim ldan la/ spus tshad legs pa'am/ yang na shugs drag dang dza drag che ba lta bu'i brjod pa khyad par ba zhig yin pa'i tshor snang ster srid pa lta bu yin/ ‘8dpe zhes bya ba 'di la go don 'ga' zhig mchis te dngos po'i gzugs dbyibs sam/ tshad gzhi sogs mtshon byed kyi ming la 'jug pa ste dpe dbyibs dang / dpe ris/ dpe tshad ces pa lta bu dang / yang rtser son nam phul du byung ba'i don la'ang 'jug ste dper 'os dang /dper 'pher ba/ dpe bzang / mig dpe/ yig dpe la sogs pa lta bu/ de bzhin 'dra ba'i don te 'dra dpe dang / mtshungs dpe zhes pa lta bu 'jug yul mang / gtam dpe zhes par 〈〈dag yig gsar bsgrigs 〉〉nang / ‘6gtam dpe ni dpe la sbyar nas don ston pa'i tshig sbyor gyi rnam pa zhig gi ming ’ zhes gsal yang / zhib tu dpyad na de tsam gyi khongs su bsdu mi thub par gong gsal rtser son nam phul du byung ba'i don la'ang 'jug pa dper na mig dpe dang / yig dpe'i go don ltar gtam gyi dper 'os pa bya ba lta bu'ang snon dgos pa 'dug gang lags zhe na gong du tun hong yig rnying las drangs pa'i gna' rabs kyi gtam dpe snga ma gnyis ni brjod bya'i don thad kur bstan pa kho na las/dpe dang don gyi rnam dbye 'byed rgyu med la deng skabs dmangs khrod du gang sar spyod bzhin pa'i gtam dpe'i khongs su'ang tshig sbyor 'os shing 'tshams pa'i sgo nas brjod don thad par ston pa'i gtam dpe 'di rigs mi nyung ba zhig mchis pabacas mdor na gtam dpe zhes pa'i tha 4

snyad 'di la dpe kho nas don shugs la ston pa dang / dpe don zung du sbrel nas ston pa/ tshig sbyor gzhan dring mi 'jog pas brjod don thad kur ston pa ste gtam gyi dper 'os pa bcas kyi go don 'dus yod pa zhig tu ngos 'dzin byas na legs pa shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ bod kyi gtam dpe'i khud chos dang / sgyu rtsal sogs kyi dbe mchon 'ga' zhig skor/ 1 gtam dpe mang che ba zhig tshig mjug 'phro can du 'jog srol yod pa de ni brjod don gang zhig drang phyogs sam/ yang na ldog phyogs/ de bzhin 'das/ ma 'ongs/ da lta dus gsum sogs gang la spyod dgos pa skabs bstun ci 'dra zhig la bsgyur na'ang chog pa yin pas bem por gyur pa'i tshig rengs po de 'dra ma yin par gson nyams ldan la/ skye stobs kyi dpal yon 'bar ba zhig chags thub pa ste dper na/ 44skyid kyi nyi ma shar dus/sdug gi mun pa sangs dus ’ zhes pa lta bur cha bzhag na tshig mjug so sor ‘6yod ’ 66med ’ ru byung ma byung ’ ‘ 'dug ’ 66mi 'dug ’ ‘4yong ’ ‘6mi yong ’ zhes pa gang rung re sbyar skabs go don mi 'dra ba re'am/ yang na rtsa ba nas go ldog pa re/ de yang dus gsum ma 'dres pa so sor 'byed nus pa'i go don gsal po re 'char rgyu yod pa 'di ni bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ngo mtshar ldan pa zhig yin la/ bod kyi gtam dpe'i spyod yul shes rtogs dang / bed spyod byed stangs/ zhib 'jug bcas bya rgyur med thabs med pa'i shes bya zhig kyang yin/5

2 sems gting gi skad cha 'ga' zhig thad kur dmar rjen du brjod mi bde ba rnams gtam dpe spyad de bshad na sus nyan yang mi mdzes pa med cing / go don legs par 'phrod thub pa dper na bod rnying par gyod gzhi kha mchu gtugs skabs zhib dpyod pa'am khrims dpon sar lkog rngan gya nom pa zhig skyel dgos shing / skabs der kha gtad phyogs la pham nyes gang che zhig phog thabs dang nga la khe dang rgyal kha gang mang 'thob thabs shig dgos zhes dmar rjen du brjod shes thabs med la/ gal te de ltar bshad na khrims dpon gyis khas len byed bde po mi yong bar brten gyod gzhi'i don gnad thog la 6 chu dma' thabs dang / zam pa mtho thabs ’ gnang rgyu gang yod skyabs 'jug yong ba zhes brjod pa tsam gyis bsam don gang yin pa de brjod yul gyi blo la bde blag ngang khra lham mer 'char thub pa ma zad/ gang drag byas chog ces lan yang rgyag bde po yong ba lta bu sogs gtam dpe'i sgyu rtsal 'di rigs ni dngos 'brel gzhan gyis tshab byed mi thub pa zhig yin no/ /3 bod kyi gtam dpe'i sgyu rtsal gal che ba gzhan zhig ni thos pa tsam gyis mi rnams gad mo dbang med shor ba'am/ yang na ther 'don bya yul la zur za gnad du phig pa zhig bya rgyu zung 'brel byed pa brgyud dpe don bsdur nas bsam blo ji tsam btang ba de tsam gyis gad mo gting nas 'chor ba ma zad/ brjod don de la bsam gyin go ba zab mo lon du 'jug la/ gtam dpe de rigs yang yang ngag nas 'don 6

zhing rang shugs kyis blo la nges thub pa zhig bzo rgyu de yin/ dper na bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs grub mtha' 'dra min sna tshogs kyis rang lugs kyi cho ga 'di dang de bya rgyu zhes kha g.yar te sgo phyugs kyi srog gcod pa sogs don dam sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgongs pa dang tag tag rgyab 'gal gyis rgyas za rgyas 'thung byed mkhan mang po yod pa de rigs la dmigs nas 4‘ches bcu re la ra re bsad/ zangs tog dpal ri ra ros bskyangs ’ zer ba lta bu dang / yang dper na/ rgyal po'i bka' khrims nor gyis bshig sgom chen phyag rgya shig gis bshig’ ces dpe sgom chen pas lus drang bsrangs te mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya dang bcas chos che mdog byed na yang / rang lus shig gis zos nas sdug sgom ma thub par rang dbang med par sgul sgul shig shig gis phyag rgya zhig 'gro ba zhes dgod bro ba'i dpe gzugs can lta bu zhig nye bar bkod thog de bzhin du don drang bzhag tshul ldan yin lugs kyi dril bsgrags gang sar byed pa'i rgyal khab kyi bka' khrims de yang / rngam mtho ba'i dngul dang rgyu nor gyi lkog rngan mdun du rang tshugs yongs rdzogs lhag ma med par shor nas dkar nag gam bden rdzun thams cad rbad de phyin ci log pa zhig bzo yi 'dug zer ba lta bu ste dpe la blta bzhin don la bsam dus lkog rngan blangs nas khrims kyog gcod mkhan gyi mi de tsho'i skyugs bro ba'i spyod tshul la zur za nan po ci 'dra zhig byas mi 'dug gam/ de dang de 'dra brjod kyis mi lang bas dpe mtshon tsam yin/7

4 gtam dpe mi nyung ba zhig gi tshig don gang gi cha la dpyad kyang / bod mi dmangs ni gna' dus nas bzung bab chags pa'i tshan rig gi lta stangs sam spyod tshul ldan pa'i phul byung gi mi rigs shig yin pa gang legs mtshon gyin yod/ dper na sna dus la babs na/ sha mos spang rtol ’ zhes pa des bya dngos gang yang rung ste de nyid mngon du 'gyur ba ni mi rnams kyi re 'dod la rag mi lus par phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen 'dzoms shing smin pa'i dus la babs dang ma babs la bltos dgos par bstan cing / bya ba la la cha rkyen ma smin na ngang thung 'tshab 'tshub ji ltar byas kyang 'grub mi srid pa dang / gal te rten cing 'brel 'byung gi rgyu rkyen tshang ba'i dus la babs na sha mo ste ser sha'i myu gu phra la mnyen pa 'di lta bus kyang spang rtsis bsdams pa'i spang sa mkhregs po bde blag ngang rtol nus pa la ltos zhes dpe dngos su bstan te/ bya dngos kyi chos nyid khong du chud pa gal che bar gdams pa lta bu dang / yang bya ba gang zhig legs par sgrub dgos na tshan rig gi spyod tshul te lag len dngos kyi nang rang nyid ngo ma zhugs nas shes rtogs bya dgos par bstan/dper na / chu phyed ka brgal na/ ha phyed ka go ’ zhes pa'i gtam dpe 'dis dkal ngal dang rnyog 'dzings che ba'i bya ba gang zhig thag gcod byed pa la bab col gyi long gtam bshad tsam byas pas mi 'thus par/bya ba de rang gi lag len nang dngos su gzhug dgos shing / bya dngos kyi lag len la ji tsam zhugs na gzhi nas bya ba de'i cha rgyus de tsam zhig lon thub ces bstan pa 'di ni/ 66ma'o kru'u zhis ‘stag tshang nang du ma 8

'dzul bar stag phrug 'dzin mi thub ཿ ces pa'am/ ca yang ‘6shigatog li sgyur bkod bya bsam na li za dgos ’’zhes gsungasaspu'i dgongs don dang kun nas mthun pas tshan rig gi chod gtam zhigatu brtsi chog pa mi 'dug gam/ de bzhin gtam dpe— mang po zhig gis spyi tshogs thog bya ba bzang ngan gang dang gang phrad na'ang/ pha rol kha gtad phyogs kyi byed bab dang bstun nas gang la de 'tsham gyi ya lan 'jal thabs shes dgos zhes bab chags pa'i tshan rig gi spyod tshul 'dzin stangs slob ston byed kyin yod pa ste/ dper na 4 chu mo'i 'gros dang bstun nas/ ko skya rgyag lugs ’ zhes pa'am/ yang na lha rnga chigs la dpags pa'i 'cham chigs ’ de mtshungs ‘6yo lo dang / gos chung tshad kyin tshad kyin ’’zer ba lta bu la sogs go bde la spyod go chod pa'i gtam dpe 'di rigs kyang mi nyung ba zhig rnyed rgyu yod pa bcas 'dir dpe mtshon tsam drangs pa lags so/ / bya dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i nang spyi tshogs kun spyod kyi blang dor bshad pa ha cang mang zhing / de yang bod mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i kun spyod kyi nang don gtso bo ni drang bden dang / ngo tsha/khrel gzhung / bag yod ldan pa sogs yin te dper na 4 mi drang dgos/lha mtshar dgos ’ zhes pa lta bur cha mtshon na/ smra shes la don go ba'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid ang dang po de ni yul dus gnas skabs ci 'dra zhig yin na'ang drang bden 'gyur ba med pa zhig dgos pa de bsam spyod mtha' dag gi gzhi 'dzin sa yin par bstan pa dang /9

dus mtshungs ldog phyogs nas 6 mi ngan gyi khog pa g.yos khengs/ dung dkar gyi khog pa 'bus khengs zhes drang bden ma yin par khram dang g.yo sgyus 'tsho ba'i mi ngan ni ches tha shal mthar lhung zhig yin par skyugs bro ba'i dpe dang bcas smad pa lta bu'o/ / ngo tsha ni kun spyod kyi rtsa ba gzhan zhig yin la gal te de dang bral na ni mi khyur mi tshukhu par brtsi ba ste dper na sna mi la ngo tsha med na khyi yin/ khyi la gzhu gu med na 'dre yin ’ zhes de bas thabs rdugs pa dang rkang 'dren gzhan med par bstan pa ma zad/ spyod tshul de lta bu dang ldan pa'i mi ni rang gi gnyen nye yin na yang dgra bo las kyang ngan par brtsi ba ste dper na 46gdong pa khrag medakyi gnyen las/ ngo tsha khrel yod kyi dgra dga' ’ zhes grags pa las gsal por mtshon zhing / drang po ma yin pa dang ngo tsha khrel gzhung bral ba'i bag med kyi spyod ngan de lta bu byed pa las/ rang srog phangs med du 'dor ba 'os shing rigs par gdams pa ni dper na/ 64khrel med gson pa las/ bag yod shi ba dga' ’ zhes sgam nan gyi tha tshig drag po bsgrags yod pa ma zad/ mi tshe gcig la rang gi kun spyod kyi grags pa bzang ngan ci 'dra zhig 'jog pa de ni rang nyid 'chi gson las kyang gal 'gangs che bar brtsi dgos tshul bstan pa dper na sna ro sa 'og tu song yang / gtam sa steng ’ zhes sam/ yang 64mi che las/gtam che ring ’ zhes pa la sogs pa lta bu yin/ gzhan yang mi chos kyi zhib phra'i lag len byed stangs kyi thad dper na gzhan sdug la snying tshim bya mi rung zer ba lta bur cha mtshon na 44snga ma kha brdabs par/ mjug 10

ma dgod ma shor ’ zhes pa'am/ yang na sna ril ril rbab la shor bar/'jong 'jong ltad mo ma blta ’ zer ba lta bu dang / da dung mi gzhan la jus nyes yong dus gdung sems mnyam skye'i rnam 'gyur nges par du 'dzin dgos par bskul ba ste dper na 44grong pa'i ba shi yang / mya ngan zhag gsum ’ zhes pa lta bu/ da dung dus —rtag tu rang nyid la nan po dang mi gzhan la gu yang bya rgyu 'di yang kun spyod bzang po 'dzin skyong byed thub pa'i rgyu rkyen gal chen po zhig yin par gdams pa dper na ‘ mi 'jam pos 'dul/ rang rtsub pos 'dul ’ zhes pa las mtshon thub pa sogs 'jig rten kun spyod kyi phyogs gang ci'i slob gso bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig mchis pa las/ 'dir gang dran pa nyung shas dpe mtshon du drangs pa 'di tsam zhig khong du chud na'ang bod mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sems khams dang / gshis lugs kyi spyir btang khyad chos rags pa tsam shes rtogs bya rgyur phan pa cung zad 'byung srid snyam zhing / gzhan du dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i dge mtshan dang khyad nus cha tshang ba ni rmongs rgan bdag lta bus brjod pa ltar bzhagabasam yul du'ang 'gyur mi nus pas re zhig 'di tsam gyis chog par byas shing / gsham du le tshan so so'i nang gtam dpe re re bzhin gyi rtsa 'grel la rtog zhib gnang na'ang blo skyed gsar pa mi nyung ba zhig 'phel thub nges lags so/ /gsum pa/ bod kyi gtam dpe'i nang do snang dang dbye zhib dgos pa'i don gnad 'ga' zhig 1 dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe'i 11

khrod du de snga'i dbang bsgyur ru tshogs kyis ngal rtsol mang tshogs la mthong chung dang brnyas ba cos byed phyir spyod pa'i dpe ngan nyung shas shig kyang mnyam du 'dres yod/ dper na sna‘'brog pa mi'i bong bu yin/ ral pa khyi'i gzhu gu yin zer ba de'i thog nas bod rnying par dbang 'dzin pas rgya che'i ngal rtsol 'brog dmangs la dud 'gro lta bu'i lta stangs dngos su 'dzin gyin yod pa'i ra sprod ngar lcags lta bu zhig yin pa dang / de bzhin sa gnas srid gzhung rnying pa'i dpon rigs tshos mdo khams kyi skye bo rnams la dgra bor gnya' mi sgur ba'i gshis rgyud cig yod par brten de la sna khams pa'i rna 'byog rkung na yod ’ ces yin lugs kyi rgyu mtshan mi shod par lcag btsan kho na bed spyad nas 'dul dgos zhes mi gzhan la ngan slob rgyag pa sogs kyi dpe ngan 'di rigs la rgyu mtshan 'dren pa'i sgo nas dgag pa brgyab ste lam lugs rnying pa'i ngo bo de dag mi rabs rjes ma tshor shes su 'jug dgos pa dang / de min bod kyi lo rgyus thog sa khul bcad bzung gis dbang bsgyur byas pa'i shul ngan gyi rjes 'bras las sa khul bye brag pa'i yul mir dma' 'bebs rang bzhin ldan pa'i gtam dpe yang nyung shas tsam lhag yod de dper na sna 'phan po shig gzan pa ’nyadang 6 snye mo sbang gzan pa ’ zer ba lta bu dang / yang sna‘mi sbo kha ba dang / bya skra (skya ) kag zer ba/ ‘‘rong pa'i mi la/tshad pa'i g.ya' ’ zer ba lta bu la sogs pa bden don ci yang med par mi dmangs mang tshogs nang khul gyi mthun sgril la mi phan pa'i gtam dpe de rigs la'ang mtha' dpyod dang 'brel spang bya brtsi 'os pa sogs 12

mdor na srol rgyun gyi rig rtsal gzhan dag dang 'dra bar dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe la yang snyigs 'dor bcud len bya 'os pa ni smos ma dgos shing / 'on kyang gtam dpe mang po zhig ni nang don brjes te deng rabs kyi spyi tshogs dang mthun par bed spyod bgyis na phan nus chen po ldan pa dang / yang la la ni spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs rnying pa de'i nag nyes dang mun nag gi ngo bo ther 'don dang 'brel mi rabs rjes mar ldog phyogs kyi slob gso gtong rgyur phan nus yod pa sogs mu mthud dbye 'byed dang zhib 'jug dgos pa'i khyad par yang shes par bya'o/ /2 yul skad kyi he bag nges can yod pa/ dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe mang che shos ni bod rigs tshang mas go thub pa gzhir bcas mod/ 'on kyang lo rgyus thog rang re'i mi rigs 'di la dar rgud kyi dus mtshams mang po zhig byung ba sogs rgyu rkye na sna tshogs la brten nas sa khul bye brag pa so so'i yul skad kyi shan che tsam zhugs pa'i gtam dpe la la yas mas rgyang ring gi sa cha gzhan zhig tu slebs dus tshig don go dka' ba'ang yong gan yod de/ dper na a mdo khul gyi gtam dpe 66brag them pa'i skas la 'gos kha sla yang / 'bab kha dka' ’ zer ba dang / 8 bong skya lin zhon nas/ stod dbus lam gcod pa ’ zhes pa/sna a krab la yab skud dang / phying ba la rdog pa ’ zer ba lta bu sogs 'di rigs dbus gtsang zhing grong gi mang tshogs tshos lam seng ci zer go dka' bas brjod don ni de bas kyang rtogs mi thub pa smos ci dgos/de dang yongs su 'dra bar dbus gtsang khul gyi yul skad shas cher 'dres 13

pa'i gtam dpe khag cig kyang a mdo'i 'brog khul du go dka' ba ni brjod ga la dgos/ gal te de rigs yig skad la nye bar phab na bod rigs phal che bas go thub par 'gyur srid de dper na gong gsal a mdo'i yul skad kyi gtam dpe gsum po rim bzhin 'di ltar/ sna brag gzar mo'i them skas la 'dzegs pa sla yang / 'bab pa dka' 7zhes dang / 4 bong rkyang dkar bzhon nas/ stod dbus gtsang bskor rgyu ’ che a krad kyis skud pa dang / phying pas rdog pa ’ bcas zer rgyu e yin/ bdag gis go ba len stangs nor med tshe 'di bzhin bris na ha lam bod mi tshang mas tshig don ma log par go thub bam snyam/3 gtam dpe la la ni yul goms kyi dbang gis tshig sdud ha cang che drags pas sa phyogs gzhan gyi mis nyan na tshig don gang thad nas go dka' ba de 'dra'ang yod de dper na khams khul gyi gtam dpe sna kha rma gso mede/ lag rma gso yod mi ces pa lta bu ngag thog nas brjod skabs cha rgyus med pa'i mis go dka' mo yin/ de la 'bru 'grel zhig byas na khaX nas tshig mtshon btab pas sems la phog pa'i rmaX de nam yang gaXso rgyu meXd/ laXg pas mtshon cha 'phangs pa'i lus kyi rmaX de dus nges can nang gaXso rgyu yoXd ces bshad tshe kun gyis tshig don gnyis ka gsal po go thub/de bzhin dbus gtsang khul du grags pa'i sna bya sha sen bgos mi zer ba'i gtam dpe de'ang cha rgyus med pa'i mi la bshad na go shin tu dka'/don ni bod rnying par khyim tshang nyams rgud du gyur nas gang sar bu lon chags te 'jal thabs med par gyar skabs srid gzhung la bde sdug snyan 14

zhu phul thog phyi nor nang rdzas gang na ci yod sbas skung med pa mna' dpang dang bcas spyi thog spungs te de nas bun 'bor che chung la dpags pa'i cha bgos kyis sprad de bu lon dag thabs yong ba zhes zhus par chog mchan thob na/ de ltar bya rgyur bun bdag tshos kyang ma nyan thabs med kyi srol lugs de rigs kyi ming la ‘6bya sha sen bgos su grags/ tshig 'grel ni kho pa'i dpal 'byor gyi lhag 'phro nyung zad byaX byi'u'i shu tsam las med pa de gris bcad nas bgo rin med pas seXn mos btog nas bgoXs pa lta bu dper bzhag bas tha snyad de ltar chags pa yin no/gzhan yang gtam dpe la lar yul bye brag pa'i nang gi sa ming ngam yul ming sogs bshad pa de rigs sa khul de rang gi nye 'khor du ma gtogs/sa khad rgyang sar cha rgyus med pas tshig don cha tshang ba rtogs mi thub dper na dbus gtsang gi gtam dpe 6 phu gang nas bskor kyang /mda' gling burdzong nya zhes dang / sna mus la 'gro mi dgos/ / mdog lha dbang rtse nas mthong ’ zer ba lta bu 'di rigs mdo stod smad khul sogs su thos skabs zhib phra'i gnas lugs gsal po shes mi thub pa bzhin gtam dpe de gras khungs so so'i nang 'grel bshad mdor bsdus re bgyis yod pas 'dir bskyar bshad ma dgos mod/ gong smos de dag gi thog nas bod kyi gtam dpe la yongs khyab kyi 'grel bshad re med thabs med pa'i gsal bshad byed thub/ lhag par du yul skad mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gyis gtam dpe 'ga' shatha cha rgyus ma lon na skabs re tshig gcig gis go ba chen po lokho 'gro ba'ang yod de/ dper na 15

dbus gtsang khul ‘6drin lan loXg 'jal ’ zer na pha ma rgan khogs sogs la bu tshas kha lan slog pa dang / sdug sbyong gtong ba/ phyir 'bud byed pa sogs bzang lan ngan 'jal lta bur spyod pa yin mod/'on kyang khams khul yul gru la lar sna drin lan loXg 'jal zhu chog pa ’ zhes brjod srol yod pa'i go don ni sku drin gyi lan ldab log gsab ༷ 'jal zhu rgyu yin zer ba yin rung / de rgyus mnga' med pa'i dbus gtsang gi mi zhig la bshad na ya mtshan po ci 'dra yong ba mi 'dug gam/mdor na bod rigs nang khul du'ang yul skad dang goms srol mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis gtam dpe la phan tshun go mi thub pa'am/ go mi bde ba/ tha na go log thebs pa sogs kyi gnad don yang yong srid pas de rigs la do snang dang dbye zhib bya dgos pa'i gnad cig kyang yod do/ /4 tshig gi gcod mtshams la do snang chen po bya dgos pa/ spyir na bod kyi skad yig gang la mtshon na'ang gcod mtshams mi nor ba gal che zhing / khyad par dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe la tshig gi gcod mtshams yang dag par shes pa bya rgyu ni de bas kyang shin tu gal che ba zhig yin/ gcod mtshams 'khrugs na gtam dpe 'ga' zhig gi brjod don rbad de phyin ci log tu 'gyur 'gro ba ste dper na 66gsang ba la rang mkhas kyang / brjod pa la mi mkhas ’ zhes pa lta bur tshig mtha' ma gnyis gcod mtshams nor te sna mi mkhas mi’zhes gcig tu sbrel na mkhas pa de mi mkhas par ga phyi tag tag log 'gro ba lta bu 'di 'dra mang du yod/ yang gcod mtshams 'khrugs na gtam dpe la la go 16

don mi 'dra ba gzhan zhig tu 'gyur ba'ang yod de dper na ‘‘pha ma shi na bu mi 'tshar ’ zhes pa 'di'i go don dngos ni/ skyes pa phos sgrub dgos pa'i khyim don gyi bya ba thams cad pha yis byed par brten rang gi bu chen po chags na yang / skyes pa pho'i bya gzhag ci yang mi shes pas na 'tshar longs ma byung ba dang 'dra'o zer ba yin mod/ gal te tshig gi gcod mtshams nor te sna pha ma shi na/ bu mi 'tshar ’ zhes brjod pa yin tshe pha ma gnyis ka shi na/ gso skyong ji bzhin byed mkhan med stabs bu chung 'tshar longs 'ong mi thub zer ba lta bu go don rbad de tha dad 'gyur 'gro ba de ni te bag chen po gang 'dra mi 'dug gam/yang gtam dpe mang po zhig la cha mtshon na tshig gi gcod mtshams nor ba tsam gyis brjod don kha rgyu go rgyu med pa chags 'gro ba dper na sna 'gyings che na seng ge gan rkyal log ’ zer ba 'di gal te gcod mtshams ma 'grigs par lha 'gyings che na seng ge gan rkyal log ’nyazer ba lta bu'am/ yang na 6‘yun ring na snal mas lcags gcod ’ ces par 6 yun ring na snal mas lcags gcod nya ces pa lta bu sogs nor sla ba'i rigs 'di ni de bas mang ba bcas dpe mtshon tsam bstan pa ltar gtam dpe klog pa'am shod pa gang gi skabs su'ang tshig cha ya dang / skad gdangs kyi 'degs 'jog ngal gso ba'i mtshams sogs nan tan dang re re bzhin yang dag par shes dgos pa 'di ni tshegs chung la rtogs sla zhing / shes na don che ba'i man ngag lta bu zhig lags so/ /17

bzhi pa/ gtam mdzod 'di nyid rtsom sgrig byed phyogs skor gyi gsal bshad/ 1 da phan bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe snga rjes su phyogs sgrig byas pa'i deb 'ga' shas dang / de min 'brel yod dus deb dang tshags par sogs kyi thog 'khod pa'i dum bu lag tu gang son byung ba bcas nang gtam dpe sna grangs khyon bsdoms chig khri yas mas tsam zhig gi khongs nas bod dmangs khrod rang gi gtam dpe yin snyam pa rnams bdams gses byas pa'i thog rang nyid kyi blo ngor nges pa dran rigs kyis kha skong dang bcas gtam dpe grangs chig stong drug brgya skor zhig zur bkol byas shing / de yang dmangs khrod kyi gtam dper song skabs yul phyogs so sor dngos su spyod skabs yul skad kyi shan zhugs rkyen rtsa ba gtam dpe gcig la'ang zhib cha'i shod stangs cung mi 'dra ba kha shas mchis pa rnams spyir btang yongs khyab gang che ba gzhir bzung yig srol dang mthun gang thub byas te bkod pa dang / yang yul gru bye brag par dar srol che ba'i gtam dpe'i rigs sa phyogs so so'i rang rtags mtshon ched yul skad kyi shod stangs 'ga' zhig sor bzhag bgyis pa ma zad/ gsham du gug rtags nang sa khul mi 'dra ba de dang de'i tha snyad kyang bkod yod cing / spyir na gtam dpe tshig 'grel dgos nges snyam pa'i rigs la tshig 'grel lam yang na zur mchan 'god gang thub dang / rtsa ba'i gtam dpe mi re ngo rer don 'grel lam yang na mi dang bya dngos sogs gang dang gang la yul dus gnas skabs ci dang ci 'dra zhig tu ji ltar bed spyod byed dgos sogs rang blos gang lcogs kyi gsal 18

bshad regs bsdus tsam re bcas bkod yod/ 'on kyang 'di ni gtam dpe'i sna grangs dang tshig don 'grel bshad sogs gang gi thad nas bltas na'ang ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po las chu thigs gcig tsam gyi thog ma'i dpe mtshon 'ba' zhig yin pa ni smos ma dgos pa dang /dus mtshungs bod kyi lo rgyus sam gtam rgyud sna tshogs dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gtam dpe khag cig la de'i 'byung khungs dang byung tshul sogs kho bo rang nyid kyis mthong thos gang shes rnams kyang yig tshogs la ma 'dzems par ci nus kyis phyogs sgrig bcas zhus yod/2 phyogs bsdus gtam dpe de dag nang gses dbye ba ji ltar 'byed pa dang go rim sgrig stangs sogs kyi thad/ da phan phyogs sgrig gnang rigs dpyad skabs re zung zhig ni nang don gtso bor bzung ste chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ bsam blo/ kun spyod/ gral rim 'thab rtsod/ spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba/ yul goms gshis lugs/ rang byung khams kyi snang tshul zer ba lta bu khag mang po zhig la phye nas sgrig khul byas 'dug kyang / don dngos la zhib 'jug byed skabs 'thag cha 'dzings pa bzhin du gyur te mtha' 'bras rgya 'ub ma 'dus pa zhig las byung mi 'dug cing / kho bos kyang de'i skor la bsam gzhigs ma bgyis pa min rung / bod dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe phal mo che'i khyad chos shig ni tshig grogs gang sbyar bltos nas go don 'gyur 'gro ba ma zad/ da dung la la ni bed spyod bya yul lam byed mkhan/ de bzhin gnas dus mi 'dra ba sogs la brten nas go don 19

yang mtha' dag gcig tu ma nges pa dang / yang skabs re gtam dpe gcig yul dang gnas skabs mi 'dra ba 'ga' la spyad kyang chog pa lta bu sogs mdor na gris bcad pa ltar gyi dbye 'byed de rigs rmongs rgan bdag 'dra ba'i shes 'khos kyis sgrub thabs ma mchis pa ma zad/ mi rabs nas mi rabs su brgyud sprod byas pa'i mang tshogs khri ma 'bum gyi shes rig gi nying khu gang mkho der spyod chog pas nus mang ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal gson po de lta bu'i bla srog phyungs te rang snang lkugs pa u tshugs kyis 'gul med bem ror 'chos pa'i tho co de rigs ci nas kyang bya mi rung bar 'dod do/ / de min deb la la ni gtam dpe so so'i tshig dang po de'i ming gzhi gang yin pa bod yig gi ka mad go rim gyi thob thang snga rting bsgrigs nas bkod pa tsam las/ rigs dang dbye ba ci yang ma phye bar mtha' dag mnyam bsres gnang ba de yang blta zhib byed mi bde bas sla bcos che drags pa 'dra bar snang / der brten da lam kho bos bod kyi gtam dpe'i tshig sbyor byed stangs mi 'dra ba gtso bo 'ga' zhig gzhir bzung ste snga 'phros le tshan lnga ru phye khul bgyis pa dper na/ 66phyi ltar du g.yang mo khyu gcig nang ltar du ma re bu re ’ zhes pa lta bu'am/64chang rang gis 'thung na mgo na/ mis 'thung na snying na ’ zhes pa/66rta pho bres la btags na/ gong thang khrom pas gcod ’ ces pa lta bu la sogs pa dpe 'ba' zhig bshad de brjod don gang yin pa rang shugs kyis gsal por ston nus pa 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉gzhung nang gi bsdus brjod kyi rgyan dang phyogs 'dra ba'i rigs 'di mang shos su mchis pa le 20

tshan dang por bkod pa dang / yang rtsa ba'i mtshon tshul gong dang 'dra rung bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom srol dpe mang gis don gcig ston pa'i rjes shul lta bu ste dpe nyis brtseg bstan te don shugs la go bar byed pa dper na 4 ko ba skam pos khab mi len/ sbang ma rlon pas chu mi len ’ zhes pa'am 64skud sne khab kyis khrid/ char sne drung gis khrid ’ ces pa/66kha ba babs na nyin srib med/ nyi ma shar na phu mda' med/’ ces pa lta bu la sogs pa dpe gnyis kyis don gcig nan tan ngang ston pa 'di rigs le tshan gnyis par bsgrigs yod/ de min tshig sdud che ba'i dpe tshig 'bru bzhi can ste dper na ‘ rgyu ngan spun rtsub/’ ces pa'am rta la g.yag 'dzem/’ zhes pa/ 6 na thogs spang 'dred/’ 6‘phag pa chil mnong /’ sna bya sha sen bgos/74sbrul mdud sbrul bshig ’’ces bya ba la sogs pa 'di gras kyang bod kyi gtam dpe tshan pa gcig tu mngon pas le tshan gsum par bzhag yod/ de min dper na 4‘ngo bstod kyis gnyen mi 'khyongs/ chig rtsub kyis dgra mi thul/’ zhes pa lta bu'am/6‘zin dka' ba de chod yin/ theg dka' ba de skyid yin/’ ces pa 64dpon dang 'dra ba'i gtam yod kyang dpon dang 'dra ba'i dbang med ’ ces pa la sogs pa lta bu brjod don gang yin pa de dpe sogs 'khyog brjod kyis ma bslad par thad kur gsal ston byed pa snyan gzhung gi rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang phyogs 'dra zhing / gtam gyi dper 'os pa'i tshan pa 'di rigs le tshan bzhi par bkod pa dang / yang dper na ‘6khyed kyis ma mthong shes bya mang / bong bus ma phyin lam 21

'phrang mang /’’zhes sam/ ‘ dpyid nyi ring por grang gsum dro gsum/mi che ring por skyid gsum sdug gsum/’’che mi gas na dbang med/ rta rgas na gong med/’ ces pa lta bu la sogs pa tshigs rkang gcig gis don dang tshigs rkang gcig gis dpe bstan nas dpe don zung du sbrel ba'isgo nas brjod bya'i don snying gsal bar ston pa ste snyan gzhung dpe rgyan nang gi 64zla bo dngos po'i dpe ’ dang 'dra ba'i rigs 'di le tshan lnga par bsgrigs yod/ 'on kyang mang du btus nas zhib tu dpyad na da dung nang gses dbye rgyu du ma yod pa gdon mi za yang / da lam thog ma'i dbye 'byed dpyad gzhi tsam yin pa ma zad/ thengs dang por gtam dpe'i sne rigs kyang yongs su tshang ba zhig yong mi srid pa bcas la brten le tshan lnga po de rang la cha bzhag pa yin zhing / dbye ba phye khul 'di la'ang phar 'dres tshur 'dres dang dbye 'byed nor ba sogs kyi skyon cha sna tshogs shig shugs ma thub kyi yong nges ni gor ma chag pa bcas zhan cha de rigs slad phyin bod kyi gtam dper zhib 'jug dang 'brel gsal bshad gnang mkhan rgyal khab phyi nang gi ched las mkhas can rnam pa tshos legs bcos dang zhib 'byed cha tshang ba zhig mdzad rgyur re bcol snying thag pa nas zhus yod/ de bzhin bod kyi lo rgyus dang / gtam rgyud/dmangs sgrung sogs dang 'brel ba'i gtam dpe ste dper na sna dngos grub mi dgos/ mdzog mgo glod rogs gnang/’ zhes pa lta bu dang /yang 6 mar dkrog phul nas/ dgongs pa zhu ba/’ 66bong bus gzigs spags gyon pa/’ lha wa skyes rgyal po wa la sdang /’ tshu ri bong 22

cal 'drog’ ces bya ba la sogs pa lta bu dang / de bzhin bod kyi lo rgyus bshad tshul dang 'brel yod gtam dpe dper na 46rgyal po glang dar gyi dbu la rwa co 'dug 'dug la zhu sa mi 'dug ci khung lags/’ zhes pa lta bu dang / 4‘mi nag can yer pa'i brag phug na 'dug kyang / nga sbyi thug la sger tshwa mi rgyag’ ces pa/ sna mi dkar la zhwa nag g.yogs pa/’ 64dpon rab gcig byed pa la/ g.yog rabā gcig shes pa dgos/’ 6‘sog po'i las la/ bsod nams chos 'phel mkhas/ zhes pa la sogs pa 'di rigs kyi 'byung gzhi'i dmangs sgrung ngam gtam rgyud/yang na lo rgyus kyi bshad srol sogs kho bo rang gis mthong thos ji byung rnams go rim ltar phyogs sgrig bgyis pa de dag le tshan drug pa'i khongs su bzhag yod pa bcas dang / le tshan khag so so'i nang gses kyi snga rting go rim sgrig stangs ni gtam dpe rang rang gi tshig 'bru dang po'i ming gzhi'i yi ge gang yin pa de bod yig gi ka brda'i rnam grangs kyi gnas rim gzhir bzung ste bang sgrig bgyis pa bcas de ltar gleng gzhi'am brtsams pa'i dgos pa brjod pa dang / bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe dang 'brel yod kyi 'bel gtam dum bu 'ga' zhigagatam mdzod 'di nyid rtsom sgrig ji ltar bgyis pa'i gsal bshad sogs sngon du 'gro 'os pa'i rim pa rnams ci rigs par bshad zin to/ / 23

le tshanadang po/ dpekho na chedadu bshadade brjod donagang yinapa rang shugs kyisagasal bar ston pa'igatamadape'i gas/1 ka bar 'jag ma'i lhan pa/ tshig 'grel/ khang pa'i ka ba gas pa la rtsa 'jag ma rkang gcig bkog nas lhan pa rgyag pa zhes dper bkod pa/don 'grel/ 'byor pa che ba'i khyim tshang la dbul zhing phongs pa'i dud tshang gis rgyu nor gsab sprod dgos pa'i gyod gzhi thag gcod byed pa lta bur ma 'os pa ma 'tshams zer bar spyod pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/ yang tshong las sogs byed skabs phyug pos dbul po'i lag nas khe bzang za rtsis byed pa sogs la'ang spyod srol yod cing / go don ni 'byor ldan la phan rngo mi thogs la/ 'byor med pa khyim gzhis stongs su 'jug pa'i mi chos dang mi mthun pa'i spyod tshul la 'phya dmod zur za byed pa zhig yin no/ /2 ka yis gnam chu sgug rgal chigs bye masakhengs/ tshig 'grel/ sos dus than pa bstan skabs zhing pas ka li gnam la gtad nas char pa 'bab res bsgugs kyang / gnam chu rag rgyu phar bzhag 24

zhing pa stod hrong ma'i rgal tshigs bye mas khengs pa zhes dpe ru bkod/don 'grel/ 'grub re med pa'i bya bar re stong chen po zhig bcangs nas sgug bsdad kyang dus tshod chud zos su 'gro ba las phan pa med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / gna' rabs kyi dpe tshig de las gnam kho nar brten nas zhing las thon skyed byed mi rung ba'i bab chags kyi tshan rig bsam blo zhig kyang shugs nas mtshon gyin mi 'dug gam/2 ko gru kha thag nye sa nas chod pa/ gyod gzhi thug skabs don rtsa chung rtsag mang po mi shod par rtsa don dam 'dzin gyis 'khrun thag gang mgyog4chod thabs bya dgos zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na zhu ba pos sa gnas de rang gi khrims sa 'og ma nas thag chod yong thabs las thag ring gi khrims sa gong mar bcar gtugs mi dgos pa zerab sogs la'ang spyod pa yin/4 ko gla sprod rgyu dang / rgyab chu brgal rgya/ tshig 'grel/de snga chu chen po sgrol skabs ko grur bsdad de gla cha sprod pa de ni chu brgal mi dgos pa'i don du yin na'ang / dbyar dus gtsang chu rgyas nas gang sar rgyugs rkyen ma chu las ko grus bsgral na yang / da dung rgyab chu ste chu lag chung chung brgal dgos pa de dper bzhag pa yin/don 'grel/ bod rnying par ngal rtsol mang tshogs tshos khral 'ul 'jal dgos pa ma zad/ dus 'gyangs phran bu byung na 'gyangs chad ces da dung dngul chad sgrub dgos pa sogs gyong gun nyis rtseg 'khel ba 25

de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / gyong gun nyis rtseg 'khur mi thub zer bas spyad kyang chog5 ko ba gcig nas dras pa'i rgyan bu/ gna' dus su rus tsho gcig pa'i mi'am/ dus phyis khyim rgyud gcig pa'i mi gnyis kyi dbar 'gal ba byung skabs rtsa ba'i rus rgyud gcig las gyes pa der phyogs gnyis gas bsam gzhigs byas te 'gal zla drag por mi 'gyur ba'i 'grig thabs kyi la rgya 'dzin dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/6 dka' las sil skyas brgyab/ ngo so gzar bus khyer/tshig 'grel/ bod rigs tsho snga dgong zas rigs kyi goms gshis rtsam thug bkol ba'i srol rgyun gyi bya rim nang / dka' las che shos ni rus thang nang rtsam pa bsre skabs rtsam 'brum ma chags pa bya rgyu de yin/de'i ched du rtsam pa sil sil 'debs pa dang dus mtshungs shing gi sil skyas rgyun mi chad par dkrug dkrug gtong dgos pa yin/ 'on kyang rtsam thug dngos su phor par blug skabs shing gi gzar bus lug pa de dper bzhag pa yin/don 'grel/ bya ba gang zhig mi gcig gam yang na mi tsho gcig gis dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyis bsgrubs te legs grub byung mtshams/dka' sgrub nang rtsa ba nas ma zhugs pa'i mi gzhan zhig gis byas 'bras de rang gi yin rkyang gi rnam pa'i thog nas gong rim dang / mang tshogs kyi mdun sar ngom ngom byed pa de rigs la lugs dang mi mthun pa yin zer ba lta bur spyod cing / zur za byed pa'o/ /26

7 dka' las brgyab pa'i dka' chang / mdzo pho bsad pa'i —sdig gla/ rang gis 'bad brtson byas pa'i yong 'bab kyi thog nas rang la 'thob cha nges can zhig len pa de ni lugs dang mthun pa zhig yin zer ba'am/ yang na 'thob dgos nges kyi 'bab de ma rag na nyan mi thub zer ba sogs tshig grogs la brten nas spyod pa yin/ rtsol bstun thob sprod kyi go don dang 'dra/8 dkar po gyen 'ded/ nag po thur 'ded/ spyir na dkar po ni bzang ba dang / nag po ni ngan pa'i mtshon rtags su byed pa ni bod kyi goms srol yin/ der brten byas pa can la gzengs bstod dang / nag nyes mkhan la nyes chad gcod dgos zer ba'am/yang na bzang ngan dang byas byung la dbye 'byed gang yang mi 'dug zer ba sogs tshig grogs la brten nas bsgyur te spyad chog pa yin/9 dkar yol chag kyang / ri mo blo la nges/ dus tshod song zin pa'am/ mi 'das zin na'ang bya ba gang dang gang byas pa tshang mas shes gsal yin zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na yig cha dbral tshar na'ang nang don gsal po bshad rgyu yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/1༷ dkon gnyer phyis dar mkhas na/ gser sku rag la btang yong / tshig 'grel/ lha khang gi dkon gnyer phyis dar mkhas drags na gser gyi sku brnyan de dag rag la 'gyur ba zhig bzos yong zhes bod kyi sku brnyan mang che ba sku rgyu zangs dmar ser las sgrub par tsha gser byugs pa zhig yin/ de rigs phyis brdar mang po byas na tsha 27

gser zad nas sku rgyu zangs ser te rag la 'gyur yong zer ba dper bzhag pa yin/don 'grel/ dngos zog rin thang can gyi rgyu dang bed spyod bdag gnyer byed stangs sogs khong du ma chud par dga' dga' gces gces lta bus 'phur brdar mang po byas na don med chud zos su btang yo nga zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/ dper na deng dus khyim spyod glog chas 'phrul 'khor gyi rigs spyod stangs yag po mi shes bzhin du gya tshom ngang sgul skyod gang byung gtong ba lta bur spyad chog skabs re mi shes shes mdog byed mkhan la'ang de ltar brjod srol yod do/ /11 bka' lan sngon po la/ zhu lan ljang gu tshig 'grel/bka' lan ni rim pa gong ma nas gsham 'og la mar btab pa'i lan dang / zhu lan ni 'og rim nas yar btab pa'i lan la go dgos/sngon po dang ljang gu ni tshos mdog gi tha snyad de/ 'dir sngon po'i lan la ljang gu spel na ha cang 'os shing 'tsham pa yin par bstan pa'o/ /don 'grel/ tshur gang bshad pa de'i lan la/ phar tshig thog tshig —'khel dang don thog don 'khyol gyi lan 'os shing ran la gnad du smin pa zhig btab song zhes pa'am/ yang na 'debs dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / de'i thog nas dbang 'dzin pa la'ang rgyu mtshan drangs pa'i sgo nas yin lugs brjod phod pa'i snying stobs ldan tshul shugs nas mtshon pa/ yin no/ /12 bka' shog gi rgyab la mi shog ba7'a shog btsan po ci 28

'dra zhig yod na'ang / de'i rgyab la mi go chod po dang kha bde po zhig yod dgos/ gal te de med na 'bru don don thog tu 'khyol mi thub zer ba'am/ 'khyol thub kyi mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/12 bka' rdo rje gcod pa/ gsung spu gri ngar ma/ chos rdo rje gcod pa rgyun du klog kyang / sems zhi dul med par tshig rtsub mo spu gri ngar ma lta bus mi sems dum bur gcod kyin 'dug zer rgyur snang /chos tshul byed kyang rang sems ma dul ba lta bu de rigs la zur za byed pa yin snyam/ (a mdo khul )14 rkang pa sa la ma tshugs par/ mgo bos gnam brtol rgyu/rang nyid rang rkya mi 'pher bar stobs ldan dgra bor phar rgol bya rgyu lta bu 'grub thabs med pa'i ham smyon gyi bsam spyod red zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/15 rkang pa phar brkyangs/ nyi ma tshur lde/ tshig 'grel/rkang pa phar brkyangs zer ba ni bag med rang snang gang shar du gnas pa'i mtshon ston dang / nyi ma tshur lde zhes pa ni las rtsol ci yang mi byed par dal por sdod pa'i dpe mtshon yin/don 'grel/ bod rnying par zhing bran rnams khral 'ul gyis ma brel bar rang dgar bsdad mi chog zer ba'i don la spyod pa yin zhing /de min rang gis lcogs tshod kyi las ka tsam yang mi byed par skyid 'dod dal 'dod kho na byed mkhan la ma rangs pa'i zur za byed pa la spyad kyang 29

chog pa dang / yang tshig mjug tu byed mkhan min zhes dgag sgra zhig sbyar na/ sgrig khrims la brtsi bkur dang / rang 'khri'i las 'gan hur brtson sgrub mkhan zhig yin zer bar 'gyur 'gro bas tshig grogs kyi dbang gis don mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su spyad chog pa 'di ni bod kyi gtam dpe'i gson nyams ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin pa gzhan dag mang po zhig la'ang khyab pa shes par bya'o/ /16 rkang pa gcig la/ cher ma brgya zug 'di ni bod rnying par zhing bran dbul phongs rnams phyi khral dang / nang khral/ 'u lagadamag khral/ skyed lci'i bu lon sogs grangs kyis mi chod pas dus gcig mnar ba'i smre ngag gi gtam dpe don la gnas pa zhig yin no/ /17 rkang 'og gi rde'u/ dpral bar 'phar ba/ bod rnying par zhing bran bdag pos rang 'og gi zhing bran la las che btsan gzhan dag la mgo btags nas tshur rgol byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'i dpe ngan zhig yin/18 rku sems la bzhag na/ thob rgyun mi 'chad/ ldog phyogs kyi dpe 'di/ shes yon la dang zhen byas na shes bya mang po rang bzhin gyis khong du chud thub ces pa lta bur spyod srol yod pa thos myong /19 rkun ma gos chen gyon pa/ nyi ma'i gung la yong / de snga bod sa gnas srid rnying gi rtsi phyag mdzod dang / bla brang phyag mdzod/lha zhol gnyer tshang sogs dpal 'byor bdag gnyer byed mkhan dpon rigs de tshos gos chen gyi las gos gyon nas yong ste/ gzhung rgyu gser 30

dngul dang / dar gos/ 'bras mar sogs gang dgos snga g.yar zhus pa zer nas res mos kyis khyer te g.yar tho zhig bkod thog dus tshod nges can re song mtshams g.yar thor skyin tshab byung zhes sel mchan bkod nas bar zos byed pa de rigs la mang tshogs kyis gnad la 'khel ba'i zur za byed pa zhig yin/ don la rkun ma chen po de mi rku bsam pa'i mi 'dra chags po de tshos rku ba yin zer bas deng skabs kyang gzhung rgyu bar zos byed mkhan gyi las byed pa dpal 'byor nyes gsog pa de rigs la spyad na mi 'tshams pa med do/ /20 rkun ma kha skyengs kyis mi gsod/ tshig 'grel/ rkun pos dang thog rgyu nor rku dgos bsam pa las gzhan med kyang / bdag po sogs kyis de tshor nas bros sa ma rnyed pa'i skabs zhed ma ham gyis mi gsod pa yin zhes dper bkod pa'o/ /don 'grel/ mi ngan gyis nag nyes che ba'i bya ba zhig rdzun mthil rdol ba'i skabs su de bas tshabs che ba'i nyes pa gzhan dag gsog nyen yod pas de rigs la 'tshab 'tshub ma byas par gzab nan gyi bya thabs 'dzin dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 21 rkun ma nang la bzhag sgo lcags phyi la brgyab/ dgon pa'i spyi bso dang gnyer tshang zer ba sogs dang / de bzhin bla brang che khag gi phyag mdzod/ lde 'chang pa zer ba sogs mdor na spyi rdzas bdag gnyer byed mkhan de tsho ngan pa lag sbrel gyis la las phyi rgyar do dam nan po byed khul dang / la las nang nas gang mkho de len byed pa de rigs 31

la zur za byed par spyod pa yin no/ /22 kun ma g.yag la bzhon/ g.yag rgod rta༄ga gtong /rkun mas g.yag brkus pas ma tshad/ g.yag la bzhon nas 'dzems med rgyug yong ba dper bzhag nas/ mi ngan gyis mngon sum 'dzems bag med par khrims med lugs med byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/22 kyen mas khrid pa'i ba/ mi gzhan dag gis mgo bskor bslu brid dam/ yang na ngan bskul btsan bshed sogs spyad nas nyes gsog byed pa'i khongs su tshud pa lta bu'i mi la spyod pa yin/24 rkyang la jo shor na/ ri dwags kun rdzad/ las rigs gcig pa lta bu'i mi gcig gi las rigs la gnod rkyen byung na/ las rigs de byed mkhan tshang ma'i khe phan la do phog yong rgyu zer ba lta bu de 'dra la spyod pa yin/25 rkyal gog chen po'i zhabs ra/ tshig 'grel/ rtsam pa sogs rkyal pa chen po'i nang blugs na rdzogs pa lta bu'i skabs su'ang /da dung rdab rdab btang tshe rtsam phor gang do tsam thon rgyu yod pa de dper bzhag pa yin/don 'grel/ khyim tshang chen po nyams gud phyin na'ang/ dbul po gzhan dang mi 'dra bar gang sa nas lhag lhag shul shul nges can zhig thon rgyu yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa dang / yang skabs re 'byor ldan pa yin rung da lta lag dngul med zer na yid mi ches pa de 'drar yang dpe 32

'di spyod srol yod/26 skam po'i phyag rgya de/ rlon pa'i chu nang du mi yong /tshig 'grel/ skam sar bsdad nas byed pa'i lag brda mkhas po de/rlon pa'i chu nang du byings dus las sla po de 'dra mi yong zhes dper bzhag pa yin/don 'grel/ dbang 'dzin pas gdan thog nas 'di 'dra dang de 'dra bya dgos zer ba'i kha ta lag brda de/ don dngos bya ba ngo ma phrad dus stabs bde po de 'dra yong mi thub ces ma rangs pa'i sting tshig lta bur spyod pa yin/27 skar ma re res/ nam re skyel/ tshig 'grel/ lo gcig khor mo yug gi nang ming can gyi rgyu skar re res dus tshod nges can gyi nam ste mtshan mo re skyel ba dper byas/don 'grel/ mi re rer yang rang gi bgo skal gyi bya ba re yod pa de legs par sgrub dgos zer ba'am/ yang skabs re rang nyid la 'khri ba'i las 'gan de rang gis bsgrub rgyu yin pas mi gzhan gyis the jus byed mi dgos zer ba lta bur yang spyod pa yin/28 mas ka ma 'dzegs par/ thog khar/ go rim ma brgyud pa'am/ yang na byas rjes gang yang ma bzhag par go sa mthon por slebs pa'i mi la zur za byed par spyod pa mang zhing / yang mi slebs zhes pa'am/ slebs re ma byed zer ba sogs skabs bstun tshig mjug bsgyur nas spyad na chog pa ni gzhan dang 'gre/ 33

29 sku nyi ma'i nang la bzhugs nas/ gsung grib ma'i nang la ma 'byon/ rang phyogs kyi 'go la bkur ba'i mis/ gzhan phyogs la phan pa'i skad cha shod mi nyan zer ba'am/ yang yon tan yod pa'i mis skad cha thabs rdugs po de 'dra bshad rgyu med ces pa lta bu de rigs la spyod par snang / (a mdo khul )20 ske bcad nas/ og mar byil byil/ tshig 'grel/ske kho rang gis bcad nas/ bcad tshar ba'i mgo bo'i og mar byams sems yod khul gyis byil byil byed pa zhes dper bkod pa'o/ /don 'grel/ bsam sbyor gnyis gnag gis mi la gnod 'tshe byas mthar da dung gdung sems yod mdog gis sems gso gtong mkhan lta bu'i g.yo khram can gyi spyod tshul la sting tshig sgrog par spyod pa yin/ 21 ske khyer nas/ zhags pa bzed pa/ mi gzhan dag 'khrug 'dzing sogs byed pa'i sar don med 'tshangs nas gri dang rdo zhar la phog pa lta bu'am/ the jus mi dgos sar rang gis zhugs rkyen chag sgo phrad pa sogs de rigs la spyod pa dang / yang skabs re nyen kha mthong bzhin du ched mngags kyi god chag de 'dra 'khur gyi min zer ba lta bur tshig mjug tu dgag sgra zhig bsnan te spyod mkhan yang yod do/ /22 ske 'di las phra na yi dwags/ gnas 'di las dma' na dmyal ba/ dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho thabs sam/ chab srid kyi gnas bab sogs gang ci mi yul du bya ba 'di las sdug na sdug thabs med ces 34

dbul phongs nyam chung tshos smre ngag 'don pa zhig yin la/ 'u thug thabs zad kyis nyen mchongs ngo rgol byed pa'i skabs su'ang spyod kyi yod/22 ske 'dod nas/ wa ba mi 'dod pa/ bu mo mna' mar len 'dod kyang / bu mo'i a ma rgan mo gso 'dod mi byed pa lta bu'am/yang na rjes khrid phru gu yod pa'i bud med cig chung mar bsu 'dod kyang /mo'i phru gu khyim nang 'jug 'dod med pa lta bu de dang de 'dra'i rigs la spyod pa yin la/ spyod tshul de rigs ni lugs dang mi mthun pa zhig yin par bstan pa'o/ / 24 ma rags las/ sne 'dzar ring ba/ gyod don rtsa ba las/yan lag gi rnyog dra mang ba lta bu'am/ yang phar don dag chung ngu zhig bsgrub rgyu mngags par tshur cha rkyen de las ldab 'gyur gyi mang ba bton pa lta bu sogs de rigs spyod pa yin/25 ba yan chad kyi skad cha/ 'dra chags chags dang / ngo srung kha mkhas tsam las/ sems nang nas 'gan mi 'khur ba'i skad cha shod pa la spyod pa yin/26 ba rags mi bud pa/ dpyi mgo'i gdeng tshod/ khrims srol gang la'ang mi brtsi bar rang snang gang dran byed pa 'di rgyab rtsa am thang zhig yod pa'i blo shed red zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / yang skabs re rang nyid la bden don dang rgyu mtshan yod pas nyen 'gan ji ltar 'khur dgos kyang mi skrag zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyad kyang chog pa yin/35

27 skya ka khra mo'i tshang nang nas/ ma khra bu dkar yong don med/ bod rigs kyi goms srol la tshos mdog dkar po ni drang bden nam bzang po mtshon byed dang / nag po ni rdzun ma'am ngan pa mtshon byed du brtsi ba yin/ 'dir mi khram pa'i bu rgyud las drang bden dang bzang po zhig thon mi srid zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ de ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rigs rgyud smra ba'i bslad skyon phog pa mtshon gyi yod/28 skya ka la mjes pa/ thang shing la spam pa/ tshig 'grel/bya skya ka thang shing gi sdong po'i thog babs na bya dang shing gnyis kur mdzes shing spam pa ste gzhan gyis blta 'dod pa zhig chags pa dper bkod pa yin/don 'grel/ pho mo gnyen sgrig byed pa'i skabs lta bur bar mis phan tshun gyi dge mtshan rnams bshad de 'os shing 'tsham la ming don gnyis tshang zhig yong ba 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa skabs dang bstun chog 29 skyid kyi rta pho mnyam bzhon/ sdug gi khur po mnyam 'khur/ skyid sdug ji ltar byung rung re khengs med par phan tshun gcig rogs gcig gis bya rgyu yin nam/ byas pa yin/ byed kyin yod sogs skabs bstun gyis spyad chog (a mdo khul )4༷ skyid sdug gal ta mgo sbrel/ spyi tshogs thog sdug bsngal 'phrad pa'i mi rnams la sems gso gtong skabs spyod pa dang / yang 36

skabs re skyid sdug ni res mos lta bur su la'ang yong rgyu yod zer ba lta bu sogs la'ang spyod pa yin/41 skyid la kha'i rtsa la mnyam za/ sdug ko mog gi chu la mnyam 'thung / 'dir ri dwags kyi khyu tshogs lta bu dper bzhag ste/ sde tsho pa gcig gam/ yang na blos thub kyi grogs po lta bu rnams 'phral phugs skyid sdug dar rgud ji ltar byung na'ang / mnyam spyod mnyam myong byed pa las/ gnas dus la bltas nas dga' 'dems zhan skyur dang /rang mgo gang thon sogs mi byed zer ba'am bya mi rung zhes pa sogs la skabs bstun gyis spyod pa yin/42 phyugs bro yang / a pha'i sto phor/ mi rigs sam/yang na khyim rgyud gcig la cha mtshon na rang gi mi rabs gong ma'i srol rgyun dang la rgya'i rjes shul de snang chung yal 'dor mi byed pa nges par rgyun 'dzin mtha' 'khyongs bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/42 byur mo gcig dang ma phrad na/ mngar mo thams cad cang cang yin/ tshig 'grel/ ro skyur mo skyur rkyang zhig za ma myong ba'i mis/ mngar mo ci 'dra zhig zos na'ang cang cang ste zhim mngar de tsam mi ldan pa 'dra ba zhig tshor gyin yod ces dper bkod pa yin/don 'grel/ las ka dka' sdug drag po zhig byed ma myong ba'i mis/ las sla po'i bya ba dag kyang khag po zhig tu mngon gyin yod zer ba'am/ yang da bar kha gtad gyong po zhig ma phrad pa'i mis gnyom chung 37

la thub tshod gtong rkyang byed pa de rang nyid dpa' bo yin snyam pa'i rloms sems skye rin med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin cing /mdor na skyid sdug ma myong ba'i mi la 'jig rten 'di'i thog da phan khyed rang 'gro ma myong ba'i lam 'phrang rtsub la kyag kyog mang ba ji snyed cig yod pas na/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal nam yang byed mi nyan zhes 'doms pa'o/ / 44 skye thengs gcig la 'chi thengs gnyis/ mis mnar gcod drag po bzod glags med pa srog 'gag pa tsam zhig myong byung zer ba'am/ yang na nad thu po zhig gis mnar te dran med du gyur pa las slar gsos pa la sogs de lta bur spyod pa yin/— 45 skye sas yar 'then/ spyod pas mar 'then/ skye khungs drag pa'i bu phrug gis kun spyod ngan pa spel mkhan la 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa yin/ 46 skra rtse rlung gis bskyod༅nga / skra rtsaka lir 'byar yod/phyi'i snang tshul la 'gyur ba'am g.yo 'gul ji ltar byung na yang / nang gi sems rtsa'am/ rtsa don la 'gyur ldog yong mi srid zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/47 brkyangs na mda' nyan pa/ bkug na gzhu nyan pa/spyod yon 'jon thang ldan pa'i gzhon nu ste bya ba gang zhig byed du bcug na'ang thams cad legs sgrub thub mkhan sha stag gso skyong bya dgos zhes pa lta bur spyad na chog pa yin/38

48 bskal pa bzang po'i ja chang de/ dus chod ngan pa'i khral la 'jags/ bod rnying par bla ma'am dpon po sogs sa gnas gang du slebs kyang de ga'i mang tshogs kyis ja chang dang / sgo nga /mar dkrog sha sogs 'bul srol rnams tho 'god byas te dus phyis lo re bzhin sprod dgos pa'i khral la 'jags pa mang po yod pa de dang 'dra ba'i gnas tshul rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / mdor na 'jal dgos nges kyi khral rigs ngo ma min zer ba'am/ rang phyogs nas yag po byas pa de mtha' ma chag sgo rang thog la log byung zer ba lta bu la spyad na'ang chog pa yin/49 bskal pa'i yur bar/ srid pa'i chu drangs/ mi rabs nas mi rabs bar sngar srol ji ltar spyod pa'i byed sgo rnams 'phyugs med byas pa yin zere ba'am/ byed bzhin yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / 'di ni srol rnying gang yin bzang por rloms pa'i bsam blo'i shugs rkyen mtshon pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/50 kha lce 'ug pa'i sgro 'dra ba/ skad cha ring tsam thung tsam kho na shod mkhan cha 'jog byed thabs med pa'i mi de rigs la spyod pa yin/51 kha tig ma myong na/ mngar mo'i bro ba mi shes/ dka' sdug myangs ma myong ba'i mis/ bde skyid ngo ma gang yin shes tshor zab mo zhig yong mi thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/52 kha stong nang gi lce stong / skad cha brgya bshad stong bshad mang po zhig byas na yang / don gyi snying po gang yang mi 'dug zer ba de 39

rigs la spyod cing / yang la las re don bcol ba'i skad cha bshad rjes 'bul tshan sogs gang yang byung ma song zer ba la'ang spyod srol yod/52 kha stong pas/ lce yug yug re 'dun bshad pa tsam las/ 'bul tshan gang yang byung ma song zer ba'am/ yang na de rigs su ma song ba rjes su drin gsab zhu rgyu yin zer ba sogs spyod cing /skabs re 'bul tshan gang yang ma byung zer ba la'ang spyod mkhan yod/54 kha gdangs nas/ glo ba mthong ba/ skad cha yongs rdzogs sba gsang med par bshad de yid ches 'thob thub pa lta bur zer zhing / ‘6dgos ’ zhes pa'am/ ‘6zhu rgyu yin ’ zer ba sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis sgyur chog pa ni gzhan dang 'gre/55 kha bdag med nang nas/ chig tshod med 'bud/ rang gi kha la rang gis bdag po mi byed par brten tshig gang byung mang byung mtshams dang tshod med de 'dra shod pa la spyod cing / de lta bu mtha' ma'i rjes 'bras ngan pa bsam yul las 'das pa zhig 'byung nges yin zhes shugs la gdams pa'o/ /56 kha bde po a 'u ne tso/ mgo bde po rtsangs pa skya leb/kha bde lce bde'i sgo nas gong rim la pad lad kho na 'khrab nas rang don rkyang rkyang sgrub mkhan gyi mi tha shal spyi tshogs kyi 'phung 'dre de rigs la 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa'o/ /57 kha nang gi rma/ kha nang du gso ba/ 'gal zla'am/rtsod gzhi byung ba sogs phyir grags mi 'byung bar nang khul du 'grig 40

thabs yong ba zhes pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/58 kha nas chig shor yu ba thung / bsam gzhigs legs par ma byas par shod mi 'os pa'i skad cha bshad pa'am/ byed ma thub pa'i bya ba khas len pa sogs byas na rang la dka' ngal dang / rnyog dra/blo 'gyod sogs yong ba de rigs la spyod pa mang /59 kha nas pad ma'i lha khang bzhengs / khog na dgo ru'i gcu phur nyar/ tshig 'grel/ kha nas o rgyan pad ma'i lha khang bzhengs rgyu dang / khog nang ri dwags dgo ba'i rwa co'i sne la rtsid skud btags te dud 'gro'i spor sdem byed gcu phur dang 'dra ba'i bsam ngan 'chang bar zer/don 'grel/ kha nas chos skad dge sbyor kho na shod na yang /sems nang gzhan la gnod 'tshe bya rgyu'i bsam ngan 'ba' zhig 'chang mkhan zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/60 kha gnam la gdangs/ rkub pho rog gis brus/ rang gis gzhan rgyu za sems 'chang na yang rag rgyu phar bzhag de las ldog ste rang nor gzhan gyis 'phrog pa zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na phyogs gcig la dogs zon byed ring la/ phyogasagazhan zhig nas gnod 'tshe phog pa zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/61 kha phar 'khor ḍa ru ngo gnyis/ kha tshur 'khor phur pa zur gsum/ mi re re'i mdun du skad cha mi 'dra ba re re bshad nas phan tshun gyi khog pa 'dru ba dang / yang na dbyen sbyor dkrug shing 41

lkebargyab ste rang don sgrub thabs byed mkhan gyi mi ngan la sting tshig smra bar spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul )62 kha ba mgo thog tu babs na/ rbad mgos g.yab gsigabya ba rang thog la babs na/ 'bad pas legs sgrub bya nges yin zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na bya thabs shig gang ltar 'tshol thub ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/62 kha sbrang rtsi/ khog cher ma/ mi kha 'jam khog gnag la zer ba go sla zhing / de 'dra bya rgyu med zer ba'am/ byed mkhan de rigs min zer ba sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'gre/ 64 kha ma thug gong la rna/ ngo yag po ma shes gong nas kha rtsod dam/ phan tshun lab rgyu gleng rgyu chags pa lta bur spyod pa yin zhing /de 'dra bya rgyu med ces pa'am/ de 'dra byung ba red zer ba lta bu tshig grogs la brten nas bsgyur chog go /65 kha chig lag pas ma bzod/ sdug sgom byed ma thub par zhu gtugs sam/ yang na sdug skad mi rgyag ka med byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 66 kha ma bsres na cham pa mi 'go mi dang bya ba ngan pa'i rigs la 'brel thug ma byas na rang nyid la gyod gzhi dang / rtsod rnyog sogs yong don med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/67 kha yis bshad na lha bzhengs/ lag la bzhag na snabs 42

lug phar bltas na kun shes kun nus yin pa lta bu'i kha bde po ba~X bshad stong bshad byed na yang / don lag len bstar dus bya ba chung rtsag gcig kyang sgrub mi thub mkhan gyi mi 'bor shob can de rigs la zur za 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )68 kha la mar zos nas/ rkan la rus pa zug bden 'brel spu tsam yang med pa'i ya la bsnyon 'dzugs kyi skad cha 'ba' zhig red ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/69 kha la phud na sman/ khog la bcug na dug sems kyi sdug bsngal lam/ yang na nye grogs phan tshun bar gyi 'gal ba sogs byung rigs skabs 'phral shod dgos pa las/ sems nang nyar rgyu med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul )70 kha sha'i pags pa/ gang la 'then 'then/ mi rang tshugs mi bzung bar sus bshad de rjes su rgyug mkhan lta bu'am/ yang na skad cha 'di yin 'di min gsal cha med pa de rigs lta bu sogs la spyod pa yin/71 kha shas bla ma bsam/ kha shas tshogs 'khor bsam/bod kyi dgon pa khag nang grwa pa byed mkhan mang po yod pa de tsho la la thar pa don gnyer yin rung / mang po zhig ni 'tsho ba don gnyer ched yin pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa dang / yang khrom ra'i nang mi mang po 'du 'dzoms byed pa de 'ga' zhig nyo bya bsam pa dang / la la rku ma e thob bsam pa zer ba de 'drar spyad kyang chog pa lta bu spyod yul mang /43

72 kha bshadakyi nyi ma shar/ lag len la mun pa rub/ kha bde pos ngas shes ngas 'jog zhes rgyas bshad rgyus bshad bya rgyur dga' yang / lag len ngo ma'i nang gzhug dus 'jon thang ci yang med mkhan gyi mi de rigs la zur za dang 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa'o/ /72 kha'i de bzhin gshegs pas/ lus kyi sgrib pa mi dgakha nas dgongs dag thugs bden zhes ji tsam bshad na'ang khrims dang 'gal ba'i rang byas kyi nyes pa de las sla por dag thabs med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/74 khag 'jog sa kha dkar rkyang / mda' 'phen sa bre ser 'brong / don gnad gzhan zhig la khag btags nas dngos 'brel mdung rtse gtad sa de nga la byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin no/ / ('brog khul )75 khab snyung 'gro gang bzang / zhi drag 'jam tsub tshod blta sna tshogs spyad nas rang don sgrub thabs kho na byed mkhan gyi spyod tshul la zur za byed par spyod pa yin/76 khab brlags dus tsha ge chig ge mdzo brlags dus sba re sbo re/ don chung la zhib tshags ru nga ha las mdog byed pa dang / don chen la snang 'jog mi byed par tshos la ma tshos lta bu byed mkhan gyi mi de 'drar zur za byed pa la spyod pa yin/77 kham bu za ma 'dod par/ skyur la snyad 'dogs/ rtsa don blo la ma babs kyang / kha nas yan lag chung sar skad 'dogs 44

byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ bsam blo ngo ma mi shod par gang dang gang la snyad 'dogs sa 'tshol ba'i bya spyod mtha' dag la spyad chog pa yin/ 78 khalakhur song bsam nas/ steng rtseg 'dir steng rtseg ces pa ni sgo phyugs la rgyab khal do po gnyis bkal ba'i bar du slar yang brtsegs nas 'gel ba'i dngos po la zer zhing / pham kha 'khur gyi 'dug bsam nas yang bskyar brnyas bco4byed kyin 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 79 khal bong busakhur bar/ rgya lamashed pa na don med/do bdag nad theg na/ mi gzhan gyis sdug skad rgyag dgos don med ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin no/ / 80 khas gong bar bshad/ gong bas cha gar bshad/ cha gas sa gzhi khyab/ gsang dgos pa'i gtam rang gis nye shos la bshad na/ nye shos des rang gi nye 'khor la bshad/ nye 'khor de tshos so so'i mtha' 'khor la bshad de mtha' ma gang sar kun la khyab 'gro ba de 'gog thabs med zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin zhing / 4gtam 'tshogs pa'i snod med nya zer ba dang don 'dra/81 khe 'dodakyi tshong dang / dal 'dodakyi skor ba/ rang la 'khur du ma 'khri ba dang / gzhan gyis ma bskul bar rang 'dod kyis byas pa'i las kur nyen 'gan nam/ chag sgo ji ltar byung rung / mi gzhan gyi sems 'khur dang / bsam shes/ rogs ram sogs 45

'thob mi thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/82 khog nang me 'bar yang / sna nas du ba ma thon pa/khong khro bzod glags med pa zhig skyes na yang / rang sems rang gis mnan te lan slog rgyu ltar bzhag khro ba'i rnam 'gyur tsam yang phyir mi mngon par bzod sran dang sdug sgom byas pa yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/82 khyi rgan rtsig khug la bkar na/ mche ba mi gcigs ka med/ mi la bsam gzhigs dang / phyir 'then bya yul sogs rtsa ba nas ma bzhag par tsha 'ded mtha' gcig bkar na/ 'u thug thabs zad kyis tshur rgol mi byed ka med yong srid zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/84 khyi nyams sprang pos lon nas/ rgyug pa sked la gzer/'go pa'am/ yang na sgrig khrims sogs kyi gdeng tshod lon nas/gsham 'og gi mis brtsi bkur mi byed pa'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 85 khri nyal sar/ gzhu gu ma lus pa/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub na yang sbyor dngos rjes gtsang zhig yong ba bya dgos si las las mjug dang rnyog dra sogs ma lus pa byed dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/86 khyi dang nye na/ rma dang nye/ mi ngan pa dang nye po byas na kho'i spyod ngan gang dang gang yod pa de rang la 'go srid zer ba'am/yang na gyo da dang chag sgo rang nyid la'ang 'khri srid zer ba lta bu sogs la 46

spyod pa'o/ /87 khyi dang wa mo kha ris gcig gyod ya'i nye phyogs kyi dpang tshig la cha 'jog byed mi thub zer ba'am/ yang na khe gyong mnyam 'brel gyi mi'i skad char bden 'dzin byed thabs med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 88 khyi dang seng ge 'dzings pa na/ seng ge rgyal yang seng ge pham/ spyi tshogs thog ming grags dang thob thang yod pa'i mis/ skye bo ma rabs tha shal gyi kha ya byas nas 'dzings mo'am/ kha rtsod brgyab pa yin na/ 'thab rtsod thog ming grags can der rgyal kha thob pa yin na'ang / tha shal la kha gtad bcar ba'i grags pa ngan pa 'byung bar brten don dngos la rang nyid pham pa yin pas/ ngan pa'i ya 'degs byed mi rung zer bar spyod pa yin no/ /89 khyi smyo yang bdag po ngo shes/ rang nyid thabs ji ltar rdugs kyang / so so drin gyis skyongs myong ba'i mi la gnod pa'i bya ba byed mi srid ces pa lta bu'am/ yang na khyed rang mi yicha na'ang khyi la mi do bar rang la drin che ba'i mi la bltos med de 'dra ba bya rung ngam zhes spyo ba lta bu de rigs la'ang spyad na chog90 khyi 'dzings kyang / khyi lpags 'thor mi rung / gnyen nye nang 'khrug shor na yang / khrims sar zhu gtugs sogs sngo lo phyi la ma 'phyar ba zhig bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/91 khyi gzhu gu che yang / sna bug kheb tsam/ mi gzhan gyis 47

'bor shob dang rgyu ngoms chen po byed par khyod la ha las rgyu med zer ba lta bu'am/ yang mi gzhan gyis khyed rang 'byor stobs chen po red ces zer ba'i lan du/ rang mgo thon tsam yin zer ba lta bur spyad na'ang chog92 khyi la 'tshosgyu gzhu gu/ khyed la 'khri ba'i las 'gan 'di kho na las gzhan dag med par las ka gcig pu de yang yag po sgrub thub mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / shugs la las ka gzhan gang yod zer ba'am/ yang na las 'gan sgrub ma thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhes pa lta bu'i dri ba zhig 'don pa mtshon gyi yod/92 khri la sto yang mi 'dug khyi la las kyang mi 'dug las ka mi byed mkhan la bza' rgyu yang yong mi srid zer ba la spyad kyang chog cing / yang bza' rgyu gang yang med par las ka byed dgos don mi 'dug zer bar spyad na'ang 'grig94 khyi la seng ge'i ming btags/ nga la kha mdog med na'ang/gong rim nas gnas bab 'dir bsko bzhag gnang byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / yang skabs re ldog nas bshad na 'jon thang med pa'i mi la dbang cha dang go gnas mthon po bskos pa zer ba lta bur spyad kyang chog95 khyi la spags kyi sdig ra/ spags gong 'phyar nas khyi la zhed snang bskul ba zhes dper bzhag ste/ go mi chod pa'i bya thabs spyod pa la khrel rgod byed par spyod pa yin/48

96 khyi lhakhang la 'dzul ba/ zhal zas kyi stogs sla/ bya ba 'di la 'brel med the gzhug byed pa ni rang la khe bzang rag thabs sam/gang ltar dmigs yul ngan pa gzhan zhig bcangs yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ —97 khris rgya nag bskor ba/ sa thag ring por bskyod na yang /'thob dgos nges kyi phan slebs dang grub 'bras sogs ci yang ma thob par stong log byas pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/98 khyod sha rwa rwa lag mang na/ nga dgo zar them pa los mang /kha gtad la dpa' rogs dang dpung rogs mang po yod na/ nga la'ang rgyab rten nam 'gog thabs kyi nus pa de bas mang ba zhig spyod rgyu yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ / ('brog khul )99 khra tshang 'og gi byi'u tshang / dper na jag pa'i khyim mtshes la rkun jag gi 'jigs nyen nam yang mi yong ba'i dmigs bsal gyi bde 'jags thob thub zer ba lta bu de 'dra la spyod pa yin/100 khral chad rgyal pos mi 'dum/ sprod dgos pa'i rigs dus thog so sor 'gyangs med 'jal sprod byed dgos pa las/ chad gsog thebs na nam zhig rgya 'ub mi 'dus pa chags yong zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/101 khral chag med pa'i bogs 'phar/ dngos 'brel byas na don 'bras 'thob dgos nges shig kyang / zhu 'bul byas pa'i 'bras bur yag tu 'gro rgyu phar bzhag de bas sdug tu phyin song zer ba lta 49

bur spyod pa yin/102 khral la gser phye 'jal/ lto la ram pa za/ 'di ni bod rnying pa'i zhing bran dbul phongs kyis myong tshul dngos bshad pa zhig yin zhing / dka' las rab cig brgyab nas longs spyod tha zhig las bya rgyu med zer ba lta bur spyad kyang chog pa yin/10 2 khri gdugs nyi mas ded na/ skya rengs mi 'char ka med/ kho la rang dbang med pa mi gzhan gyis rgyab nas 'bud 'ded btang ba red ces pa'am/ yang na ngas bsam bzhin byas pa min yang /de ltar mi byed ka med kyi gnas la gyar song zer ba lta bu sogs skabs dang bstun nas bdag gzhan gang la'ang sbyar te spyad chog104 khrims med dpon pos gnang na/ ra mda' su la sbran/khrims lugs tshang ma 'go nas bshig na/ zhu 'bod dang gtugs bsher gang du bya dgos zhes mang tshogs kyi ma rangs pa'i 'bod sgra lta bur spyod pa'o/ /105 khrung khrung dkar la/ mjug rtse nag pa/ phan tshun dbar 'brel ba bzang po yod pa la/ mjug tu 'gal zla byung ba lta bu'am/ yang na bya ba dngos gzhi legs sgrub byung na'ang/ mtha' mar skyon cha zhig lhags pa lta bu de rigs la spyod cing / chags song zer ba'am/ mi chags pa byed dgos/ chags nyen yod zer ba sogs skabs bstun tshig sgyur byed na chog106 khron pa'i nang gi sbal pa/ mthong rgya thos rgya med pa'i 50

khengs dregs rang rloms can gyi mir 'phya ba'i sting tshig la spyod pa yin cing / dpe 'di'i gtam rgyud le tshan drug pa'i nang gsal lo/ /107 khrom dus gcig la/ sde thang gnyis/ bya ba gcig pa zhig la gtan 'bebs mi 'dra ba gnyis lag len bstar ba lta bur de ni lugs dang mi mthun pa'i byed stangs ya mtshan zhig red zer ba de rigs la spyod pa yin/1༷8 khrom thog chod dus/ rta kha 'then/ tshig 'grel/bod rigs ni rta rgyug gi sgyu rtsal la dga' zhing dar srol che/ rta rgyug rtsal ston byas te khrom tshogs nang skad grags khyab na de la khrom thog chod pa zer/ —don 'grel/ bya ba gang zhig legs grub gzengs su thon pa byung nas snyan grags chen po thon dus/ las mtshams de gar bzhag na yag po yod zer ba lta bur spyod cing / mdor na tshod zin mkhas pa bya dgos zhes pa'i don yin/109 mkhris nad can gyis/ dung dkar ser por mngon/rang sems rnam par ma dag pa'i dbang gis mi gzhan gyi lhag bsam rnam dag la'ang skyon mtshang du mthong ba yin zhes pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/110 'khon med nyi ma sprin bral/ phyogs gnyis gyod gzhi thug pa'i rjes thag gcod dam/ bar 'dum byas par gnyis mos byung ba'i skabs su slad phyin sngar 'khon zhe 'dzin bya rgyu med ces par dpe 51

'di spyod pa mang / 111 'khugs dus gos dang / ltogs dus zas/ gang dang gang mkho ba de dang de dus thog tu sbyin pa ni dngose 'brel gyi rogs skyor yin zer ba'am/ yang na sdug dus gang mkho de sprod kyi drin skyong nus pa gang thon byas pa yin zer ba lta bur spyad na 'grig112 'khyags pa thug na/ chu la dung sems skye/ dka' ngal che shos shig myangs na/ gzhi nas rgyun ldan gyi ngal rtsol rnams las sla po yin pa'i tshor snang skye ba yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/112 'khyar re 'khyor re'i rta pho las/ rang thag chod pa'i rkang thang dga'/ las 'gan mnyam rub rkang len mi byed pa'i rogs zla yod pa las med pa dga' zer ba'am/ yang na yong yong 'jon 'jon stong bshad la re ba bcol ba las/ rang nyid kyis 'bad sgrub byed pa dga' zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/114 'khrug pa lha yi yul na'ang yod/ mthun pa srin po'i yul na'ang yod/ mthun tsam dang mi mthun tsam yong ba ni mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba'i 'phel 'gyur rgyun ldan can zhig yin pa'i rtsod sgrub kyi chos nyid bstan pa'o/ /115 'khrug pa lha yul dang / 'grig pa mi yul/ dper na gyod ya phan tshun 'gal zla chen po chags skabs bar 'dum byed mkhan gyis bshad sbyang byas te mi 'grig pa yong mi srid ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 52
