116 ga ler song na/ bong bus rgyal khams 'khor/ 'di ni bya ba sgrub skabs 'tshab 'tshub dang rings stabs bya mi rung bar/ngang sgug ngang bsrings kyis sgyid lug ma byas na nam zhig 'dod don lhun gyis 'grub nges yin zhes kha ta byed pa lta bu'am/ yang na rang gis brel 'tshab ma byas par rgyun bsrings pa la brten nas bya ba chen po legs sgrub byung song zer ba sogs la spyad kyang 'grig117 gang drag byas pas ci drag mi zhig la re ba bcol rung / kho la'ang thabs shes bya rgyu ci yang mi 'dug zer ba lta bu'am/yang na mi mang po 'tshogs nas gang dga' ci legs gros bsdur byas na'ang / su la yang thabs shes bzang po gang yang ma rnyed zer ba lta bur yang spyad chog11〈 gang mi yogs par/ do/ tshig 'grel/ lto chas phor pa gang za mi thub par do ji ltar za zer dper bkod/don 'grel/ bya ba gcig sgrub mi thub bzhin du da dung bya ba gzhan dag ci 'dra byas nas sgrub thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/khyed kyis de 'dra khas byed mi rung zer ba'am/ yang na ngas de 'dra mi 'jon zer ba/ khos de rigs byed mi thub zer ba sogs gang mkho skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis sgyur chog119 go ma chod pa de lab rgyu mang / rang 'khri'i las 'gan sgrub ma thub pa'i mi de la/ khag 'dogs sa'i rgyu rkyen mang po bshad rgyu yong zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/53

120 go kha ma gtogs sa mi shes/ pha ma ma gtogs mi mi shes/ 'brog khul lta bu'i mi med lung stong du 'tshar longs byung ba'i phru gu sogs la spyi tshogs kyi cha rgyus ci yang med ces pa'am/ yang na mi 'thom sgye shar nub kyi dbye ba mi chod pa la 'phya dmod byed pa lta bur spyad na yang chog121 go chod med kyang / go bkag rang nyid la kha thabs med na yang / gong rim nas las gnas 'dir bzhag pa yin pas/brtsi bkur mi byed ka med yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/122 gom gsum spo dbang / chig gsum shod dbang /btsan shed kyis gnas lugs rgyu mtshan shod du mi 'jug pa sogs la spyi dmangs kyi khe dbang longs su spyod rgyu yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /(khams khul ) 12 2 gos chen thang la bting na/ bzo khog yid la 'char dgos/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub pa'i 'char gzhi dang / bya rim sogs cha tshang gtan 'khel ba'i skabs su/ byed pa po rang nyid la 'di nas 'di byed rgyu'i rtsis gzhi'i gdeng tshod cig yod pa bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/124 gos chen rgas kyang / ri mo'i gzhung / spyi tshogs kyi cha rgyus sogs nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa'i mi sna lo rgas kyang shes yon gzhan dang mi 'dra zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'am/ skabs re bud med mdzes ma lo na rgas rung rus bzo mdzes chos kyi rjes shul da 54

dung mngon gyi 'dug zer ba la'ang spyod srol yod/125 gyang na ning log thal 'tshub da lo langs song zin pa'i don rtsa rnying pa gzhi nas bskyar slong gi gyod gzhi bzo ba lta bu ma 'os pa zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/126 gro no med kyis sha mi chod/ shes rig dang 'jon thang med pa'i mis/ bya gzhag chen po sgrub mi thub zer ba'am/ blo khog dang ngar shugs med pa'i mis drag po'i dmag 'thab byed mi thub zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/127 gro ma gting la med na/ gro lo kha la mi thon/ sems nang gnad don med na/ skad cha de rigs shod mi srid zer ba lta bu sogs rnam pa brgyud nas ngo bo rtogs pa'i rigs〉la spyod pa yin no/ /128 grog ma 'gro 'gro mang na/ rkang lag thang chus 'dzin/sdod tshugs mi zin pa'i mi dang / yang na bya byed mang ba'i mi la tha tshig sgrog pa lta bur spyod pa yin/129 grog ma rta thog nas mi mngon/ sngon chad 'brel 'dris che ba'i mi yin na'ang / da lta dbang nor gyis dregs nas kha ya tsam byed kyi mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/120 grong pa'i ba shi yang / mya ngan zhag gsum/ mi gzhan la chag sgo byung ba mthong dus gdung sems mnyam skye bya dgos pa las/gzhan sdug la snying tshims sam snang med bag yangs kyi spyod tshul 'dzin mi rung bar mthun gshib shes dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /55

121nga grong pa nye 'dod na/ gong lar cher ragasargyobs/bod kyi grong gseb tu khyim tshang gi thog kha'i mtha' skor du tsher ma rtsig srol yod/ de ni gcig nas tsher rlon skam gses dang / gnyis nas rkun ma 'gog byed yin/ 'dir khyim mtshes thog 'brel la brten rgyu dngos brlag shor dang / pho mo'i 'brel ba sogs kyi dogs gzhi dang rtsod gleng ma byung sngon 'gog bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/122ོ grod pa 'grangs kyang / zhim blo mi bde/ rogs pa byas na'ang / lhag bsam rnam dag dang kha zhe gnyis med cig byas ma byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/122 gla ba na ning shi/ ril ma da lo 'gul/ 'das zin pa'i gnas tshul rnying pa la mi srid pa'i bskyar rtsod slong ba ma 'os zer ba lta bur spyod par snang /124 glang chen mjing pa sbom po sbom rkyang / grog ma sked pa nyag pa nyag rkyang / dbang nor gyis dregs pa rnams khrims med lugs med rang 'dod ltar byed shag shag dang / dbul phongs nyam thag rnams brnyas bcos rdog rdzis 'khur shag shag gi lam lugs ngan pa 'di lta bu zhes spyi tshogs kyi tshul min spyod tshul la yid mi rangs pa lta bur spyod pa yin/125 ming bu gtongasgyu dang / rtsam pa 'gam rgyu/ skabs rtsa ba nas mi mtshungs pa'i bya ba gnyis dus gcig tu sgrub rtsis byed mi rung zer ba'am/ yang na sgrub thub thabs mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs 56

la spyod pa yin/126 glo bar ma phan/ mchin pa'i skran/ phan sems bcangs te kha ta byas pa der/ phar phyogs nas go ba log sgrub kyi 'khon du 'dzin gyi 'dug zer ba'am/ yang na mi gcig la phan pa'i bya ba byas pa la bya yul des phan par mi sems pa'i khar/ 'brel yod mi gzhan zhig la phog thug byung song zer ba lta bu sogs la spyod pa yin/127 dgo ba spang la rgyag kyang / spang thog 'gyel rabs med/ spyi tshogs thog bya gzhag 'di dang de spel myong yang / zhabs 'dren 'di zhus song zer ba'i lo rgyus bgrang rgyu med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul )128 dgon pa'i khyi la gzhus na/ bla ma'i thugs la phogami dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba la phyogs yongs nas blta shes dgos te/rgyab rtsa yod pa'i mi khas zhan yang / phog thug btang na rang la gyong gun rag rgyu las med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/129 dgos pa'i lha khang nag por bzhag mi dgos brag la sku dkar gsol/ rgyu nor sogs gtong dgos nges kyi rigs la mi gtong bar/ bag med rgyas spros sogs mi dgos sar chud zos gtong ba zhes pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ —140 dgra mis bsad pa'i mgo lag rang gis sgrub 'dod shin tu che yang rtsa ba nas sgrub ma thub pa'i bya ba dka' tshegs can zhig mi gzhan gyis legs sgrub byas nas phan 'bras byung zer bar spyod pa'am/57

yang na mi gzhan gyis dka' sgrub byas nas thob pa'i byas 'bras de so so rang gis sgrub khul 'phyar ngom byed mkhan la zur za'i tshul du spyad na'ang 'grig141 mgar ba rang gi ral gris bsad/ rang nyid kyis bzos pa'i lam ngan nam/ jus ngan gyis mtha' ma so so brlags pa'am/ 'phung ba'i rgyur gyur pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin no/ /142 mgo skyes kyi rwa co/ mig la zug rang gis drin gyis bskyangs pa'am/ chung ngu nas skyed bsrings byas pa sogs kyi gnyen nyes rang nyid la gnod pa byed pa lta bur spyod pa'o/ /142 mgo thar na dpung pa 'dzad pa/ thog ma re ba chang ngu ///de ///de sha sgong sa bye ga bton pa khas blangs pa'i rjes su chog shes med par/ slar yang gom pa re re byas nas ham pa je cher gtong ba'i spyod tshul la ma rangs pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 144 mgo bde po'i zhwa mo brlags pa/ mgo bde dran 'phrul ha cang che ba'i mi la skabs re mgo bde drags nas jus nyes sam/chag sgo 'phrad pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / 'di la zur za dang snying tshims pa'i go don zhig kyang shugs la mtshon gyin yod do/ /145 mgo spu med la/ ral pa'i khral/ rang la cha rkyen med par las 'gan dkris byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa'am/ yang skabs re shes rig gi bya gzhag sgrub skabs so sor cha rkyen de 'dra med ces khengs skyu~X byed par yang spyod srol yod/

146 mgo ma chos par/ klad pa ldag pa/ tshig 'grel/lug mgo sogs za skabs sngon la yag po btsos rjes gzhi nas za ba yin mod/ 'dir mgo ma tshos gong nas klad pa lces ldag pa zhes dper bkod/don 'grel/ bya dngos gang yin pa de'i rtsa ba'i gnas lugs ci yang shes rtogs ma byung bar ma shes shes mdog gis de'i skor la 'di dang de zhes rgyas bshad byed mkhan zer ba lta bu de rigs la zur za byed par spyod pa yin/147 mgo ma bton na dpon po/ g.yog ma rgyug na g.yog po/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam lugs nang / dpon po dang g.yog po so sor 'gan 'khri'i 'os 'gan re yod zer/ zhing bran la zhing bran bdag po gzhan gyis btsan gnod phog skabs rang gi dpon khungs la zhu 'bod byed dus spyod pa mang /148 mgo mi na bar/ thi gus bsdams pa/ tshig 'grel/zhing 'brog khul du mgo bo na skabs lham sgrog sogs kyis sdem pa'i yul thabs shig yod pa dper bzhag pa'o/ /don 'grel/ byed mi dgos pa'i las ka byas pa la brten nas rang nyid la rnyog dra dang ca bsun 'phradapa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/149 mgo 'og tu/ lus chug pa/ sde tshan nam/ yul tsho/tha na khyim tshang bcas kyi 'gan 'khur bas so so rang khongs su gtogs pa rnams bka' khrims dang / yul srol sogs las ma 'gal ba khrims 59

mthun/ sgrig 'khur yong ba bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/150 mgo rul ba/ sna yis ma chor ba/ tshig 'grel/rang gi mgo bo rul zin na'ang de'i rul dri sna yis tshor ma thub pa zhes mi srid pa lta bu dper bkod pa'o/ / don 'grel/ rang dang rtag tu mnyam gshibs kyi bya ba'i nang gnad don tshabs chen lhags kyang / da dung do snang rtsa ba nas ma byas pa zer ba lta bu lhod g.yeng chen po byed mkhan de rigs la sting tshig smra ba'i gtam dpe zhig yin/151 mgo la me shor yang / 'phur long med pa/ las brel ha cang che bas long khom cung zad tsam yang mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/152 mgo la rwa mi 'dzugs kyang / rkang la thi gu mi medogs/phan thogs pa'i ram 'degs ma thub kyang / gnod skyel ba'i rgyu rkyen mi byed zer ba'am/ bya mi rung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ (mdo khams khul ) 152 mgo las dpung pa mtho ba/ go rim la mi brtsi bar rim pa 'og mas/ gong ma las lhag pa lta bu byed kyi 'dug zer ba la spyod pa yin/154 mgo las rma che ba/ bya dngos gang yang rung ba de'i ngo bo las chag sgo che ba yong zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing /'di la ma 'os pa'am/ lugs dang mi mthun pa zer ba'i go ba zhig 60

kyang shugs la yod/ 155 mgyogs pos ma ded/ 'gor pos ma zin/ kha gtad gyong po zhig dang thug ma myong ba dang / nyam chung rnams kyis 'thab ma phod par lus pa'i mi zhig red zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/156 mgron po gsar par sne len ched/ gu yog rnying pa me la 'bud/ a gsar gsar 'grogs la ngo dga'i ched du byas can grogs rnying pa khrel med sdug mthong byed mkhan gyi mi la spyod pa'i sting tshig cig yin no/ /157 'go lhas ma bslas nas/ mjug gi mdud pa rgyag dgos/ bya ba gang zhig yin rung / 'go btsugs pa'i rjes su de'i mjug 'khyongs ba zhig nges par bya dgos zer bar spyod cing / yang skabs 'gar rang gis sbyar ba'i rnyog dra de rang nyid kyis sangs thabs bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyad na'ang yongs su 'grig pa yin no/ /158 'gyings che na/ seng ge gan rkyal log nga rgyal dang khengs dregs che drags na mthar thug mgo rting log nyen yod pas rang tshod rang gis 'dzin shes pa zhig bya dgos zer ba'am/ yang na sgrob nyams che drags na yong rgyu de las med ces snying tshims bzla ba lta bu spyad na'ang 'grig159 'grangs pa gnyid khug kyang / ltogs pa gnyid mi khugakhe phan rag mkhan rnams 'dod pa khengs na yang / gyong gun phog mkhan tsho nad mi theg zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/61

160 'gran ya g.yag la bcol na/ rta pho'i rgya ma lugadabang nor dpung stobs yod mkhan nam/ yang na khrims med lugs 'gal byed mi sogs la kha gtad bcar na/ gyong gun so sor rag rgyu las med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/161 'grul lan gcig brgyab pa/ hal khri dang phrad/tshig 'grel/ rtsis gzhung nang sa bdag hal khyi nag po dus gang la phyogs gang du rgyu ba'i tshul 'khod yod pa ltar de'i tshe phyogs der 'grul bskyod byas nas de dang 'phrad na chag sgo chen po 'byung bar bshad pa de dper bzhag yod/don 'grel/ bya ba gang gin rung de thengs gcig byas ma thaga'agal rkyen phrad byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/162 'gro mi dgos par gnya' nang la phyin/ len mi dgos pa'i lcags dos gcig blangs/ jus 'khri med pa'i bya ba zhig la so sos the jus byas par brten mthar rnyog dra'i nang tshud pa ma zad/ 'gan 'khri nges can zhig kyang mi 'khur ka med byung ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/162 'gro ba'i mi la/ sdod pa'i sems med/ spyir na 'gro rgyu gtan 'khel ba'i mi la bag phebs lhod sdod kyi sems med zer ba go sla yang / skabs re snying thag pa nas mthun thabs med pa'i bza' tshang lta bur re zhig 'grig 'dum byas kyang / phan pa med zer ba lta bur spyod pa'ang mthong thos yod/62

164 gan mo gser 'khur gyi dus las/ rta pa mdung khyer gyi dus min/ khrims srol yod pa'i dus bde zhod 'jags kyi skabs su yang khrims dang rgyab 'gal gyi bya spyod 'di 'dra spel byung zer ba'am/spel mi chog zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/165 rgas rgas bzhugs dang / dbu dkar las kyis 'khrungs/ na gzhon tshos rgan rgon la 'phya lad byed pa'i lan la spyod pa mang zhing / yang skabs re dus la slebs na 'bras bu smin thub zer ba la spyad na yang chog pa yin/166 rgya gar la rnga ma rgyug dus/ ra gzhug la bye khrus rgyagami'i rang bzhin ni spyir na gzhan rjes su gzhogs rgyug bya rgyur dga' ba zhig yin pas/ gzhan tshos 'ur sgra rgyag dus rang nyid la cha rkyen med kyang u tshugs kyis rjes rgyug byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing /dpe'i tshig zin ltar na bod mi rigs la'ang khrom rar tshong zog 'gran rtsod kyi 'du shes sngar nas yod pa mtshon gyin mi 'dug gam/167 rgya rgyug pas brngungs na/ gsung bod skad 'byon/tshig 'grel/ de snga bod sdod am ban dbang shugs chen po yod dus/bod pa mi 'khyams re zung gis rgya skad thar thor brgyab ste grong gseb tu rgya dmag yin khul gyis za bed brdab gsig byed pa de rigs rdzong khag nas rdzun ma yin pa shes rjes 'dzin bzung gis rgyug pa gzhu skabs gzhi nas bod skad shor ba dper bzhag ste/ g.yo brdzu byed mkhan la tsha 'dri byas na don dngos ra sprod byed thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/63

168 rgya ja zhan le yin nam/ bod chu ngan le yin/ rgyu rkyen gang la bltos pa ma shes kyang / gang ltar 'thob 'os pa'i grub 'bras de thob mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )169 rgya mtsho skam nus na/ sbal pa 'chi nus/ 'byor pa ldan pa'i mis khyim tshang blos gtong nus na/ dbul po'i yod tshad shor rgyur skrag dgos don ci yang med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/0 170 rgya mcho 'gram du bzhag ko skam mchil mas sbong /ha cang blun rmongs dang thabs rdugs pa'i bya ba mi rnams gad mo shor dgos pa'i glen spyod de rigs la 'phya dmod kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas spyod pa'o/ /171 rgya lu 'tshar 'tshar la/ bram ze rgas/ bu phrug ma longs gong la pha ma rgas pa'am/ dge phrug ma thon gong la dge rgan rgas pa lta bu sogs mdor na shul 'dzin pa 'tshar longs ma byung gong la 'gan 'khur mkhan rgas tshar nas rjes zin pa mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /172 rgyan cha med na/ a ṇi rang shugs yin/ tshig 'grel/bod rigs zhing grong khul gyi bu mo mna' mar gtong skabs 'byor 'khos la dpags pa'i rgyan cha ma ster na mi 'grig pa'i goms srol yod/dbul phongs tshos rgyan cha bzo mi thub stabs bu mo rnams skra bcad nas btsun ma yin khul mi byed ka med de dper byas/don 'grel/ bya ba gang zhig byed skabs 'gro cha mang po gtong 64

dgos pa de rigs la/ dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen de tsam med na stabs gang bde zhig ma byas rang byas yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/(gtsang khul )172 rgyal bka' blon po'i bsgyur phyogs/ rgyal po'am/rgyal khab kyis gtan la phab pa'i bka' dang / khrims sogs yod na'ang / zhib phra'i lag len gang 'dra byed min de lag bstar byed mkhan la rag lus pa yin zer ba lta bur spyod srol yod/174 rgyal po glang dar gyi dbu la rwa co 'dug 'dug la zhu sa mi 'dug ci khung lags/ gong rim gyi mis khrims lugs dang mi mthun pa'i bya spyod spel ba dngos su mthong na yang / 'di 'dra byed kyi 'dug zer bshad na 'khon lan slog par skrag nas shod sa mi 'dug ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs gtam rgyud le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/175 rgyal po byis pa dang / rgyal khrims rtsed mo/ mi la las khrims 'gal lugs dkrug tshod med byed na'ang btang 'dzin byed mkhan med par brten ham pa dpa' thal gyis ngan spyod je cher spel ba'i rgyu rkyen 'dren pa lta bur spyod pa yin/176 rgyal po'i bang mdzod la/ sprang po'i ster tshod/gzhung phyogs kyi dpal 'byor mdzod gnyer pa dang / bla brang ngam/dgon pa'i gnyer phyag sogs nas gsham 'og gi mi la gtong sgo dang 'gro cha sprod dus spus 'bor gang thad nas dgos nges kyi thob thang ji bzhin 65

sprod kyi mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/177 rgyal po'i rgyal sa ma bde na/ sprang po'i nyal sa ga la bde/ spyi tshogs yongs la bde 'jags kyi khor yug cig med pa yin na/mi sger ram khyim tshang mi re ngo rer yang bag phebs kyi 'tsho ba bde skyid ldan pa zhig ga la yong thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/178 — 1 rgyal srid rgyal po'i sku bsod/ srid don blon po'i bye brag rgyal po'am/ yang na rgyal khab ces gzi brjid dang snyan grags che na yang / zhib phra'i srid don gyi bya gzhag bzang ngan ji byed rim pa khag gi dbang cha lag bstar byed mkhan gyi lag na yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/178— 2 rgyu phun sum tshogs pa la/ lag len rnam par ma dag pa/ 'dzugs skrun gyi las grwa lta bur mtshon na rgyu 'gro gya nom pa zhig gtong rgyu yod na yang / las ka las mkhan gyis lag bstar yag po ma byas par ar las kyi spus tshad mtha' zhan las byung mi 'dug zer ba de rigs la spyod pa yin/179 rgyu gtong mi dgos pa'i/ lha dbu chen po/ 'gro gron nyung ngu las gtong mi dgos par don dag chen po sgrub dgos zer ba dang / yang na dngul sprod mi dgos par ca lag yag po 'thob re byed mkhan sogs lta bur zur za byed par spyod pa yin/1ra0 rgyu phar song gi gtam tshur lhags/ gyong gun rang phyogs la phog na yang / da dung gyod gzhi'i le khag tshur 'gel byed kyi 66

'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/181 rgyu ma chad na'ang / gson po'i re ba/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub 'dod pa de'i rgyu rkyen yongs su bral na yang / da dung re thag ma chod pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/182 rgyu yod na bu mo spun mched/ rgyu med na bu mo g.yog mo/spyi tshogs thog gnyen nye'i brtse dung dang la rgya las kyang / rgyu nor yod dang med de gtso che bar brtsi ba'i dar srol ngan pa de rigs la zur za byed par spyod pa'o/ /282 rgyu la med na/ bcos la dka'/ gshis rgyud rtsub pa'i mi la bslab bya ji ltar brgyab kyang zhi zhing dul ba zhig tu bcos dka' ba yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / 'on kyang bcos su med ces bshad pa ma yin pa ni smos ci dgos/1ra4 rgyu'i bdag po slebs dus/ sla nga'i lhan pa bkogatshig 'grel/ dper na lcags kyi sla nga zhig g.yar nas yun ring bed spyod btang mthar mthil rdol bar lhan pa brgyab nas da dung bkol spyod byed bzhin skabs/ bdag po sla nga len par yong dus lhan pa de yang bkog pa lta bu zhes dper byas/don 'grel/ tshur rang la phan chen po btags zin na yang /phar la khe phan til 'bru tsam yang shor dogs byed mkhan gyi mi tha shal de rigs la sting tshig sgrog par spyod pa yin/ (mdo khams khul )185 rgyug ra brag la byas na/ rta las ra mgyogs/ 'jig 67

rten gyi bya gzhag kun la mkhas pa ni yong mi srid pas/ dmigs bsal gyi bya las bye brag pa re zung la snyan grags can gyi mkhas pa las kyang /skye bo tha mal pa mkhas shing byang chub pa yong zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/186 sga lhu bzhi'i rgyun thag sra na/ sa gyen thur med par rgyug chog dper na rang so sos dpal 'byor gyi 'gro gron thogs pa med pa zhig gtong rgyu yod na/ 'dzam gling gi mdzes ljongs grags can gang sar spro 'cham la 'gro chog zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyad na 'grig(a mdo khul )187 gal pas 'drongs༅nga / rtsibs mas mi 'drongs/de snga khral 'ul lci la mang ba de 'dra re zhig 'khyol rung / yun ring 'khyol thabs mi 'dug zer bar spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re 'khyer 'khos bzang ba tshos theg na yang / 'khos zhan rnams kyis theg mi thub zer ba lta bur spyad kyang chog pa yin/188 — 1 sgo ngas brag la rngung ba/ thub thabs med pa'i dgra la 'dzing ba'am/ dbang shugs btsan po'i mi la kha gtad bcar ba sogs glen rtags kyi bya ba brtsams na rang nyid 'phung ba zhig las/yong rgyu gzhan med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/188— 2 sgo nga mthong dus a lu lu/ bye'u phrug mthong dus a ci ci/ a lu lu zer ba gtsang khul gyi yul skad ngo mtshar che ba'i mtshon byed cig yin zhing / bza' rgyu'am khe bzang zhig mthong na rna 'byog krong krong gis dga' po byed pa dang / dka' nyen zhig mthong na 68

zhed snang gis g.yol thabs byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ (gtsang khul ) 189 sgog pa skog la zos༅nga / sgog dri ngos la kha/ bya ba ngan pa lkog tu byas na yang / rjes shul ngan 'bras dngos su phyir mngon rgyu ni 'gog thub thabs med pa zhig yin zer ba lta bu'i rigs la spyod pa yin/190 sgog pa rang gis zos na kha tsha/ mis zos na mig tsha/bya ba rang nyid kyis byas na legs par sgrub mi thub la/ mi gzhan dag sgrub tu mi 'jug pa'am/ sgrub na mi 'dod pa'i ko long byed mkhan gyi mi tha shal de rigs la zur za byed par spyod pa yin/191 skye mo stong pas/ rang 'tsho mi zin/ chags sa rten sa'am/ bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu ci yang med par 'tsho thabs mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/192 sgye mo ngan yang / sgye lung lcags thag rang nyid kha thabs zhan yang / rgyab bdag am thang zhig yod zer ba'am yod pa red zer ba sogs skabs bstun bsgyur te spyad chog192 sgrub pa 'gro 'gro 'bel na/ srin po'i yul la slebs yong / gang sa gang la rgyug rgyug mang drags na/ chag sgo chen po 'phrad par slebs nyen yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/194 sgran me 'od snang gsal yang / rang gi zhabs ra mi mthong / gzhan skyon brjod par mkhas na yang / rang skyon rang gis 69

mthong mi thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/195 brgya bshad stong la phab kyang / yos la 'bab rgyu rtsam pa/ skad cha mang po ji ltar bshad na'ang / don gyi 'bab sa gcig kho na las mi 'dug zer ba'am/ yang na brgya bshad stong bshad ci tsam byas kyang / bsgrub bya'i don thog tu 'khel ba zhig dgos pa yin zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/196 brgya tham pa'i gral 'gor ma slebs kyang / stong tham pa'i gral gzhug tu ma lus tsam/ slob sbyong ngam bya las gang la zhugs rung ma mtha'i re 'dun 'don pa la spyod pa dang / yang skabs re rang so so mtha' gras su ma lus tsam yod zer ba'am/ lus mi yong zer ba sogs la spyod mkhan yang yod/ 197 brgya'i nang nas bdams/ stong gi dkyil nas bsgrugs/ mang po'i khrod nas 'dems 'dems sgrug sgrug byas pa yin zer ba'am/ byed pa zer ba/ bya dgos zer ba sogs bdag gzhan dus gsum skabs dang bstun nas spyad chog19ra nga gcig min na/ su gcig yin/ nga rgyal khengs dregs kyi rgyags pas mi gzhan dag mig nang mi 'jog pa sogs gzu lum gyi spyod tshul la ma rangs pa lta bur spyod pa dang / yang na spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong med pa'i gzhon skyes la de ltar byed mi nyan zhes bslab bya byed pa lta bur spyad na'ang chog pa yin/199 nga spags las bzos pa dang / khyod lcags las grub 70

pa/ 'dzing mo thug dus pho 'dra 'dra mnyam mnyam yin pas skrag dgos don ci yang med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa mang zhing / phan tshun la rogs zla yod na nga tsho dang / khyod tsho zhes bsnan na 'grig200 nga shi bas ma gtogs/ bong bu slong stangs de 'dra ma red/ mi zhig gis bya ba gang zhig byed par rtsom pa na de byed stangs byed lugs ji bzhin mi shes pa mthong dus/ ngas byas na de 'dra ma red zer ba lta bu'i skabs spyod pa'i kha mtshar gyi gtam dpe zhig yin zhing / 'di'i 'byung khung sa dmangs sgrung gi bshad tshul le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal bar gzigs/201 ngang pa mtsho la 'bab par/ nya mo skrag don med/rgyun ldan rang bzhin gyi bya bar 'drog mgo lang don med zer ba'am/yang na so so'i bya gzhag so sos sgrub par phan tshun the gtogs byed dgos don ci yod zer ba lta bu sogs la'ang spyad chog pa skabs dang bstun na 'grig2 02 ngang pa mtsho la 'bab par/ snga blta phyi blta/ bya ba chen po gang zhig byed na'ang sngon la 'das pa'i gnas tshul dang / ma 'ongs pa'i mjug 'bras sogs yu la dus gnas skabs kyi cho bab gang ci'i thad bsam zhib nan tan bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 202 ngam shod bye mas rkang pa chig de nas 'am bu sprung la tshud/ mchan/ ngam shod ni bsam yas dgon pa'i gtsang gzhung dang /71

'am bu zhes pa ni nga rang zer ba'i don yin/don 'grel/ sna bsun thengs gcig 'khel bas bslab bya zab mo zhig thob byung bar brten/ da cha bya ba ji ltar bya dgos pa gsal po shes kyi yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / rgya rigs kyi gtam dper 66'obs su thengs gcig lhungs na/ shes rab thengs gcig 'phel ’ zer ba dang don gcig yin/204 ngu mkhas drags na/ gad mo dang nor yong / rdzun dang g.yo khram bshad drags na/ mtha' ma rdzun mthil de bas gsal po rtogs thub pa'i rgyu rkyen du 'gro ba las/ yong rgyu gzhan med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/205 ngo gnyer ma dang / migamachi ma/ lus la dka' sbyong dang sems la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag po rgyun ma chad par myong dgos byung zer ba'am/ myong nas sdod dgos pa zhig yong nyen yod zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun nas spyad chog206 dngos grub mi dgos/ mdzog mgo glod rogs gnang /dper na mi zhig gis khe las gcig la ma rkang bzhag na khe bzang ldab log 'thob thub zer bar yid ches kyis ma rkang bzhag kyang / khe 'bab rag ma thub pa'i gong khe las de ha log tshul thos skabs ma rkang 'jog mkhan des/ da cha khe bzang ma byung rung ma rkang phar bzhag pa de phyir slog bya rogs zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs dmangs sgrung gtam rgyud le tshan drug pa'i khongs 72

gsal yod pas de la gzigs/ 207 rnga gog brngungs na/ gzer gog 'phar/ mchan/'dir gog ces pa ni rnying pa'i don yen/don 'grel/ gnad don rnying pa bskyar slong byas na/ de dang 'brel ba yod pa'i rnyog gzhi rnying pa gzhan dag mang po bskyar du langs yong nyen yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/208 rnga rding rgyug du ba langs rgyag rang dang 'brel ba med rung / skad cor ram/ zang zing / mi tshogs sogs gang du yod sa der rgyug mkhan zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing /bod kyi dmangs srol la dus chen nam/ 'du 'dzoms kyi byed sgo spel skabs rnga rdung ba dang / bsang dud gtong ba'i goms srol yod pa de mtshon gyi yod/ 209 4 mong che rung sgo phyugs/ ri bong chung yang ri dwags/dper na tshong khang zhig 'byor stobs chen po yod rung / ma dngul gzhan nas g.yar ba dang / kher rkyang 'khos ka chung yang rang thag chod pa'i rgyu nor yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la skabs dang bstun nas spyod pa yin/210 za ཿjigs la dbag ba 'i 'cham tshigag/ kha gtad phyogs kyi byed stangs dang / shod phyogs sogs ci 'dra byed pa de la dpag pa'i lan slog rgyu zhes bzang ngan nam/ ring thung / 'jam rtsub sogs gang zhig ying na'ang / pha rol po'i byed bab la bltas nas 73

gang la de 'tsham gyi lan 'jal ba'i nus pa yod zer ba lta bu yin/(rnga gdangs la dpag pa'i 'cham stangs ) zer ba'ang gong dang don gcig go 211 snga char ma chad/ dgong char/ rnyog dra gcig thag ma chod gong la rnyog dra gzhan zhig langs pa lta bha'am/ yang na chag sgo gcig thog nyis rtseg byung ba lta bu de rigs la skabs dang bstun nas spyod pa yin/212 snga dro ra dang / dgong dro lug skabs re yin zer ba dang / skabs re min zer ba sogs kha mi brtan pa'i mi la zur za byed pa sogs la spyod pa yin/212 snga dro bla ma las dal ba/ dgong nye gnas las brel ba/mchan/ bla ma ni spyi tshogs thog dal shos dang / nye gnas te bla ma'i zhabs phyi ni brel tsha shos kyi dper bkod pa'o/ /don 'grel/ las ka 'go tshugs pa nas bzung bstar chags kyi 'bad rtsol ma byas par dus tshod yod dus nya be nyob be byas te sdod pa dang / dus la gtugs skabs brel brel 'tshub 'tshub byed mkhan gyi spyod tshul la 'phya dmod byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/214 snga ma kha brdabs par/ mjug ma dgod ma shor/ mi gzhan la god chag dang / jus nyes sogs byung bar gzhan sdug la snying tshim mam/ 'phya dgod sogs gtan nas byed mi rung / srid pa 'di ru legs nyes ci yang 'khor nas 'ong srid pas rkyen ngan de 'dra ba nam 74

zhig rang nyid la'ang mi 'byung ba'i nges pa rtsa ba nas med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 215 snga ma ma rnyed/ phyi ma brlags/ bya ba gcig 'bad pas sgrub bzhin rung da dung ma 'grub pa'i gong la/ bya ba gzhan zhig slar yang thor zhig tu song ba lta bu'am/ yang na bya ba gcig legs 'grub ma byung bar bya ba mang po 'go 'dzugs pa de ni mtha' mjug gcig kyang mthar mi phyin pa'i nyen kha yod ces pa lta bur spyad kyang chog216 sngar mgo yi zhwa nyan pa de/ da rkang pa'i lham mi nyan pa/yul dus 'gyur ldog dbang gis spyi tshogs kyi spyod tshul la la mgo mjug log pa'am/ yang na a gsar yol ba'i dga' rogs kyi lta stangs 'gyur ba sogs la spyod pa dang / skabs re bltos bcas dbang gis 'gran ya drag zhan las/ sngar gyi ang dang po de da cha mjug mthar lus pa lta bu de rigs la spyod srol yang yod do/ /217 sngar thug chu ma nyan par/ da ja chu ga la nyan/mchan/ thug pa bkol ba'i chu ni spyir btang gtsang ma yin na 'grigs kyang / ja khu 'don pa'i chu ni de bas dwangs gtsang dang gsar rkyang zhig dgos pa'o/ /don 'grel/ sngon chad rang la dma' 'bebs byed myong mkhan gyi mis da cha gnas dus 'gyur ba'i dbang gis gzengs bstod dang gong bkur byed pa lta bur zur za byed pa de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 218 sngar bya nyal sar/ da byi'u mi nyal/ 'di ni bya dngos 75

kyi 'gyur ldog bzang ngan gang la spyad kyang chog cing / spyi tshogs rgyun mi 'chad par 'phel 'gyur 'gro ba'i lta ba mtshon byed cig yin/dper na grong gseb pas kyang ‘ ga lā o ge'i ’ gzhas gtong gi 'dug zer ba dang / yang ngas tshong mkhan gyi kha la yid ches byas kyang / ca lag 'di rdzun ma red zer ba lta bu de rigs kyi lan la spyod pa'o/ /219 sngar sbrul khra bos srog bcad/ da thi gu khra bor yid mi ches/ sngon chad sna gug brdabs pa'i bslab bya drag po zhig phog myong bar brten/ da cha tan tan tig tig byas na ma gtogs yod tshad la blos 'gel thub pa mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/220 bcad khar ma tshang yang / mthud khar tshang ba/ gra sgrig byed pa'i dus su rjes ma zin na yang / dngos gzhi'i skabs su le ma thogs pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / tshig mjug tu zhu chog pa zer ba'am/ yang na nges par bya dgos zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun nas bsgyur na 'grig pa gzhan dang 'gre/221 bcad pa'i shul la/ btsugs pa 'dra ba/ pha rgod po zhig 'das pa'i rjes sa ba de bas kyang 'jon pa zhig thon yod zer ba lta ༄༄bu'am/ yang na dmag dpon skad grags yod pa zhig brjes pa'i tshab la dpa' bo de bas lhag pa zhig gtong dgos zer ba lta bu sogs de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /222 bcu gsum khog rtsis ma shes na/ grong pa'i a pha ga la yong / mchan/ bcu ni phyogs bcu'i gnas tshul dang / gsum ni 76

'das da lta ma 'ongs dus gsum gyi 'gyur ldog la zer ba'o/ /don 'grel/ rang gi khog pa'i nang spyi dang bye brag gi gnas lugs la gdeng tshod nges can zhig med na/ don chen gros thag gcod par yong mi srid zer ba'am/ yang na yong rung go mi chod zer ba lta bu sogs de rigs la spyad kyang chog 222 bco lnga mchod pa phar tshad red/ rang mgo thon na lha rgyal red/ tshig 'grel/ bod zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga'i mtshan mo lha sa'i bar skor du cho 'phrul smon lam gyi mchod pa'i dus chen skabs 'tshang kha ha cang che ba'i nang tshud dus 'gro sdod dang gar 'gro rang dbang bral ba lta bu dper byas/don 'grel/ bya ba 'ga' zhig dang thog 'di dang 'di ltar bya snyam pa yod rung / bsam yul las 'das pa'i don rkyen zhig gis ci bya gtol bral gyi gnas su gyar song zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang zhing /skabs re mi khyod kyi kha thabs la bltas na bya ba chen po de 'dra bsgrub rgyu phar bzhag so so mgo thon na rab yin zer ba lta bur spyod mkhan yang yod / (lha sa khul ) 224 lcags kyi ril bu za na/ rno yi 'gram so dgos/mchan/ rno zhes pa ni ngar lcags la zer/don 'grel/ dper na gzhung rgyu lkog za byed pa la rang srog blos gtong gi snying khams dgos zer ba lta bu sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin/mdor na bya ba de byed par las sla po med ces pa'i go don ldan yod/77

225 lcags tsha thog la rngungs/ bya ba mang po zhig gnad don thon ma thag tu brtsad zhib dang thag gcod byas na byed bde po yod cing / nyin 'gyangs zhag 'bud du bzhag tshe rnyog 'dzing je cher 'gro ba sogs de rigs 'phral mar lag len bstar dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/224 lcags la mthar dang / mthar la nan/ tshig 'grel /'dir mthar zerwa ba ni lcags rigs kyi dngos chas bzo brdungs zin rjes su 'jam rdung snyoms mthar yang nan dgos pa de dper bkod/don 'grel/ bya ba 'gangs chen po sgrub skabs tan tan tig tig dgos pa ma zad/ gzab gzab nan tan yang bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/229 lcags la me 'bar na/ lan la thal ba rgyobs/ mi srid pa'i bya ba de 'dra byung dus/ 'u thug pa'i thabs shes kyang de lta bu zhig las bya thabs med zer ba lta bu thabs rdugs pa'i las ka phrad dus spyod par snang / 228 lcang ma'i bdag por/ go g.yog dkon/ ming tsam gyi bdag dbang las/ don dngos longs su spyod dbang mi 'dug zer ba'am/ yang na rgyu nor gyi bdag po ser sna che drags pas bed spyod byed mi nus zhes zur za byed pa sogs de rigs laspyod pa yin/229 lcam sku zhabs kyi phebs stangs ma shes/ bu mo rang gi 'gro stangs kyang shor/ mi gzhan gyi lad mo bya rgyu kho nar dga' ba'i mi de rigs la zur za byed par spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re lad zlos 78

byed dgos nges kyang so so rang gis legs par mi shes zer ba la'ang spyod mkhan yod/ 220 chagasgorab la/ godakha 'bring / chag sgo'i ngos nas bshad na che shos shig byung na yang / rgyu rkyen gzhan dag la brten nas god kha ste gyong gun de tsam gyi chen po rang ma byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / rgyun gtan rab ces pa legs shos la go ba yin rung / 'dir chag sgo'i thog spyad pa yin stabs che shos la go dgos so 221 chags na zho dang ma chags dar ra/ mi dang bya ba gang yin rung / 'grigs kyangade 'dra zhig yin la/ ma 'grigs na yang ha las dgos don ci yang med zer ba lta bu ste/ gnad don de la snang chung byed pa 'dra zhig la spyod pa yin/222 chang khas btungs/ rtsis rig pas zin/ chang btungs nas ra bzi na'ang / don dag gang yin blo la nges pas 'phyugs mi srid zer ba ste/ chang 'thung mkhan gyi mis rang nyid ra bzi na yang dran shes gsal po yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang / 'dir rig pa zhes pa ni dran shes la go dgos so/ / 222 chang mis 'thung na snying na/ rang gis 'thung na mgo na/ bya ba zhig mi gzhan gyis bsgrubs pa la khong khro ko long byed pa dang /bya ba de rang nyid sgrub tu bcug na klad pa 'khrugs nas cha shas tsam yang sgrub mi thub mkhan gyi mi nga rgyal phrag dog can de rigs la sting tshig 79

gnad du 'khel ba zhig bsnun par spyod pa yin zhing / mi de gras ni deng skabs kyang gang sar mthong rgyu yod do/ /224 char thag chod kyang / thigs thag mi chod/ gnad don che ba thag chod kyang / chung rtsag rnams da dung thag ma chod pa lta bu'am/ yang na phyi rgyar thag chod kyang nang khul du zhib phra'i 'gan 'khri brtsad gcod bya rgyu zer ba la sogs pa de rigs la skabs dang bstun nas spyod pa yin no/ /225 char pa chu grogs/ nyi ma me grogs/ phyogs gang ci'i thad nas mthun grogs su 'gyur ba'i skabs bstun gyi rogs ram gang drag yong ba zhes pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/226 chu skor gyi gnyer pas/ dkar yol la nyams zhib/bya ba gang zhig la nyams myong dang cha rgyus phar bzhag spyir btang gi 'brel 'dris tsam yang med pa'i mis bya ba de'i thad la the jus rtsa ba nas byed mi 'os zer ba'am/ yang na bdag gnyer dang dbye zhib ci 'dra byas te byed thub zer ba lta bu ma 'os ma mtshams pa'i mi don gyi skor la spyod pa mang /227 chu dkrogs nas/ mar mi thon/ don stong pa 'brel med kyi gnas tshul la rtsod 'ben mang po byas na'ang / mtha' ma'i 'bras bu gang yang thon rgyu med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/228 chu grang mo btung yang / kha chig pa/ 'di ni brjod yul mi'am khyim tshang des gang sa ci thad la ma khyab pa med pa'i rogs 80

skyor de lhag bya rgyu med pa lta bu zhig gnang byung zer ba la spyod pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/ 'on kyang tshig 'grel thad ‘6chu grang mo btung nas kha tshig byung ’ zer na ma gtogs/ de min byas ma byung zhes pa'i skad cha tshig gcig bshad rgyu med zer ba lta bur go dgos pa yin nam snyam pa da dung gtam rgyud 'dra yod med sogs dpyad pa mu mthud yod pa zhu/2 29 chu 'gromakhan dang / gram pa sdod mkhan/ bod rnying par sa gnas so so'i rdzong dpon ni lo gsum re nas 'phos 'gro zhing /yul de'i dgon pa'i las sne dang / sger drag sogs 'go gtso rnams ni sa cha de rang du sdod mkhan yin stabs/ mi ser tsho rdzong dpon gyi rjes su 'brang rgyu med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 240 chu char pa'i skyo rogs ma byung yang / sad ser ba'i sna 'dren ma byed/ gzhi rkang phan 'dogs pa'i 'os yod na yang / de tsam gyi rogs phan byed bzo med pa'i mi la/ phan ma thogs kyang gnod ma skyel rogs zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / yang skabs re ngas phan ma sdogs rung gnod bskyal mi yong zer bar spyod mkhan yang yod/241 chu chung 'ur sgra che ba de/ phu na gangs shig yod pa'i rtags/ stobs zhan gyi dgra zlas ngar ngar 'di tsam byed stangs la bltas na/ rgyab phyogs nas ngan rogs byed mkhan stobs dang ldan pa zhig yod pa'i rtags mtshan 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/('brog khul ) 242 chu rnyog rang rnyog na/ 'go nas rnyog bka' khrims 81

dang sgrig srol sogs nyams dmas 'gro ba de dang thog dbang cha yod mkhan tsho rang gis gtor bshig gtong ba las/ gsham 'og nas khrims 'gal byed mi phod la/ gal te byas kyang lam seng gcun bde po yin/ 'go nas dkrugs rkyen gsham la'ang gnon 'doms bya thabs med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/242 chu rnyogs nas/ nya bzung ba/ mi ngan gyis dkrog rkyen bzo thabs spyad de zing cha'i khrod nas mi gsod pa dang / rgyu nor 'phrog bcom sogs rang nyid kyi dmigs yul sgrub thabs byed pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/244 chu thigs bsags na rgya mcho/ shes yon cha shas re nas bsags na/ nam zhig mkhas pa chags thub zer ba'am/ yang na 'byor pa chung rtsag nas bsri tshags kyis spel thabs byed thub na rim bzhin phyug po chags zer ba lta bur spyod pa go sla'o/ /245 chu thon song / zam pa ga le bzhugs/ 'gag rtsar thug pa'i skabs su rogs ram don la phan pa zhig byas na yang /dka' ngal de las grol ma thag thugs rje che zhes pa'i kha yag tsam mi shod pa ma zad/ rjes su phrad skabs ngo shes dri smed tsam mi byed pa'i ngo tsha khrel gzhung gi dri mas ma gos pa'i mi tha shal de rigs kyi spyod tshul la spyod pa'i sting tshig cig yin/ 246 chu 'thung yun ring na/ chu drita/ yul lam/ las gnas/ mi la sogs pa 'grogs yun ring drags na skyon cha mthong 82

ba'am/ mi 'dod pa rim bzhin 'phel ba sogs mdor na a gsar yol ba'i mtha' 'bras de rigs la spyod pa yin/247 chu phyed ka brgal na/ ha phyed ka go bya dngos gang zhig yin rung rnam pa tsam mthong bas do bo dngos rtogs pa dka' ba yin stabs/ lag len dngos nang zhugs nas nyams zhib bya dgos pa dang / de yang nyams zhib ji tsam byas na gnas lugs ngo ma yang de tsam zhig khong du chud thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / yang skabs re bya ba bye brag pa de'i thad rang nyid la cha rgyus nges can yod pas gnas lugs kyang gang 'tsham zhig shes zer ba lta bur spyad na'ang chog go248 chu bya'i phru gur/ rkyal slob mi dgos/ zhing pa'i phru gur ngal rtsol dang / 'brog pa'i phru gur phyugs 'tsho rgyu/ 'byor ldan pa'i phru gur rgyas spros longs spyod/ khram pa'i phru gur rdzun shod rgyu sogs tshang ma goms 'dris dbang gis shes 'gro ba las/ ched du slob mi dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin /249 chu ma bde na/ nya mi bde/ yul lung khyon yongs la bde 'jags 'khos su phebs pa zhig ma byung na/ khyim tshang so solam/yang na mi sger sogs su la'ang blo bde bag phebs shig 'byung mi srid zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 25༷ chu mig kham chig tsam nas/ nya chen 'doms pa bco brgyad/ phyi rol gyi dngos po'i gnas tshul gang dang yang rtsa ba nas mi mthun pas hang sangs shing / rna bar mi 'gro ba'i rdzun gtam zhud sgrog 83

byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 2 51 chu mo'i 'gros dang bstun nas/ ko skya rgyag lugs/bya ba gang dang gang yin rung / yul dus gnas bab dang bstun nas gang la de 'tsham gyi bya thabs spyod gang thub bya dgos zer ba'am/ byas pa yin zhes pa/ byed kyin 'dug bya rgyu yin zer ba sogs bdag gzhan dus gsum skabs so so dang bstun te spyod dgos pa gzhan dang 'dra ba shes dgos so/ /152 chu mo'i gting tshod lon nas/ nya la sbar 'dzin/ rgya la khrims dang / sgrig srol la sogs khog tshod lon nas 'dzems bag med par khrims med lugs 'gal byed kyi 'dug zer ba'am/ yang na pha rol por rgyab rtsa am thang zhig yod par brten nas khrims 'gal lugs dkrug 'di 'dra byed phod pa red zer ba lta bu sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 252 chu dma' thabs dang / zam pa mtho thabs/rang phyogs la rgyal kha gang che dang / kha gtad phyogs la pham nyes gang mang yong thabs gnang rogs zhu bskul byed skabs spyod pa dang / yang bar 'dum byed mkhan gyis dper na zlos ya phan tshun dpal 'byor slog sprod kyi grangs 'bor la he bag chen po shor skabs/ sprod len gyis grangs 'bor yar tsam spor rgyu dang / len mkhan gyis grangs tshad mar tsam gcog thabs kyi bsam shes bya dgos zedzab lta bur spyad kyang chog254 chu rmar chu mtha' nas dwangs dgos/ nya gser mig 84

lhang la 'bud dgos/ gyod gzhi'am don gnad de mtha' gsal ba bzo dgos pa dang / don rkyen bzo mkhan ngo ma su yin ther 'don gsal po zhig yong ba bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod par snang / (a mdo khul )255 chu la rgyug pa gzhus nas/ nya la yang lci med/gnad du ma 'khel ba'i bya thabs de 'dra zhig spyad nas/ dmigs yul la ni phan gnod kyi nus pa til 'bru tsam zhig kyang thon mi thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa'am/ yang skabs re khyod kyis kho la bzang ngan gang zhig byas na'ang nga la ni 'brel ba ci yang med zer ba lta bur spyod pa'ang yod/256 chu la zam pa med na/ rgal ba las 'os med/ gnas lugs dang rgyu mtshan ji ltar bshad na yang / bsam gzhigs dang nyan shes bya rgyu med na/ bya thabs gzhan zhig ste khrims sar skyel ba'am/yang na btsan shed kyi bya spyod spel rgyu las/ thabs shes med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/257 chu len par phyin nas/ ban stong par log pa/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub par ched du mngags na'ang / de ma grub par phyir log pa la go chod mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / tshig mjug bsgyur nas mi log ces pa'am/ yang na log mi rung / log thabs med zer ba sogs sbyar go don yang de dang bstun nas bsgyur 'gro ba ni gzhan dang 'dra bar smos ma dgos/258 chos skyong rang mgo mi thon/ mgo nag mi yi yar 85

'dren/ rang nyid kyi byed sgo rnams 'thus sgo tshang tsam zhig sgrub pa'i 'jon thang med par/ mi gzhan mgo 'don 'tsho skyong bya rgyu ni gad mo'i yul yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / yang skabs re mi gzhan gyis rang la rogs mgon byed rogs zer bar nga la de 'dra'i nus pa med zer ba lta bur spyad na 'grig pa yin/259 chos mi la shod shod/ bla ma khyed rang gnang dang /gong rim nas khrims srol khyab bsgrags dang / rgan rabs tshos kun spyod shod pa sogs shod mkhan rang nyid kyis bshad pa'i don rnams lag bstar nan po byas na gzhi nas mi gzhan tshos nyan sems dang don 'khyol yong thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod cing / skabs re chos kyi 'go 'dzin la thad kur spyod mkhan yang yod/260 chos zab sar/ bdud sdang / gang du bde skyid dang phun sum ji tsam tshogs sar bar chad dang / 'gal rkyen sogs kyang de tsam gyis mang ba yong zer ba lta bur spyod cing / skabs re chos phyogs la thad kur spyod srol yod /261 chos sar chos dang / gzhas sar gzhas/ yul dus gnas skabs dang bstun nas gang la gang 'os ltar spyod dgos pa las/'gyur med mkhregs bzung gi spyod tshul 'dzin mi nyan zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / mtha' 'khor gyi mi so so'i spyod tshul dang mthun thabs bya dgos pa'i go don yang shugs la bstan yod/ 282 mchod rten mgo gzhug logakyang / bang rim sked par 86

gnas tsam/ chag sgo chen po zhig byung na yang / da dung sdug mthar ma lhung tsam gyi sems pa gnas sa yod pas chog shes bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/262 mchod rten la 'grogs na dkar rag sla nga la 'grogs na kre nag grogs bzang po dang 'grogs na shes yon dang kun spyod sogs rang shugs kyis gong 'phel yar rgyas su 'gro ba dang /grogs ngan pa dang 'grogs na zhe sdang dang nga rgyal phrag dog dang ma rabs kyi spyod pa tha shal gyi rigs rnams je mang du 'phel 'gro ba yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / dkar po ni legs pa dang nag po nyes pa'i mtshon rtags su byed pa 'di ni bod kyi goms srol gang sar khyab yod/ 4264 'char can gyi rgyal po lo gsar la/ dmigs bsal gyi brda tho gtong mi dgos/ kun shes yongs grags kyi las ku'i rigs la/ched mngags kyi dran bskul dang brda lan sprod pa sogs byed dgos don ci yod zer ba lta bu sogs la spyod pa yin/265 nga zhim pa/ mar gyi bka' drin yin/ ja srub ma zhim dang mi zhim de mar yag nyes la 4ga lus pa las/ ja rang nyid kyi nus pa de tsam med ces dper bkod de/ mi che ge mo gtam don gnyis tshang 'di lta bu byung ba de 'go 'dren nam/ yang na gnyen nye bzang po'i drin la brten nas chags pa ma gtogs/ kho rang gi 'jon thang las byung ba min zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/87

266 'jag ma sdod du/ rlung bus mi 'jog don rkyen nam gyod gzhi slong ba de do bdag gi rang sgul ma yin par/ lkog nas mi gzhan gyis ngan bskul byas te bzos pa zhig red zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ / 267 'jag shad chigs la ma thogs pa/ tshig 'grel/ rtsa 'jag ma sen mdzub kyi bar du shad pa'i skabs su tshigs mtshams la thogs pa lta bu ma yin pa zhes dper bkod pa'o/ / don 'grel/ bya ba'am gtam bshad sogs byed sgo gang yin pa de khon khon thogs thogs med pa dgos zer ba'am/ yang na byed rgyu yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/268 'jam po gri yis mi chod/ yang mo phrag la mi lon/tshig 'grel/ phying pa sogs gri yis chod dka' ba dang / bya spu lta bu dgung la yar nas phrag par lon dka' ba zhes dper bkod pa'o/ /don 'grel/ 'jam zhing mnyen pa'i mi der kha gtad bcar dka' ba dang / yang zhing skyen pa'i rigs de'i gdeng tshod lon dka' ba yod zerwa ba lta bur spyod par snang /269 'ju na sman dang / ma 'ju dug bya ba gang zhig 'jon na khe spogs che ba dang / ma 'jon na nyen kha chen po yod zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na bya dngos gang zhig bed spyod shes na dge mtshan che rung / gal te ma shes na chag sgo slong srid zer ba sogs spyod pa yin/270 nya khrims bla mas bsdams/ nya khral bla mas bsdus/88

dbang 'dzin pas 'di mi chog dang / de ma byed ces sdom khrims mang po bzo na yang / de dag las byung ba'i khe phan rnams dbang 'dzin pa rang gis len gyin 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 271 nya go nyung mas mi chod/ mi ngo ma'i go de ngo tshab kyis chod mi thub zer ba'am/ yang dngos po bzang ba'i go de zhan pas mi chod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /272 nya mo spags la dad na/ rang srog rang gis skyel/mchan/ de snga bod khul nya 'dzin dus lcags kyu'i rtse mor spags skon srol yod/ don 'grel/ rgyu nor la rngams sems che drags pa'am/ yang na 'dod sred la chags zhen che ba/ nag nyes can gyi mi dang 'grogs 'dris mang drags pa sogs de rigs kyis mtha' mjug rang nyid 'phung la sbyor srid ces pa lta bu skabs bstun gyis spyod pa yin/272 nya mo ma thebs pa ma gtogs/ mtsho mtha' ma bskor ba med/ dmigs bya de lag tu ma son pa ma gtogs/ thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sgrug gi 'bad rtsol ma byas pa rtsa ba nas min zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/274 nyal sa byung na/ rgyong sa/ spyir na mi'i rigs kyi 'dod rngams ni ji tsam grub pa de tsam gyis je cher 'phel ba zhig las/tshim pa nam yang 'thob dka' ba zhig yin zhes ston pa ste/ dper na gcig byung na gnyis dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin no/ /89

275 nyi mar sgron me'i gsal 'debs/ brjod yul la che bstod kyis blo gros dang shes rig sogs gang sa nas rang nyid las ches cher lhag pas blang 'dor mi mkhyen pa med na yang / lhag bsam gyis ma bzod par snyan lcag zhu bskul bya dgos byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod srol yod/276 nyi shar sbar mos mi khebs/ yongs su grags zin pa'i bya ba zhig la/ gsang rgya ji ltar byas na'ang 'gog thub thabs rtsa ba nas med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/277 nyin dkar gyi zas chag nub mo yi gnyid chagasems la bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal dang dngangs skrag chen po myong dgos byung zer ba'am/ yang na bya ba ga ge mo de'i don la sems khur chen po nyin mtshan mi 'khyol ba zhig myong ba yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la skabs bstun gyis spyod pa yin/ (khams khul )278 nyin dkar lha mor lha las rogs/ mtshan mo 'dre mor thags 'thag rogs/ mdun du dga' nye yin mdog gis rogs ram byed khul dang / rgyab tu dgra bo dang 'grogs nas ngan jus 'god rogs byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bu 'di rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / lha zhes pa ni rang la rogs dang mgon byed mkhan zhig dang / 'dre zer ba ni rang la gegs dang gnod skyel mkhan zhig tu brtsi ba 'di'ang bod rigs kyi goms srol yin/ (a mdo khul ) 279 nyin gyi kha ba bzhu yang / sribakyi 'khyags pa mi bzhu/90

phyi tshul la sngar 'khon zhe 'dzin med pa'i rnam pa ston na yang / sems nang gi 'khon 'dzin las sla por zhi mi srid zer ba lta bu kha 'jam zhe rtsub kyi mi'i phyi'i spyod tshul la yid ches mi rung zhes par spyod pa dang / yang skabs re tshogs pa dang shog kha'i bar gyi gnad don lta bur cha mtshon na/phar phyogs kyi mi khag cig gi sems shi yod na'ang mi la la'i sems da dung shi med zer bar spyad kyang chog pa yin/280 nyin mo lha dang / mtshan mo 'dre/ ngo thug dus 'dzum dmul dmul dang skad cha snyan rgu shod na yang / lkog tu bsam ngan sbyor tsub kyi dbyen sbyor dkrug shing dang / ngan bskul ngan slob sogs gnod sems yod rgu 'chang mkhan gyi mi ngo gnyis ma de rigs la spyod pa'i sting tshig cig yin/ 281 gnyid ma nyal ba'i rmi lam/ don dngos dang rtsa ba nas mi mthun pa'i skad cha dang / 'grub re med pa'i stong bsam sogs de rigs la spyod pa'i 'phya tshig cig yin/282 gnyan dpon lags kyi ko ba de/ chod sa gcig la chod 'gro tshig 'grel/ dbyar chu rgyas che'i skabs phred gtong ko ba de gtong mkhan rang nyid kyi dmigs tshad du gcod mi thub par rgyang thag gang 'tsham bar khyer ba dper byas/don 'grel/ bya ba gang zhig rang gi 'char 'god bzhin ma grub par rgya 'ub ma 'dus pa'i skabs da cha gang la thug kyang thabs shes mi 'dug zer ba lta bu'am/ yang skabs re bya ba sgrub mkhan de la 'jon 91

thang dang gdeng tshod ci yang mi 'dug pas klung rtas gar bskyal red zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyad kyang chog pa yin/282 snying rje po ci ci'i phru gu/ cher longs nas ras phad rtol mkhan/ bu tshab dang / dge phrug sogs chung dus gus gus zhum zhum gyis kha la nyan na'ang / rang mgo thon rjes drin lan log 'jal byed mkhan nam/ yang na de 'dra yong srid zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/284 snyabs pa lag pa su ring / gzhung rgyu'am thun mong gi spyi rdzas la bdag gnyer do dam gang yang med par ham pa su ches khyer nas sger gyi dgos mkhor bed spyod byed pa de rigs la spyod pa'i zur za'i dmod tshig cig yin/ 285 gtam 'dod brel kha mtho na/ mdzo pho stogs grir shi/mchor 'dod dang grags 'dod kyi longs spyod thal drags na/mtha' ma rgyun ldan gyi 'tsho ba'ang skyel mi thub pa zhig yong zer ba'am/khengs dregs che drags na nam zhig gnyen grogs su yang 'khor mkhan med par grogs med khor lus thabs rdugs po zhig yong zer ba sogs la spyad chog pa yin/286 gtor ma chu la skyur na/ bya khyi kho thag chod/ kha gtad phyogs gnyis khe phan gyi thob char ma 'cham pa rtsod pa thug skabs thob cha de dag gzhung thog gam/ spyi rdzas su len rgyu zer ba'am/ yang na bzhes rogs gnang zer ba de rigs la spyod pa yin/92

287 btang na mda' nyan pa/ bkug na gzhu nyan pa/gyong sar gyong ba dang / mnyen sar mnyen pa/ btang 'gro bzhag sdod 'pher zhing / gnas lugs dang mthun pa'i spyod tshul 'dzin thub pa'i pho khyo ga 'jon thang yod pa zhig yin zer ba lta bu'i rigs la spyod cing / dgos zer ba'am/ thon thub zer ba la sogs pa tshig grogs gang 'os skabs dang bstun nas bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'dra/288 rtargan la thog brgyab/ khyi rgan la nyi ma shar/ mchan/bod du rta bong shi ba'i ro khyi la ster ba dang / nyi ma shar zhes pa ni 'dir khe phan yongs su thob pa'i don la go dgos pa'o/ / don 'grel/ khyim tshang zhig la jus nyes chen po zhig byung ba de la brten nas khyim tshang gzhan zhig la khe phan chen po rag song zer ba'am/ yang na dbang cha chen po yod pa'i dpon po zhig gnas dbyung btang ba'i tshab de dpon chung dkyus ma zhig la rag song zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/289 rta rgod ma'i sngon la/ rte'us rgyug shes yon dang cha rgyus yod pa'i mis kha grag pa'am/ bya ba ma byas pa'i gong la4'os bab gang yang med pa'i mis 'di yin dang / de min zhes shod pa'am/yang na 'grig dang mi 'grig ces kha mtshon gcod pa/ 'di dang de byed ces bya ba ngo mar zhugs pa sogs la ma 'os ma 'tsham zhes 'khang ra byed par spyod pa'o/ /290 rta gcig la sga gnyis/ mi gcig gis dus gcig la/93

las ka gcig ma gtogs gnyis byed mi thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / gong du gsal ba'i 6 rgyab gcig la sga gnyis ’ zhes pa dang go don gcig pa yin/291 rta thog nas/ grog ma gzigs pa/ dbang grags ldan pa'i mi chen gyis/ nyam thag pa'i mi la do snang blta skyong gnang ba zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / 'di la drin bsam dang ngo bstod kyi nyams ldan yod/ yang skabs re rta thog nas grog ma mi mthong zhes ldog nas spyod mkhan yang snang ngo / /292 rta pho rgyag che na/ mtha' ma g.yang la sbung / mi ya yug chen po byed mkhan la/ bya ba gang yin yang tshad las brgal te thal drags na/ mtha' 'bras bzang po yong mi srid ces dran bskul byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 292 rta pho thang lasgyug na/ rta dpyad khrom pas gleng / mi so sos rang 'khri'i las ka rnams bstar chags su bsgrubs na/ 'jon thang dang / grub 'bras/ dge skyon sogs ji ltar yod med mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis mjug bsdoms don la gnas pa zhig byed nges yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / so so rang nyid kyis btang btang byas byas sogs sgrog spel byed dgos don med ces shugs la ston gyin yod/ 294 rta pho chas kyis gsos nas/ drin lan 'phra yis 'jal/pha mas bu phrug chung dus nas gces spras kyis gso skyong byas na yang /94

chen po longs rjes pha mar sdang zug byed pa sogs mdor na phar drin gyis bskyangs pa'i mis tshur drin lan log 'jal byed pa de rigs la spyod pa yin no/ / 295 rta pho chen/ yur bar thogs dogs med/ bya ba gang la 'dris shing byang ba'am/ yang na de sgrub pa'i cha rkyen yod pa zhig la/de ring bya ba de sgrub pa'i skabs phrad dus tshad las brgal nas legs sgrub byed thub zer ba'am/ yang na rang nyid kyis gdeng tshod yod pa'i sgo nas legs sgrub bya rgyu yin zer ba sogs la spyod pa'o/ /296 rta pho bres la btags na/ gong thang khrom pas gcod/kho las nga drag dang / su las su yag sogs kha mi 'cham pa byung dus/rang rang gi byas rjes sam grub 'bras rnams gsal bshad byas na/dngos 'brel su legs dang su zhan rgya che'i mang tshogs gleng phyogs kyis dbye ba 'byed rgyu red ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ rang snang bden rloms bya mi rung bar mang che ba'i ngos 'dzin la brtsi 'jog dgos zhes pa'i bden don yang mtshon no/ /297 rta pho la rgyug shed yod na/ byang thang la mu mtha' med/bya gzhag sgrub par nga 'gro ngas 'jon zhes 'tshang kha shig shig byed skabs/ pho gsar tshor shes nus dang 'jon thang yod na/ spyi tshogs kyi phan bde skrun pa'i bya gzhag rdzogs mtha' med ces pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 'on kyang bod rnying par mi la shes nus yod kyang / chos phyogs kyi thad la ma gtogs 'don pa'i yul dang 'don pa'i cha rkyen med pa 95

red/298 rta ma rgyug gong la 'dang rgyob/ sa 'bar 'bur yod sar mnyam 'jog bya ba gang zhig yin na'ang ma brtsams pa'i sngon nas bsam gzhigs legs par bya dgos pa dang / bya bar dngos su gzhug skabs 'gal rkyen yod rigs la nges par du de bas gzab nan bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyad na 'tshams par mngon/ (a mdo khul )299 rta ma chad gong la/ babs na bzang / bya ba gang zhig yin rung yul dus cho skabs la bltas nas/ gnas tshul bzang po med na mtha' la ma lhung gong nas rang sgul gyis phyir 'then nam/ mtshams 'jog sogs gang 'os byas na legs zhes kha ta dran bskul byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/200 rta lam grog mas 'gog pa/ stobs shugs btsan drag can gyi dgra zlar/ gnyod chung nyam thag gis 'gog rgol byas na rang nyid 'phung ba las 'os med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/201 rtas lcang ma za ba/ ras bslabs pa/ byed mi 'os pa'i las ka de sngon la mi gzhan dag gis byas par brten/ de nas khos kyang shes pa red zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na las ka 'di —khyed rang gis byas pa la bltas nas ngas kyang shes byung zer ba sogs la skabs dang bstun nas spyod pa yin/202 rtogs ldan mi gcig lag gcig ngag pa mi mang lag mang / mi mang dpung sgril byas pa'am/ yang na mang sne nyung gis 96

brten par ci bya gtol bral du gyar song zer ba'am/ yang na nga rang mi gcig la las 'gan sne mang rnyog 'dzing yod pa dang / 'brel yod mi sna mang por kha ya byed dgos pā sogs lcogs thabs rtsa ba nas mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyad na yang chog pa yin/202 lta ba lha dang mnyam yang / spyod pa mi dang bstun dgos/ rang nyid shes yon nam/ go gnas/ snyan grags/'byor stobs sogs ji ltar che na yang / spyi tshogs thog 'tsho ba skyel skabs 'brel 'dris dang / spyod tshul/ sgrig srol sogs gang ci spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs mi khyur 'dres pa zhig bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/204 ltag chu chad pa'i jing bu/ yong khungs kyi rgyun zad pa'i dpal 'byor lta bu'am/ yang na rgyab dpung med pa'i dmag sde sogs la spyod pa yin/ 205 lto khyi'i sto la/ las bong bu'i las/ bod rnying pa'i zhing bran dbul phongs rnams kyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/206—1 lto gar zos kyi sgo khri/ lto gang nas ster ba de'i sgo srung ba khyis kyang byed pa ltar rang gi 'tsho ba'am khe phan gyi 'byung khungs gang yin pa de la sha zhen dang / la rgya/ lhag bsam rnam dag bcas ni byed dgos nges shig yin la/ ma byas na mi 'grig pa lta bu de rigs spyod pa yin/206—2 ltogs sla can pa/ dug dang 'phrad/ khe bzang 97

zhig 'thob res 'brel med kyi bya bar the gtogs byas pa la/ mtha' ma gyod gzhi'am chag sgo'i nang tshud pa lta bu de rigs la zur za byed par spyod cing / yang rang gi sogs la ltogs shed kyi khe bzang kho nar rngams pa byed mi nyan zhes bslab bya byed par spyod mkhan yang yod/207 snya re rdo la gzhus na/ sku gyong lcags la phog yong /btsan po'i rgyab rtsa yod pa dang / dbang shugs 'byor stobs can la phog thug btang na/ so so rang nyid la gyong gun rag yong zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/208 stagakha che yang / mid par sor do/ kha gtad phyogs kyi bzang cha kho nar blta rgyu med par de'i zhan cha'i phyogs kyang mthong thub pa bya dgos/ de ltar dbye zhib byed shes na de tsam gyi skrag snang skye dgos don med zer ba lta bur spyod pa 'di rigs la bab chags kyi rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba ldan yod do/ / 209 stag gi rnga ma mi 'jin/ bzung rting slad nas ma glod/mi ngan rengs can dang rtsod 'khrug mi yong ba bya dgos/ gal srid bzlog thabs bral bar 'thab mo bya dgos byung na/ blo thag rbad bcad kyis mtha' ma'i rgyal kha ma 'thob bar du 'dzing mo rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos pa las/ the tshom dang / lhod g.yeng phra mo tsam shor na pham nyes yong nges yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ (mdo khams khul )210 stag mchongs sar wa mchongs na/ wa'i sked chigs bud/ dpa' rtsal dang / shes yon/ 'jon thang sogs gang yin 98

rung byang chub pa'i mis bsgrubs pa'i ngo mtshar can gyi bya gzhag de/khyad yon de dag dang bral ba'i mis lad mo byas te u tshugs kyis sgrub par zhugs na/ ngo tsha dgos pa'i pham nyes shig yong nges yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /211 stag thig le can de nags la song / khyi rnga ma can de shul na lus/ pha bzang po gshegs zin pa'i rjes su bu dman pa lus song zer ba'am/ slob dpon mkhas pa chen po 'das pa'i shul du slob ma blun po lus 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/212 stag lpags du bas tshos kyang / dgu tshan dgu yi gral 'go bod kyi sngar srol la yar 'bul ba'am/ mar legs skyes sogs bstar skabs dngos rigs sna grangs dgu dang / bdun/ lnga/gsum sogs gang rung star du sgrig pa la dgu tshan dang / bdun tshan/lnga tshan sogs zer zhing / dgu tshan zhes pa rgyas shos dang / stag lpags ni thob thang che shos su rtsis nas dang por 'jog pa dper bkod/dona'agrel/ spyi tshogs nang snyan grags brtsi bkur thob pa'i mi sna lo rgas rdzi dibs gyur pa zhig yin na'ang / thams cad kyis bkur sti dang gus zhabs bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /212 stag mo stogs kyang / rang sha mi za/ thabs ji ltar rdugs kyang / rang nyid 'phung la sbyor ba'i bya ngan mi byed zer ba'am/yang na drag gnyen go ldog dang / drin lan log 'jal sogs mio'atshams pa'i bya ba de rigs byed mi srid zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun 99

nas spyod pa yin/214 stag la mchongs chen bco brgyad yod na/ wa la 'dzul khung bcu dgu yod/ khyod la phar rgol byed pa'i thabs shes ji tsam mang po yod na yang / kha gtad phyogs la'ang rang srung byed thabs de las ma nyung ba zhig nges par yod pa shes dgos zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin/215 stag shi yang sder bzhi skam med/ nyams rgud byung na yang / rtsa med du gyur med zer ba'am/ 'gyur mi srid zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin/216 steng rdo non chung na/ 'og rdo 'phar che/ 'go nas 'chun 'doms chung drags na/ gsham 'og nas zing cha bslangs yong zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/217 ston pa'i dbu la byis pa'i lag rtsed/ rtsa 'gangs che ba'i dngos po la/ spyir btang gis lag pa 'chang ba la de ltar byed mi rung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/218 ston bza' kha bye dus/ sbal kha 'grigs/ ston dus rtsi thog kun smin nas bza' bya yongs su 'dzoms pa'i skabs sbal pa'i kha 'byar ba dper bzhag ste/ dus kyi ston mo chen po ran khar byes su thon dgos byung ba'am/ yang na so sogs na bas zas za ma thub pa sogs la kha mtshar du spyod srol yod/219 brtag sgril ma red dngul sgril red/ jo bo ma red byams pa red/ go ming thob thang dang dbang cha sogs bsko bzhag byed 100

dus phyi tshul la drang po drang bzhag byed tshul dril bsgrags byed na yang /don la rgyu rngan rjes 'brangs kho na las mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs lo rgyus le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal bar gzigs/ (lha sa khul )220 thag khra sbrul du mthong ba/ rnam rtog gi dbang du gyur nas dgos med kyi dogs pa dang / 'jigs snang byed pa sogs spyod pa yin/221 thang gi rdo bsgrugs nas/ rum gyi bro lhung / phan med la sred zhen byas nas phan yod kyi bya dngos shor ba'i spyod tshul de lta bu'i rigs la spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul ) 222 thab chung chung la/ me tsha po/ khyim tshang ngam bya gzhag sogs gang yin rung / rgya che khu ma 'dus de 'dra ma yin par gra 'grigs tshags tshud po yod pa de rigs la spyod pa yin/ tshig grogs ni skabs dang bstun nas sbyor dgos/222 thal ba gnam la gtor na/ phyed ka rang gi mgo 'khrug slong sogs thal cha yong nyen gyi bya ba brtsams na/ mtha' 'bras nyams nyen dang chag sgo sogs rang gi mgo la'ang 'bab srid zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 224 thig btang sar/ gye'u mi 'gro ba/ rang gi bsam 'dun gyi 'char gzhi de/ dngos don thog ji bzhin bsgrub pa yong mi srid zer ba'am/ yang na kha nas bshad pa ji ltar lag len du 'khyol 101

dka' mo yin zer ba lta bur spyod srol yod/225 theg thal yang / gye'u ma thal ba/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub skabs tshig thal shor na'ang / da dung don rtsa thag gcod dngos su bya rgyu thal cha ma song ba bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'am/ yang na da lta da dung thabs shes yod zer ba la'ang spyad chog226 thug pa 'thung khar/ tshwas lag thogs/ rang nyid kyis bsam blo sngon thongs ma thub pa'am/ yang na las 'gan 'khur mkhan gyis gra sgrig 'thus tshang ma byung bas bya ba zhig rtsom skabs cha rkyen gal che ba zhig ma tshang bar thebs chag pa'am/ dgos mkho de rin gong mtho po sprad nas pham nyo mi byed ka med bya dgos byung ba sogs kyi skabs spyod pa yin/227 thugs 'dod la rgya yod kyang / 'gram par spu ma skyes/rang blor mtho 'dod dang / mchor 'dod yod kyang / 'jon thang dang dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen mi 'dug zer ba'i mtshar gtam lta bur spyod cing / rang gzhan su la spyad kyang chog pa yin/228 thud 'cho ba/ mar gyi bka' drin yin/ khyim tshang zhig gam/ mi zhig rang mgo thon pa'am/ 'dra chags po byung ba de rang gi byed nus la brten nas byung ba ma yin par/ pha ma'am gnyen tshan bzang po'i rogs skyor la brten nas byung ba zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/229 be'u rang la dbang byungan/ go kha thal bas smyong / mi 102

ngan la dbang cha 'thob na/ mi 'os mi 'tshams pa'i bya ba ci yang byed zer bar spyod pa yin/ 220 them pa'i sgang gi ril ma/ langs phyogs brtan po med pa'am/ rang tshugs mi zin pa'i mi la spyod pa yin zhing / phyi nang ngam dgra gnyen jir 'gyur nges gtan med pas blo gtad dang yid rton mi rung ba mtshon par spyod pa yin/ 221 thog gnya' nang du brgyab/ ber la phyi ru langs/ la phyi ni gnya' nang dang ri bo chen pos chod pa'i sa cha'i ming yin zhing /don rkyen dngos su thon sar rnyog gzhi gang yang byung med kyang / sa gnas gzhan du yod pa'i gnyen tshan sogs kyis nad mi theg pa'i 'ur sgra rgyag pa lta bu'am/ yang na snyad med snyad 'dogs kyi bden khungs rtsa ba nas med pa'i ham bsnyon shod kyi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/222 mthu mi la brgyab/ ltas rang la 'khor/ bsam pa ngan pas mi la gnod skyel gyi bya ba bcoms na yang / nus pa ma thon par/ rang nyid la rkyen ngan 'phrad pa lta bur spyod pa yin/222 mtho gang gi snyob sar/ 'dom gang gis mi snyob pa/gyod gzhi'am/ bya ba gang zhig thog ma las sla po'i thog nas thag chod dam/ sgrub thub pa zhig la byed thabs ma mkhas pa'am/ dkrog rkyen chags pa sogs la brten nas thal cha dang / rnyog gzhi chen por gyur pa la zer ba yin/ chags song ngam/ chags yong sogs tshig grogs 103

skabs dang bstun chog 224 mthong na rtsed mo dang / ma mthong rkyan ma/ mi khram pas bsam bzhin du mi gzhan la brkyangs skum bya rgyu yod pa'i mgo skor gtong thabs spel ba sogs la spyod pa yin/225 dag pa sangs rgyas dang / ma dag dmyal ba/ dkar nag brdar sha bcad nas bden yod bde ba'i lam la 'khod pa dang /nyes can yan por ma shor ba zhig dgos zer bar spyod pa yin/226 dar lcog sdod du/ rlung pos mi 'jog rang gis sdug bsran byas kyang / kha gtad phyogs kyis brnyas bcos gtses bsun btang ste khrims gtugs mi byed ka med byung zer ba'am/ yang na kha gtad do bdag dang mi 'grig pa med kyang / mi gzhan dag gis lkog nas ngan bskul byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur yang spyod pa yin/227 dus la babs na/ sha mos spang rtol/ dngos po'i nang rkyen dang phyi rkyen 'dzoms shing smin pa'i dus su sha mo'i myu gu mnyen po de lta bus kyang spang rtsis bsdams pa'i sa mkhregs po bde blag ngang brtol thub ces dpe bstan te/ mi la las don chen lam seng ma bsgrub par ngang thung 'tshab 'tshub byed pa'am/ yang na yun ring bsgugs nas re thag chad nas sgyid lug byed pa sogs la de ltar bya mi rung zer ba sogs spyod pa yin/ 228 drin can gyi lag la rdos rdung / tshur phan btags pa'i lan la/ phar gnod pa byed pa lta bur spyod pa yin/104

229 dred mos 'phyi ba bzung ba/ dred mo yis 'phyi tshang bsngogs nas 'phyi ba bzung skabs dang po de rkub kyi 'og tu bcug ste gnyis pa bzung bar 'gro skabs snga ma de bros shor de ltar ji tsam bzung yang / mthar thug mjug shos de'ang rag mi rag las mi yong ba dper bkod nas slob sbyong mjug ma slob ring snga ma brjed 'gro ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/240 drog kha nang du slebs pa lces 'phul/ rang nyid la mdzangs ma'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i bza' zla bzang po zhig yod pa dang kha bral ba'am/ rin thang can gyi dngos rdzas shig pham tshong shor ba/don chen bzang po zhig rtsa ba'i cha nas grub zin pa de rang gi byed pa ma mkhas pas chud zos su gyur pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/6 drog ’nyaces pa ni nom pa'am/ dngos grub zhes pa dang 'dra ba'i kha skad kyi brda rnying zhig go/241 gdong la 'bag gon nas/ 'cham mi rgyag ka med/rang skyon gyi nyes mtshang rdol dus dpral ko mthug pos ham shed mi byed ka med chags pa red zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na gnas lugs 'di tsam la gyar skabs ma yin yin mdog mi byed rang byed la thug byung zhes pa lta bu sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin/242 bden pa rang che/ ham pa mi che/ bden pa bden sar 'khyol dka' mo byung ba'i skabs su spyod pa'i dpe zhig yin no/ /242 bden pa lug la yod༅nga / 'chi god lug la byung / 105

khrims gcod pas bster sbyin gyi rjes su 'brangs nas bden rdzun go ldog gi gcod rgya gtong skabs bden yod blo pham gyi smre ngag lta bur spyod pa yin/244 mda' gar brgyab/ rde'u 'dir thon/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub na'ang / kha stong tshig stong ma yin par 'di byas pa'i rjes shul 'di yin zhes ston rgyu yod pa zhig dgos zer bar spyod pa yin/245 mda' rgyag sa yod kyang / gzhu ngom sa med/ kha gtad de rang la cha mtshon na khrims sar gtugs pa'am/ 'thab ra sprod pa sogs ci byas rung chog kyang / de'i gnyen tshan nam nye grogs che ge mo la bltos na de ltar byed thabs med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/246 mda' brgyab pas ma tshad/ gzhu mchog ngoms/247 mdung btsugs pas ma chog ba dan ngoms/ byed mi 'os pa'i bya ba zhig byas pa ma zad/ da dung mi tshogs kyi khrod du ngom ngom 'phyar 'phyar byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ gong gsal dpe de gnyis bshad srol cung zad mi 'dra tsam las/ go don la khyad par med/ 248 mda' gcig gis/ sha ba gnyis bsad pa/ bya ba byed thengs gcig gis/ don dag mi 'dra ba gnyis dus gcig tu 'grub pa la spyod pa yin/ bsad song dang / gsod thub/ gsod dgos zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun nas bsgyur na 'grig249 mda' nye 'ben rgyang med pa/ gcig la nye ba dang /106

gcig la ring ba ma yin pa drang pos gzhung srong ba zhig byed dgos zer bar spyod pa yin/250 mda' la yid ma ches/ mdung la srang gang sprad/ mi gzhan dag la blos ma 'khel bar/ khyed rang la re ba bcol ba yin zer ba lta bur spyod cing / yang skabs re nga la yid ma ches par khyed la mngags pa red ces par yang spyod pa ni/ tā la'i bla ma bdun pa'i yang srid brtsad gcod ched gong ma chan lung gis lcang skya bod du mngags par rdo ring paṇḍi tas dpe 'di bshad tshul rdo ring gi byung ba brjod pa'i nang gsal yod pa lta bu'o/ / 251 mda' shes nas/ gzhu nyos pa/ dpal 'byor yod nas tshong brgyab pa zer ba'am/ khrims lugs shes nas kha mchu brgyab pa zer ba/ dpa' rtsal yod nas dmag sna khrid pa zer ba lta bu sogs la spyod cing / yin dang / red zer ba tshig grogs bsgyur nas rang gzhan gnyis kur sbyar chog252 mdun la mi dang / rgyab la 'dre/ mdun la kha mkhas mdza' grogs kyi rnam pa kho na ston yang / rgyab tu ngan sems kyis gnod pa 'ba' zhig skyel ba'i ngo gnyis pa la spyod pa yin/252 mdun la so dkar gyi 'dzum/ rgyab la khro gnyer gyi sul/ dngos su 'phrad dus 'dzum dkar gyis bsu na yang / rgyab slog ma thag ngan smras khro tshig gi lkog lab rgyag mkhan la spyod pa yin/254 mdog dang bro ba mi mtshungs pa/ spyir na phyi'i rnam pa 107

dang nang gi ngo bo rgyab 'gal du gyur pa la zer ba dang / dpe 'di ni phyi'i snang tshul las/ nang gi don snying legs pa'am/ gyong ba/'jon pa/ mthong chung byed mi rung zer ba lta bu de rigs la gtso bor spyod pa yin no/ /255 'dam brgya shog brgyad kyi dpon po yin/ nga ra'i dpon po nang na yod/ khyim tshang gi nang bza' zla bud med kyis gang bshad ltar la nyan dgos pa'i skyes par zur za byed skabs spyod pa yin zhing / 'dam brgya shog brgyad ces pa ni go shri han gyi skabs sog dmag gi ru shog bca' sdod byed yul byang gnam mtsho'i lho 'dabs su yod/ da lta grong khyer lha sa'i khongs 'dam gzhung rdzong zer/256 'dus pa pa lo dang / ma 'dus sil ma/ phyogs gnyis dbar 'dum thabs byed skabs/ 'grig re yod pa rnams gang thub ci thub kyis 'grig thabs dang / mi 'grig pa rnams gnas skabs rang bab tu bzhag nas 'gal rkyen che ru mi 'gyur ba bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 257 'dogs thag a long nas grol ba/ gnad don nam/dogs gzhi ci yin rung / 'byung khungs sam phugs rtsa nas gsal rtogs yong ba la spyod pa yin/ grol song ngam/ grol ba zhig dgos sogs skabs dang bstun nas sbyar chog258 'dra po yod༅nga / 'grig po med pa/ phar bltas na 'dra chags po lta bu zhig yod na'ang / zhib tu bsam zhing brtag dpyad 108

byed dus bden pa ma yin pa'i mngon tshul mthong ba de rigs la spyod pa yin/259 'dre shar du gnas/ glud nub la brdzangs/ bya thabs gnad du ma 'khel ba ma zad/ rbad de ga phyi log pa de 'drar spyod pa yin/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis 〈〈gsung mgur shar gangs ri ma 〉〉nang du'ang / ‘6'dre shar sgo'i phyogs su gnas pa la/ glud nub sgor gtong ba don re chung ’ zhes dpe 'di spyad gnang yod/260 rdo ma gzhus na/ sa mi zags/ khyod kyis dkrog rkyen de ma bzos na/ rtsod gzhi 'di yong mi srid zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na ngas ther 'don de ma byas na/ khos ngos len byed mi srid zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun nas spyod dgos/261 rdo rje go khar sgung na/ bu chung gi rtsed chas/ bla ma babs log byung ba'am/ dpon po gnas dbyungs phog pa sogs mang tshogs dang mnyam 'dres skabs brtsi bkur byed mkhan rang shugs kyis med par 'gyur ba de rigs la spyod pa yin/262 rdog khres spyan 'bebs zhus na/ a ma lags dgongs pa dngas/ gnas tshul yongs rdzogs zhib gsal gsed sgrol byas na dogs gzhi byed dgos don med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ dpe 'di'i yong stangs ni gnas tshang zhig nas dngos po brlag pa 'grul pa gcig la dogs pa byed pa na/ khos rdog khres bshig nas zhib bsher byed du bcug ste bshad pa'i skad cha yin par snang /109

262 ldan ma'i stong / ji tsam sprad na yang 'phrod dus med pa bod rnying pa'i zhing bran gyi ba lon lta ba de rigs la zer ba yin/rang rangadape 'di'i byung tshul le tshan bzhi pa'i nang gsal yod/265 sdig pa mthong dus/ sbal pa lha la mngon/ mthar thug pa'i mi ngan zhig dang thug dus/ rgyun gtan mi sdug cag la brtsi ba de tsho yang / a'u tsam 'dug snyam pa'i tshor snang byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ sdig pa ni 'bu srin sdig pa ra tsa la zer/265 sdug thang nas blangs te/ thod la khur/ dka' ngal dang sems sdug gi 'byung rtsa 'di nyid rang so sos ched mngags kyis dang du blangs te nyos pa zhig rang yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / bdag gzhan dus gsum sogs skabs dang bstun chog pa gzhan dang 'gre'o/ /266 sdug bong bus myong / chag rta phos za/ dka' ngal mi ser gyis brgyab pa'i 'bras bu longs spyod dpon po sogs kyis byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/267 sdong po bskyur nas/ yal garacus bshad/ don gyi snying por g.yol nas/ g.yas bshad g.yon bshad byas te nyi ma skyel thabs byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/268 sdod sa dpral bar bsdad/ mig la thal ba bsho /gnyen nye sogs rang dang 'brel ba yod pa'i mis/ mi 'os pa'i gnod pa skyel ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 110

269 na 'dred/ spang thogs med pa/ na la 'dred po dang /spang la thogs song zer ba med pa zhes bod rnying par 'brog pa'i khral 'bab dus bka' las ma 'gyangs par 'jal dgos zer ba'i don yin pas/ ka kor shod sa med zer bar spyod pa yin/270 nag mo'i long gtam gyis/ rta pa'i nyin lam 'gogabud med kyi skad cha rdzogs rgyu med pa des/ dus tshod chud zos su ma gtong zer ba lta bur spyod pa ste/ 'dir bud med la ma thong chung byed pa'i goms srol gyi mtshon tshul yod/ ('brog khul )271 nang la rtsam pa med par/ sge khung rtsam ral yog yogarang rang gi 'khos 'byor dang bstun pa las/ med bzhin yod mdog gi gtam 'dod byed mi nyan zer ba'am/ yang na dbul pos mtshar 'dod byed kyi 'dug ces 'phya ba la spyad kyang chog— 272 nad pa nad theg nas/ em chi nad mi theg pa/dper na bar 'dum byas pa'i thag gcod la do bdag gis khas blangs pa'am/ len rtsis yod na'ang / 'brel yod gnyen tshan nam grogs po sogs kyis khas len byed du mi 'jug pa lta bu la spyod pa yin/272 nam 'dra 'dra langs nas/ sbyad pa su la g.yar/dper na yul gyi dus chen slebs dus rgyan gos g.yar dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/274 nam tshod bya phos bzung / ngo so bong bus khyer/bya ba dngos de mi gzhan gyis bsgrubs na yang / gong rim mam yang na 111

spyi tshogs thog rang nyid kyis byas pa yin khul byed mkhan de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 275 nam ring sgrung gis mi 'khyol/ yun ring gi dka' sdug bzod bsran ji ltar byas kyang 'khyol thabs mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/276 nam lang khar nyal gcin shor/ bya ba gang zhig 'go brtsams pa nas bzung ha cang legs par sgrub pa byung na'ang / las mjug bsgril khar jus nyes tshabs chen zhig shor ba lta bur spyod pa yin no/ /277 nam langs pa/ sbar mos mi khebs/ kun shes yongs grags su 'gyur nges yin pa'i bya ba zhig sba gsang bya rtsis byed pa ni sgrub thabs med pa zhig yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /278 gnam ka med 'og ga rgod po mabyer med/ byang thang du dpung shed ngoms nas khrims med byed mkhan gyi jag dpon nam/yang na ltag rtsa ngoms nas spyi tshogs thog bya ba ngan rgu byed kyang /gcun 'doms byed mkhan med pa'i mi ngan de rigs la spyod pa yin/279 gnam mgo la gyon/ sprin pas og sgrog rgyag khengs dregs kyi spobs pa mtho pos gsham 'og gi gnas tshul ci yang mi shes pa'i blun po rang mthong can la 'phya dmod byed pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin no/ /280 gnam rdo sa la sbung na/ thab rdo mi byed rang byed/ bla 112

ma babs log byung ba'am/ dpon po gnas dbyungs phog pa sogs yin na/ mi ser dkyus ma dang mnyam du khral 'ul sogs 'khel rung /mi rgyug rang rgyug yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ (gnam rdo ni skar rdor zer )281 gnam sdod mkhan dang / sprin pa 'gro mkhan/ gong du gsal ba'i ‘6chu 'gro mkhan dang / gram pa sdod mkhan ’nyazhes pa de dang go don spyod yul bcas gcig pa yin/282 gnam la rdog rgyag gzhus na/ ltag khung rdo la brdab yong / dbang shugs can la gyen rgol byas na nus pa thon rgyu phar bzhagarang nyid la rdung rdeg dang gyong gun phog yong zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/282 rnam rtog dgrar langs/ khang stong rkyan ma sdang /rnam rtog mang drags na/ rgyu rkyen gang yang med par dogs pa za nas rang nyid blo bde ba'i go skabs phra mo tsam mi yong zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 2ra4 gnas tshang g.yar bas ma chog gnas bshad/dper na mi la /las dngos chas rang la med par gzhan nas g.yar na'ang / g.yar dngos la mtho bshad dma' bshad byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/285 rnam rtog can la/ 'dre rgya 'khor/ go don gong du 'dra mtshungs yin zhing / 'dis rkyen pa min nam/ des byas pa min nam zer ba lta bu dgos med yod tshad la rnam rtog za ba de rigs bya mi 113

rung zer ba la spyod pa yin/ 286 sna thag mi la shor ba/ bya ba gang zhig rang gi 'dod pa ltar thag gcod mi thub pa mi gzhan la 'dri dgos pa'am/ bstun dgos pa ma zad/ gzhan gyis thag bcad pa de ma 'dod bzhin du byed dgos pa lta bu la spyod pa yin/ rang gzhan su la sbyar yang chog sna phub pa'i phyugs rigs dper byas pa gong dang 'dra/287 snam bu dkar po'i chos mdog gang la sgyur sgyur/gcig nas bcos su yod pa'i mi dang bya ba la spyod pa dang / gnyis nas rang tshugs med par gzhan gyis gang byas la 'gro ba'i yid brtan med zer ba lta bu la'ang spyod pa skabs bstun blta dgos/288 snam chong pa dang / dor chad pa/ gcig la lhag nas bsdad pa de/ gcig la chad nas dgos pa gnyis tag tag stabs 'khel byung ba de 'dra la spyod pa yin/289 snam bu 'dom pa gang gis/ zhwa gos lham gsum/'gro gron nyung nyung las ma btang bar/ rgyas gshom chen po dgos 'dod byed mkhan la 'phya ba'i sting tshig lta bur spyod pa yin/290 snod zhabs rdol la chu blugs pa/ shes yon sogs ji tsam bslabs na'ang / yid la mi 'jags shing don la mi phan pa de rigs spyod pa rang gzhan su la sbyar yang chog 291 pa phrug chab chab byung na/ dbus mo chab chab yong /sgrub sla ba'i cha rkyen de 'dra zhig la ha las rgyu dang / ngo mtshar che rgyu ci 114

yang med zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin/292 pad 'dzoms rtag par ngu bar/ rnamartog brtsi rgyu gang yod/ rtag tu mi la kha ngan dang tshig ngan kho na shod mkhan la phar yang 'dzems bya byed dgos don med zer bar spyod pa'i 'phya tshig cig yin/292 dpa' bo'i zil mthong dus/ sdar ma'i jus thor/khrims ra'am/ yang na kha gtad dang gdong gtugs pa 'gag rtsar thug dus ci shod 'di shod med par 'tshag ge 'tshig ge byed pa lta bu la spyod pa yin/ (mdo khams khul )294 dpon phyir bltas slog pa dang / g.yog sked gzer byed pa/ stabs ha cang ma legs pa zhig tag tag 'khel nas chag sgo'am/ nyams nyen phog pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/295 spang skya thag chod kyang / ri bong sngo dri ma sangs/bza' tshang tha dad dam/ yang na las gnas dang kha bral zin na yang /da dung khyim tshang rnying pa'am/ bya gzhag rnying pa der zhen chags byed pa lta bu la spyod pa yin/ 296 sru mi mthun sa la/ gra sdebs don med/ blo yid mi mthun pa'i mi la/ mnyam las byed don med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 297 spu gri'i so la byugs pa'i sbrang rtsi/ kha snyan tshig 'jam gyi bslu brid byed pa'i khog na gnod sems gdugs pa can zhig bcangs yod pa lta bur spyod pa yin/115

298 spos mdong jag pas khyer yang / 'gro sa bla ma dkon mchog bya ba gang zhig gnas skabs kyi thob shor ji ltar byung na'ang /mthar thug gi 'bab sa gcig pa yin pas khyad par med zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin/ 299 sprungashargas nas mthol bshags/ rang gi ngan shugs kyi nus pa yongs rdzogs shor zin pa'i mi ngan gyis sngar byas la 'gyod sems skye khul byed pa zhes dmod tshig sgrog pa la spyod pa yin/400 sprung kirta zan/ lug ros mi0gas/ lkog rngan chen po zos nas lang la shor ba'i dpon ngan gyis 'bul rten chung chung la do snang byed mi srid zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/401 sprung ki'i kha nas lug ro/ rag thabs rtsa ba nas med pa'i re stong byed pa lta bu la spyod pa yin no/ /402 spyangasha ma stogs tsam dang / lu gu ma shi tsam/ 'di ni phyogs phan tshun gnyis kur rgyal pham chen po rang med par lta rtogs byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod srol yod cing / dpe'i tshig zin thog nas bshu gzhog byed mkhan dang bshu gzhog myong mkhan bar la phan tshun bsam shes sam/ phan tshun lta rtogs bya dgos zer ba ni bshu gzhog lam lugs srung skyong byed pa'i dpe ngan zhig yin pa shin tu gsal /402 sprung phrug gsos nas/ sgo khri mi nyan/ mi gzhan gyi phru gu chung gsos byas kyang / chen po longs rjes phan mi thogs zer ba'am/phan thogs ma byung zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/ 116
