404 sbyi thug la/ sger tshwa mi rgyag rang don ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i bag chags 'di ni da lta'ang khyab chen po yam̐d/ bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha la lar/ rgyal po glang dar gsod mkhan brtsad gcod skabs mi zhig gis/ ‘‘mi nag can zhig yer pa'i brag phug na 'dug ste/nga spyi thug la sger tshwa mi rgyag ’ ces bshad tshul gsal yod/ 405 sprang khyi thog khar btags na/ nam mkha'i bya la yab/ma rabs mtho sar bskyal na/ mi 'tshams pa'i tho co byed yong zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin/406 zang po'i bra wang / snyan thog la bzhag na spam/ bya ba'am/ gtam bshad sogs 'dra chags thogu la bzhag na yag po 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod cing / bya rgyu'am bshad rgyu mang drags na mi rnams zhe khrel ba'am/ rna ba bsun pa zhig las mi yong zer ba shugs la bstan pa'o/ /407 sprang pos sprang rtags ma bstan na/ rgyal po'i sras dang nor dogs yod/ mi ma rabs 'tshogs dus/ thog mar 'dra chags mdog kha po byed na'ang / bza' btung spyod pa dang / bshad res gtug res byed skabs ring por ma thogs pa rang tshul rjen par thon yong zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 4༷8 sprin dkar po tshad du btsugs/ sa nag po 'dom la 'jal/ sa thag ring po zhig nas/ dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis 'ongs pa yin zer ba'am/ 'gro dgos zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/117

409 sprin byi'u mgo tsam med par/ thog rta mgo tsam/bden cha til 'bru tsam med pa'i rdzun gtam ha las dgos pa kho na shod kyin 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/410 spre'us 'khrab pa las/ seng ges 'gyings pa mtshar/shes yon med pa'i mis brgya bshad stong 'khrab byas pa las/ shes yon ldan pa'i mis kha ma grag rung / mgo bo 'jog tsam byas pa de rin thang ngam gzi brjid che zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/411—1 pha rgod po sha gzan la/ bu khwa ta skyag gzan/mi bzang po'i rjes shul 'dzin mkhan ngan pa la sting tshig sgrog par spyod pa'i a mdo khul gyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe'o/ /411 — 2 pha spun dgra la langs kyang / rus pa gser/pha ma spun mched dbar mi mthun pa chen po ji tsam byung na'ang / mi gzhan dang mi 'dra bar rigs rus gcig gyur gser dang mtshungs pa de la 'gyur ba med pas zhe gnag 'khon 'dzin bya mi rung zer ba'am/yang na don chen 'gag la thug dus gcig sgril bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 412 pha tsan dag sdong po la/ bu chu shing 'um bu/ pha bzang po'i shul bu ngan pas bzung ma thub zer ba la spyod cing / yang bla ma bzang po la slob ma ngan pa byung ba dang / chab srid kyi las shul 'dzin mkhan yag po ma byung ba sogs la spyad na yang chog412 pha yul narta brgya/ rang 'gro dus rkang thang / rgyu118

nor dang gnyen grogs sogs mthun rkyen mang po yod kyang / dgos pa'i dus su ma phan pa la spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re mi yod yod mang gi 'bor shob kho na shod mkhan la zur za lta bur spyod pa'ang thos/ 414 pha yis bu la/ dug chu/ de ni dpe mi srid pa ste/dogs pa gtan nas byed mi dgos zer bar spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re blos bkal sa nas ched mngags mgo skor btang ba sogs la'ang spyad chog pa ni tshig grogs kyis 'gyur 'gro ba yin/415 pha rigs bu la ma rgyugs na/ ri bung la shor to ga nas yong / bya spyod dam/ gshis lugs/ gtam brjod sogs gang rung nas pha dang bu 'dra po yod pa la zer zhing / de yang ngan pa'i phyogs nas mtshungs pa la spyod pa'i smad tshig la ma gtogs/ bzang phyogs la spyad na mi 'grig pa mtshungs chos shor to zhes pa las gsal po rtogs dgos so/ / 416 pha yul shor yang / pha skad mi shor/ gnas dus ci 'dra zhig gi 'og tu'ang / rang tshugs kyi la rgya mi 'dor zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang /417 phag pa dbyar lam la ma chud pa/ khrims srol dang sgrig lam rang 'khur byed pa'i bsam pa med par gang byung byed kyi 'dug ces gshe gshe gtong skabs spyod pa yin/418 phag pas bltas na phag tshang gzhal yas khang / mthong rgya dang thos rgya med pa'i mis rang gi mig snga'i snang tshul tsam la yid tshim 119

pa'i blo sbug dog po byed par sun 'byin phyir spyod pa mang zhing /skabs re rang gi yod tshad yag po yin zer mkhan la zur za byed par spyod pa yang yod/419 phan ma thogs na/ kha nang gi so yang phud/ gces skyong byas pa'i bu phrug gam gnyen 'khor sogs kyis kha la mi nyan par bya log spyod log sogs byas tshe phyir 'bud dam/ yang na skyid sdug tha dad byed 'os zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang / 420 phar ri'i lci ba med/ tshur ri'i slel po med/ thog mar phyogs gang thad nas phan pa yong rgyu'i re ba 'char na yang /mtha' ma 'bras bu gang yang ma smin pa'i dpe la spyod pa mang zhi nga /skabs re phyogs gcig rang brten na legs pa las/ re ba nyis 'dzugs byas na mthar thug gnyis ka med pa zhig yong zer ba lta bur yang spyod srol yod/421 phar 'gro brgya dang / tshur yong stong / 'di ni bod rnying par gzhung lam 'khel yul mi ser tshos rta khal 'u lag tshad med rgyug dgos pa'i sdug skad rgyag skabs spyod pa mang zhing / de min su yin dang 'dis byas zhes shod tshod ga la yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa'ang yod/422 phar song gi mi la/ tshur yong gi gtam/ ched gnyer gyis ma ngags pa'i mi la ched don de'i skor 'di byas 'di byung gi lan zhig nges par dgos zer ba'am/ yang na bshad rgyu med pa ci yin zhes 120

pa sogs la spyod pa yin/422 phu ganganas bskorakrang / mda' gling burdzong / skad cha bskor bshad ci 'dra byas na'ang / dmigs sa gcig rang las mi 'dug zer bar spyod pa mang / gling bu rdzong ni lha sa'i byang ngos dog sde'i nang gi gsum mdo khar yod/ (lha sa khul )424 pho rgod kyang rgyab la dpung gcig dgos/ dpung stobs mi do bar glen ngar gyi 'dzing mo byed mi rung zer ba dang /skabs re mi sger dpa' bo'i ring lugs la zur za byed par spyad kyang chog425 pho rgod po rang gis ma 'jon na/ mtshon non po dgra bo'i nom pa yin/ bya ba gang dang gang yin na'ang / gtso bo rang nyid kyi 'jon nus la rag lus pa las cha rkyen gzhan dag ni thag gcod rang bzhin ldan pa'i rgyu rkyen ma yin pa ma zad/ da dung ldog phyogs su 'gyur ba'ang yong srid ces pa lta bur zer/426 lo rgyan shor ngus pas la mi dag rang thog tu babs pa'i bya bar ka kor dang / bsnyad 'dogs sogs byas na khungs 'khyol thabs med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/427 pho byes song gi dman yul rdung / yul tsho'am/khyim tshang sogs gang rung gi 'go 'dzin nam/ go thang rgod hrag gi mi ma bsdad pa'i skabs su sde tsho'am/ mi gzhan gyis tshur rgol dang brnyas bcos byas byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/428 pho rog gi tshang la/ skyungaka'i bya ra/ 'gan 'khri dang 5 121

'brel ba spu tsam med pa'i mis ched gtad kyis bya ba 'di la the jus byed dgos don rtsa ba nas med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 429 phyi gos chen rtsam khug nang yug rtsam skam sog bod rnying pa'i dpon ngan gyi phyi dbyibs dang nang don ga phyi log pa la zur za byed pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/420 phyi ltar g.yang mo khyu gcig nang ltar ma re bu re/phar bltas na phyogs khag gi la rgya de dag gcig gyur lta bu zhig tu snang yang / don dam la khyim tshang so so'i khe gyong de rang rang tha dad yin pas rnam pa la brten nas ngo bo'i rgyu rkyen 'khrul mi rung zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 421 phyi bshig gi sta re las/ nang bshig gi ste'u thu/ phyi yi dgra bo las/ nang nas thon pa'i dgra bo de gnod pa ldab mang pos che ba yong bas/ nang gi dgra bo la dogs gzon de bas lhag pa bya dgos zer ba yin/ 422 phyi'i char pa las/ nang gi thigs pa sdug phyi phyogs kyi kha dgra las/ nang khul gyi mug bshad rdzogs rgyu med pa de thu ba 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 422 phyi'i char thag chod kyang / nang gi thigs thag mi chod/phyi phyogs kyi gyod don thag chod zin na'ang / nang khul gyi le lan su la chags sa sogs kyi bda' 'ded zhib bsher bya rgyu bsdad yod zer ba'am/ yang na nang tshags nga min kho yin gyi rtsod rnyog thag chod rgyu mi 122

'dug zer ba sogs skabs bstun gyis spyad na'ang 'grig424 phye rkyal bong la bltas nas za lugs/ rang gi dpal 'byor gnas bab la bstun nas zas gos/ gnas lam/ 'gro 'dug spyod gsum gyi longs spyod bya dgos pa las/ yod tshad gzhan la 'gran zla byed mi rung zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /425 'phan po bas dmag mi 'jon/ mi khyod kyis sam/yang na khos bya ba 'di rtsa ba nas sgrub mi thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs lo rgyus le tshan drug pa'i nang gsal yod/ (lha sa khul )426 'phur sa gnam yin yang / 'bab sa sa/ gnas skabs bros byol dang / gab yib sogs gang du byas na yang / mthar thug 'khor sa rang gi khyim tshang ma gtogs med zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/427 ba ma shi rnyang ma rgyun mi 'chad/ gyod gzhi'am/gnad don de rtsa ba yongs rdzogs thag chod pa zhig ma byung na/ rnyog dra rgyun mi 'chad pa thon rgyu nyag cig yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin /428 ba mo dbyar 'jo/ dgun nas gso/ bya ba gang zhig yin rung / rjes yong sngon dran gyi gra sgrig tshags su tshud pa zhig snga sa nas bya dgos zer ba de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 429 ba mo med pa'i mar dkrog 'byung khungs med pa'am/yong sa mi shes pa'i ya mtshan gyi bya dngos la zer ba yin zhing / rang 123

shugs las gang nas byung ba yin nam zhes pa'i 'dri gzhi zhig mtshon gyin yod/ 440 ba mo bsad pa las/ bzhos pa dga'/ 'di ni bod rnying par mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyis zhing bran la 'dzin pa'i shod stangs shig dang / byed stangs shig yin/ 'tsho skyong gi ming btags nas shi 'dod kyang shi mi 'jug pa'i jus ngan zhig spel gyin yod/441 bang med kyang / thu ba gzengs gzengs/ rang nyid la kha mchu rgyag rgyu sogs kyi cha rkyen med na yang / pha rol pas sdod du ma bcug par brten kha gtad mi gcog ka med byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re don la phan nus med kyang / rgyab skyor gyi rnam pa tsam bstan pa'am/ yang na ston dgos zer ba sogs la spyad na'ang chog 442 bu skyes nas/ ming btags chog bya ba legs sgrub byas zin rjes gzhi nas grub 'bras gtan 'khel byed chog ces pa lta bu ste/ stong gtam dang sbor shob sngon la shod mi nyan zhes zur za byed pa sogs la spyod pa yin/ 442 bu ga can la lhan pa/ bya dngos gang yin rung /dgos nges gyi thog la gnad du 'khel ba zhig dgos zer ba lta bur spyod par sna nga /444 bu mo skyo sar/ a mas mi phan/ rjes yong sngon dran gyi bsam gros gra sgrig dgos pa las/ gzhan yul lam gzhan gyi mdun 124

sar chag sgo 'phrad skabs rang yul gyi mthun rkyen bzang po ji tsam yod rung / dgos sar phan mi yong zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/445 bu mo la bshad nas/ mna' ma la go ba/ skad cha 'ga' shas thad kur shod mi bde la/ bshad kyang phar phyogs nas dang len byed dka' ba rnams shod bde ba'i mi gzhan zhig la bskor nas bshad de/ shod yul ngo ma des rang shugs kyis rang nyid la zer ba de go thub pa bya dgos zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 446 bu mo rang yul la log par/ gza' dang skar ma/rtag par yang yang byed bzhin pa'i bya ba la rnam rtog dang / gzab nan de 'dra dgos don med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ de las bod mis bya ba gang dang gang la'ang gza' skar rtags rten sogs brtsi ba'i yul goms yod pa shugs las mthong thub/447 1 bong bu bzhon nas/ bong bu 'tshol ba/ dper na mi grangs ji tsam yod brtsi skabs rang nyid grangs khongs su brtsi rgyu brjed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung tshul le tshan drug pa'i nang gsal yod/447she 2 bong bu 'gro thog la 'ded dgos/ tshong las/bya ba/ spyod tshul sogs gang yin rung / 'gro rgyug che dus mu mthud nas shugs chen gyis dar spel gtong dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyad na chog44〈 bong bu sngon dang / sa thal rjes/ sa thal ni 125

'khyags pa'i thog rta bong sogs mi 'dred pa'i ched sa bsho ba la zer/bya ba sngon la bsgrubs nas thabs shes rjes su gzhi nas byed pa lta bu ste/ bya rim snga phyi rbad de go log pa'i glen spyod rigs la zur za byed pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 449 bong bu bslangs par yag byung med par/ gzhu gu bkog pa'i ya la/ mi gzhan la rang nus kyi rogs ram byas par bsam shes kyis thugs rje che zer rgyu phar bzhag da dung rkyen rtsa phra mor ma 'grig ma 'thus mang po shod kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing /dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs len tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/450 bong bu'i rna bar/ gser blug pa/ rgyu mtshan ji tsam bshad kyang / go shes rtsa ba nas med pa'i mi'am/ yang na shes yon med pa'i mi la rig pa'i gnad zab mo ji ltar bshad rung / phan thogs gtan nas med ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/451 bong bur nyal lugs bco brgyad yod na/ tshong par slong stangs bcu dgu yod/ kha gtad phyogs la bya thabs ji tsam mang ba yod na/ rang la de lan 'jal thabs de bas mang ba zhig yod ces par spyod pa 'di ni dbang sgyur pas shod stangs yin zhing / gong du ‘ stag la mchong chen bco brgyad yod na ’ zer ba ni dbang bsgyur myong mkhan phyogs kyis spyod pa yin no/ /452 bong bus ma phyin/ lam 'phrang mang / khyed rang gis mthong ma myong ba dang / thos ma myong ba'i bya dngos sam shes bya/126

gnas lugs sogs ha cang mang po yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa'i zur za'i gtam dpe zhig yin/452 bong bus gzig spags gyon pa/ med par yod brdzu dang / mi shes par shes khul sogs g.yo brdzu de rigs byed pa la spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs gtam rgyud le tshan drug pa'i khongs su gsal yod/454 bya brgya shar blta/ pha wang nub blta/ mi gzhan dag kun gyi byed stangs dang rgyab 'gal tag tag byed pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs gtam rgyud le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/ 455 bya de pho med kyang / nam mkha' lang / khyed rang med na'ang ha las rgyu med/ nga tshos byed dgos pa'i bya gzhag mtha' dag rgyun ldan ltar byed kyi red zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/456 bya pho rum la bcug kyang / bya sgro mchan nas bud/sbas sbas bsub bsub byas kyang / rjes ngan 'gebs srung mi thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul )457 bya byed mang na/ byed rkang chag bya rgyu byed rgyu mang drags na/ mtha' ma chag sgo chen po dang 'phrad yong zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 458 bya ma 'drog par/ sgo nga lon thabs/ kha gtad phyogs sam/ nye 'khor sogs la dogs 'drog mi 'ong ba'i thabs 127

mkhas kyi sgo nas rang gi 'dod don de 'grub thabs bya dgos zer bar spyod pa yin/ 459 bya med na/ bong bus nam chod/ gal te rgyun gtan bya ba de sgrub mkhan gyi mi de da lta bsdad med na/ de'i tshab ngas go chod pa zhig ma byas rang byas yin zer ba'am/ yang na kho bsdad med ces las ka de sgrub mi thub par 'jog gi ma red zer ba lta bu gang rung la spyod pa yin/ 460 bya med kyang / bong bus nam chod byed/ tshogs pa'i 'go 'dzin nam/ slob dpon sogs sngon ma de med pa'i rjes su rang ngos nas khong gi shul 'dzin byed sgo rnams mthud ma shor tsam byed bzhin yod ces pa lta bur spyod pa mang /461 byang mkhan gyi a ma stogs grir mi shi/ sems nad kyis shi/ bod rnying par byang mkhan thag shur zer ba'i khral zhig rgyug dgos par khral rten sa zhing yag po yod rung / nyen kha shin tu chen po yod pa dper bzhag ste khe bzang yag po yod kyang / nyen kha'i sems khur chen po 'khur dgos zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs le tshan bzhi pa'i khongs gsal/ 462 byang tshwa kha nor bu'i bang mdzod/ snyab pa lag pa su ring / rang gis 'bad brtson dang / blo nus/ 'jon thang sogs 'don thub na bsgrub bya'i don de la 'dzad mtha' dang dmigs tshad sogs gang yang med par/ ci 'dod gang mos ltar lag thog tu 128

blangs chog chog yin zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/462 byang tshwa lon dang / g.yag gu shi/ yang na 'dod don de legs sgrub bya rgyu dang / yang na rang srog blos gtong bya dgos byung rung phangs sems med ces ya yud chen po zhig bya rgyu zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang ‘ 464 byi la gnyid la shor yang / bsam rgyu bye'u/ dus dang gnas skabs gang 'dra zhig la'ang / 'dod don ga ge mo de kho na ma gtogs/ bsam rgyu dang dran rgyu gzhan mi 'dug ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / pho mo'i dga' grogs kyi thad la sbyor srol mang bar snang /465 byu ru dmar po'i khog pa/ stong skud nag pos bskyangs/mi sems drang gi khog par g.yo can gzhan gyis jus ngan bskul ba la brten nas rnyog gzhi byung ba yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/466 byung nam mkha' dang / thim sa gzhi/ 'di ni char dang kha ba dper bzhag ste spyi thog la gang byung ba rnams bar lag bor brlag med pa spyi phan rang gi thog la btang ba yin zhes pa'am/ yang na gtong dgos/ phab pa zhig bzo dgos zer ba sogs bdag gzhan dus gsum skabs dang bstun nas spyod pa yin/467 bye ma gcir nas mar khu/ yong thabs rtsa ba nas med pa'i re stong sgug pa zer ba'am/ yang na de lta bu'i re ba nam yang byed kyi med zer ba lta bu la'ang spyod pa yin/468 bye'u skyo yang / 'bu thub/ kha thabs ji ltar zhan 129

na'ang / rang nyid las nyam thag pa zhig mthong na thub tshod kyi brnyas bcos byed zer ba lta bur spyad na 'grig469 byel chung gsung skad snyan yang / sku shagro srang do/ phyi dbyibs 'dra chags po 'dug kyang / dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi ha cang nyams thag pa zhig las mi 'dug ces pa lta bu 'phya dmod kyi shod stangs la spyod pa yin/ 470 bre srang logs la bzhag nas/ mar la spom tshod/ gtan la phab pa'i grangs tshad sogs phra zhing zhib pa zhig kun shes yongs grags su yod pa zur du bzhag ste/ rang 'dod sgom g.yor gyi tshod rtsis byed dgos don ci yod ces pa lta bu zur za'i gtam dpe zhig yin/471 bla mas ci gsung ma shes gong / grwa pas 'don dbyangs ldir ri ri/ sgrig srol lam lugs dang 'gal nas 'go mjug med pa'i spyod tshul la zur za byed par spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul ) 472 bla ma'i mar/ bla ma'i khris zos/ bya ba de la gzhan gyis the gtogs dang / klan ka byed dgos don med zer ba'am/yang na de ni ma 'tsham na yang 'os pa zhig red ces zur za byed pa lta bur spyad na yang chog pa skabs dang bstun dgos/472 bla ma mjal thog la chos/ rang gis zhu dgos pa'i re 'dun nam/ 'dri dgos pa'i dka' gnad lta bu brjod yul gyi mi de ched du ma btsal bar 'phrad skabs 'dod don ma bshad gong de ltar spyod pa'am/ yang 'phrad dka' ba'i mi zhig 'phrad skabs bshad rgyu gang 130

yod shod kyi yin zer ba'am/ yang na mi gzhan la shod dgos zhes bskul ma byed pa sogs la spyad na'ang chog474 bla mas gnang na mdzad pa/ gra pas byas na 'bar gogadapon g.yog la sbyar na'ang 'grig la/ deng sang gi tshul min gyi 'go khrid dang mang tshogs dbar thon pa'i gnad don la sbyar na'ang ma 'tshams pa e yod snyam/ 475 bla mas bum pa gar bzhag ma gtogs/ bum pas bla ma gar bzhag min/ 'go 'dzin gyis gsham 'og gi mi la bkod 'doms byed pa ma gtogs/ gsham 'og gi mis 'go 'dzin la 'di bya dgos dang 'di byed dgos zhes bkod 'doms byed pa ma yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/476 bla mas ra bsad chog sar/ nye gnas kyis rgyu ma skyang mi chog pa/ gong rim gyis khrims 'gal chen po byas kyang lkog bsrub dang / gsham 'og nas khrims 'gal chung ngu byas kyang khrims rar tshud dgos pa gang yin nam zhes dri tshig shugs nas 'don par spyod pa lta bu/47〉 blun pos bstod pa las/ mkhas pas smad pa snyan/mi blun rmongs pad lad can gyis phyin ci log gi bstod pa byas na mi rnams bzhad gad kyi rgyur gyur te bstod yul kha skyengs dgos pa de 'dra bzo ba la spyod pa yin/ 478 blo klad pa'i rgya yul la med/ legs nyes la ma bltos par rang nyid kyi bsam yul las yongs su 'das pa'i bya ba zhig glo bur 131

thog babs su byung bar de ltar spyod pa yin/479 blo phyir gtad/ grod pa nang gtad/ phyogs khag gam/ tshogs pa/ tha na khyim tshang tshun chad nang blo kha phyi phyogs la gtad pa'i mi la spyod pa yin zhing / byed mi rung dang / mi byed ces pa la sogs tshig grogs skabs bstun gyis bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'gre/480 blos bkal nas/ snying brkus pa/ rang phyogs nas blos yongs su bkal nas snying khong gi gros gtam sogs bsha da na yang /pha rol pos g.yo thabs kyis gsang gnas brku thabs spyad de dgra phyogs la bskyal ba sogs ngo tsha khrel med kyi spyod ngan la steng tshig smra ba la spyod pa'o/ /481 blos grod par bkal/ grod pas chu glod/ bya ba gang rung mi zhig la blos ling 'gel byas na'ang / mi des nor nyan pa ma byas pa'am/ yang na byas rung nus pa ci yang ma thon par bya ba de ma grub pa zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin/482 dbyar nam zla bzang po'i sku drin la/ 'ebu a tshag tshag par gshog pa thogs/ 'go 'dren nam/ rgyab rtsa bzang po zhig gis 'then pa la brten nas mi tha shal kho 'dra bar yang ming dang dbang cha rag nas gar stegs thog thon rgyu byung song zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 482 dbyar lam la ma mjal yang / dgun lam la mjal yong / phan tshun 'khon 'gras byung ba'i gnod lan de da res 132

'jal thub ma song yang / rjes su go skabs shig rnyed srid pas de dus 'jal chog zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/484 'bag phar bstan/ sdig ra tshur bskul/ rdzig nyams phar bstan na yang / zhed snang bya rgyu phar bzhag de las ldog ste da dung tshur 'jigs bskul byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / tshul min phyin ci log pa'i spyod tshul la dmod pa zhig yin/ (gtsang khul )485 'bu gsod pa la sta re 'phyar/ nyam chung bcom pa la 'phyar rgyag gdengs gsum de 'dra byed dgos don med ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/246 'bu sa 'og tu sdod par/ snyad grog mas bsko bsko/rang nyid nyam chung 'gro bzo sdod mkhas kyi kha khu sem por sdod pa la/kha gtad phyogs kyis gtser bsun sdod thabs med pa bzos byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/487 'bru sna rlung la 'phyar na/ yang lci rlung gis 'byed/mi mkhas pa yin min bstan bcos brtsams na shes pa dang / dpa' bo —yin min g.yul 'gyed drag po zhig byas na gzhi nas shes thub zer ba lta bu de dang de 'dra'i rigs gang la'ang skabs bstun spyad na chog pa yin/4〈8 'brug mo hor la bsdad kyang / bsam pa gling la dkar/ sdod sa dgra phyogs su sdod dgos byung na'ang / blo snying brang gsum rang phyogs la gtad yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs hor gling g.yul 'gyed kyi khongs su gsal yod/133

489 'brog pa khris ded pa'i gral 'go dngos 'brel tshul bzhin ma yin par rgyu rkyen dmigs bsal gzhan zhig la brten nas go gnas 'phar ba'am/ thob thang rag pa sogs de lta bu'i rigs la dpe 'di spyod pa yin/ 490 'brong bsad pas ma chog za ma'i dar lcog khrims med lugs med byas pas ma tshad par da dung khrims 'gal gyis blangs pa'i dngos zog rnams mi gzhan gyi mdun la 'phyar 'phyar ngom ngom byed kyin 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/491 spru ba chu yis brtags pa'i/ gzhal yas khang / pha ma bzang po'i drin gyis mchor sgeg ldan pa'i bu phrug gam 'go 'dren chen pos bskyangs pa'i 'pher 'dod che ba'i mi sogs la gnas skabs kyi bde skyid de rang nus kyis grub pa min pas yun ring gnas mi thusta zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/492 sbal pa mthong dus/ lcong mo lha ru mngon/ dngos 'brel gdug rtsub dang 'jigs su rung ba'i bya dngos shig 'phrad skabs/gzhi nas rgyun gtan mi sdug pa'am 'jigs 'jigs su blta ba'i bya dngos de dag yid la 'gro ba zhig tu gzhi nas mthong thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 492 sbal pa rma can gcig gis/ sbal tshang phung / mi nyes can la bdag nyar dang / rogs skyor byas na 'brel ba byed mkhan tshang ma phung la sbyar yong zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 134

494 sbyad pa ldir sgra che yang / lag pa'i 'og don dam nus pa ci yang med par/ 'bor shob dang 'ud sgrog ji ltar che na yang /ha las rgyu gang yang med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/295 spyor shes na/ dug kyang sman la 'gro/ 'dul skyong dang do dam legs par byed shes na dgra phyogs kyi mi'am bya ba sogs kyang rang phyogs la phan thogs che ba'i mthun rkyen du 'gyur thub pa yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ / 496 zang ma me 'od la ma chags/ 'di ni bod rnying par rgya che ba'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs rnams khral dang / bun lon/ 'u lag bcas kyi skad gtser bzod ma thub par yul byol du 'gro dgos byung ba'i rgyu rkyen 'dren skabs spyod pa mang /497 sbrul gcir na yan lag thon/ nyes can zhig thebs na ngan rogs dang / lag 'brel sogs ji yod kho pa rang la tsha 'dri byas na thon thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 498 ma 'chang wa rnga sob sob/ 'chang na wa spu sbar gang /phar bltas na rdzig nyams che mdog kha po zhig mngon na yang / don lag thog tu len skabs ya nga dgos pa zhig las/ ha las rgyu gang yang mi 'dug zer ba lta bu mi dang bya ba gang la spyad kyang chog('brog khul )499 ma bdag bdag tu bzung / bdag po sgo phyir 'bud/bdag dbang skor gyi gyod gzhi thug skabs ham shed kyis dkar nag ga phyi slog nas bsnyon 'dzugs byas byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang /135

500 ma myong ba la yug za phog ngu la phyin pas gad mo shor/cha rgyus dang nyams myong ci yang med pa'i mis bya ba gang zhig byas na yang /snang bar 'gro po zhig byed mi shes pa ma zad/ skabs re rbad de phyin ci log pa de 'dra yang byed srid zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin no/ (gtsang khul ) 501 ma zhim pa so khrag bzhin du mid pa/ ma 'dod pa ji ltar byung rung / sdug sgom brgyab ste kha nas ma bton par bzod sran byas pa yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod cing / bdag gzhan dus gsum sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis sgyur chog 502 ma ṇi rang gis mi 'don/ phreng ba mi la mi sprod/dbang cha'am/ las 'gan gang zhig rang nyid kyis lag len thag gcod byed mi thub la/ mi gzhan dag la sprad nas legs sgrub byed du'ang mi 'jug pa'i spyod tshul lta bu la zur za byed par spyod pa yin/502 mang pos brtags na/ lcam las gdung ma yang / bya ba gang zhig yin rung mi mang pos bsam nus gcig sgril gyis bsgrub pa yin na shin tu dka' ba'i bya ba yang bde blag ngang sgrub thub ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi stobs shugs ni 'gran zla med pa zhig tu blta ba'o/ /504 mar dgrog phul nas/ dgongs pa zhu ba/ dang thog rang nyid kyis khas len byas na yang / gnas tshul 'gyur ldog byung ba'am/ yang na bskyar du bsam zhib byas pa brgyud bya ba de las phyir 136

bshol bya rgyu yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs dmangs sgrung gtam rgyud len tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/505 mar gyi dkyil nas spu bton/ phar 'dres tshur 'dres med par kher gtsang zur du bton pa'am/ dbye ba phye ba lta bur spyod pa yin/506 mar rdog la dad drags nas/ dkar gong gis so bcag zos po kha gnyog gis bza' rgyur dga' drags nas/ nyin gcig chag sgo chen po zhig dang 'phrad song zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/507 mi dkar por/ zhwa nag po/ 'di ni nag med nyes 'gel byas byung zer ba'am/ byed kyin 'dug ces pa lta bu 'di rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / bsdus par 8 mi dkar zhwa nag ’nya kyang zer/dpe 'di dang 'brel yod lo rgyus le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/50nga mi mgo la/ khyi lag bod rnying par rim pa mang ba'i lam lugs 'og rim pa dma' ba'i mis rim pa mtho ba'i mi la 'dra mnyam byed mi chog ces par spyod pa ste/ mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba de mi dang khyi'i dbar gyi khyad par lta bur bshad pa yin/ 509 mi rgya'u la/ spu 'dug ma shod/ 'di ni dper na mi 'byor ldan skad grags chod pa zhig la/ khong gi dngul la thogs pa mi 'dug zer ba lta bu shod mkhan la spyod pa yin te/ don la skad cha de ni shod mi dgos pa zhig yin par ston pa'o/ /51༷ mi ngan la dbang byung na/ chu ngan bre la gshor/ mi la 137

la 'go la slebs ma thag gsham 'og la sngar na ma grags pa'i zhib tshags po dang / do dam po byed pa lta bur spyod pa'i dmod tshig cig yin/ gtso bo dpal 'byor gyi thad la bsdu mang gtong nyung byed pa la zer/ 511 mi gcig yod na/ khyi las drag phru gu chung chung de 'dras lcogs tshod kyi lan skyel ba'am/ las ka rtsag rtsig byed shes pa de rigs la spyod pa mang /512 mi cha yod kyi mdun la/ gtam cha med/ bya dngos gang zhig la cha rgyus dang / myong 'dris zhib cha yod pa'i mi la/ de skor cha med rgyus med kyi mi zhig gis rgyus bshad byas na/ zhe khrel ba'i rnam pa'i thog nas spyad na 'tshams pa yin/ 512 mi chu la g.yug par/ rang chu yi rked pa/ mi gzhan dag la gnod 'tshe gtong dgos na/ rang nyid kyang nyen kha de'i phyed tsam gyi khor yug nang ma tshud par thabs med ces thog mar bsam gzhigs gzab nan bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang 514 mi ltogs par/ khyi skyug pa'i re ba/ 'byor pa'am/yang na shes yon mi ldan pa'i mi zhig la rgyu nor gyi rgyab skyor ram/ yang na shes rig gi slob ston yong ba'i re ba byed pa ni stong bsam rang yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 515 mi mthun rta g.yag mgo sbrel/ rtsa ba nas mthun thabs med pa'i mi gnyis te las rogs sam/ khral rogs/ yang na khyim 138

mtshes/ bza' tshang sogs gang yin rung/ slad mnyam gshibs bya thabs med zer ba'am/ yang na mnyam du ma bzhag na legs zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/516 mi nag can yer pa'i brag phug na 'dug kyang / nga sbyi thug la sger tshwa mi rgyag khrims dang 'gal ba'i bya ba byed mkhan nyes can pa de su yin ngas shes na yang / spyi'i don la sger gyi dgra bzo 'dod med zer ba lta bur spyod cing / dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/ 517 mi byed rgu byed byas na/ mi yong rgya yong yong / byed mi dgos pa'i bya ba lhag po de 'dra byas pa la brten nas/ yong mi srid pa'i chag sgo 'phrad pa de lta bu la spyod pa'i sting tshig cig yin no/ /518 mi phar bsad/ stong tshur len/ dkar nag ga phyi slog ste khe bzang rang gis zos nas/ da dung mi gzhan gyi sa nas gun gsab sprod dgos zhes shod mkhan lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'i ma rangs pa'i sting tshig cig yin/519 mi sbyar rdo la sbyin sbyar/ de snga gzhon nu pho mo gnyen sgrig pha mas thag gcod byed par brten phan tshun brtse dung yag po ma byung na'ang / da dung kha bral du mi 'jug pa de rigs la spyod pa mang /yang de min bza' mi do bdag gnyis ka tha dad byed 'dod yod kyang /rgan rabs sam gnyen tshan sogs kyis u tshugs ngang 'grig thabs byed pa lta bur yang spyod kyi yod/ 139

520 mi che ring na/ lha shi ba'i ro mthong / mi rgad pos sngar na ma grags pa'i bya ba ngan pa'am/ 'gyur ba chen po bsam yul las 'das pa de 'dra 'phrad skabs shod pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/521 mi ma shi/ shig gu drod skyes/ khyim tshang zhig la dpal 'byor gyi thad gyong gun tshabs chen phog pa'i skabs gnyen nye sogs kyis sems gso gtong ched spyod pa mang zhing / mi ma shi na rgyu nor longs spyod rang bzhin gyis 'phel thub zer ba yin/ 522 mi che ri la bskyal/ ri dwags ngo mi shes/ bya dngos gang rung zhig dang rtag tu 'grogs pa'i mi gcig gis bya dngos de'i gnas tshul ches spyir btang pa tsam zhig kyang shod mi thub pa lta bur spyod pa'i 'phya dmod kyi gtam dpe zhig yin/522 mi che las/ gtam che ring ba/ spyi tshogs yongs kyis dmod pa'i bya ngan yongs su grags pa rkun jag gam/ g.yo khram/ pha mar drin lan log 'jal lta bu sogs 'gog pa'i ched du spyod pa yin/524 mi ro skam po chu la sbangs nas/ lo rgan drug cu'i rtsis rgyag lo mang song ba'i sprod len rnying pa bar skabs 'phros gleng med pa de 'dra bskyar slong gis rgyu dngos len rgyu yod tshul gyi tho yig rnying pa 'don pa sogs la spyod pa yin/525 mi g.yo can gyis/ nyi ma rgyab nas lde/ 'jig rten g.yo thabs kyi bya bar byang chub pa'i mis bya ba gang yin rung sgrub dgos pa'i dmigs yul ngo ma de thad kur mi shod par kho rang gi bsgrub 140

bya der phan pa'i brjod bya gzhan zhig bskor nas shod pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin no/ /526 mi gsum thod gtugs na/ chig gsum mgo thugagyod gzhi sogs don rtsar he bag byung skabs/ 'brel yod kyi mi gang mang gi bshad tshul 'dri nyan go bsdur brtag zhib byas na bden don gsal rtogs thub pa yong zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )527 mi'i chem bur/ rang gi khab bcag mi gzhan gyi don du rang gi rgyu nor gtong ba'am/ yang na dka' ngal rgyag pa sogs la don snying med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/528 mig na dgos pa/ lag pas bzos/ byed mi dgos pa'i las ka byas nas dka' ngal lam/ yang na gyod gzhi'i nang tshud pa sogs rnyog dra chags pa de rang nyid kyis bzos pa zhig red zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ bsdus na 8 mig na lag bzos ’ zer/529 mig med na/ ling tog rgyu 'di med na rkyen 'di 'dra ba yong don med zer ba lta bur spyod cing / rkyen de mi bzod pas 'byung gzhi'i rgyu de rang blos gtong rgyu'i rnam 'gyur zhig kyang shugs la mtshon gyin yod/ 520 mig rtsar bltas nas/ rwa rtsar khrag mi gzhan zhig la mi dga' ba'i gnod sems bcangs te/ de'i gnyen nye'am/phyogs gtogs shig la gnod bskyal ba zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/521 mig la bu ram dang / kha la la cha/ kha nas khas 141

len gtsang mar byas kyang / lag len thog phyin ci slog pa'am/ yang na gtso bo la khas rab cig blangs rung / 'khor g.yog la lag len tha gcig bstar ba zhes pa lta bur spyad na'ang chog522 chu ge'i sgang la/ zla lhag dpal 'byor thog dka' ngal ha cang che ba'i thog la/ 'gro gron mi gtong thabs med kyi yul 'phar ma zhig thon pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ ‘6zla lhag ’ ni bod kyi lo tho'i brtsi tshul la lo gsum re'i thog zla ba gang rung zhig nyis brtsegs 'don pa de la zer/ 522 chus la 'gro mi dgos/ mdog lha dbang rtse nas mthong / tshig 'grel/ gtsang stod mus zhes pa'i yul gyi mdar/mdog lha dbang rtse zer ba'i lung pa zhig yod/ de nas bltas na mus lung pa'i chags bab skyo po de mthong thub ces dper bkod pa yin/mdog zer ba yul ming yin la 'dir kha dog la go don 'grel/ mi dang bya ba gang la sbyar rung / de'i phyi tshul la bltas pa tsam gyis don snying dang ngo mtshar sogs ci yang med pa lam seng rtogs thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ (gtsang stod khul )524 me khab rtse tsam gyis/ ri bo bsreg bya ba chung rtsag tsam la'ang snang med lhod g.yeng byas na/ des nam zhig chag sgo lung pa gang bzos yong zer ba lta bur spyod pa'i bskul lcag gi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin/142

525 metog dri bsung zhim na/ bung ba lasakyis 'khor/rang nyid kun spyod dang / shes yon/ 'jon thang sogs ldan na gtan grogs bzang po 'tshol mi dgos par 'tshang ga bshig bshig gis 'khor yong zhes pa lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / de min rgyu nor snyan grags sogs rang bzhin gyis 'phel zer ba sogs la spyad na'ang chog526 me btang sar/ sa chig pa/ bya ba gang 'dra zhig byas na'ang byas 'bras dang / shul rjes gsal po thon pa zhig bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/527 me dang nyi ma/ rgyang nas lde/ gnyen dang nye ba sogs 'brel 'dris ha cang nye drags na mtha' ma 'khon pa'i rgyur 'gro ba mang bas rgyang tsam ste/ khyim tshang gcig pa lta bu sogs ma yin par dus dus su 'brel thug dang / skyid sdug gal che ba'i skabs sogs la phan tshun rogs phan byed dgos zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/528 me 'bar ba'i sgang la/ shing gshag pa/ mi zhig mi dang bya ba gang rung zhig la khong khro chen po langs pa'i thog la/ slar yang mi dang bya ba de'i 'chugs rkyen nam/ skyon mtshang bskyar bshad byed pa lta byā la spyod pa yin/ mdor na de ni byed mi rung ba zhig la brtsi ba'o 529 dmyal ba'i sems can/ dmyal bar skyid/ grong gseb ri khug dang / byang thang 'brog khul du dka' sdug chen po myong bzhin pa'i mi mang po zhig goms gshis kyi dbang gis grong khyer du yun 143

ring sdod mi 'dod par zhing 'brog pha yul rang du log rgyur dga' po byed pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 540 rma la phan na/ khri'i chil/ don rkyen 'di la phan thogs na/ gtam 'dod gang la'ang mi brtsi bar thabs shes sam/mi su 'dra zhig la (rang gi dgra bo tshud ) zhu 'bul byed dgos byung na'ang bya rgyu zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/541 rma drag na/ sman brjed/ dka' ngal chen po 'phrad dus de las thar ba'i rogs ram byas kyang / rjes su khyim 'tsho zin nas yag po chags skabs/ sngar gyi rogs ram byed mkhan de brjed 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ yang deng sang gi mi phal cher de 'dra byed mkhan red zer bar spyad na yang 'grig542 rmi lam ngan par bskyar nyal/ sngon chad yag po ma byung ba'i bya ba de yang bskyar slar yang bya 'dod med zer ba'am/ byas nas phan pa med ces pa lta bur spyod pa mang /542 rgyun pa'ikha ya byed mkhan/ smyon pa yin/ ma rabs tha shal gyi mi ngan nam/ yang na chang a rag gis rab tu myos pa'i mi sogs kyis kha ngan tshig ngan smra ba sogs ya bo byed mi rung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /544 rmod la med pa'i rdung ga shes yon slob sbyong ngam/lag rtsal dang las ka sogs la 'jon thang rtsa ba nas med par/ chang rag 'thung rgyu'am/ rgyan po 'gyed pa/ tha na 'khrug rtsod bya rgyu sogs 144

la 'pher sha dang / sbor shob/ blo khog che mdog byed pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/545 ci gu'i dpon po je rgyags/ ci gu'i 'khor tshogs je nyung / / bod rnying par dbang sgyur pas gnya' gnon bshu gzhog btang rkyen mi ser rnams 'khyer 'khos je zhan du gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen de la thug ces pa lta bur spyod par snang / ('brog khul )546 ci ci ma mad kha mthun nas/ zhi mi'i ske la g.yer kha btags/ kho tsho lkog tu gros byas nas nga la gnod pa byas byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs gtam rgyud kyang len tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/547 ci ci zhim mi med pa'i/ gu yang / gnon mkhan med pa'i gnas tshul 'og gsham 'og tshor gang 'dod byed pa'i go skabs byung ba zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis 'gyur ba 'gro ba ni gzhan dang 'dra/ 548 gtsab gdan rdo la byas na/ sku gyong lcags la phogagong rim mam/ dbang dang 'byor stebs ldan pa la kha gtad bcar ba yin na—/ gyong gun so sor phog yong zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin zhing /skabs re nga la 'gran zla byas na/ gyong khyed rang la rag yong zer bar spyod mkhan yang yod/549 btsag dang bsdeb na dmar/ ram dang bsdeb na sngo/grogs po bzang po dang 'grogs na spyod bzang shes pa dang / ngan 145

pa mnyam du 'grogs na spyod ngan 'go ba yin zhes par spyod pa yin/550 btsun pa gcig gis nyes na/ brlag btsun sdug btsun/ las rigs sam/ mi rigs/ yul phyogs sogs gcig pa yin pa'i mi zhig gis bya ba ngan pa yongs su grags pa zhig byas na las rigs sam/ yang na mi rigs/ yul phyogs sogs de'i mi tshang mar lta stangs sam/ bag chags ngan pa yong zer bar spyod pa yin/551 rtsa ba ma rul na/ lo ma mi skam/ nang du gnad don med na/ phyi la mngon tshul 'di ltar yong mi srid zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/552 rtsa ba zab na/ rtse mo mtho/ pha ma'am/ dge rgan sogs kyis bslab bya gting tshugs pa zhig byas pa yin na/ bu phrug gam slob ma'i kun spyod je bzang du 'gro ba yin zhes pa lta bu sogs la spyod par snang /552 rtsa nyin ri nas zas/ lci ba srib ri la bskyal/ 'tsho ba khyim tshang ngam/ sde shog 'di ru bskyal nas/ blo'i gtad sa'am/phan 'dogs sa gzhan du byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/554 rtsam pa'i khag theg bul tog lhag pas 'khyer na 'khyer mnyam/ bod rnying par mi ser dbul phongs kyis bun lon len skabs bun bdag gis yid ma ches par brten khag theg khrid dgos/khag theg kyang 'byor pa zhan tsam las med na dpe 'di spyad nas dma' 'bebs gtong srol yod/146

555 6da skud kyis/ g.yag ro drud/ phar lag rtags sogs dngos po chung chung zhig sprad par/ tshur skyes lan rgyu nor rin thang ldab mang pos che ba de 'dra rag par dpe 'di spyod srol yod/556 rtsub po shing la mi 'gro 'jam po bal la mi 'gro byi phyogs kyi mi la mi chos zhi 'jam kho na las/ rtsub mo'i rigs spyod rgyu med pa dang / nang gi mi la kha mkhas 'dra chags byas na mi phan pas/thad kur skyon brjod byas te yo bsrang byed 'jug dgos zhes pa'i go don yin/557 rtse mo skam yang / rtsa ba rul med/ khyim tshang zhig la mtshon na nyams gud phran bu byung yod kyang / rtsa brlag tu 'gyur gzhi chags med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 558 brtsi dus tshang / tshang dus yal/ 'gro song gtong dus yong 'bab dang bstun nas 'char 'god yag po ma byas na tshur byung ni sems la nges che yang / phar 'gro ni song ba ma shes pa lta bus mtha' 'bras yi mug pa zhig yong zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/559 tshwa ya bal gyis mi do yang / bal do chu la sbang tsam/'byor stobs sogs kyi thad nas kha gtad 'jal thabs bral na yang thabs shes yod rgu btsal te ya lan 'phrod thub pa bya rgyu yin zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/560 chigs thog la ma 'khel na/ lug gzhug sta res mi chod/ gnad thog tu ma 'khel na/ stobs shugs chen po bton na'ang 147

don 'grub mi thub pas/ bya ba gang la'ang de'i gnad 'gag gtso bo gang du yod shes rtogs bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyad na 'grig561 tshur gnam gang ma rtsisan/ phar ches gcig brtsi don med/ mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba de phar phyogs kyi byed stangs dang bstun nas spyod dgos/ tshur ngo shes sam grogs po sogs brtsi 'os pa'i gnas bab de ma rtsis na/ phar yang de bzhin brtsi don med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/562 che gang sgrub pa brgyab pa/ zhogs gang g.yang la g.yugayun ring dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyis bsgrubs pa'i snyebyas rjes rnams yongs rdzogs bya ngan byed thengs gcig gis yud tsam zhig la med pa bzos song zer ba lta bur spyod cing / g.yang la ma g.yug dang /g.yug yong sogs tshig grogs skabs bstun gyiso bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'dra/562 cher phung chung yang / bdag po klu/ khyod kyi kha gtad de nyam chung zhig yin rung / kho la rgyab bdag btsan po zhig yod pa shes dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 564 cher phung la bskor nas/ ri bong la 'jab rdo/mngon gsal dang thad kur ma yin par/ g.yo thabs gzhan zhig spyad de bskor ba brgyab nas gnod skyel gyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/565 cher ma rno yang / brag ri 'big mi thub/ shes rig dang kha rtsod sogs kyi cha rkyen yod na yang / dbang shugs 'byor stobs 148

can la gyod ya bcol mi nyan zer ba lta bur spyod pa'am/ yang na/khyod la nus rtsal ci 'dra yod na'ang / nga la gnod 'tshe gtong mi thub zer bar spyad kyang chog566 cher ma zug dus/ rdog pa dran/ gnad don phrad nas bzlog thabs dran pa ni phyis drags pa yin pas nam yin yang rjes yong sngon dran thub pa bya dgos zer ba'am/ yang na mi rnams kyi spyod tshul ni rang la mi bde ba zhig byung dus gzhi nas skyob mkhan de dran gyi yod ces pa lta bur spyad kyang chog567 chong 'dus gcig la/ sde thang gnyis/ don rkyen gcig rkyang la thag gcod mi 'dra ba gnyis byung ba'am/ khe las gcig pa gcig rkyang la dpya khral che chung mi 'dra ba len gyi 'dug ces pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ —568 chong pa la ngo tsha med na/ bong bu btsos nas zo/dka' sdug mang po myangs nas phar la phan thogs chen po byas na yang /bsam shes med par bzang lan ngan 'jal kho na byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur 'u thug pa'i dmod tshig dang bcas spyod pa'o/ /569 mtshal rang la bzhag nas/ btsag mi la re/ mi dang dngos po gang zhig yag shos rang phyogs su yod pa de snang med du bzhag nas/ de las zhan pa zhig phyi phyogs su yod pa de rag thabs byed pa lta bur spyod pa ste cung zad ma rangs pa'i nyams kyang yod/ 570 'chig pa g.yag la za/ rgyug rdung be'urakhel/ khong 149

khro mtho sar za nas/ de'i bran 'khor la gnod pa skyel ba'am/ pa phar ma 'dod pa skyes te phru gur gshe gshe gtong ba lta bu sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin/571 mdzub mo lnga la grangs ka mi thebs pa med/ don gnad de ni rtogs dka' ba gang yang min zer ba'am/ yang na phar phyogs la stobs nus ci 'dra zhig yod shes gsal yin zhes pa lta bu sogs la spyod pa yin/ 572 mdzub mo gar bstan la shar/ mi gzhan gyis gang dang gang bshad na yang / de dang de rang yin par rtsis nas mun thom ngang gzhan dbang du gyur pa lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / bya mi rung zer ba'am/ byas pa'i ngan 'bras yin zhes pa sogs tshig grogs skabs dang bstun nas bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'dra/572 mdzo khyung dkar bzang rung rtol rgyud/ g.yag rog po ngan rung 'brong rgyud/ a mdo'i 'brog khul gyi gtam dpe ste/ khyod da lte'i gnas bab bzang yang sngar gyi rgyud pa mi bzang / nga da lta'i gnas bab zhan rung pha rgyud ma rgyud bzang po yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'i rigs rgyud smra ba mtshon pa'i dpe rnying zhig yin/ ('brog khul )574 rdza khog chag pas yag song / khro zangs lag par thebs byung / bza' tshang kha bral rjes bskyar du khyim thabs gsar sgrig byas pa de/ snga ma las yag pa byung zer ba lta bur spyod sa mang zhing /de dang 'dra ba'i don gzhan la'ang spyad na chog 150

575 rdza khyer nas rdo nyos pa/ chag sgo'am/ don rkyen de rang nyid rang gis ched du bzos nas byung ba red ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 576 wa skyesacul po/ wa la sdang / mi la la dpon por bskos na/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rigs la dmigs bsal gyi sdang po byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'di'i 'byung tshul gtam rgyud le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal/ 577 wa 'gro 'gro mang na/ wa lpags shor/ bya rgyu byed rgyu mang drags na/ rang nyid la yod pa'i gnas bab bzang po de yang shor 'gro nyen yod ces pa lta bur spyod pa'o/ /578 wa byang thang du brgyal yang / ya rkan grang rogs/ mi ser dbul phongs rnams zhing 'brog khul du sdug skad ji tsam shor na'ang /rang nyid snang sems skyo rogs ma gtogs phan pa ci yang med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / skabs re khyod rang skad ngan brgyab rung /sdug gyong red ces thad kur spyod mkhan yang yod/579 wa mi brgyal ka med/ spre'i 'gram lcag bod rnying par gzhung g.yog a drung ngam/ bod dmag sogs kyis nyes rdung 'phrog bcom byas rkyen mi ser rnams zhu 'bod mi byed ka med byung zer ba lta bur spyod srol yod/ yang skabs re khos de 'dra mi byed ka med rgyab logs nas 'bud rgyag gtong mkhan yod zer bar spyad na'ang 'grig151

580 wa mo g.yo skyu mkhas kyang / jon pa'i snyi las mi thar/rkun jag khram pa sogs thabs ngan ji tsam mkhas na yang / nyin gcig khrims kyi dra rgya las thar thabs med pa lta bur spyod pa'am/ yang na khyod rang thabs jus ji ltar mkhas kyang / mi nga'i mig 'og nas thar mi thub ces thad kur spyod mkhan yang yod/5ra1 wa gsod pa de/ pags pa'i don du yin/ klan ga'am/ rnyog gzhi bzo ba 'di dmigs yul ga ge mo de'i don du yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 7582 zha lu nas byung ba de/ tshong 'dus su bskyal/ gtsang khul gyi gtam dpe ste/ zha lu dgon par yong 'bab byung ba de de'i 'gram gyi gtsang gi tshong 'dus mgur mo zhes pa der bskyal zhes gcig nas phran bu zhig byung ma thag gzhan zhig tu bag med longs spyod kyi rgyur gtong ba zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ (gtsang khul )582 zhabs bro gang du rgyag rgyag sgog gtun gyi nang la/spyir btang bya ba zhig gang du byas na'ang chog pa la/ da res rnyog dra yong sa kho nar byas pa de ha cang thabs rdugs zhes pa lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / mdor na bya ba de spyod yul shin tu ma 'tshams pa la zer ba yin/584 zhabs bro mnyam du brgyab nas/ sked gzer logs gar/ bya ba gang zhig mnyam du byed bzhin pa la/ bye brag gi snang tshul 'ga' zhig gcig gyur ma yin pa mngon pa de gang yin nam zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ kyi152

585 zhal dkar phyogs gcig bod rnying par dbang sgyur pa nang khul phan tshun la rgya gcig gyur bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa dper na/ 8 sger pa zhal dkar phyogs gcig ’ ces mi ser ram/yang na dgon pa sogs la kha gtad mnyam du bcar dgos zhes shod skabs spyod pa'o/ /(lha sa khul ) 586 zhal la pad ma'i mdangs 'phro yang / thugs la 'dzer pa'i 'khyog 'dug kha nas bshad rgyu snyan po dang 'dra chags po 'dug kyang / sems nang du 'khon 'dzin gyi gnod sems bcangs 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /587 zhi mi bros tshar nas/ skarakhung 'gebs pa/ las ka nyes tshar nas/ bzlog thabs byed pa zhes ma rangs pa'am 'phya dmod kyi rnam 'gyur dang bcas khrel dgod byed skabs spyod pa yin/588 zhun mar 'chol bar/ zhun mar dgos/ dper na dngul gsog spel byed par ma dngul dgos pa'am/ yang na rang la cha rgyus med pa'i sde tshan gcig gi nang ngo shes shig 'tshol dgos na/ thog mar sde tshan de'i nang rgyus mnga' yod la/ rang dang yang 'brel ba yag tsam yod pa'i ngo shes shig 'tshol dgos zer ba lta bu'i rigs la spyod pa yin/sku89 zho'i lung par/ da ra'i khyos ma/ dper na 'brog par lag rtags phyur ba dang / zhing par yos bskur ba lta bu rang yul gyi khyad thon gtso bo de lung pa de'i mi la lag rtags su sprod pa zhes ga phyi 153

ga log gi spyod tshul de'i rigs la 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa yin/590 gzhas la yong rgyu zho gang / gzhas gos g.yar gla srang gang / gtong yong go log gi bya ba gyong gun phog rigs byed pa la 'phya dmod lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / dpe'i 'byung khungs ni bod rnying par gzhas rgyag lta bu yang mi ser la khral 'gel bar brten 'khrab gos rang med gzhan g.yar byed dgos pas mtha' ma'i sdom rtsis shig yin/59 1 gzhu mnyen thog la/ sga phobs/ pha rol po shugs nyams te 'grig thabs byed par yong skabs/ phyin chad lang rgyu med pa zhig bzo rgyu'i kha dan nam/ gros chod/ yang na cha rkyen sogs 'thab jus nan po zhig 'don dgos zhes pa lta bur spyod pa mang /592 gzhong pa stong par gzhong 'dzing / rtsa don thog rgyal pham dang thob shor sogs gang yang med pa'i don dag gam/ skad cha tsam la nga bden nga yus kyi rtsod bsher drag po byed pa la don med stong bshad ma byed zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/592 bzhengs pa las/ bzhugs pa spam/ kha bde po bshad pa las/ kha rog bsdad na spam pa mi 'dug gam zhes brjod yul gyi mi der bya ba de'i thad la khyod kyi skyon 'tshang 'don rgyu yod ces shugs kyis bstan nas phar phyogs gnon thabs lta bur spyod pa yin/594 za ba'i kha yod kyang / 'ju ba'i pho ba med/bza' sgo len pa'i go skabs yod kyang / lugs dang mthun pa'i thob thang ngam rgyu mtshan med ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/154

595 za dus bco brgyad drug cu/ las dus nga rang gcig pu/ yong 'bab len dus mi grangs mang po yod na'ang / las ka byed dus mi nyung nyung las mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/596 za byed stag gi kha yod kyang / 'ju byed go bo'i pho ba dgos/ yong 'bab za ba'i dbang cha dang thabs shes yod na yang /de dang mthun pa'i byas rjes sam phan 'bras thon dgos/ de lta ma yin na lugs dang mi mthun pas mtha' 'bras yag po yong mi srid zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /597 za shes nas/ las shes pa/ bza' rgyu kho na brtsi ba las/ las rgyur do snang dang 'gan rtsa ba nas mi 'khur mkhan lta bur zur za byed par spyad kyang 'grig598—1 zas zakhar/ thal ba 'dres/ don dag 'grub la khad kho nar bar chad byung zer ba'am/ yang na don lag tu lon khar/ chus zos btang song zer ba lta bur spyad na'ang chog598—2 zas na dga' dang / 'thung na dga'/ mi che ge mo kho rang gi 'dod pa ltar gang dga' dang gang 'dod pa mtha' dag cha rkyen gang yang med pa'i sgo nas re ba bzhin sgrub thabs byed kyi yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / 'on kyang de la brda lan 'os shing rigs pa zhig ma byung ba'i rang mdangs shig shugs kyis go rgyu yod/599 zo zer bar/ thang khug stong pa/ bya ba sgrub pa la rgyu cha'am/ ma dngul sogs ci yang med pas thabs shes mi 'dug zer ba 155

lta bur spyod pa yin/600 zos pa lto la phan pa/ phyin pa 'grul la phan pa/'bad rtsol byas pa de dmigs yul gyi bsgrub byar phan pa zhig zer ba'am/yang na rgyu nor btang ba de 'jal dgos nges kyi bca' khral la phan pa zhig dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / 'di'i shugs las dkal ngal 'bras med dam/ 'gro gron chud zos 'gro bar ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshon gyi yod/ 601 zla gam nang gi mdzog rum/ gdong thug na ci yang shod mi nus par rgyab tu ngan smra sa dang / gtong rgyu tshad rgyu yod ces sbor shob shod mkhan la spyod pa'i 'phya tshig cig yin/602 gza' ma brgyab na/ khami 'khyog las ka gra ma 'grig thon pa'i le khag tshang ma gzhan la 'da' zhing / rang nyid dag 'bud bya thabs byed mkhan la dmod pa'i sting tshig la spyod pa'o/ /602 gzar mo'i brag la ma 'dzegs na/ bde mo'i spang la slebs mi thub/ dka' las drag po zhig ma brgyab par/ bde skyid chen po zhig 'thob ga la srid zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/('brog khul ) 604 gzig tshang gi sgo 'gram la/ gla ge'i 'phag 'tshagastobs 'byor dbang shugs ldan pa'i mi la dgra zla 'tshol mkhan la spyod pa'am/ yang na thad kur nga'i kha gtad la nyam chung khyod lta bu langs na rang nyid rtsa med du 'gro ba las/ yang rgyu gzhan med ces pa lta bur 156

spyod mkhan yang yod/605 gzugs med na/ grib ma yong don med/ rgyu mtshan zhig med par klan ka de 'dra yong mi shes zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/606 bzang sla nga gang la/ ngan thom bu gang los 'dres/bya ba zhig legs par bsgrubs pa'i khrod du/ skyon dang mi legs pa 'ga' zhig kyang yong srid pa ni dngos po'i gshis lugs yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /(a mdo khul ) 607 bza'argyu mdzo zas/ gtongargyu be'u lci/ spyi thog nas yong 'bab 'bor chen zhig za na'ang / spyi phan gyi bya ba til 'bru tsam las sgrub mi thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 608 bza' rgyu med pa'i skyug rgyu/ spyi'i bya ba zhig bsgrubs pa'i mtha' ma'i 'bras bu der khe bzang rag rgyu phar bzhag rang sger la gyong gun 'khel byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/609 bza'agyu byung na/ 'khyer rgyu/ mi ltogs shed can la lto chas grod pa rgyags nges shig bster na yang / des ma tshims par da dung gom gang mdun spos kyis ltogs sla byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/610 bza'argyu gla sug tsam la/ labargyu gla spu las mang ba/khe slebs chung ngu las med par/ rnyog dra dang klan ka rdzogs rgyu med pa lhags pa'i bya ba de 'drar spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )611 bzos pa gla med/ skud pa'i rgyu 'don/ bya ba zhig 157

grogs por mngags pa de legs sgrub byas pa ma zad/ de'i don du 'gro song yang grogs pos btang ba lta bur de 'dra byas na mi 'grig zer bar spyod pa'am/ yang skabs re rogs pa ngas byas chog kyung / 'gro gron gtong mi thub zer bar spyad na'ang 'grig pa ni tshig grogs kyis 'gyur ba gtong phyogs yin/ 612 bzo byed par / sol ba/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub na'ang cha rkyen dgos pa ste/ dper na tshong rgyag par ma dngul dgos pa dang /bstan bcos brtsams par shes yon dgos pa/ de med na bya thabs med pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/612 bzo tshod sol bas zin pa/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub pa'i rgya khyon dang spus tshad sogs gtso bo rgyu char rag lus pa ltar/ rgyu cha med na byed mtshams ma bzhag ka med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ mi la la sems nas bya ba mang po sgrub bsam na yang dpal 'byor med pas rang sar ma bsdad rang bsdad red ces par spyad kyang chog614 bzo yas bzo la/ bkod pa mas bkod/ bod rnying par gsham 'og gi mis 'di 'dra dang de 'dra bya dgos zhes jus 'god bton pa la/ 'go dpon gyis ngo tsha kha skyengs lta bus the jus byas pa de ma 'os pa yin zer gshe gshe gtong skabs spyod pa'i kha dpe zhig yin/615 'ang gu'irkub nas a long / mi ser sna can gyi lag pa nas phan rngo thogs pa'i sbyin pa'am rogs ram sogs 'thob rgyu'i re ba 'chang mi rung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ skabs re khyod rang gis de 158

'dra sprod mi nus zer ba la thad kur spyod mkhan yang yod/ (lha sa khul )616 zhug pa'i kha nas/ 'ug gcig mi la lar rgyu mtshan dang / dge skyon sogs ji tsam bshad na'ang thog mar shod pa'i skad cha de rang las/ bsam gzhigs gang yang mi byed pa de rigs la spyod pa mang /617 6 thug pa'i mchong ga gyen la rgyag bya thabs gang spyad kyang phan thogs ma byung bar 'u thug pa'i skabs su gyen log byed pa'am/ yang na khrims srol dang 'gal ba'i nyen yod kyi bya spyod mi spel thabs med yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/618 'ug pas myan pa rub na bsam/ bya phos nam mkha' lang na bsam/ phan tshun gyi bsam blo'i 'khyer so'am/ bya ba spyod stangs rbad de rgyab 'gal gyur pa de rigs la spyod pa mang zhing / mi so so'i bsam phyogs mi 'dra zer ba lta bur spyad na'ang chog pa yin/619 'o ma phar blugs/ phyur khu tshur blangs/ legs pa gang yod pha ra la sprad nas/ zhan cha thams cad tshur la blangs te phan cha yod tshad ma byas pa med zer ba lta bur spyod par snang / 'brog khul gyi gtam dpe/620 'o ma'icu mchor/ khrag gi thigs pa/ bya ba legs pa sha stag byas pa de khrims 'gal nyes gsog gi bya ngan gcig gis chud 'dza' ba'am/ yang na nang khul blo thub 'thab grogs kyi khrod du dgra bo'i myul ma 'dzul ba lta bur spyod par snang /159

621 'ol ba mon la 'gro dus/ sbal pas lag pa bkrab/sdug po lan mang gtong mkhan dgra bo yul nas kha bral skabs/ sdug myong mkhan tsho dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/622 ya la med pa'i ya la/ thug pa lud pa'i ya la/ rgyu mtshan dang 'brel ba ci yang med par bsnyon 'dzugs byed kyin 'dug ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/622 yab yum bka' gros kyi thog nas/ bu mo skyid sa/rgan rabs gnyen grogs sogs kyis gang dga' ci legs dgongs bzhes thag gcod gnang ba de rang la blos 'gel dang len zhu rgyu yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / skabs re legs nyes ji lta bu byung rung khyed rang shes zer ba la spyod mkhan yang yod/624 yar 'then gyi rgya lung ma nyan rung / mar 'drud kyi rgya rdo mi byed/ phan chen po rngo thogs pa 'dogs ma thub na'ang / gnod pa'i bya ba rtsa ba nas mi byed zer ba'am/ khyed kyi mtshan snyan gong 'degs ma byung rung / zhabs 'dren zhus mi yong zhes pa lta bur spyad na chog(a mdo khul )625 yar rlangs shor dang / mar thigs zags/ bod rnying par dbang sgyur pas mang tshogs la khral dang bu lon sogs dus thog tu 'jal dgos pa las/ rgyu rkyen gang zhig la'ang khag 'dogs byas mi chog zer ba la spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re rang gis dus thog le med sprod rgyu'i khas len byed dus spyod mkhan yang yod/160

626 yar langs na mgo brdab/ mar bsdad na rkub brdab/gong 'og gnyis kyi bar du las ka byed mkhan khag po 'dug zer bar spyod pa mang zhing / 'tsho ba ngo ma'i nang gnas lugs de 'dra ba mang po gang sar mthong rgyu yod/ 627 yas so can gyis bcad pa la/ mas so can gyis skyug ldad/ bod rnying par dbang sgyur pas gong nas bshad pa la/ 'og nas de ltar ma yin pa'i bden don gyi rgyu mtshan ngo ma shod skabs su btsan shed kyis lan rgyag skabs spyod pa'i gnon gtam zhig yin/62ra yi dam byol song la bcol na/ 'gro sa dmyal ba/shes rmongs 'dod rngams can la gros dris nas khos bshad pa ltar byas par chag sgo byung dus spyod pa zhig yin zhing / gros 'dri sa ni nges par spyi tshogs kyi shes yon dang nyams myong phun sum tshogs po yod mkhan la ma gtogs spyi btang gi mi gang byung la byed mi rung bar shugs la bstan pa'o / 629 yun ring na/ snal mas lcags gcod/ bya ba 'ga' zhig lam seng grub 'bras thon pa dka' na'ang / 'bad brtson rgyun bsrings byas na mthar 'bras bu 'thob thub zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na 'gro gron sogs grangs 'bor chen po min rung / dus rtag tu gtong dgos byung na nam zhig rgya 'ub mi 'dus zer ba lta bu de rigs la'ang spyod pa yin/620 yul btsun yul la mi brin/ sa cha de rang gi mi yin na 161

dpon po'am/ yang na mkhas pa sogs gang zhig chags rung / yul mis brtsi mthong de tsam mi byed zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/621 yul yar klungs langasdad na/ lha yar lha sham po/lung pa'am/ sde khag sogs gang gi khongs su bsdad na/ de'i 'go khrid der 'dod min gang ltar yang bsten dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ dpe de'i thog nas bod kyi gdod ma'i yul srol te yod tshad lha la brten pa'i goms gshis de mtshon gyi yod/ 622 — 1 yod pa de med pa bzos/ dar ba de phyur khur btang / bya ba'am dngos po gang rung chud zos su btang 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ dper na 'phrul 'khor lta bu mi shes bzhin bzo bcos byed khul byas te mthar rbad de 'phro brlag btang ba lta bu'o/ / 622 2 yul la bde skyid byung na/ rgyal po a ṇis byed kyang byed/ cha rkyen gtso bo de 'thus tshang byung na/ phal pa'i rigs la khyad par med zer ba lta bu ste/ dper na las khungs kyi las 'gan yongs rdzogs legs sgrub thub na/ 'go khrid las byed pa sus byas kyang byed ces pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /622 yod la med la'i nyi ma las/ blo thag chod pa'i grib so skyid/ yin tsam min tsam byed pa'i bza' tshang de 'dra las/ nga rang gcig pu yin na blo bde sems skyid yong ba 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs spyad na chog 162

624 yod la med la'i rta pho las/ blo thag chod pa'i rkang thang mgyogs/ phan thogs med pa'i las rogs de 'dra zhig btang ba las/ nga rang gcig pus byas na las 'gan 'di mgyogs pa sgrub pa 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 625 yos rdog blos ma thong / spags gong g.yang la sbung /bya dngos gang yang rung ste chung rtsag blos ma thongs pa'i rkyen gyis che sar gyong rag pa de rigs la spyod pa'i dpe zhig yin/626 g.yag che bas/ lci ba che ba mi gtong / mi thob thang che ba'am/ skad grags che ba de tshos las don thog byas rjes che ba 'jog pa'i nges pa med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin la/ dngos don la'ang de lta bu'i mi sngar nas da bar mthong rgyu nyung nyung min/627 g.yag chad gcig gis/ g.yag chad brgya/ 'di ni g.yag gcig chad na de'i rgyab khal g.yag gzhan dag la bkal bas rim bzhin de dag kyang chad 'gro bar zer zhing / bod rnying par mi ser gcig bud stong phyin na de'i khral bun khral rogs rnams la bkal rkyen de rnams kyang rim bzhin yul byol du mi 'gro ka med yong ba de rig4la spyod pa yin/ 628 g.yag zha nas rtsa za ba/ bya ba la dpyod skabs phyogs gcig kho na las/ phyogs yongs mthong mi thub mkhan la spyod pa'i dpe zhig yin/629 g.yag gzhug la re mi dgos/ rang skra sked pa zin 163

tsam/ gzhan la re bcol bya mi dgos pa/ rang nyid rang mgo thon tsam zhig yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ de ni mi sger la spyad na 'grig la/ tsho pa'am/ sde tshan lta bu che sar spyad na'ang chog640 g.yang rtse'i sgang la/— yas sgron/ legs thog legs rtseg zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / 6 byung song ngam/rang red/ yong ba 'dug sogs tshig grogs ni skabs dang bstun nas gang mkhor bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'gre/ 641 g.yar po yun ring bdag po'i tshul/ rang la mi dbang ba'i dngos po spyi rdzas sam/ yang na mi gzhan gyi sa khang ngam rgyu nor yun ring bdag gir spyod rgyu byung bar bag gzon med par rang nyid bdag po ngo ma yin pa'i ngang tshul 'dzin gyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o 642 g.yas par sbyin dang / g.yon par mig dga' nye dang phyogs zhen gyi dpe ste/ bya mi nyan nam byed kyi med/ byed kyi 'dug byas mi yong ngam/ byas mi chog sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs gang 'os su bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'gre/642 g.yas phyag rgya byed dus/ g.yon bum pa shor/ byed dgos pa zhig la byang po med pa'am/ tha na byed mi shes pa gsal po 'dug ces rdzus rtags bstan pa'am/ ma yin yin mdog gi 'dzol rtags ston gyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/644 g.yer masargun 'brum la kha ta/ na tshod dang / shes 164

yon/ nyams myong sogs rang las lhag pa la phar bslab bya rgyag rgyu de 'os bab mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / yang skabs re khyod 'dra pos nga la kha ta bya rgyu mi 'os zhes thad kur spyod mkhan yang yod/645 g.yog byas kyi mtha' ma nag srid gzhung ngam/ khyim tshang / tha na mi sger gang rung gi don du dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis yun ring hur thag byas pa'i mi la mtha' mar nag med nyes 'gel gyi mtha' ngan 'di lta bu byung zer ba sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin/646 ra mgo ra lpagasakyis thum tsam/ khyim tshang lta bu la cha mtshon na gtong yong 'go thug tsam yod ces pa dang / las 'gan lta bu yin tshe rang 'khri'i las 'gan de rang gis sgrub thub tsam yod zer ba de rigs la spyod kyang / shugs che ba de dpal 'byor gyi thad gzhan la re ma dgos tsam yod ces pa la spyod pa mang 647 ra mgor zhen chags/ g.yag mgo brlags/ bya dngos chung rtsag blos mi thongs par chags zhen byed ring la bya dngos chen po 'thus shor ba'am/ chud zos su 'gyur 'gro ba zer ba lta bur spyod pā yin/648 ra dang mnyam du sla'i/ lug dang mnyam du 'ba'i/mi su 'dra zhig gi mdun du slebs na'ang / khos gang zer gyi rjes rgyug byed mkhan rang tshugs rtsa ba nas mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod cing /mdor na de rigs kyi gtam spyod gang la'ang yid rton byed mi rung bar ston pa yin/165

649 ra spu'i 'ur rdo/ ra yi mgo la/ rang gis bsgrubs pa'i bya dngos kyis rang nyid la chag sgo khyer yong ba lta bu'i rigs la spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re rang gis byas pa'i ngan 'bras yin zer ba la spyod pa'ang mthong ste dpe don de tsam gyis mthun pa min snyam/650 ra 'phag nas/ ka ba slog mi thub/ shes nus dang 'jon thang zhan pa'i mis ngar ngar 'phag 'phag byed na yang / yo khyom chen po gang yang bzo mi thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/651 ra ma brag thog 'dzegs na/ seng ge'i snang ba 'char/mi phal pa zhig gnas skabs kyi 'go gtso lta bur bskos pa la yang /rang nyid dpon chen yin mdog gi dregs nyams ston gyin 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/652 ra yi ril ma la/ lug gi ngo so/ mi gzhan gyis bzhag pa'i byas rjes de 'brel ba med pa'i mi gzhan zhig gis kho rang gis byas pa yin khul ngo so gtong ba lta bu la spyod pa yin/652 ra ri la btang nas/ don lhas rar tshang ba/ dper na sku mgron la dga' bsu dang sne len gzab rgyas zhu ba de/ dga' bsu dang sne len kho na'i ched du ma yin par bsgrub bya'i dmigs yul de nyid don thog tu 'khyol ba zhig bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/654 rwa mgo la brgyab na/ rwa rtsa la gzer/ phru gur nyes rdung btang na pha ma'i snying la gzan zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/166

655 rwa can brgya thar na/ a yu gcig mngon gsal du sgrig 'gal byed mkhan mang po 'di 'dra bar brtsad gcod byed mkhan med par ngas lkog tu sgrig 'gal thengs gcig byas par bag tsha rgyu ci yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/656 rang gis btsos pa'i chang de/ zhim po med༅nga 'thung dgos/ rang nyid kyis bzos pa'i rnyog gzhi'am/ chag sgo gang zhig yin rung dkal ngal dang ca sun ji ltar che na yang so so rang gis ga sel bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/657 rang nyid 'phung bas ma tshad/ sto tshang / spyi tshogs la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen bzo mkhan gyi mi dang bya ba sogs la the gtogs byas na ngan 'bras bsam yul las 'das pa yong nges zhes pa lta bur spyod pa mang / rang so so blos thongs na yang khyim tshang bza' tsho bu phrug bcas la thag zhor 'breng drud ji yong bsam blo gtong dgos zhes nyen brda gtong ba sogs la spyad kyang 'grig658 rang gi drel la/ rang gis tho log rang gi mi la rang phyogs kyis mthong chung dang / ngan ming 'dogs pa sogs la dgag pa rgyag pa lta bur spyod pa yin/659 rang thag rang gis chod kyang / dpon thag g.yog gis mi chod/ 'di ni dpon g.yog kho na'i gnad don tsam ma yin par/rang las cung mtho ba'am/ yang na spyi pa'i las don sger gyis thag gcod mi thub pa lta bu sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / skabs re 167

khag 'dogs byed par yang spyod srol yod/660 rang 'thag bcag na/ lte nad sangs/ rang 'thag ni phye sogs 'thag byed rdo sgor mo nyis sgrig gi ming dang / lte nad ni de gnyis kha sbyor gyi dbus su mkhregs shing las bzos pa'i shing rdog cig yod pa de 'grig po ma byung na rang 'thag 'khor bde po mi yong ba de la zer/'gal ba'am gyod don chags gzhi'i gtso gnad kyi mi'am gnad don gang yin de rang rtsa med bzos na 'gal gyod rang zhir 'gro thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 661 rang don khog tu bcug pa'i/ gzhan don smin ma gzengs gzengs/ gtso bo chos 'bag gyon nas bshu gzhog gtong mkhan gyi khram pa de rnams kyi bsam spyod ther 'don byed pa zhig yin zhing / bsam blo dang spyod tshul de 'dra ba'i rigs gzhan la sbyar yang chog662 rang don 'grig na/ cha lugs ngan yang ngan/ rang gis bsgrub dgos pa'i bya ba de don thog tu 'khyol na/ mi gzhan gyis mtho song dma' song zer na'ang khyad par mi 'dug ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 'di rang don ring lugs pa dang mi 'dra'o/ /662 rang gdong ma mthong / sbal par 'phya/ rang skyon mi mthong bar mi gzhan la 'phya dmod bya mi rung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/168

664 rang sdod sar/ mi zhog dgos/ bya ba'am/ lhag par rtsod gzhi byung skabs rang gi gtam don la rgya kho na ma gtogs bsam gzhigs mi thub mkhan gyi mi la bsam blo'i las ka byed skabs spyod pa mang / rgyun gtan mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba mthun 'grig yong thabs kyi bslab bya la spyad na'ang 'grig665 rang zhwa mi theg mi'i rmog rang nyid la 'khri ba'i las 'gan yang sgrub mi thub pa la/ mi gzhan dag gi las 'gan 'khur rgyu4ni rtsa ba nas thub thabs med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/666 rang gsang mkhas kyang / mi shod mkhas/ bya ba gang zhig phyir grags mi 'byung ba'i thabs shes 'di dang 'di yod zer mkhan la de ni sgrub thabs med pa zhig yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 667 ri khog par tshud nas/ khyi ra rgyag bka' khrims la nyams tshod lon nas/ khrims med lugs med byed kyi 'dug zer ba sogs mdor na khog par gdeng tshod rnyed nas bya ba de 'dra byas pa red ces pa lta bu'i rigs la spyod pa yin no/ /668 ri rgyal sbun po la/ sbrang ma'i gshog lcag phar phyogs kyi kha gtad stobs 'byor dbang shugs sogs ha cang chen po yod pa la/ 'byor stobs dbang grags sogs ci yang med pa'i dbul phongs nyam thag cig gis nus pa gang yod kyis dmod mo btab na'ang /dgra bo'i ba spu gcig la yang g.yo 'gul mi thebs pa de lta bur spyod pa yin/169

66/ 9 ri che che la kha ba/ rdo chung chung la ba mo/ yul spyi'i bde sdug gam gtong yong gang ci che thob chung thob kyi 'brel ba'am bsdu bgos bya dgos zer ba lta bu sogs la spyod par snang / ('brog khul )670 ri bong gi pags pad/ 'then shed med/ dbul phongs nyam thag gi dpal 'byor la theg shugs phran bu tsam yang med zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ / 671 ri bong gi spu la/ mthong ba rnasnya gsum/ bya dngos gang la'ang mi rnams kyi lta phyogs dang mthong phyogis mi 'dra ba yong gi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 672 ri bong mgo la/ sha po'i rwa co/ 'os 'tshams dang 'dra chags po rtsa ba nas med pa'i bya ba'am/ gtam brjod sogs la spyod pa yin/ 672 ri bong gnam rdib kyi sdug bsngal/ nyen kha rtsa ba nas med pa'am/ yang na 'brel ba dang rgyu mtshan gang yang med pa'i bya ba la dgos med kyi sems khral byed pa de rigs la spyod pa yin no/ /674 ri bong bya glags kyis khyer na/ 'bod sa a sngon gnam/ nga la chag sgo phrad dus/ skad rgyag sa khyed rang ma gtogs med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/675 ri byel thang la 'bab pa/ brgya ma lan gcig rgyun gtan yong ma myong ba'i mgron po gal chen la sne len dmigs bsal gzab rgyas byed pa sogs kyi skabs su spyod pa yin/170

676 ril ril zab la shor bar/ 'jong 'jong ltad mo ma lta/ mi gzhan la chag sgo byung dus ltad mo bltas nas sdod mi rung bar rang nus gang yod kyis rogs ram bya dgos/ chag sgo ni gang ltar nyin gcig rang nyid la yang mi 'phrad pa'i gdengs tshod su la'ang med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin no/ /677 rus pa med na shig red/ rna ba med na bya red/ mi la la rgya dang rus zhen med na ha cang thabs rdugs shig red zer bar gtso gnad kyi spyod par mngon zhing / tshig rjes ma de'ang mi la go shes med na dud 'gro dang khyad med zer ba'i go ba zhig kyang med dam snyam/('brog khul ) 678 ro dur khrod nas log pa/ re ba rbad de zad pa la/slar yang re don smin pa lta bur dpe mi srid pa'i sgo nas spyod pa yin/679 ro bdag med/ khyi'i longs spyod/ gzhung rgyu'am spyi rdzas sogs bdag gnyer byed mkhan med par ham pa su ches khyer spyod byed pa lta bur spyod pa mang /680 ro ma mthong gong nas ngu ba/ gnas tshul gsal po ma shes gong nas sdug skad dang skad ngan rgyag pa lta bur spyod pa dang /66ma ngu ’ zhes dgag sgra brgyab na'ang 'grig 681 ro sa 'og la song yang / gtam sa steng / spyi tshogs thog grags pa bzang ngan ci 'dra zhig 'jog pa de la gal ha cang chen po brtsi ba ste/ 6‘'jig rten lto gos gtām gsum ’ zhes mi tshe'i lta tshul du 171

'dzin mkhan yang yod/ gong gi dpe ni gtso bo mi rabs kyi snyan grags su 'gyur ba zhig las/ zhabs 'dren du 'gro ba zhig shi na'ang byed mi rung zer ba'am/ mi byed zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang / mi gzhan gyi byung bar bstod smad byed skabs kyang spyod mkhan yod/ /682 rong pa'i mi la/ tshad pa'i g.ya'/ mi de la gang ltar bzang po min pa'i g.ya' zhig 'dug ces pa lta bur spyod cing / skabs re mi khyod la ngan pa'i rtags gcig 'dug zer ku re lta bur spyod mkhan yang yod/ 682 la mgo'i char pa de/ lung gzhung la mi 'bab/dbang nor yod mkhan la thob pa'i bde skyid de/ mang tshogs byings la 'thob mi thub zer ba'am/ grong khyer gyi phan bde de zhing 'brog sa khul du longs spyod mi thub zer ba lta bu sogs de'i rigs la spyod pa yin/('brog khul )684 lagan bshar ba'i bong rgan/ khal theg med kyang lam rgyas/ lo rgas pa'i mi tshor lus shugs 'jon thang sogs med kyang /spyi tshogs kyi bya ba'i nyams myong dang cha rgyus chen po yod zer bar spyod cing / skabs re mi rgas 'khogs la las/ rang la bya ba de dang de'i cha rgyus gsal po yod ces par spyod pa yang yod do/ /685 la cha'i bang chen/ rdo la sbyar/ grogs po mang po 'tshogs skabs grogs po gcig grogs po gzhan zhig 'bod du btang ba na/ grogs po gzhan des 'bod mkhan la sne len gzab rgyas byas rkyen 172

kho rang yang log ma thub pa sogs de lta bur bzhad gad kyi tshul du spyod pa mang / 686 la thel sgang la/ spags tham/ dper na bya ba zhig 'thus tshang legs sgrub zin pa la dgos med kyi bskyar skor yang skor byed pa lta bu'i rigs la 'phya dmod kyi rnam pa dang bcas spyod pa yin no/ /687 la mo dang dod pa'i rta pa/ rang mos kyis khas len byed thal shor nas/ bya ba dngos su sgrub dus dka' ngal lam ca sun phrad de blo 'gyod byed mkhan sogs la spyod pa yin/ dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs gtam rgyud le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/6ra8 la mos nyag tsam/ mdzo phos gzenges tsam/ dper na kha gtad phan tshun gnyis sprod len gyi grangs 'bor lta bur ma dan par he bag shor skabs bar pa byed mkhan gyis phyogs gcig gis yar tsam spar ba dang / phyogs gzhan des mar tsam bcag nas 'grig thabs bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin no/ /689 la re 'dzegs na/ thur re/ 'jig rten gyi bya dngos gang la yang 'phel rgyas dang nyams rgud kyi 'gro phyogs shig res mos kyi tshul du 'gyur ba yong gi yod pas rgyal pham sogs la ha las dgos pa'i gnad don med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /690 la la kha ba dang / klung la ba mo med pa/ kha dan zin pa'i bya ba la rgyu rkyen gzhan dag gi khag dkri gang yang bya rgyu med pa dus thog lag len du 'khyol dgos zer ba lta bur spyod srol yod cing /173

yang khag dkri gang yang byed kyi min zhes khas len la spyod mkhan yang yod do/ / 691 lag mgo ring / phu thung thungs/ bya dgos pa'am/bya bsam pa'i las ka mang po zhig yod na'ang / 'gro gron gtong byed dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen mi 'dug ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin no/ /692 lag pa gcin pas bkrus pa'i gtsang tog tog phyi tshul lam kha nas shod dus gnad don gang yang med pa lta bu'i rnam pa ston na'ang / don dngos la de ltar min par gtsang ma ma yin pa'i gnas tshul mang po thon rgyu yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /692 lag pa tsha dus skam pa/ gtso bo dpal 'byor gyi thad la spyod pa mang ste/ dgos gal shin tu che ba'i skabs su rogs ram don la phan pa zhig byas pa yin zer ba ste/ shugs la da lta tshab skyin mi 'jal ba'am/ yang na bka' drin bsam shes byed kyi mi 'dug zer ba mtshon par spyod pa yin/694 lag pa ya gcig gi zlog pa/ phyogs gcig rkyang pas bya ba de sgrub thabs mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / yang sgrub thub kyi ma red ces par spyad kyang chog pa yin/ 695 lag par sha yod na/ nam mkhar bya 'khor/ rang nyid la dpal 'byor yod na/ gnyen sgrig gi re ba byed mkhan nam/yang na rogs ram byed mkhan sogs gang zhig dgos na yang ma bskul dang len 'tshang kha shig shig yong gi red zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod 174

pa'o 696 lan rtsa can la rgyad kyi bzhi zur/ mi gsod dam/yang na dpal 'byor nyams nyen chen po sogs byung nas gyod la gtugs skabs gyod rtsa de'i le lan yod mkhan la nyes chad kyi bzhi zur thob zer srol yod pa ltar de rigs kyi rtsod gzhi thug skabs spyod pa yin/697 labasgyu pha bsad kyi bu la'ang yod/ tshig 'grel/ pha gsod mkhan bu zhig gis/ pa phas nga la gshe gshe ma btang na/ ngas pa pha gsod srid kyi ma red ces rang la rgyu mtshan yod pa lta bur bshad ces grags/ mi la las rang nyid kyis ma 'grig pa gsal po mthong yang / le lan gzhan dag la khag dkris nas g.yol thabs byed mkhan de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /698 lasakamed na/ skas 'dzegs bshig mi 'ga' shas bya mi dgos pa'i las ka yang bskor bskyar bskor byas te dus tshod chud zos gtong mkhan la zur za dang bcas spyod pa yin no/ /699 las ngan pa'i sdig pa ma bsags na/ skrag mi dgos pa gshinarjetshasathol yin/ rang gis khrims srol dang 'gal ba'i bya ba ma byas phyin/ su la'ang zhed snang byed dgos don med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 700 las byas na mi tshar/ bzhag na tshar/ las ka ni ji tsam las na de tsam gyis mang du gang 'gro ma gtogs/ zin pa'i dus med ces dper bkod pa'o/ /175

don 'grel/ rtag par tshar rgyu med pa'i bya ba kho nar mgo 'khor nas sdod mi rung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/701 las su chos byas/ sangs rgyas dgrar langs/ bya ba gzhung don kho nar dmigs nas lhag bsam rnam dag byas na'ang /'go gtsos rtag par ma 'grig ma 'thus pa kho na shod kyi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa 'o/ /702 lu gu rgyags kyang / rkang mar khrag lo chung gis kha bde po shod pa la rgan rabs kyis ma 'dod par zur za byed ched spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re 'gan 'khri lci po de 'dra lo gzhon gyis theg mi thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyad kyang chog70 2 lug mgo bkal nas/ khri sha chong ba/ ma yin yin khul gyi khram pa'i g.yo thabs la ther 'don byed skabs spyod pa'i sting tshig nan po zhig704 lug gcig 'dzin par/ lug brgya'i mtha' bskor dgos/ dper na nyes can gyi mi gcig 'dzin bzung bya dgos na/sngon la nyes don brtsad gcod dang / nyes can bros byol mi yong ba'i ched du khyab khongs nges can zhig nang gi mi mang por yang dam gnyer mnyam 'khur dgos pa sogs bzos ma bde phran bu mi yong thabs med yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/705 lug bal can la bal/ nya spu med la khram/ bod rnying par dbang sgyur pas mi ser dpal 'byor phran bu yod mkhan la ming 176

'dogs sna tshogs kyis dngos po'i nyes chad spyod pa ma zad/ dbul po dbul rkyang tshor rgyu nor sprod rgyu med na lus thog tu mnar gcod gtong rgyu yin zhes par spyod pa'i dpe ngan zhig yin/706 lung chung nang gi dpon chung / khyab khongs nges can zhig gi nang du/ khrims srol gang dang mi mthun pa'i rang snang gang dran byed kyin 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod cing / yang skabs re kho ni brtsi rin gang yang med pa zhig red ces mthong chung byed par spyod pa'ang yod/707 lung pa chus khengs na/ rdo leb skam po/ spyi tshogs yongs la chag sgo byung na/ khyim tshang ngam mi sger la'ang shugs rkyen mi phog pa ga la yong srid ces pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin no/ /79ra lus la na tsha med par/ gdong la dreg pa/ rang la bya ba mi legs pa byas pa'i mnong 'gyod med par/ zhed snang 'tsher snang bya dgos don ci yang med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/709 lo brgya sman dang / 'chi khar dug tshe gang gi ring la yag po byas na'ang / mtha' mar thabs rdugs de 'dra byas byung zer ba'am/ yang na bya mi rung / byed pa ga la srid/ bya bsam pa rtsa ba nas med ces pa la sogs bdag gzhan dus gsum skabs dang bstun nas tshig grogs kyis bsgyur ba ltar spyad na 'grig710 lo yag thog la/ btsas ma/ bya ba gang zhig yin rung gra sgrig 'thus sgo tshang tsam zhig byung ba'i skabs su byed mtshams de gar bzhag nas mjug sgril na legs zhes gtso bo tshod ran po bya dgos zer 177

ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ dpe'i tshig mjug tu/ 66gal srid glo bur sad dang ser ba zhig byung na ’ zer ba zhig shugs bstan du brjod pa 'di'ang bod kyi gtam dpe'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin/711 lo re la dbyar re/ dbyar re la mu ge re/ rtag par 'char can gyi rnyog dra lang ba dang / rnyog dra'i mjug 'bras la yang rtag tu gyong gun phog pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / de'i shugs bstan las chag sgo de rtsa bcos bya dgos pa'i 'dod tshul mtshon gyi yod/712 lo legs na/ phug ma zhar la 'byungaka don chen de 'grub na/ don chung gzhan dag rang shugs kyis zhar la 'grub yong ba yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /712 lo gsar dang / lug mgo/ bya ba zhig spyi yongs nas bkod sgrig byas pa'i nang du/ 'char can yin pa'i bye brag gi bya gzhag rnams rang shugs kyis tshud pa de ni shod mi dgos pa zhig los yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 714 long bas bltas kyang / khams gsum/ las ka de ni 'di 'dra zhig yin pa mi su 'dra zhig gis bltas na yang ha cang gi gsal po mthong thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ dpe 'di ni ma goms pa'i mi tshos go bde po med/715 sha khog phar sprad/ rti kha tshur sgug dpal 'byor gyi 'byung gzhi lte ba de phar sprad de/ de las byung ba'i yong 'bab kyi cha 178

shas phra mo tsam tshur yong rgyu sgug nas sdod pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/716 sha ba sgo rtsar slebs dus/ mda' gzhu gzhi nas bzo ba/ bya ba mgo thog tu babs tshar dus gzhi nas gra sgrig byed rtsis byed pa zhes phyis drags thag chod pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/717 sha ma chos༄ ma shes/ gri mi rno ba'i mgo la/ bya ba gang zhig rtsa ba'i nang rkyen la brten nas sgrub ma thub pa la/ byed pa por 'bad brtson ma byas pa zhes skyon brjod 'khel ba'i lan lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/718 sha zhim po de a pho srungakisachos/ khag ngan pa de a ce wa mor 'khel/ khe bzang de mi gzhan dag gis zos nas/ ngan khag de nga la 'khel byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )719 sha za mi dgos/ sha khur mdzub mo bcug pas chogakhrims 'gal gyi bya ba de'i nang nas khyod rang la dngos su khe phan 'thob med na yang / bya ngan de lta bu byed pa'i khongs su the zhugs byas pa tsam gyis khrims dang 'gal ba red zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/720 sha yin na za bde ba dang / rus yin na skyur bde ba/dga' rogs sam/ yang na grogs po sogs gang rung yang / yin la min la lta bu'i spyod tshul lung ma bstan de 'dra ma yin par rnam 'gyur gsal po zhig ston dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /('brog khul )721 sha shi sha dang / sder ma gser sder/ ngo chen zhu ba sogs kyi skabs do bdag la ma dgongs na'ang / zhu brgyud byed pa po'i 179

ngo la dgongs nas don 'bras de smin pa zhig gnang rogs zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 722 sha gsar a ma skal sgron la/ sto nad ma gtogs gtam nad med/ lto gos kyi gnad don la bsam blo gtong ba ma gtogs/ mi gzhan gyis bstod bsngags dang / spyi tshogs kyi thog ming snyan grags don gnyer sogs gtam 'dod rigs med zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ / (bye rags a ma skal sgron yang zer )722 shi khar ma ṇi tsha 'don/ rgyun gtan nas ma 'ongs sngon rtsis kyi gra sgrig gang yang mi byed par 'gag rtsar slebs tshar nas brel brel 'tshub 'tshub byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / de ltar byed par phan 'bras thon mi thub pa zhar la bstan pa'o/ / 724 shig la brgyab kyang / gong ba'i phyi nang / de snga rang 'og gi mi lta bu bros byol du song na/ kho la rgya che thag ring gi 'gro sa dang nus pa gang yang med ces mthong chung byed sa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/725 shing bzang po'i drin gyis/ 'jon gyis gnam mthong /shes yon dang 'jon thang chen po ldan pa'i mi dang mnyam las sam/gzhogs 'degs kyi tshul byas pa la brten nas don dam 'jon nus ci yang med pa'i mi dag kyang ming grags chen po thob pa lta bu la spyod pa yin zhing / 'jon ni mkhrid nas skye ba'i rtsa zhig gi ming gtsang khul gyi yul skad do/ (gtsang khul ) 180

726 shing bzang pags pa'i 'og tu rul/ shes yon nam/ nus rtsal/ 'jon thang sogs dngos 'brel yod na yang /de dag spyi tshogs kyi phan bde'i ched du bed spyod mi gtong ba de ni chud zos chen po red zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /727 shing bzo mkhas kyang / rdo brkos mi 'jon/gang la sbyangs pa de la mkhas zer ba ltar/ gcig shes kun mkhas yong mi srid pas dper na rtsom pa po mkhas can zhig yin rung / tshong yag po rgyag mi thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin no/ /728 shing sog shing la mi 'gro/ rang mnyam rang 'dra'i rigs kyis bkod pa dang gcun 'doms byas par gzhan tshos brtsi 'jog dang len 'thob mi srid zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/729 shel sgo'i nang gi mog mog mig gi longs spyod tsam las dngos su bed spyod byed thabs mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/720— 1 shod mkhan chung / nyan mkhan che/ bkod 'doms byed mkhan dang / bya yul gyi bar la go ming ngam dbang cha sogs bar khyad chen po med par brten bshad kyang nyan gyi mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/720—2 shes bya dgra la yang thongs/ 'dir shes bya zer ba ni nyan shes dang bsam shes sogs la go dgos shing / thongs zhes pa'ang skyid po thongs zer ba ltar yong ba shog ces smon tshig gi bskul ma 181
