yin/ bsam shes ni dgra bo la'ang ldan pa shog zer ba'i shugs las rang gi bza' zla'am/ yang na gnyen nye lta bur bsam shes mi 'dug zer ba de rigs la zur za'i tshul du spyod pa'o/ /721 bshad pa bu mo dang / go sa mna' ma/ skad cha thad kur shod bde po med mkhan la/ tshab byed cig btsal te de la bskor gtam shod pa lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / skabs re thad kur khyed kyis kho la bshad khul ma gtogs/ rgyag sa ngo ma de nga red zer ba lta bur spyod mkhan yang yod/722 sa brkos na rdo langs/ bde 'jags dkrugs na rnyog dra langs srid zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 722 sa khug khug gi mi tsog tsog sa mtha' 'am/ byang thang sa khug kyog gi 'go pa chung chung lta bu ste sa gnas de rabal gtso bor brtsi na'ang / bod yongs la dpags na brtsi rin med zer ba lta bu la spyod par snang / ('a brog khul )724 sa 'khod snyoms nas/ rde'u 'bur 'don/ gnas tshul 'dra mtshungs kyi nang nas/ dmigs bsal sdang zug byas byung zhes pa'am/ byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/725 sa ma grib gong nas/ bzhun mar chol/ bya ba gang yang thog tu ma babs gong nas rjes yong sngon dran gyis gra sgrig tshags su tshud pa zhig bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 726—1 sil snyan nam mkhar 'phyar mi dgos pa/ dril 182

bu sbar khud du dkrol nas 'thus pa/ dpon zhu khrims gtugs sogs yongs grags kyi sngo lo 'phyar mi dgos par nang khul du 'dum thabs yong ba bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang /726—2 sa la zhog pa la phangs pa/ gces spras bya rgyu med na ma gtogs yod tshad byas pa yin zer ba'am/ yang na gces gces thal drags pa byed kyi 'dug zer ba sogs de rigs la skabs dang sbyar nas spyod pa yin/727 seng ge'i yas rkan dang / phag pa'i mas rkan/ bya ba'am skad cha gang zhig yin rung / 'go mjug dang kha zhe mthun 'grig cig gang 'dra byas na'ang byung ma song zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin la/skabs re gyod gzhi 'dum 'grig byed dus phan tshun gyi shod stangs la 'gal chen po sgrig thabs mi 'dug zer bar spyod pa'ang mthong /728 seng ge'i g.yu ral la/ spre'u'i lag rtsed/ go gnas dang / thob thang sogs mtho ba'i mi snas bed spyod byed pa'i yo chas/spyir btang gi mi snas spyod pa la shod pa'i kha mtshar rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin/ 729 sems bsam pas bar snang la rta rgyug kyang / rgyu dngos pos sbar mthil la so mi thebs/ rlabs che ba'i bya gzhag cig rtsom 'dod chen po yod na'ang / dpal 'byor thog nas 'gro gron gtong byed med pas rgya 'ub 'dus kyi mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/183

740 so yod sran ma za bar/ so med snying rlung ma langs/rgyu nor yod mkhan gyis 'dod yon longs su spyod par/ nor med rnams kyis zhe sdang ma byed zer ba lta bu de'i rigs la skabs bstun gyis spyod pa'o/ / 741 sog po la yod pa/ rnga mong / nga la yod pa de yin pas nges par du phul chog zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing /bdag gzhan dus gsum sogs skabs dang bstun nas 〉〉ka grogs bsgyur chog pa yin/ 742 sog po'i las la/ bsod nams chos 'phel mkhas/bya ba 'di la mi che ge mo cha rgyus che ba'am/ byang chub pa yo da zer ba lta bur spyod cing / gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs lo rgyus4le tshan drug pa'i khongs su gsal yod/742 sol ba chu yis bkrus kyang / nag tu 'gro/ rang bzhin ngan pa'i mi la btud nas re 'dun brjod kyang / je thur 'gro ba las/ phan thogs med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/744 sra sar 'dred/ snyi sar zug ngo rgol dang kha gtad bcar na bya rgyu ci yang med pa dang / sems chung sdug 'khur byas na je thu je ngan du 'gro mkhan zhig red zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /745— 1 srin po mir rdzus/ (srin 'bu mer rdzus kyang zer ) ma yin yin mdog gis rdzus ma mgo skor gtong mkhan la spyod pa yin/184

745— 2 sran ma ma thub/ yos la kha cheg cheg dbang nor gyis dregs pa'i btsan po rnams la kha gtad bcar mi nus par/gnyom chung gi mgo la rdog rdzis gtong shag shag byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ 746 gsang dang ma gsang mi 'dug zhabs rjes gangs la bzhag rang gis gsang ba byed khul byas kyang bya ba de'i rjes shul gsal po kun gyis shes par bzhag pa zer ba lta bur spyod cing /gtam dpe 'di ni tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu'i gzhas tshig nas chags par mngon/747 gsang ba la rang mkhas kyang / rjod pa la mi mkhas/bya ba mi legs pa zhig byung dus mi mang pos de phyir grags mi 'byung ba'i thabs shes la 'bad pa chen po byed pa de rigs la gang ltar gsang ba byed thub thabs med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/748 gsal yang mar me gcig 'bar/ skyid kyang ston mjug sbrang ma/ da lta gnas tshul bzang po yod na yang / de ring por gnas mi thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul )749 gsung rgyu bla mas gsung yong / mdzad rgyu bla mas mdzad yong / 'di byas na mi 'grig dang / de byas na mi chog ces shod mkhan kho tsho rang gis byas na mi 'grig pa dang mi chog pa tshang ma sngon la byas yong zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/750 gser dang rag gang yin/ ka shu ka la brdar na shes/185

mi bzang ngan dang / don bden rdzun gang yin de tshang ma spyi tshogs kyi lag len ngo ma brgyud na gzhi nas dbye ba gsal po 'byed thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ / 751 gser sa le sbram/ me la mi skrag rang nyid la nyes skyon ci yang med na/ brtsad zhib dang brtag dpyad ji ltar byed na'ang skrag dgos don med zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ / 752 gser sa 'og na yod༅nga / 'od nam mkha'/ mi la shes yon dang 'jon thang yod na/ rang nyid kyis ngom 'phyar ma byas na'ang / spyi tshogs thog de'i snyan grags 'gog thabs med par khyab 'gro ba yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 752 gsog pa che gang dang / dgos pa nyin gcig don gnad gal 'gangs chen po thug dus 'gro gron la 'dzems rgyu med par gtong phod pa bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /754 bsod nams la ba bskos kyang / dbang thang la bzhon skam/ dper na mi zhig sa zhing gshin po rgya chen zhig gi bdag por gyur na yang / stabs ma legs par lo nyes chen po sngar na ma grags pa zhig byung ste ston 'bras lag tu len rgyu ma byung ba lta bu la spyod pa yin /755 bsod bde med pa'i sgog gtun du/ chil lu brdungs kyang zhag mi 'khor/ dper na lam 'gro zhan pa'i mi zhig nom pa chen po yod pa'i bya ba bdag gnyer mkhan zhig tu bskos na yang / lam bar nas rgyu nor yod do cog jag rkun gyis bcom ste gang yang ma lhag pa lta bu 186

de rigs la skabs dang bstun nas spyod pa'o/ / (gtsang khul )756 ham pa ri tsam ma bshad na/ bden pa g.yag tsam ga la thob/ spyir na ham pa can la nyes chad thob dgos mod/ 'on kyang spyi tshogs kyi rgyu rkyen sna tshogs 'og bden rdzun go ldog pa'i gnas tshul yang yang thon par brten de lta bu'i spyod tshul la yi ma rangs par spyod pa'i ldog bshad kyi gtam dpe zhig yin/757 hor chen rgyal po'i mnga' 'og hor zhwa mi gyon ka med/bya ba 'di 'dra zhig byed 'dod med kyang / gzhan dbang du gyur pas mi byed ka med byung zhes pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /758 lha khang ma las/ sgo mchor mtshar ba/ gong rim las/'og rim rgyas spros che ba 'dug zer ba lta bu mtho dma' 'am che chung go log pa de rigs la spyod pa yin/759 lha khang rnying par/ gnas bshad gsar pa/ 'char can gyi don dag la rgyu mtshan gsar pa bshad kyang / don snying ci yang med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/760 lha mang sar/ 'dre mang / dgon pa chen po'i nang tshul ldan gyi chos pa mang ba de bzhin tshul min spyod ngan byed mkhan gyi grwa pa'ang de bas mang po yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/761 lha mdun la bzhag lha phyag rgyab la 'tshal blo gtad bcol sar rgyab gtod byed pa zer ba lta bu sogs phyin ci log pa'i bya spyod kyi rigs la spyod pa yin/187

762—1 lha lung la/ 'dre lag rgyal khab bam/ yang na srid 'dzin sa khul sogs so so'i bdag khongs kyi sa char gzhan gyis btsan gnod dam/ ham za byed pa sogs la spyod pa yin/762—2 lha las lhag pa'i lus/ re ba las lhag pa'i don chen 'grub pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin te/ dper na bu rgan pa de dmag khral khongs tshud par pha mas bu rgan pa 'di'i tshab la bu 'bring ba 'di btang nas 'thus pa zhig gnang rogs zhes khyim tshang gi dka' ngal sogs zhu skabs/ dmag bsdu bas dka' ngal de 'dra yon na khyed tsho'i bu gnyis ka dmag khongs su 'gro mi dgos pa ci 'dra 'dug zer ba'i lan du de 'dra byung na ‘6lha las lhag pa'i lus ’ yin zhes pa lta bur spyod pa gzhan la'ang 'gre/762 lha lung dpa' rdor ri la bros kyang / rta pho'i zhabs rjes thang la bzhag yod/ mis g.yol thabs byed bsam na'ang byas rjes drud shul gsal po bsdad yod pas thar thabs med zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ / gtam dpe'i 'byung khungs le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal/ 764 lha sa'i rgan mos/ lha sa'i jo bo mi mjal/ yul lung ngam grong khyer gcig gi nang du gnas na yang / phan tshun mjal 'phrad kyi go skabs ha cang dkon po 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /765 lha gsar pa las/ 'dre rnying pa dga'/ rgyus med pa'i ji tsam yag pa las/ rgyus yod pa'i mi ji tsam ngan na'ang gdengs 188

tshod ldan pas de yag zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / 'di'i thog nas bod dmangs rnams phyi thag ring ba'i lta tshul de mtshon gyi yod/766 lha gsol ma dgos par/ dpal rgya thongs nas babs/'bad brtson byed ma dgos par/ rang gi 'dod don de lhun gyis grub song zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/767 lhan pa gcig gi 'og la/ skud sne brgya tshud pa/ bar 'dum lta bu byed skabs 'brel yod rnyog gzhi chung rtsag gang yod kyang chabs cig 'khrun thag chod pa zhig yong ba'am/ yang na yong ba dka' zer ba sogs skabs bstun gang 'os su spyad chog76〈 lham mdog ngan yang nywa dro/ dngos po mig la mi mdzes na'ang / don la phan thogs po yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ (khams khul )769 a khu ston pa/ sa nas sa la zag rgyu med/ nga da lta'i gnas bab 'di las dma' ru 'gro sa med ces blos gtong mi phod rgyu gang yang med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ dpe 'di'i byung tshul le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/770 a khu med na med thabs med/ a khu yod na yod thabs med/ mi shes rgu shes dang / mi dran rgu dran mang bas skabs re phan thogs pa dang / skabs re rtsod gzhi rnyog dra bzo mkhan gyi mi de lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'di'i 'byung stangs le tshan drug pa'i khongs su gsal yod/ 189

771 a khus btang btang mang la/ shor shor mang / rtag tu ngas btang ngas 'jon zhes 'bor shob kho na shod na yang / don la 'jon nus ci yang med par mi tsho'i 'phya yul du gyur pa'i mi de rigs la spyod pa'i zur za zhig yin/ dpe 'di'i byung tshul le tshan drug par gsal yod/ 772 a ces shes bya byas pa de/ nu mos 'phrul rgyag la gorang ngos nas lhag bsam rnam dag gis bsam shes byas pa de/ phar phyogs nas mgo skor bslu brid lta bur brtsi yi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/772 a nes btsugs pa'i zam par/ a ne rang 'gro dgos/ranganyid kyis byas pa'i las ka de rnyog dra dang dka' ngal chen po ci 'dra yodan yang / so so rang gis mgo thag 'bud dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung rkyen le tshan drug pa'i nang gsal yod/ 774 a pho rang gis 'jon na/ dga' ldan gser khri la bdagapo med/ rang gi 'bad brtson dang 'jon thang gis ma bslus na/ spyi tshogs thog mi kun gyis brtsi bkur dang snyan grags rang shugs kyis 'thob nges la bkag 'gog byed mkhan med ces 'gran rtsod la bskul bar spyod pa yin/775 a phos 'khrab 'khrab/ ra phos 'khrab pa/ dbang nor ldan pa'am/ yang na thob thang yod mkhan gyis longs spyod byed pa 190

nang bzhin mi phal pas byed mi chog zer ba'am/ yang skabs re mi skyid med sdug zad kyis gang byung mang byung byed pa lta bu tshang mas bya rgyu med zer ba sogs la skabs bstun gyis spyad chog776 a bra'i dpon po rdza bra/ sre mong 'ongs na mnyam bros/mi de lta bu 'go khrid la bskos na yang / dka' ngal 'phrad dus sel thab sa kyi nus pa gang yang 'don mi thub pas med pa dang 'dra zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )777 a (rna ) 'byog bkog nas/ rkub kyi lhan pa/g.yas len g.yon 'jal sogs bya thabs ha cang gi thabs rdugs po phan las gnod che ba byed mkhan la spyod pa yin/77〈 a (rna ) 'byog rgyab kyi lhag pa/ bslab bya'am/yang na mngags gdams sogs yang nan bskyar nan byas na'ang /sems la gtan nas mi zhog par snang med du gtong ba lta bur spyod pa yin/779 a ma a shag nu ma nu shag mi dang bya ba gang yin na'ang sngar gyi 'brel ba'am/ byed stangs de ga rang sor bzhag byed pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / 'on kyang phar phyogs nas de dang mi mthun pa zhig byung ba shugs la ston gyin yod/780 a'u rtsi dang grogs po ma byed/ a'u rtsi/ a'u rtsi zhes gnas skabs kyi kha mkhas spyod mkhan gyi mi dang grogs po byas na don gnad 'gag rtsar thug dus phan ci yang mi thogs zhes kha mkhas can la 191

yid ches ma byed zer bar spyod pa yin/ 781 a yag dgos na/ a tsha sgoms/ snying rje po yong dgos na/ sdug rus byed dgos zer ba ste dper na/ bu mo tsho rna 'byog la bu ga 'big skabs lta bu sogs de 'dra'i rigs la spyod pa'o/ /782 a rig rig pa khra yin na/ grong stod shar pa mi yin/khyod spyang po dang thabs 'phrul ji tsam yod na yang / nga yang shes rig dang spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong gang dang gang la byang chub pa zhig yin pas tshad bsdur ga re byed na'ang byas chog zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/grong stod shar pa zer ba ni de snga shangs rnam gling rdzong khongs kyi khyim tshang chen po zhig yin/ (gtsang khul )782 a ru ra rgya gar la skyes pa dang / go snyod rtsig khug la skyes pa ga la 'dra/ 'di ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rigs rgyud smra ba'i bshad tshul zhig yin/ skye sa rus khungs mtho dma' gnyis mi'i shes rig dang 'jon thang sogs 'dra sa med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / dpe tshig 'di'i thog nas bod rnying par spyi tshogs kyi bsam blo rig gnas thad rgya gar can du gyur pa'i phyogs lhung gsal por mngon gyin yod/ 784 ye yod nang gi da yod/ sgo nga'i nang gi ser ril/tshang ma'i nang gi yag shos dang / yag shos nang gi yag shos de yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/785 o rti'i sked pa bcag yong / ma 'ongs pa'i phugs re 192

'grub nges kyi gdengs tshod ci yang med bzhin du 'di dang 'di byas te grub 'bras 'di dang 'di thob na bed spyod 'di ltar byed zer ba stong bsam 'chang mkhan la zur za byed par spyod pa yin zhing / gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung tshul gtam rgyus le tshan drug pa'i nang 'khod yod/ (lha sa khul )786 o lo deng gos chung / tshad kyin tshad kyin/ phar phyogs kyi byed stangs la blta yin blta yin bsam blo gtong rgyu zer ba lta bu ste/ bu tsha'am yang na mna' ma mag pa/ dge phrug sogs shul 'dzin pa gso skyong byed phyogs skor de rigs spyod pa mang / de kha gtad phyogs gzhan la spyad na chog pa yin/ (gtsang khul )193

le tshanaganyis ba/ bodagana' rabs pas dpeyang drangs nas donagacig mtshonapar byed pa'i rtsom srol gyi rgyunaltar/ dpe nyis rtsegagis brjod don gang yin pade nan tanadu ston pa'igatamadape'i gras/1 ki la ki lan dang / dgra la dgra lan/ tshur rnam 'gyur ram/ spyod tshul ci lta bu zhig 'dzin pa de bzhin du phar yang de dang 'tshams pa zhig 'dzin rgyu yin zer ba'am/ yang na 'dzin dgos zer ba lta bu skabs bstun gyis sgyur chog pa yin/ 2 ki hor pas rgyag rgyu hor mos/ khyi bdag pos 'gog rgyu mgron pos/ bya ba gang yin yang byed 'os pa des ma byas par/ byed ma 'os pa zhig gis go ldog nas byed pa de ni 'jig rten srol lugs dang mthun pa'i bya ba zhig min zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/2 ko ba skam pos khab mi len/ sbang ma zlon pas chu mi len/dper na kha mchu byang ma'i mi la kha gtad dang rgyu mtshan ji ltar bshad na yang / nyan shes byed mi srid zer ba'am/ khrims med ngan rengs su song ba'i mi la dge skyon yin lugs kyi go gsed ji tsam byas kyang phan pa 194

med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/4 dkar po nog sla/ ring po chag sla/ mi dang bya ba gang yin ru nga ha cang rtser son pa la gnod byed kyi 'gal rkyen ma nga po 'ong sla bas na/ 'os shing ran pa'i dus su tshod bzung dgos zer ba lta bur spyod par snang / (a mdo khul )5 rkyan mar dpa' dar dang / srungasha che thar/ tshig 'grel/dpa' dar ni dpa' bor gzengs bstod byed pa'i don yin pas de rkun ma la sprod pa dang / spyang ki tshe thar du gtong ba ni lugs dang mi mthun pa dper bzhag pa'o/ / don 'grel/ khrims sa nas nyes can la khrims ltar chad pa ma bcad par ngan pa byas rgyal du btang song zhes ngo rgol byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/6 skud sne khab kyis khrid/ char sne rlung gis khrid/ dpe nyis rtseg drangs te don la gyod gzhi'am/ dmag 'khrug sogs yong rkyen gyi rtsa ba thug sa'am sna khrid byed mkhan la le lan 'ded skabs spyod pa yin/7 skrangs pas sbyar len dgos/ 'breng pas chu len dgos/rang la phan pa yod pa zhig yin phyin/ 'phral la mi bde ba'am mi bzod tsam zhig yin rung / bzod sran skyed de dang len bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ / 8 kha gcig pa 'khor lo 'dra 'dra/ gros gcig pa rgya ma 'dra 'dra/ dper na tshong rar dngos zog gi rin gong 'dri skabs gcig 195

nang bzhin shod pa dang / mtha' ma'i gong tshad gtan 'khel skabs kyang tshang mas gros byas pa nang ltar grangs tshad gcig pa shod kyin 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul )9 kha stong nang gi chig stong / lag stong nang gi phyag rgya/ kha bshad stong pa rkyang rkyang bshad nas don la phan pa'i skad cha tshig gcig med mkhan gyi mi la 'phya dmod byed pa la spyod par snang / (a mdo khul )10 kha ba babs na nyin srib med/ nyi ma shar na phu mda' med/ skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung rung spyi tshogs yongs khyab la 'brel ba yod pas spyi la phan gnod gang yong bsam blo gtong ba las/ sger phan spyi gnod kyi bya ba byed mi nyan zer ba la spyod pa mang zhing / yang skabs re ldog nas spyi don bzang ngan gang byung yang tshang mar 'ong rgyu las/ nga sger la khyad par mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod mkhan yang yod/11 khab rgyas mgar ba dang / chu rgyus mnyan pa/ dpe nyis rtseg 'di bya ba gang dang gang yin na'ang / de dang de lag len rgyun du byed mkhan la cha rgyus zhib phra yod zer ba la spyod cing / yang skabs re bya ba ga ge mo de'i cha rgyus tshang ma nga la yod zer bar spyod srol yang yod/12 khab chem mngags/ sbyad pa dbugs mngags/ khyod rang bya ba de sgrub mkhan la ched du mngags pa las/ de ma yin pa'i bya ba gnyis pa zhigagatan nas med zer ba lta bur spyod cing / bya ba de ma 'grub pa ci yin zer ba'am/ nges par du sgrub pa zhig ma byas na 196

'grig mi yong zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun/ 12 khal gsum theg nas bong bu'i lus/ nam chod thing nas bya pho'i lus/ bya ba sgrub pa'am/ yang na thag gcod bya rgyu sogs gang zhig yin na yang / go chod pa'am gdengs tshod yod nas 'dir 'ongs pa yin zer ba lta bur spyod cing / yang skabs re mi gzhan la khyod rang go chod byas nas 'dir 'ongs pa red zer ba la'ang spyad na chog pa yin/14 khog pa'i snying dang / dpral ba'i mig yod tshad thams cad kyi nang nas gces shos dang / rtsa ba che shos 'ba' zhig de yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 15 khyi gcig gis gla pho gnyis/ mda' gcig gis bya rgod gnyis/ de ni mi thub pa dang mi srid pa zhig yin pas de lta bu'i las 'gan sgrub dgos she na bsgrub mi thub ces pa'am/ yang na de ltar sgrub kyi yin zer na rtsa ba nas bsgrub mi nus zhes bshol 'debs pa sogs la spyod pa yin/ 16 khra khra 'ug pa'i sgro 'dra/ mi snyoms sog le'i kha 'dra/skad cha bshad pa de la yin tsam min tsam dang / snga tshig phyi 'gal 'bur tsam nyag tsam sogs skyon cha mang po 'dug pas yid rton mi 'pher zhes pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshon byed lta bur /spyod pa yin/ 17 ོ 'khar rnga phyi nas rdung / dril bu nang nas rdung / mi tshang mar gnas bab mi 'dra ba'i thog nas so sor mi bde ba bzo mkhan gyi rgyu rkyen re re yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/197

1nga gong ma'i yan na gong ma/ bla ma'i yan na bla ma/ lung chung nang gi dpon chung sogs kyis rang nyid las lhag pa med pa lta bu'i khengs dregs byed pa'am/ yang na gzhi rim nas gyod don thag gcod drang po mi byed pa la gong zhu bya rgyu zer ba sogs la/spyod pa yin/19 gos gsum brtsegs pa'i 'og ma/ gdan gsum brtsegs pa'i steng ma/ 'di ni yag shos dang gzab shosade yin zer bar spyod par snang zhing / de'i thog nas bod rigs sa mthor gnas pas gos dang / gdan rtseg srol yod pa dang / de yang gos yin na 'og ma je zab dang / gdan yin na steng ma je legs spyod pa'i goms srol yod pa de'ang shes thub/ (a mdo khul ) tsho20 gyod klan ka gnyis kyi mgo khungs/ rnag chu ser gnyis kyi gzhi ma/ rtsod gzhi dang 'khrug rkyen tshang ma'i sne khrid dang 'byung gzhi'i rtsa ba mi che ge mo 'am/ khyim tshang ga ge mo 'di rang thug yod ces pa lta bur spyod pa'o/ /21 grong gcig pa la rkyan ma sdang / lug gcig pa la spyang ki sdang / dpe nyis rtseg bkod nas/ nyung sa dang dkon sa kho nar chag sgo dang bar chad yong nyen che zer ba'am/ 'byung ba yin zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/22 dgos ran dus rgod po ri la shor/ rgyag ran dus me mda' kha su shor/ rgyun gtan bya las gang dang gang la yang nga mkhas/ngas 'jon zhes kha pho sgrog pa'am/ skad grags dang spobs pa yod 198

mkhan gyi mis/ da lta bya las de dang de la dngos sa 'jug dgos pa'i ༄skabs de las g.yol ba'am/ yang na nus pa ci yang 'don mi thub pa la zur za byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/2 2 dgra khar grog shor/ khyi khar rus shor/ dpe nyis rtseg 'di ltar bkod nas rang phyogs la'ang phan pa byung dogs kyis ma shor rnam gsum gyi phangs sems byed kyin 'dug ces zur za byed pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 24 mgo thog gi bum pa/ lce thog gi bdud rtsi/ brtsi bkur che shos dang / bka' gsung dang len zhu sa 'di ga rang yin zhes bla ma'am/ dge rgan sogs la spyod pa mang zhing / la las dpon por ngo bstod byed dus kyang spyod mkhan yod/25 mgo bo rmog gis rmas/ dkon gnyer sku 'dras mnan/rang nyid skyob rgyu'i re ba bcol sa de las/ rang la gnod 'tshe phog byung zer ba de rigs la spyod pa yin/26 mgo la dpag pa'i zhwa dang / kha la dpag pa'i so/ dpe nyis rtseg 'di pho gzhon mo gzhon tshos gnyen zla sgrig skabs rang la 'os shing 'tshams pa zhig yod zer ba'am/ yong srid ces pa lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / yang skabs re 'os bab yod pa zhig 'tshol dgos zhes pa lta bur spyad kyang chog pa yin/27 'grul pa 'gro kha dang / nad pa 'chi kha/ ngang bsrings dang / sgug sdod bya rgyu'i long khom med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa 199 4

yin/2ra 'gro wa mo ltar phyin rung mjug ma ring skyon/ sdod ri bong las tsog kyang rna ba ring skyon/ zhe sdang phrag dog can gyi khor yug nang / sems chung dang bag yod ji ltar byas na'ang ma 'grig ma 'thus pa'i lab rgyu gleng rgyu nam yang rdzogs mtha' mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 29 'gro zhim mi las mkhas pa/ sdod ri bong la tsog pa/snyoms chung 'gro bzo sdod mkhas kyis su la'ang phog thug mi shor ba byed kyi yod zer ba'am/ bya dgos zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 20 rgyug dmyal ba dang / rgyobs pha mgo cha rkyen gang la bltos pa med par ci gsung de sgrub rang srog 'dor phod pa bya/ rgyu zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ / 21‘ rnga dang 'dra ba'i ngo gnyis/ sbrul dang 'dra ba'i lce gnyis/ phyogs khag phan tshun nam/ yang na mi re re'i mdun du ngo mi 'dra ba re ston pa dang/ yin min nam bzang ngan sogs skad cha rbad de phyin ci slog ste shod mkhan gyi mi dbyen sbyor dkrug shing rgyag mkhan la spyod pa'i sting tshig drag po zhig yin no/ / 22 brngams che na stag mo mid pa 'gag mchongs che na seng ge gan rkyal log stobs ldan ci 'dra zhig yin na'ang / bya ba sgrub skabs ha cang thal che drags na mtha' 'bras bzang po mi yong bas pho tshod 'dzin shes pa de gal che ba yin zer ba'am/ yang na ham pa che 200

drags tshe mtha' mjug yong rgyu de las med ces snying tshim bzla ba lta bur spyad na'ang chog pa'o/ /22 cha lugs mi gcig so so/ chos lugs mi gcig khag khaga'atsho ba'i spyod tshul dang / bsam blo'i khyer so sogs gang gi thad nas kyang gcig mthun yong thabs mi 'dug zer ba lta bu bza' tshang tha dad byed dgos pa'i rgyu rkyen nam/ gnyen sgrig khas len mi byed pa sogs la spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul )24 chu rgyug shul dang / gdung ma drud shāl/ sngar gyi lam srol gang yod ltar byas pa yin zer ba'am/ yang na sngar lam gang dang gang yod pa 'tshol zhib kyis de gzhir bzung bya rgyu las ma 'das zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/25 chu dwangs du dwangs du/ nya gsal du gsal du/ rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnas tshul rnams re re bzhin brtag dpyad dang zhib 'jug byas na gang zhig bden/ gang zhig rdzun yin pa je gsal je gsal du 'gyur thub pa yong zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/26 chu gtsang po dkrugs nas mar mi thon/ rdo g.yam pa gcir nas snum mi thon/ don snying dang 'brel ba med pa'i stong bshad mang po phar bshad tshur bshad rdzogs rgyu med pa byed pa'am/ tha na don med rtsod gleng yang byed pa sogs de rigs la dgos don dang / snying po ci yang med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )27 chos lam rim klog gin zhe sdang je che/ rdo cong zhi za 201

bzhin nad pa je thu/ phan tshun mthun 'grig yong ba'i don la phan ched thabs lam dang spyod tshul ma lan ma 'gyod pa zhig byas na yang / re 'bras smin rgyu phar bzhag de bas ldog phyogs su 'phel nas gnas tshul je zhan je sdug tu 'gyur bzhin 'dug zer ba de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 28 nga bkol na thab zangs kha kha/ me 'bud na dud khung so so/ phan tshun dbar gang dang gang gi thad la'ang 'brel ba dang /'dra 'dres rtsa ba nas med pa khag khag so so yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul )29 jo lags sku thang mnyel rogs/ sha khri rkang pa tsha rogs/ ri dwags gsod mi thub par rngon rgyag tu 'gro ba ni mi dka' las che ba dang / rngon khyi rkang pa tsha ba las 'bras bu med ces dper bstan te/don la 'grub mi thub pa'i bya bar 'bad rtsol byed pa ni ngal gron gyi rgyu las ma mchis zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ (kong po khul )40 'jag ma'i la btsas/ shog bu'i dar lcog la la la btsas dang / de la dar lcog 'dzugs pa sogs ni gna' rabs bon las chad pa'i bod kyi yul srol zhig yin pa de dper bzhag pa'o/ / don la yid rton gtad so ci yang med pa'i mi dang bya ba sogs la zur za byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/41 'jog par zhabs ra dang / 'chang bar lung / nyer spyad dngos po'i rigs la mar 'jog pa'i zhabs ra dang / lag pa 202

'chang sa'i lung med na mi 'grig pa dper bzhag ste/ mi dang / bya ba/ gtam brjod sogs gang yin rung / brten sa'i khungs lung dang rgyu mtshan yod dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / med na mi 'grig zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun chog pa yin/42 nyag kha'i ser ba/ lung mdo'i chu log rtag par gzhan gyi brnyas bcos sam/ 'phrog bcom bar chad yong sla ba'i sde tsho'am/ khyim tshang sogs la nyams nyes yang yang phrad pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )42 nyi ma je ring dang / rtsam pa je 'im/ gtso bo gtan grogs gshis bzang zhig btsal na mi tshe ring po ji tsam gshibs pa de tsam gyis mdza' brtse je zab tu 'gro zer ba lta bur spyod par snang zhing /rtsam pa ni bod rigs kyi bza' cha gtso bo ji tsam zos rung / zhe kha log rgyu med pa zhig yin pa dper bkod pa des gsar 'grogs kyi a gsar gtan nas bya mi nyan pa shugs la bstan yod snyam/44 nyin mo'i mi dang / mtshan mo'i khyi/ spyi don nam/yang na khyim tshang gi don du nyin mtshan gang la'ang ma bltos par rang nus gang yod lhag bsam zol med kyi sgo nas 'bad brtson lhod med byas pa yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/45 nye ring med pa'i gtam zhig shod/ che chung med pa'i skal zhig bgo ngas phan tshun gnyis ka la nye rgyang med pa'i bar 'dum zhig bya rgyu yin zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na khyed rang gis drang bzhag 203

tshad ldan zhig gis bar gzu bya dgos zer ba sogs la spyod pa dang /yang tshad ma'i skyes bu'am tshad ma'i spyod tshul zhes pa 'di lta bu la bya zer ba la spyad kyang chog('brog khul )46 gnyom chung gi mgo la/ sems chung gi sbar mo bkab/gong 'og g.yas g.yon sogs su la'ang phog thug mi 'gro ba dang / gang sar khrims mthun lugs mthun 'gro gzo sdod mkhas kho na byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ bdag gzhan dus gsum dang bya byed sogs skabs dang bstun nas bsgyur chog47 te po'i nang gi gzugs bzang / sprang po'i nang gi stobs ldan/ mchan/ 'dir gzugs bzang ni gzugs tshad mtho ba dang / stobs ldan ni 'byor pa ldan par go dgos shing / go don ni zhan pa'i khrod nas cung zad ngo mtho ba zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / rang dang sbyor skabs khengs skyungs kyi nyams dang / mi gzhan la sbyar na mthong chung gi rnam pa mtshon gyi yod/48 gtam kha byang / bris lag byang / mi tshe hril por kha mchu rgyag mkhan gyi mis bshad pa'i gtam dang / bris pa'i zhu gtugs kyi yi ger 'dra 'dra 'grig 'grig kho na yod rung / de la cha 'jog bya thabs med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin 'dra snyam pa dpyad dgos/ (a mdo khul )49 gtam a phas lab rgyu a mas/ mda' bu tshas rgyag rgyu bu mos/ phan tshun gyod gzhi thug skabs/ ngas shod dgos pa'i skad cha 204

de phyin ci slog nas kho pas tshur shod kyin 'dug ces dngos 'brel nad mi theg pa de nga yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'dir pho mo 'dra mnyam med pa'i shan che tsam zhugs yod/50 rta kha lag pas sgyur dgos/ yob chen rkang pas non dgos/ rang nyid sde tshan zhig gi 'gan 'khur na/ de'i khongs gtogs kyi mi dang bya ba'i kha lo sgyur shes pa zhig dang / btang 'dzin gang byed rang gi lag par 'dzin thub pa zhig bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul )51 rta rgod khrid na thur thag ring dgos/ sdong rgan gcod na sta yun ring dgos/ spyi tshogs thog gi bya ba tshang ma gcig ma yin pas dmigs bsal gyi bya bar dmigs bsal gyi bya thabs re yod dgos/de yang bya yul dngos kyi gnas lugs dang mthun pa'i bya thabs khyad par ba zhig 'dzin shes pa bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/52 rtargyug na rgyug mnyam/ guracug nakha sprod/ phan tshun phyogs gang thad nas 'dra 'dra mnyam mnyam yin pas khyod 'og la nga 'dur dgos med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'di'i thog nas bod kyi sngar srol la rta rgyug snga rting dang / gur rgyag sa mtho dma' de ni mi so so'i spyi tshogs kyi thob thang mtshon pa'i rtags mtshan gal chen po zhig la brtsi ba gsal por mngon gyin yod/52 rta 'do ba'i rgyug lam bde dgos/ khab skud pa'i shur lam drang dgos/ bya ba gang dang gang byed na yang / de dang de'i 205

dgos mkho dang 'tshams pa'i mthun rkyen mi 'dra ba so sor 'dzoms dgos pa yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ (a mdo khul )54 ltas ngan la blta skyor/ dri ngan la snom skyor/ sngar byas jus nyes byung ba'i bya ba de/ da cha bskyar du byed 'dod gtan nas med zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na bza' tshang nang ma mthun par bye bral bya rgyu zer skabs bar mi gnyen tshan gyis bskyar sgrig yong thabs go skon byed pa'i lan la 'grig 'dod med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/55 stag mchongs sar rjes/ shing rta drud sar shul/ bya ba gang dang gang yin rung / de dngos su byas phyin chad gang byas pa'i rjes dang shul zhig nges par ston rgyu yod dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la skabs dang bstun nas spyod pa yin/54 stag dar mas stag phrug khrid khrid/ 'brong bre lus 'brong phrug gso gso/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'am/ yang na ched las kyi shul 'dzin pa sogs slob khrid sbyong gsum gang ci'i thad la dka' ngal dang / 'gro gron 'dzems med kyi sgo nas gso skyong lhad med byas yod zer ba lta bu'am/ bya rgyu yin dang byed kyin yod sogs gang dgos tshig grogs bsgyur na 'grig(a mdo khul )57 ltar ka phyed gshag mda' mo ltong gshag bza' mi'am/ khyim tshang tha dad byed skabs phan tshun phyogs gnyis kur phyi nor nang rdzas ji yod mang nyung med par phyed ka tag tag bgo bsha' rgyag dgos zer ba la spyod pa yin/206

58 ster ba'i ngo so dang / btsongs pa'i rin pa/ dngos rdzas g.yar nas phyir sprod ma byas pa'am/ bun lon mi 'jal ba sogs byung dus spyod pa yin zhing / rgyu dngos phyir song la thob 'os pa'i lan gong gsal gnyis ka ma byung zer ba'o/ /59 tho rengs langs nas gang yong / rnga shang dgrogs nas gang yong / 'di ni bon po la 'phya ba'i gna' gtam zhig yin pa mtshon/dus phyis nam ma gsal gong nas langs na'ang / don go ci yang ma byung ba'am/ byung ma song zer ba'i mtshar gtam la spyod pa mang /60 bden pa'i lto zos/ bden pa'i gos gyon/ rnam pa kun tu khrims mthun lugs mthun gyi 'tsho ba skyel ba las/ khrims srol dang 'gal ba'i bya ba gtan nas byed ma myong zer ba la spyod pa yin/61 bden rdzun bar na sor bzhi/ skyid sdug bar na gom gang /khrims las mi btsan pa'i dus su bden pa rdzun par 'gyur ba la tshegs med pa de lta bu'i 'og skyid sdug ji ltar yong ba la'ang gdengs tshod ci yang mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /62 mdud pa dgo rus mi khrol/ 'dzen pa sta res mi gsil/dge bshad skyon ston gyi go gsed ji ltar byas na yang / phan tshun gyi 'khon sems mi zhi ba dang / 'gal zla mi sel ba zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod par snang / ('brog khul )62 mdun rten gyi 'khar ba/ rgyab rten gyi brag ri/ re sa dang / brten sa gang zer na'ang khyed rang ma gtogs gzhan med zer 207

ba lta bur spyod pa yin/64 mdun brten gyi khar ba/ rgyab rten gyi slog pa/ de ni 'gal rkyen kun sel ba dang / mthun rkyen mtha' dag yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i mgon skyabs nyag cig yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ (khams khul )65 rdo chung yang rdza gcog me chung yang shing 'chig gnod byed kyi rigs chung ngu la'ang snang chung byed mi rung bar/ 'go 'bud ma thag tu do snang dang / sel thabs byed dgos zer bar spyod pa yin/66 sdig chen dmyal bar 'gro zhor/ har pa bu lon len zhor/ jus nyes sam/ ming shas kyi grags pa ngan pa zhig khyab zin pa'i skabs su yid chad pa'am/ 'u thug nas mu mthud ya yud che ba'i bya ba zhig brtsam rgyu yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ / har pa ni tshong nyes shor te ma rtsa stongs nas bu lon sprod mi thub mkhan la zer/67 sdig pas snum thigs dang / sbal pas tshwa thigs/ 'bu srin sdig pa ra tshas mar snum gyi thigs pa dang / sbal pas lan tshwa'i thigs pa rtsa ba nas mi bzod pa de dper bzhag ste/ bzod bsran mi thub pa dang bzod glags mi 'dug zer bar spyod pa yin/68 sdong bzang la 'bras bzang thogs/ son bzang la myug bzang skye/ pha ma bzang po la bu tsha bzang po 'ong ba dang / dge rgan bzang po las dge phrug bzang po thon thub pa yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / 'di la rigs rgyud ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen cung zad phog 208

yod pa ltar snang rung / sgo phyugs dang gcan gzan sogs dngos yod las rgyu mtshan med pa'ang min snyam/69 nam mkha'i bya dkrogs/ sa gzhi'i 'bu dkrogs/ yul mi drag 'bring dkyus gsum tshang mar dogs 'drog 'khos su mi phebs pa yong gzhi'i don rkyen bzos pa lta bu la spyod pa yin/70 nam zla'i bab la bltas nas gyon lugs/ phye rkyal bongs la bltas nas za lugs/ spyi tshogs kyi bya spyod gang yin rung dus bab dang bstun nas bya dgos pa dang / 'tsho ba longs su spyod stangs ni rang nyid kyi dpal 'byor yong 'bab la dpags pa zhig bya dgos zhes pa lta bur spyad kyang chog la/ thad kur zas gos spyod stangs la gdams par go na'ang 'grig71 gnam sngon mo 'bab res thang res/ sa dog mo skya res sngo res/ sde tsho'am/ khyim tshang sogs phan tshun chags sdang gis gcig la jus nyes byung dus/ gcig shos kyis ltad mo blta ba lta bur spyi tshogs thog skyid res dang sdug res sam/ dar res gud res sogs tshang mar yong srid pas ltad mo phar lta tshur lta yin zer ba lta bur spyad na chog('brog khul )72 gnam mtsho la rab dang / thang lha la la/ sngar na ma grags shing / mi srid pa'i gtam mam bya ba sogs rna bar mi 'gro ba zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )72 dpe med kyi mchod rten la/ lung med kyi rab gnas/209

bka' khrims dang / yig rigs/ yul srol sogs gang dang yang mi mthun par rang snang gang dran gyis rtsod gzhi khungs lung med pa zhig bzos pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/74 spo'o la bu tshas rnam thar/ nas la sbang mas kha ta/ cha rgyus zhib phra yod pa'i mi la/ rgyus mnga' de tsam med mkhan gyis 'di 'dra dang de 'dra byed dgos zhes shod pa lta bur zur za byed pa la spyod pa yin/ (gtsang khul )75 sprung ki la ki dang / lug rdzi la brda/ 'brel yod so sor brda lan dus thog tu sprad pa yin zer ba'am/ yang na sprod dgos zer ba/ sprad ma byung zer ba sogs skabs don dang bstun nas tshig mjug bsgyur te spyod pa yin/76 sprung ki la dkar nag dang / rnga ma la sbom phra med/ spyi tshogs la gnod pa'i mi ngan gyi rigs la bzang ngan dang / che chung sogs kyi dbye ba phye dgos don med pa tshang mar rdung rdeg gtong dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/77 spyang gis sha za/ rkun mas mna' za/ de dag ni gdon mi za ba yin pas/ mi gzhan gyis bden bden 'grig 'grig gi skad char lam seng yid ches bya mi nyan zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/78 phug ma la sngas dang / yol ba la rgyab snyes/ 'di ni blo gtad dang rgyab rten bcol mi nyan zer ba'am/ yang na de 'dra mi yong ba'i brtag dpyad gdengs 'khel gtan tig bya dgos zer ba sogs 210

skabs bstun tshig grogs gang 'os dang sbyor srol yod/79 pho sha shug sdong mi rgas/ mo gyod rgya mcho mi skam/ phan tshun sha lan chags pa'am/ gyod gzhi thug pa ni dus yun ji tsam ring po song na yang / yal thabs med pas mi rabs nas rtsod lan sprod rgyu yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /(a mdo khul )80 phyi yi lcags ri/ nang gi nor bu/ khyu tshogs sam/shog khag de'i yod na med na e yod nang gi de yod de yin zer ba la spyod pa yin/81 phyin pa 'grul la phan pa/ zas pa sto la phan pa/ las ka byas pa'am/ yang na rgyu dngul btang ba sogs dmigs yul lam/yang na sprod dgos pa'i chad bun gyi 'jal grangs la sman pa zhig dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang /82 phra rab sprungs na ri bo/ thigs pa bsags nacu mcho/shes yon nam/ yang na rgyu nor/ snyan grags sogs legs cha gang dang gang yin rung / dus dang rnam pa kun tu cha shas byas te 'bad brtson rgyun chad med par byas na/ nam zhig gi tshe mkhas pa'am/phyug chen/ grags can sogs chags thub pa las/ glo bur du stong bsam 'grub thabs med zer ba sogs la spyod pa'o/ /82 bar gyi mi dang / mtshams kyi rdo/ gyod don nam rtsod gzhi sogs gang yin rung mi dpang dang / dngos dpang yod zer ba'am/ yang na dgos zer ba sogs la skabs bstun gyis spyod pa yin/211

ra4 bya ba'i rgyal po thabs dang / skud pa'i rgyal po 'gug zad/ don zhig sgrub pa'i don du thabs brgya jus stong gis bya rgyu med na ma gtogs yod tshad spyad na'ang dmigs yul de sgrub ma thub pas/ da cha bya thabs rbad de rdzogs song zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/85 byas pa rjes med/ byugs pa shul med/ phan 'bras ldan pa'i bya ba mang po zhig 'bad pas bsgrubs na'ang byas rjes til 'bru tsam bstan rgyu med pa chags song zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang / tshig mjug tu byed mi nyan zer ba sogs sbyar na go don bsgyur chog pa ni gzhan dang mtshungs/86 bla ma'i thugs la'ang mi 'dug dpe cha'i nang la'ang mi 'dug dngos 'brel spyi phan byed dgos nges kyi bya ba zhig yin na'ang/gong nas byed dgos zer mkhan yang mi 'dug la/ gsham nas byed 'dod byed mkhan yang mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/87 dbyar gsum du ba sprug 'dres/ dgun gsum chon thag snol 'debs/ a mdo'i 'brog khul gyi gtam dpe ste/ phan tshun 'bral med mnyam 'grogs kyi khyim mtshes yin zhes skyid sdug mnyam myong dang / blos 'gel rogs res dgos pa mtshon gyi yod/ ('brog khul )88 'bu nag rwa co can la 'brong mi zer/ sbrang ma thig ris can la stag mi zer/ stabs legs nas rgyal kha phran bu thob pa la dpa' bo mi zer la/ stes dbang gi lam 'gro rgyugs pa la 'jon po mi zer zhes pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )212

89 rbab rdo 'dril sar g.yang / rlangs pa lang sar mtsho/chag sgo dang gyod gzhi sogs chags par de 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig yod pa de zhib brtsad bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /90 mang nyung bre la 'jal/ yang lci srang la 'degs/ phan tshun gnyis kyi bar la bden pa mang nyung dang / nyes pa che chung ngam/yang na blo gros sam/ snying stobs/ shes yon/ 'jon thang sogs gang gi thad la 'gran zla byas kyang chog ces shugs kyis khyod las nga mi zhan zer ba lta bur spyod pa dang / yang khyod la gang 'dra yod med ngas tshod lon gyi yod zer bar spyad kyang chog go /91 mar khu me thog nas bkag ko ba chu nang du skyongs/ bya ba gang yin rung de sa de thog tu lam seng thag bcad nas sgrub dgos pa las/ nyin 'gyangs zhag 'bud byas na 'gyur ba dang rnyog gzhi dka' ngal sogs yong srid ces pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/92 mar khu la rdor dang / cher ma la rno/ 'dang nges yod bzhin du da dung bskyar ldab yang ldab tu snon pa ni dgos pa rtsa ba nas med ces pa lta bur spyod pa dang / yang yod pa la yod gcig gam/med pa la med gcig red zer bar spyad kyang chog pa tsam mo /92 mi go ba can la chig gcig rta gom 'gros can la lcag gcig gnad don gal che go gsed dam/ go skon slob gso byed skabs bskyar bshad yang bshad bya dgos don med par khyed kyis bsam blo gtong thub nges yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )213

94 mi chung la bskul bde/ rta chung la bzhon bde/ mi gzhan gyis mthong chung dang brnyas bcos byed pa'akhur mi thub pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshon par byed pa la spyod pa yin/95 mi pho'i ngo thog rta pho'i sga thog rang nyid la 'khris pa'i las 'gan de 'bad brtson ldab brgyas legs sgrub byed pa las/zhabs 'dren rtsa ba nas zhu rgyu med ces bskul ma gtong ba'am/ yang na zhabs 'dren zhu yi min zhes khas len byed pa sogs la spyod cing / de min mi tshang ma gcig 'dra ma yin pas so so'i bya spyod dngos la blta dgos zer 'drar spyad kyang chog96 mi ming can/ rta gdong can/ gleng bya'i mi de ni spyir btang ma yin par kun shes yongs grags can mi sna su dang yang nor thabs med pa zhig yin zhes pa lta bur spyod ga yin/97 mig nang gi gra ma dang / sha nang gi cher ma/ gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal gyi sdang zug bzod par dka' ba byed kyi 'dug ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/98 mun nag mda' 'phen lha'i sprun/ long bas rdo 'phen klu'i mgo spyi tshogs kyi shes bya ci yang med par rang snang gang dran gyi skad cha kha nas gang thon bshad na/ gong rim la phog thug dang /gnyen nye bar go long sogs bzo ba'i rgyur 'gro nyen yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )99 me khag khag dang / du ba so so/ mi dang bya ba gang yin 214

rung / de gnyis phan tshun 'brel ba rtsa ba nas med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/100 me tog chung yang mchodangs/ gurakum nyung yang sman rdzas/ phan tshun lag rtags sprod dus dngos rdzas rin thang chen po med kyang / lhag bsam rnam dag mtshon byed yin pas dgyes bzhes gnang rogs zer ba lta bu'i skabs spyod pa yin/101 me du ba med par gtong mi shes/ chu rlangs pa med par bkol mi shos/ dngos po'i gshis lugs bcos su med pa de dag drangs nas mi sgrub pa'i las 'gan dang / mi 'os pa'i dgos 'dun 'don pa la phar rgol byed phyir spyod pa yin no/ /102 me rang shi dang / du ba rang yal/ 'khrug gzhi'am don rkyen zhig chags na yang / rgyu rkyen gang rung la brten nas gnad don tshabs cher ma gyur pa ma zad/ phan tshun rang rtogs kyi lab gleng gzhi med du gyur pa lta bu la spyod pa yin/102 dmag khas blangs/ mdung rked gzer/ gyod gzhi 'di'i skor la khyod rang gis 'gan yongs rdzogs blangs nas ched du thon yong ba red zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / byed mi nyan dang /byas med zer ba sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis 'gyur 'gro ba ni gzhan dang 'dra/104 dma' nye bas phab/ mgo gser skus bcag yong mi srid pa dang / 'byung mi 'os pa'i bya ba zhig yin zhes pa lta bur spyod 215

pa'o/ /༄ 105 za chu ma rig na skom mi sod/ jo bo ma mjal na sems mi bde/ gyod don lta bu zhig yin na/ khrims sa gong ma rang la gtug rgyu dang / khrims dpon ngo ma rang la ma zhus par thabs med zer ba lta bu de rigs na spyod par snang / (a mdo khul )106 me che na bcos bde/ ral che na chem bde/ sde tsho'am/yang na khyim tshang ste phan tshun bar la lab gleng rtsod gzhi chags skabs 'khrug 'dzings sogs de bas tshabs che ru gtong dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/1༷7 ma ras thag pa dang / spen mas mda' mi nyan/ mi dang bya ba gang la bshad rung / de ni don de 'grub pa'i rgyu cha rtsa ba nas ma yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 108 tsan dan gyis go g.yog gos chen gyis thab phyis/mi go gnas sam/ snyan grags can sogs la spyir btang gi bya ba de 'dra gnang rogs zhu skabs spyod pa mang zhing / spyir na mi gzhan la bya gzhag re bcol byed dgos byung skabs kha yag de ltar shod mkhan yang yod/109 tsha po dgos dus rlangs pa tshub tshub/ grang mo dgos dus 'khyags rom chil chil/ bod rnying par dbang sgyur pas bran g.yog la sdug las sna tshogs bskul te rang snang gang shar shod pa de bzhin du sgrub dgos kyi yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang / gzhan yang 216

gang dgos de sgrub byed pa zhes par spyad na'ang chog110 chig gsum dar gyi mdud pa/ mi 'gyur rdo thog yi ge/phan tshun kha dan byas pa'am/ chod yig bzhag pa sogs gang yin rung /nang don de las 'gyur ba spu tsam yang gtong gi min zhes pa'am/gtong mi nyan zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/ (mdo khams khul )111 mig gsum ma bshad par lce dang / gom gsum ma spos par nywa/ bden rdzun nam/ yin min gyi bdar sha ma bcad par mun thom mam/ btsan shed sogs kyi sgo nas thag gcod byed pa khur mi thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/112 tshong pa sdod 'dod dang / bong bu nyal 'dod/ phan tshun phyogs gnyis kyi bsam tshul gcig pa yin pa'am/ yang na 'dod mos gcig gyur byung ba zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/112 mdzub chad kyis gnam dang / sho ras kyis me/ mi nyam chung la bden pa yod na'ang gyod gzhi khrims gtugs byas kyang rgyal kha 'thob mi srid ces pa lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re khyed rang gi kha thabs de lta bu las med par don chen sgrub mi thub zer ba lta bur mthong chung gi rnam pas spyod pa'ang yod/114 mdzub mo lnga po spun yin/ lag pa'i phyi nang sha yin/mnyen nye'am/ grogs po blo dkar sogs la nga tsho khyim tshang gcig pa dang khyad par med zer ba lta bur spyod pa'i a mdo khul gyi gtam dpe zhig yin/217

115 mdzub mos gnam mi brag snyung bus rdo mi phig rang la bden pa yod na'ang / 'byor stobs dang dbang shugs sogs kyi cha rkyen med pa yin na/ nus pa gang yang thon mi thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /116 rdza khra yag yan na gangs yod/ gangs dkar po'i yan na gnam yod/ dpon po'am/ 'go pa gcig gi gong na de las che ba rim pa bzhin yod ces sa gnas kyi 'go dpon chung chung la ha las rgyu med zer ba lta bur spyod pa'i a mdo khul gyi gtam dpe yin/ de bzhin mkhas pa 'dra ba la yang spyad na chog117 za ma gang la chos long / gzhong pa gang la grang long /bya ba gang dang gang la'ang byed long spyod long ste/ dgos nges kyi dus tshod re nges par dgos pa yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/118 rdza la mgo skor/ spang la phog thug gong rim la mgo skor btang / gsham rim la mgo gnon byed mkhan zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )119 zha mo 'di ga gyon nas/ phyag 'bul 'di ga zhus yod/nyams myong 'di rang la brten nas/ thabs shes 'di rang spyad de gnad don thag gcod byed kyi yod ces mi gzhan gyis bya thabs bstan pa de dang len mi byed ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/120 zha dma' sa nas blangs te mtho sar bskyal/ rdo gzar sa nas blangs te bde sar bzhag rang ngos nas bya ba 'os shing 218

'tshams la/ phan pa ldan pa sha stag lag len byas pa yin zhes pa lta bu la spyod par snang / ('brog khul )121 zhing 'debs na gshol dgos/ nas 'phyar na rlung dgos/ bya ba gang dang gang zhig sgrub dgos na'ang de la dgos nges kyi cha rkyen 'dzoms dgos pa las/ rang snang gang shar ltar lam seng bsgrub rgyu'i 'tshab 'tshub kyi bsam blo gtong mi rung zhes pa lta bur spyod pa'o/122 bzhi brgya nad kyi 'byung gzhi/ dmar nag dug gi sa bon/ rtsod gzhi'am gyod don yongs kyi rtsa ba mi'am/ yang na bya ba ga ge mo 'di la thug yod zer ba lja bu la spyod pa yin no/ (khams khul )122 zos zos pas kha bsnyogs/ phyin phyin pas lam byang /gong rim la pad lad 'khrab nas/ gsham 'og gang sa gang la za bed brdabs gsig kho na btang ste 'tsho thabs byed mkhan ngan pa lang shor de rigs la spyod pa'i dmod tshig cig yin/124 gzugs chung yang gser gyi thigs pa/ nyag phra yang stong skud sum sgril/ phyi'i mdog bzang ngan kho nar blta rgyu med par ngo bo rtogs dgos zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na nga nyams chung lta bur brtsi rung pham kha rtsa ba nas 'khur mi thub ces pa 'dra bar spyod mkhan yang yod/125 bzang byas pa ngan du gyur/ ja blug pa gcin la gyur/phyogs gcig nas bsam pa rnam dag gis phan pa'i las bzang byas na'ang / phyogs gzhan des skyon dang ngan byas par mthong gi 'dug 219

zer ba lta bur spyod par snang / (a mdo khul )126 bza' sa'i kha bkag 'gro sa'i lam bkaga'atsho ba dang thon skyed sogs gang sar 'gul bskyod byed sa med pa bzos byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/127 g.yag ma bshas ko tshad thang la 'bri/ rta ma ded bgo bsha' ri nas rgyad bya ba ci yang ma byas gong la de'i grub 'bras dang yong 'bab bed spyod byed stangs sogs la gros mol dang rtsod pa byed pa de rigs la spyod pa'i 'phya dmod kyi gtam dpe zhig yin/128 g.yag la ma slebs rtsid pa'i zhol zhol/ 'bri la ma slebs 'o ma'i 'jol 'jol/ na tshod dam/ go gnas/ thob thang /mtshan snyan sogs nges can zhig la ma slebs gong nas/ de dang der slebs pa lta bu'i dregs nyams ston gyin 'dug zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin/129 g.yu bsdur dgos/ rta gcag dgos/ bya dngos gang dang gang la'ang rang gi ngo bo dang bstun pa'i brtag dpyad zhib 'jug so sor nan tan bya dgos zhes pa lta bur spyod cing / skabs re ni gang zhig yin rung 'gran rtsod kyi nang nas thon pa byed dgos zer bar spyad na'ang 'grig120 ra tshang nang du gzig dang / sman khug nang du dugamathun thabs med pa gnyis gal te mnyam du gshib dgos byung na/chag sgo chen po zhig bzo rgyu las/ gzhan gang yang yong mi srid zer ba 220

lta bur spyod pa'o/ /121 ra che zad 'phar ba'i sgo rtsa/ 'bu che zad grog ma'i sgo rtsa/ rang gis rang 'phung ba'i lam du skyel ba las/ 'bras bu bzang po ci yang 'thob mi thub zer ba lta bur spyod cing / skabs re khyod kyis nga la kha gtad bcar na pham nyes chen po nyo rgyu red ces par yang spyod mkhan yod/122 ra bsad na lug 'dar/ khyi brdungs na phag skraganyes can gcig la srog khrims gcod pa des nyes gzhug mang po bkag 'gog byed thub pa yin zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/122 rang gis rang la byin gyis brlabs/ rkang pas mgo la byin gyis brlabs/ rang nyid kyi shod stangs sam/ byed stangs kyis rang la dma' phab pa'am/ rang gi mtshang bton pa yin zer ba lta bur spyod par snang /124 ri ngan gyi rtsa mi zhim/ sa ngan gyi chu mi zhim/ sngar 'khon zhe 'dzin yod pa'i khyim tshang ngam/ sde shog sogs kyi bu dang bu mo phan tshun gnyis mos kyi gnyen sgrig pa lta bur pha ma'am sde shog gi 'go pa/ yang na rgan rabs sogs kyis khyim tshang de'am/ sde shog de'i bu rgyud yin na 'grig po zhig mi yong zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /125 ri de la 'khor ba'i ri dwags/ chu de la 'khor ba'i nya sram/ khyim tshang ngam/ sde shog sogs gang yin rung thad ku'i 'brel ba med na yang / de dang de'i gcig la gnyis brgyud kyi rang phyogs su 221

gtogs pa zhig yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/126ོ ri sprug pas bzung ba nyil bar bsam/ stag bsil nyal brgyab pa shi bar snyam/ nyen dogs gang yang mi dgos sar blo g.yeng chen po byed pa dang / dngos 'brel gyi nyen kha drag po yod sar lhod g.yeng rnam 'gyur 'dzin gyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /('brog khul )127 ri 'os par rdzong / thang 'os par zhing / bya ba'am mi sogs gang dang gang la/ de dang de 'os shing 'tshams pa'i sgo nas bkod sgrig bya dgos zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/12ra ri lug pa thag pas mi 'dum/ gyang 'gyel ba dbyug pas mi lhongs/ spyi tshogs sam/ rang byung khams kyi gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa lta bu rang sa nas nyams pa sor chud thub thabs mi 'dug zer ba sogs de rigs la spyod cing / dus gsum sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'gre/129 rlung bser bu zhags pas mi zin/ chu lu ma rdo yis mi non/ bya ba la la bcos su med pa'i don la lus sems ngal bar byas rung snying po med do zhes dngos po'i chos nyid ni mi rnams kyi blo 'dod la rag lus pa zhig ma yin pa'i dper spyod pa'o/ ('brog khul )140 brlag 'dod na rtsis pa'i ba yang brlag shi ran na em chi'i bu yang shi/ phyi yul bya dngos kyi chos nyid ni sus kyang bzlog tu med pa zhig yin zer ba lta bur spyod cing / skabs re stabs ma 222

legs pa'i god kha byung dus sems gso byed pa'i thog tu'ang spyod mkhan yod/141 la khar shi na bya ro/ chu khar shi na nya ro/ chos phyogs nas bshad na bdag 'dzin blos btang ba yin zer ba dang / 'jig rten phyogs nas bshad na 'u thug nas 'khon lan slog rgyu lta bu las khe nyen skyid sdug gi bsam blo gzhan dag gtong rgyu med zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/142 la gnyis bar gyi la btsas/ chu gnyis bar gyi zam pa/khyim tshang ngam/ sde shog phan tshun dbar rtsod gzhi lhags skabs bar 'dum byed mkhan la nye ring phyogs lhung med pa zhes bstod bsngags gtong bar spyod la/ yang bar 'dum pa rang gis phyogs res byed kyi min zhes khas len byed skabs spyad kyang chog pa yin/142 la mtshams kha bas chod/ khyi mtshams rgyug pas chod/sngon chad 'brel ba yod pa de da cha so sor 'brel mtshams bcad zin pa yin zer bar spyad na chog pa dang / yang chod pa zhig dgos zer bar spyad kyang tshig grogs la brten nas bed spyod byas na 'grig144 shi ma myong bar dmyal ba'i lo rgyus/ rgas ma myong bar mi che'i skyid sdug nyams myong cha rgyus sogs ci yang med pa'i mis 'di byas na 'di yong sogs stong bshad byed mkhan la zur za byed pa la spyod pa yin/145 shig gsod par sta re/ mar gcod par sog le/223

dgra bo nus med cig bcom pa'am/ bya ba chung rtsag cig sgrub pa la 'phyar rgyag chen po dang / gra sgrig mang po de 'dra byed dgos don ci zhig yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/146 sa snyi sar gro ma nyis brko/ lug gcig la pags pa nyis bshu/ 'gro sar brnyas bcos tshad med lugs med byed kyi 'dug zer ba'am/ byas na ga la 'grig ces pa lta bur spyod pa'o/ /147 sa bre la 'jal/ rdo srang la 'degs/ mi 'os pa'i zhib tshags dam 'dzin tshad las brgal bar zur za byed pa la spyod par snang /148 sa zad gram thug so zad rkan thug bod rnying par zhing 'brog mang tshogs rnams khral dang bu lon gyis gtses nas 'tsho thabs zad song zhes par spyod pa yin/149 sangs rgyas la ka kha/ a mes la gna' gtam/ mi shes mkhan gyis shes mkhan la 'di 'dra dang de 'dra bya dgos zhes shod mi 'os zer ba'am/ yang skabs re ngas shod mi 'os pa mang po bshad thal song zhes dgongs sel gyi tshul du spyod mkhan yang yod/ (khams khul )150 gsal po can la gsal skyor/ nag chung sran mar sgril skyor/ dngos dngos rjen rjen kun shes yongs grags kyi bya ba la slar yang gsal bshad byed dgos don gang yang med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/224

151 gso dus med pa'i nad pa/ slebs dus med pa'i mgron po/ — ji tsam re sgug byas kyang 'bras bu smin rgyu mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/152 har pa bun lon len zhor/ sdig chen dmyal bar 'gro zhor/ byus nyes yang yang byung mkhan gyis de bas nyen kha che ba'i bya ba zhig blo thag bcad nas brtsams pa lta bu la spyod pa yin zhing / bdag gzhan dus gsum sogs skabs dang bstun nas tshig grogs kyis bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'gre/152 lha gcig la gsol ba thobs/ lam gcig la rtog pas gnon/ rgyab rten bcol sa dang thabs jus sogs gcig rang la blo gcig sems gcig gis mtha' 'khyol ba bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/154 lhag pa langs thog gi rngul/ char pa babs thog gi chu/rnyog dra langs pa'i skabs 'dir rtsod gzhi gzhan de yang bslangs na chabs cig thag gcod gtsang ma yong srid zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod par snang /155 a jo nga la byas byas pa/ shangs pa khyis ded ded pa/rtag par jus nyes dang / gra ma 'grig kho na thon yong gi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ (gtsang khul )225

le tshanagasumab/ tshigasdud che ba'idape tshig 'bru bzhi can gyis brjod don stonapar byed pa'igatam dpe'i gras/1 kun shes gcig rngugs/ bya ba kun shes khul gyi kha pho sgrog na yang / don du las ka sne gcig kyang khungs mi 'khyol ba'i thabs rdugs pa zhes dper bkod de/don la mi gzhan gyis byas pa'i las kur 'di yang mi 'grig de yang ma 'grig zhes skyon 'dogs kho na byed kyang / kho rang la don dngos kyi shes nus dang 'jon thang sne gcig med pa'i mi kha bde po de gras la ther 'don zur za byed pa lta bur spyod pa yin/2—1 rkang rjes lag sub/ tshig 'grel/ rang gis bzhag pa'i rkang rjes de rang gi lag pas sub pa zhes dper bkod pa'o/ /don 'grel/ sngon chad rang nyid kyis bya ba bzang po bsgrubs pa'i byas rjes rnams/ da cha bya ba ngan pa zhig byas pa des med pa bzos pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / bdag gzhan bya byed dus gsum sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis gang mkho ltar sgyur chog pa ni gzhan dang 'gre/226

2 2 ker leb sgur gsum/ 'di'i ker zhes pa mi dang /leb ces pa sa zhing / sgur zer ba ba phyugs rigs bcas kyi tshig sdud cig yin/ ‘4ker leb sgur gsum gyi khral rigs chag yang ’ zer na mi phyugs zhing gsum la 'khri ba'i khral rigs sprod mi dgos zhes pa'i don yin/2 rkun rgyab rdzun langs/ nyes can la 'geb srung dang dag 'bud byed mkhan nam/ yang na khrims sar bar dpang yin khul gyis nyes can skyob thabs byed mkhan sogs laspyod pa yin/4 skugs pa'i lcang gcod/ byed stangs sam spyod stangs dngos la bltas pa tsam gyis glen pa'i rang rtags mngon sum du ston mkhan de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs gtam rgyud le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/5 skabs babs gseg gcod/ bya ba la la phugs phan chen po yod pa mthong dus 'phral sel dge mtshan de tsam med na yang / lam seng thag gcod byed rkyang bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod cing / 46skabs la babs na gseg la gcod ’nyaces kyang brjod srol yod/6 skom pa chu 'dod/ yun ring kha bral ba'i pha ma bu phrug 'phral du thug 'dod pa lta bu sogs kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi re 'dun sgug nas sdod thabs med pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/'i skyid med rdugs zad/ mi tshe gcig la jus nyes dang bya ngan kho nas dus 'da' zhing / spyi tshogs thog ming don gang la'ang lta 227

bzo 'di bzo med par nyi ma re re'i lto tshe 'bud thabs tsam byed mkhan gyi mi tha shal can de rigs la spyod pa yin/8 skyug pa 'dom 'jal/ chang rigs 'thung tshod ma zin par rang tshugs yongs su shor ba'i skyur rkyal tsho'i skyug bro ba'i snang tshul la 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa yin/9 kha chag rna ral/ bya ba 'di 'grub ma song dang / de yang byung ma song zer ba lta bu de rigs kyi tshig sdud gtam dpe zhig yin la/med pa dgos rgyu zhes pa'am/ byung na mi 'grig ces pa sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis sgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'gre/10 kha thog lag bzhag kha nas ji ltar bshad pa nang bzhin lag len gyi thog tu 'khyol song zer ba'am/ yang na don la gnas kyi 'dug zer ba lta bu sogs de rigs spyod pa'i tshig sdud yin/11 kha nang lce rgyus/ yul de'i gnas tshul yul de ga'i mi rnams la cha rgyus yod ces pa'am/ don gnad 'di'i skor thog mtha' bar gsum gyi gnas lugs tshang ma mi 'di dang 'di la rgyus mnga' yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yod/12 kha zas lce thims/ rang nyid kyis blangs nas bed spyod btang zin pa'i bu lon lta bu la de ltar brjod srol yod/12 kha zas 'gab btang / bka' khrims sam/ srol lugs/ bslab bya sogs shes bzhin du brtsi med gtong mkhan nam/yang na pha ma dang / slob dpon/ 'go byed sogs la ji mi snyam par 228

rdog rol du gtong ba sogs la spyod pa'i dmod tshig yin/14 khab shul snyung 'tshang / dang thog chung sa nas kha sho 'don thabs byas thog rim bzhin mu mthud don rtsa che sar ham sems bcangs mkhan gyi spyod tshul la zur za byed par spyod pa yin/15 khas btang sos zin/ mi gcig gis khas blangs na yang /gcig gis khas mi len pa lta bu de 'dra la spyod pa yin/16 khas len sos theg khas blangs pa tsam gyis mi tshad par 'gan srung gtan gtan tig tig byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod cing /zhu rgyu yin lta bu'am/ byed kyin 'dug byas song zhes pa sogs bdag gzhan dus gsum skabs bstun gyis sgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'dra/17 khri khar rus bzung / sa rigs sam/ khang pa/ rgyu nor sogs phyir sprod bya dgos nges kyi rigs khag 'dogs sna tshogs kyis mu mthud mkhregs bzung byed pa de rigs la spyod pa yin/18 khyi nyal rgyug slong / phar brnyas sogs gang yang ma byas par 'jam thing nger sdod skabs/ ched du tshur rgol gyi 'khrug rtsod dam/gyod gzhi bslangs byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing /yang byed mi rung zer ba lta bu kha ta byed par spyad na'ang chog19 khyi mthong ri 'khur/ mi rnams kyis cha mthong ci yang mi byed rung / rang nyid kyis so so gang min tshad cig yin par rloms kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ byed kyin 'dug gam/ byed rgyu med ces pa sogs skabs bstun gyis tshig grogs bsgyur na 'grig229

20 khyi sprung lag sprel/ mi ngan gyi rgyab rtsa mi ngan gyis byed pa zer ba'am/ yang na mi ngan mnyam sdebs kyis spyod ngan spel ba zhes pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/21 gyang nag kha spyor/ gyod don tshabs chen yong ba shes bzhin snga tshud nas bar mol zhi thabs ma byas par/ thad kur phan tshun la ngar slong 'thab 'khrug sbyar ba lta bu'am/ yang na lkog tu dbyen sbyor dkrug shing brgyab ste ched mngags phan tshun 'thab rtsod sbyar ba sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin/22 grib nag 'drer mthong / rang gi rnam rtog gis bzos nas don med don brtsi dang / dogs med dogs 'drog snyad med snyad mthong byed pa sogs la spyod pa yin no/ /22 grib nag sbar 'dzin/ sgrub thabs med par 'bad brtson dang / yong thabs bral ba'i re smon sogs byis blo lta bur spyod pa'o /24 glang sker bel btags/ che bar chung ba rtsis sprad nas brlags stor ma song ba bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / 'di'i 'byung tshul lo rgyus le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/25 glang khal bel log gzhan gyi 'khri khral lci po khral rogs nyam thag la 'gel ba lta bu'am/ yang na las 'gan chen po nyams myong med pa'i na gzhon gyi thog tu 'khri ba sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin/26—1 dgra dga' gnyen skyo/ don rtsa chung ngur nang khul 230

'khrug 'dzings sam/ yang na khrims sar zhu gtugs sogs thabs rdugs pa'i bya ngan byed pa ni rtsa ba nas mi 'os pa yin zhes pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/26 2 rmo bur thog rgyag sngon rtsis 'char gzhi sogs blo yul la'ang med par skad cig la thog brgyab pa lta bu zhig byung zer ba dang / go don ni gra sgrig sogs bya long byed long rtsa ba nas ma byung zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/27 1 mgo bkrus mjing dag khas blangs pa ltar 'gan len thub pa zhig dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re las 'go btsugs pa'i rjes su mjug 'khyol ba zhig dgos zer ba la spyad kyang chog27—2 dge bshad sdig bkrol/ rgyu mtshan drangs nas khe nyen dang / dge skyon ji yong sogs gsed sgrol gsal po byas te blangs 'dor 'di ltar bya dgos zhes ston pa lta bur zer/28 mgo thog lag bzhag bza' mi ya gcig nas tshul min gyi spyod pa byas pa'am/ yang na bu tsha chen po chags nas pha mar drin lan log 'jal byed pa sogs kyis 'grig thabs med par gyar skabs/bar mis 'dum sgrig chod 'doms byed dus slar yang de rigs byas na thob skal ci yang med par phyir thon bya rgyu zer bar spyod pa yin/29 mgo bya mig bskos/ tshig 'grel/ mgo bo'i thog bya ra byed mkhan la ched mngags mig gnyis bskos yod ces dper bzhag pa 231

yin/don 'grel/ bya ba ga ge mo zhig la blta rtog byed mkhan khyod rang dmigs su bkar nas btsugs pa yin zer/ ched bskos mi snas go chod mi 'dug ces pa lta bur dpe 'di spyod pa mang /20 mgo la rna 'byar/ bya dngos gang yin rung de dang 'bral thabs med pa'i khe nyen nam/ yang na bza' gyod gang dang gang yin yang chabs cig tu 'gan len dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/21 'gyel thog rdog rdzis/ chag sgo'am jus nyes bstud mar byung ba'am/ yang na nyam thag pa'i mi la yang bskyar gnod 'tshe phog pa lta bu sogs la spyod pa yin zhing / yang byed mi nyan zer ba sogs skabs bstun tshig grosas kyis sgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'gre/22 rgya che dkyil stong / nyams gud du song ba'i khyim tshang phyi sgrom che yang phyi nor nang rdzas gang la'ang lta bzo med pa de 'dra'am/yang na tshong dang bya ba sogs gang yin rung thor rgya che drags nas khu bsdu mi thub pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /22 rgyab gcig sga gnyis/ tshong zog gcig la sho khral gnyis sprod dgos byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / ma dgos pa'am/mi thub/ mi 'os zer ba skabs dang bstun nas tshig grogs kyis don so sor ston pa gzhan dang 'dra/24 rgyu ngan spun rtsub/ snam bu dper bzhag pa ste rgyu ngan 232

pa'i thog la spun rtsub po 'dzoms na snam bu tha shal las 'ong thabs med pa ltar bza' tshang lta bu gcig gshis ngan gyi thog la gcig shos kha tsha po zhig 'khel na rtag tu 'khrug rtsod rdzogs rgyu med pa zhig las yong mi srid zer ba sogs la spyod pa'o/ /25 rgyu ma phu 'ded/ tshig 'grel/ lug sogs bsad pa'i rgyu ma kyag kyog mang na'ang 'khru bshal byed skabs rgyu sne'i bu ga nas phu btab ste ril ma sogs rim brgyud kyis mthar 'ded gtong ba de dper bkod pa yin/don 'grel/ bya ba gang yin rung thog ma'i 'byung rtsa nas bzung ste rim pa re re bzhin brtsad bsher mthar phyin pa bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ 26—1 rgyun bu ko 'breg 'gro gron gtong dgos rigs ma rtsa'am dngos po de rang gi thog nas gtong rgyu las ma 'das zer ba'am/gtong dgos zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ 26—2 rgyug pa khrog langs/ rgyug dum mang po phung gsog brgyab sar rgyug pa gcig la sgul skyod btang na rgyug dum mang po zhig la rang shugs kyis 'bud rgyag thebs te gang sa gang nas langs yong ba dper bzhag nas/ bya ba gang zhig sna gcig la sgul skyod btang na gzhan dag nas nad langs kyi red zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /27 sgog pa rtsa bkog bya dngos gang yin rung de'i rtsa ba bsngogs nas slad phyin de rigs thon rgyu med pa bzo dgos zer ba lta 233

bur spyod pa yin/28 sgog pa gsed rngung / gnad don gang du thug yod pa mi re re bzhin byas nas brtsad zhib dag bsher bya rgyu zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/29 bsgo ba rnar gzon/ bslab bya byas pa sogs rna bar ma song ba'am/ ma bzhag par brtsi med gtong gi 'dug zer ba'am/brtsi med btang mi chog zer ba lta bu sogs la spyod pa yin/40 nga min kho yin/ bya ba mi legs pa zhig byung dus de'i le lan phar 'bud tshur 'bud kyis sus kyang 'gan len mi byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/41 nga bden nga yus/ phan tshun tshang mas ngas dka' las rgyab rabs dang / ngas las bzang sgrub rabs sogs shod pa las/phar phyogs kyi dge mtshan dang rang nyid kyi zhan char bsam shes mi byed zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /42 ngan pa byas rgyal/ mi la las bya ngan nag nyes can mngon gsal du byas na yang brtsad gcod dang / 'dri zhib/ khrims gcod sogs gang yang ma byas par srung skyob 'og bde ldan ngang 'jog pa de rigs la ma rangs par spyod pa yin zhing / kho nar gtong gin 'dug ces pa'am/ btang na mi 'grig gtong mkhan su yin zer ba sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs bsgyur na 'grig42 lcags rdar mnyam zad/ tshig 'grel/ gri rdar mi shes 234

mkhan gyis ji tsam brdar na'ang gri rdar gnyis ka mnyam zad las/'bras bu mi thon pa dper bkod pa'o/ /don 'grel/ bya ba'i gnad mi she4bzhin du nan tur 'jug khul byas kyang / rang nyid ngal zhing dus tshod gron pa las/ grub 'bras 'thob mi srid zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/44 lcags dmar skam gcun/ — bu brug pha mas dang / slob ma dge rgan gyis/ mgron po gnas pos sogs so sos gcun thub pa zhig bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / skam pa'i las 'gan ni lcags demar tsha po gcun rgyu de yin zer/ 45 chag yang gas 'degabasha dngos po chag kyog gi kha ya/gas kyog gis byas na phan tshun gnyis ka gtan med rtsa brlag tu 'gro rgyu las ma 'das zhes phyogs gnyis kur 'thab 'khrug dang / gyod gtugs byed pa'i cha rkyen med zer ba'am/ yang na ngan pa'i ya 'degs byas na/ rang nyid kyang ngan par 'gyur ba yin zer ba lta bur spyad na yang 'grig pa yin/ 46 chang lan chu 'jal/ phar la ཿphan btags drin skyong sogs byas pa'i lan la tshur phan 'dogs bya rgyu phar bzhag da dung gno da skyel byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang zhing /— yang bya mi rung zer ba'am/ mi byed zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun nas tshig grogs kyis sgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'dra/ 47 chad mthud yo srong / bya ba zhig sgrub phyogs la slob ston 235

zhu ba'am/ yang na rtsom yig gcig la legs bcos gnang rogs zhes zhu skabs ma tshang bar kha gsab dang / ma 'grig sar skyon bcos sogs gnang 'os gang yod gnang skyong zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / chad sar mthud thabs dang yo sar srong thabs yong ba zhes tshig zin ltar go sla'o/ / 48 chab chab bco brgyad/ bya ba'i rnam grangs mang po zhig gi phyogs cha tsam mam/ phyi tshul tsam mthong zhing shes na yang / don dngos su cha tshang ba dang khungs 'khyol ba sne gcig kyang mi shes mkhan gyi mi de rigs la spyod pa yin/ yang skabs re khengs skyungs kyi tshul du rang gis rang la/ nga ni chab chab bco brgyad de 'dra yin zhes zer mkhan yang yod/ 'dir chab chab zer ba ni theb chag zer ba'i don yin no/ /49 chu gram mnyam 'jags/ gyod gzhi bar 'dum mam/yang na khrims thag gcod skabs phan tshun rtsod rnyog chung rtsag rnams re re bzhin rtsa ba zhib slong byed ma dgos par bzhag pa zer ba lta bu 'di rigs la spyod pa mang zhing / de min phan tshun sngar nas da bar 'di mus ltar gnas bzhin pa yin zer bar yang spyod mkhan yod/5༷ chu brgya zam 'dus/ lab rgyu gleng rgyu mang po zhig lhags pa'i skabs su don rtsa re re bzhin 'dri zhib brda 'ded ma dgos par 'dum che sa zhig nas thag gcod yong thabs zer ba'am/ yang na thag gcod bya rgyu yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la skabs dang bstun nas spyod pa 236

yin/51 chu ngan lam shor/ (chu ngan lam zhugs kyang zer )khral 'ul dang 'bul rten sogs dngos 'brel 'khri ba zhig min na yang /dad pa'am pad lad sogs kyis thengs gcig 'bul rgyugs byas pa de thor bkod nas lo ltar sgrub dgos byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 52 chu sna gar 'khrid/ rang tshugs kyi bsam blo med pa'i mi/gzhan gyis skad cha gang bshad kyi rjes su rgyug pa sogs rtsa don gang yang med par phar sgyur tshur sgyur g.yo 'gul can gyi mi de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 52 chus khyer rkyal rlom/ rang dbang thams cad yongs su shor zin nas gzhan dbang du gyur na yang / ltar snang mi gzhan gyi mig lam du rang nyid kyis ched du de ltar byas pa'i rnam pa ston gang thub byed mkhan rlom sems can spyod tshul lta bu la spyod pa yin zhing / yang skabs re so so rang dbang dang bral ba'i gnas tshul 'og de ltar mi byed ka med byung zer ba lta bur spyod mkhan yang yod/ 54 nya nyungamanyam sres/ mi dang bya ba gang la'ang bden rdzun nam/ 'grig dang mi 'grig las 'gan legs sgrub byasadang ma byas la sogs pa lta bu bzang ngan dbye 'byed med par tshang ma mnyam du bsres 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / yang byed mi rung zer ba sogs la'ang spyad na 'a thus/ 237

55 nyinasa'i skar ma/ de ni bya dngos sam/ don bzang ngan sogs gang zhig la sbyar na'ang ha cang mthong dkon pa dang / tha na mi srid pa lta bu de rigasal spyod pa yin/ 56 nyes bsags rang 'khur/ kha chad chod don 'jog skabs de ltar ma byas pa'am/ de las 'gal rigs shar na zer ba lta bu'i mtha' 'doms su spyod pa mang zhing / bya dgos zhes pa'am/yang na zhu chog pa zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun nas gang mkho ltar spyad chog pa yin/ —57 rta mgo lug gzhug skad cha'am/ bya ba gang yin rung mgo mjug mi mtshungs pa dang / 'dra chags po med pa lta bu'am/yang na dang thog yin mdog kha po zhig la mjug 'khyongs ma song zer ba sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin/ byed mi nyan zer ba'am/ chags nyen yod/ chags song zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun nas bsgyur na 'grig58 rta brgyugs rngul yal/ bya ba yongs rdzogs mjug 'gril zin pa'i rjes su/ gzhi nas ‘ rnyog ma gting slong ’ gi rtsod gzhi 'dzugs pa lta bur/ skad cha de rigs shod rgyu phyis drags thag chod pa red zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/ 59 rtagayag mgo sbrel/ mnyam du mthun thabs rtsa ba nas med zer bar sbyod cing / byed ma dgos pa zer ba'am/ bya rgyu med/byas pa red zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun nas tshig grogs sgyur chog pa 238

ni gzhan dang 'dra'o/ / 60 rta thog stan 'khel/ bya ba gang zhig yin rung / a la pa la ma yin par gzab gzab nan nan gyi sgo nas bya dgos zer bar spyod pa yin/ 61 rta la g.yag 'dzem/ 'dzem bya chen po byed kyi 'dug zer ba'am/ yang na 'dzem bya byed dgos don ci yang med/ 'dzem bya ma byed zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun nas tshig grogs bsgyur nas spyad chog 62 rta bsu mdzub skyel/ tshig 'grel/ tshur lam rta btang nas bsu ba byas shing / phar lam mdzub brdas 'di nas phar phebs shig ces skyel ma byas pa dper bkod pa'o/ / don 'grel/ dang thog bkur sti gus zhabs byed na'ang / bya ba bsgrubs rjes lam seng mthong chung snang med du gtong ba'i spyod tshul de rigs la zur za byedabar spyod pa yin/ 62 ltas ngan g.yang 'gug ma gzhi dgra phyogs la nye ba'i mi yin rung / thabs mkhas kyis tshur 'gug thabs byas te rang jus la phan pa yong re byed pa lta bu le spyod pa yin / mdor na 'gal rkyen mthun rkyen du 'gyur ba byed pa'i godon yod/ 64 stag seng kha sprod/ mi dang khyim tshang gang yin rung /'byor pa ldan zhinge snyan grags che ba gnyis sam/ mabapo tshogs pa la zer ba yin/ — 239

65 thag zhor 'breng 'drud/ gzhi rkang bya ngan nam byed nyes med na'ang / rogs ngan gyi zhor drud phog ste rnyog dra dang / chag sgo byung ba sogs la spyod cing / dus gsum na skabs dang bstun nas bsgyur chog go /66 thi gu sne shor/ bya ba chung rtsag sne gcig nas mthud shor byung na rim bzhin rgya cher 'gyur ba la zer/ byung ba'am/ mi yong ba bya dgos/ yong nyen yod sogs tshig grogs gang 'os skabs dang bstun nas spyod pa yin/67 tho po mi gzugs/ 'jon thang med la/ go gang yang mi chod par ming tsam khyer nas sdod sa zin mkhan gyi 'go dpon nam/'gan 'dzin pa la spyod pa yin/ 68—1 dran gtam gsar skyed/ dang thog khas len gtsang ma zin rung / rjes su khag 'dogs sa gsar pa 'tshol ba'i rnyog bshad byed kyi 'dug zer ba'am/ de rigs byas mi chog zer ba sogs la skabs bstun tshig grogs bsgyur te spyad chog 68—2 du ba gnam gtod / du ba gnam la gtong mkhan gyi khyim tshang yod tshad zer ba'i tshig sdud cig yin/ bod rnying par khyon yongs 'gel ba'i khral 'ul bsdu bskul byed skabs tshig sdud 'di yang yang bed spyod gtong lam yod/ 69 dri ngan sa g.yogs/ bya ngan spyod ngan gyi rjes shul bsub thabs byed pa la spyod pa yin zhing / byed kyi 'dug gam/ byed mi 240

nyan zer ba sogs skabs da nga bstun dgos/ 70 gdong bzhi mig brgyad/ thun mong gi don gnad 'gangs che zhig la gros bsdur byed pa'am/ yang na yin min gyi gnad don chen po zhig thagagacod byed skabs/ don rtsa de dang 'brel ba yod pa'i mi sna tshang ma mnyam 'dzoms kyis bya dgos zer bar spyod pa yin/71 mda' skad gling bsgyur/ mda' mi shu can brgyab pa'i skad sgra de ni gling bu'i skad sgra yin par bsgyur pa dper bzhag ste/don la sgrub byed dang po de khungs ma 'khyol ba'i skabs slar yang sgrub byed de dang phyogs 'dra ba'i gnyis pa zhig yin zhes kha bsgyur ngo bsgyur byed kyi 'dug ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/72 mda' shul sgro 'brangs/ a ma'i rjes su phru gu gso dgos zer ba'am/ khang par bsdad nas nyams gso byed dgos zer ba lta bu la spyod par snang / 72 mda' shes gzhu nyos/ 'jon thang dang blo khog yod nas gyod gzhi'i nang 'tshangs 'ongs pa zer ba lta bu de rigs laspyod pa yin/74 na thogs spang 'dred/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub skabs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la khag 'dogs byed pa'am/ byas mi chog zer ba lta bur spyod cing / skabs re khag 'dogs mi byed ces khas len la'ang spyad chog66na mar thogs song dang spang la 'dred song ’ zer ba'i tshig sdud yin/75—1 nad thog sman 'khel/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub pa la thag gcod rang bzhin ldan pa'i nus pa chen po thon song zer ba lta bu de 241

rigs la spyod cing / de min thad kur smanabacos kyis drag skyed mngon ga sal can byung ba'i nad la'ang spyod— mkhan yod/ 75—2 nad grol gdon grol/ 'gag sgo 'ga' shas brgyud dgos pa'i bya ba zhig thag thogs med par rim grol thub pa lta bu'am/yang na gnyen sgrig bya rgyur pa phas khas ma blangs par brten a mas kyang kha grag ma nu4pa de/ da cha pa pha4khas len bya4stabs a mas kyang rgyab skyor thongape lta bu de rigs laspyod pa 'o/ / 76 ne tso'i ma ṇi/ go don ci yang mi shes par chos dpe 'don pa'am/ legs bshad ngag skyor byed pa sogs la spyod pa'i 'phya tshig yin/ 77 gnam lcagasathog babs/ bsam yul la med pa'i bya ba zhig glo bur du thon pa lta bu la spyod cing / yang gong rim gyi bka' btsan po bzlog tu med pa zhig glo bur phebs pa la'ang spyod pa yin/78 rnag thog gtsag 'gel/ bya ba ngan pa sus byas pa'i byed pa po de rang la nyes chad gnad du 'khel ba gcod thub song zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod cing / — ‘ rnag yod sar gtsag bu 'dzugs pa ’ zhes pa'i tshig sdud yin/ 79 sna thag mgo dkris/— su la'ang stabs bstun byed mi dgos par/ rang thag rang gisagacod thub pa lta bu la zer/ byed mi nyanazer ba'am/ byed dgosazer ba/ byed thub bam zer ba sogs skabs dang ba stun nas spyad chog sna phug pa'i phyu gas rigasadaper 242

bzhag pa'o/ / 80 snum zad mar me/ bya brgya thabs zad kyi skyob thabs med pa'i tshad la slebs pa de 'drar spyod pa yin/ 81 snod bcud ga 'dzol/ snod dang bcud gnyis bzang ngan nam che chung sogs cha mi mtshungs pa'i mi dang / bya dngos gang la'ang skabs bstun gyis spyad chog pa ste/ snod ngan bcud bzang ngam/snod bzang bcud ngan sogs thams cad la 'jug pa yin/82 gro'i sgyel rmo'i slong / phyogs gcig mar mnan te/phyogs gzhan zhig yar 'then pa'i phyogs ris kyi byed stangs ngan par steng tshig sgrog pol spyod pa yin/ 8 spre'ur ngomacurkub/ mi zhig gis bya ba ngo mtho ba thengs gcig tsam byas na rtag par de'i skor gyi byas yus bgrang ba'am/ yang na kho rang largyab bdag byed mkhan zhig yod na yang yang de'i skor bshad nas ngam ngam byed mkhan lta bu la zur zar spyod pa yin no/ /84 phag pa chil mnong / khos skad cha de 'dra shod pa'am/rnam 'gyur de rigs ston pa ni kho rang la nyes pa yod pa'i rang mnong mtshon pa yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/85 pho zad mo thug bod rnying par rtsa za chu bed sogs kyi don la sde tsho phan tshun gyod gzhi thug skabs/ mi ma zad bar du 'dzing mo bya rgyu yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa dang / yangaskabs re khyim tshang gi pa pha 'chi ba sogs la brnyas bcos phog dus kyangade ltar spyod mkhan yod/243

86 phyar ba gru 'degs/ phyar ba zur bzhi nas 'degs pa dper bzhag ste/ bya ba gang zhi 4/ legs 'grubayongached mi tshang mas mnyam rub gzhogs 'deg byed pe zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/87 phying pa rdo sgril/ skad 4 'jam po yin pa la/ nang don lci zhing nan po dang / lhag par 'phog yul la na zug drag po gtong ba de 'dra la zer ba yin/ 88 phyingatsol gnam 'phyar/ nang khul gyi skyon mtshang yongs rdzogs phyi logs la sba gsang med par shes su 'jug pa'i gtam spyod de rigs la zer ba yin/ — 89 phyogs na mi yod/ yul phyogs de gar sgrub dgos pa'i bya ba yin phyin nga rang ngo bskyod mi dgos par khyed nas gnang rogs zhes pa'am/ yang na khyed rang ngo phebs ma dgos pa nga la gsung 'phral dam pa don gnyer gyis sgrub rkyang zhus chog zer ba lta bu gnyis kur spyad chog pa/ skusgozud/ 90 'phar sprung lag sbrel/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs phan tshun ngan pa lag sbrel byas te rang la gnod pa byed par zer ba yin/ 91 'phyar rgyag gdeng gsum/ dgra bor rgol skabs yar 'phyar ba dang / dngos su rgyag pa/ mtshon cha gdeng ba ste ngom pa lta bu sogs gang la de 'tsham gyis bya thabs dgosazer ba'am/ yang na kha gtad phyogs nas de ltar byed kyin 'dug zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/92 ba she glang 'gel/ bod rnying par mi gzhan gyis 'jal 244

dgos pa'i khral lam/ sprod rgyur bsdad pa'i bu lon sogs khral rogs gzhan dag la 'ded srol yod pa de 'dra la spyod pa yin/92 bal 'dab rdo gnon/ gyod gzhi thug skabs phan tshun gnyis ka nas don rtsa chung rtsag mang po 'don res kyis lab rnyog je mang du 'gro skabs khrims sa'am/ bar 'dum pas don chung rnams tshang ma lab gleng mi dgos par mnyam 'jags su bzhag pa yin zer bar spyod pa'o/ /94 bong ba gser gzigs/ mi gzhan gyis rang nyid la tshad las 'das pa'i mthong chen nam/ bkur ste che bstod gnang byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ (bong ba ni sa rdog la zer )95 bya rgan sgro zad/ mi lo na rgas te nus pa shor ba'am/khyim tshang nyams gud du gyur nas 'tsho ba'i yo chas kyang tshong dgos la thug song zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/96 bya gral byi so/ mi mgo bde po de tshos thabs shes ngo gnyis ma bed spyad nas gyong gun las g.yol thabs sam/ yang na khe bzang 'phar ma za ba'i spyod ngan byed mkhan la zur za byed dus spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'di'i byung tshul le tshan bzhi pa'i khongs su gsal yod/97 bya sgro rlungaster/ chags sa brten sa med par rgyal khams gang sar bskor bskyod byed pa'i mi 'khyams po'i spyod tshul lta bu'am/yang na 'byung khungs 'di yin med pa'i spyi tshogs kyi gleng phyogs sogs skad cha gang sar khyab 'gro ba la'ang / ‘6gtam bya sgro rlung ’ zhes spyod 245

srol yod/98 bya rdo lam 'phrad/ phyogs gnyis kur dmigs yul dang nyams snang sogs ci yang med par glo bur stes dbang gi thug 'phrad byung ba zer/ pho mo'i dbar 'brel ba byung rigs la spyod pa mang /de min ngo shes sogs la spyad na'ang chog99 bya 'jin nya 'dzin/ bya ba gcig mi 'grub par gnyis brtsams na gnyis kur 'bras bu bzang po mi thon zer ba'am/ 'char gzhi dang go rim sogs med par bya ba gang thebs thebs byed pa zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/100 bya sha sen bgos/ bod rnying par khral pa bu lon sprod thabs med par gyar skabs phyi nor nang rdzas gang yod tshang ma bun bdag rnams 'dzoms te bun lon che chung la dpags na cha gses bgo sha brgyab ste ji thob blangs nas dag pa byed srol yod pa de la zer/1༷1 dbyaramajug gangs 'khyol/ da phan phan tshun rogs skyor sogs yag po byung ba de slad phyin chad kyang sngar mus bzhin mjug 'khyongs pa zhig dgos zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/1༷2 'bu ches chung zos/ spyi tshogs rnying par gong nas 'og bar rim pa gcig gis gcig la gnya' gnon bshu gzhog byed pa'i lam lugs ngan pa der dmod pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/102 'brug mgo sbrul mjug bya ba'am gtam bshad gang yin na'ang / 'go brtsams dus brjid nyams ha cang che yang / rim 246

bzhin je sdug je zhan du gyur mthar mjug 'gril dus ni thabs jugs ya nga ba zhig chags song zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/10( sbrul mdud sbrul bshig rang gis bzos pa'i gyod gzhi'am/ byas pa'i las 'dzol sogs rang nyid kyis khungs skyel lam/dag 'bud bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa dang / yang zhus chog pa dang / byed rgyu yin pa'i tshig grogs sbyar na so sos 'gan 'khur rgyu zhes par yang spyad chog105 ma myong rgya thug 'jig rten gyi bya ba yag nyes spyi dang /bye brag nor 'khrul lam/ jus nyes/ chag sgo sogs tshang ma brgyud myong ba'i mi de rigs la spyod pa yin/ bdag gzhan bya byed sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs dang bstun dgos/106 mar me sdong 'khol/ bod rnying par bun lon gtong skabs do bdag la yid ma ches par khag theg mi gzhan 'dzugs dgos shing / bun 'bab dus thog 'jal thub pa khag theg rang gis bskul lcag gtong dgos zer ba lta bur spyod srol yod/1༷7 mar me snum zad/ rgyu rdzogs zin nas gsab thabs med pa ste/ dper na gzungs zad kyi nad pa 'chi kha ma lta bur spyod pa yin/108 mi glud sprel rdzongs/ dka' ngal dang / rnyog dra/nyen kha sogs yod sar rang 'og gi mi so so'i ngo tshab yin khul btsan shed kyis btang byung zer ba'am/ btang 'dug ces pa sogs la 247
