skabs bstun gyis spyod pa'o/ / /109 mi chen zhal dro/ mtho rim gyi mis las sla mdog kha po'i khas len dang / 'bor shob shod par yid mi ches pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshon byed du spyod pa yin/110 mi 'phya khyinyod/ bya ba gang zhig yin rung rbad de phyin ci log nas 'bras bu ngan pa spyi tshogs kyis 'phya dmod byed pa de 'drar spyod pa'i sting tshig cig yin/ mi yong ba bya dgos sam/ mi yong ba zhig byed kyi yin sogs tshig grogs bsgyur nas spyad chog pa ni dpe gzhan dang 'dra bar skabs dang bstun chog go /111 mig sman mig phan/ bya dngos gang yin rung / gang la dmigs pa de rang du 'khyol ba'am/ phan pa zhig dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/112 chun nag mda' 'phen/ dmigs yul dang 'char gzhi gang yang med pa'i bya ba'am gtam brjod spel ba la 'phya dmod kyi rnam pas zur za byed par spyod pa zhig yin/112 mes chig mer gtugs/ gnod rkyen gyi 'byung khungs gang nas byung ba de rang la nye bar gtugs nas gnod pa zhi thabs byed pa de dmigs bsal gyi man ngag cig yin zhes par spyod pa yin/114 mo ston phag mgo zog brdzu byed mkhan nam/ bsnyon 'dzugs byed mkhan zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ dpe 'di 'byung khungs gtam rgyud le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/248

115 mon yul rdoragacod/ yang dag pa de nor 'khrul du brtsi ba dang / nor ba de yang dag par brtsi ba de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs gtam rgyud le tshan drug pa'i khongs gsal yod/ (a mdo khul ) 116 rma brgya bug stong / srid gzhung ngam/ khyim tshang gang yin rung khungs mi 'khyol zhing / slar gso bya dgos byung rung dka' tshegs ha cang chen po yod pa lta bur spyod pa yin/ (bug stong ni/ bu ga stong phrag zer ba'o/) 117 smod chad gong bud/ mi khrims lugs dang / yul srol kun spyod gang la'ang mi brtsi ba'am yang na ngo tsha rgyu dang zhe khrel rgyu med pa de rigs la spyod pa'i smad tshig cig yin/ tshig 'grel ni khal ma smed chad gong bud nas bskyar du khal 'gel bya thabs med pa zer/— 118 btsos sha rjen ldog sha btsos nas rjen log pa dper bzhag pa ste/ kha dan rgyab skyur ram/ khas blangs log sgrub sogs la spyod pa yin zhing / bdag gzhan dus gsum sogs skabs sbyar tshig grogs kyis gang dgos ltar bsgyur chog pa gtam dpe gzhan dang mtshungs/ 119—1 tsha grang ya 'gal/ phan tshun dbar la he bag chen po 'dzol ba'am/ yang na rbad de rgyab 'gal du gyur pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 119— 2 chu ma bal 'degs/ stobs shugs do mi snyoms 249

par kha gtad gcag mi nyan zer ba lta burasbyod pa'am/ yang na stobs shugs mi do na yang ya lan ma 'jal thabs med chags song zer ba lta bur spyad na yang chog pa yin/ 120—1 tsha gtugs rgu gtugs/ brel brel 'tshab 'tshub ste gra sgrig sogs kyi dus tshod khom pa rtsa ba nas ma byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ —120 — 2 tsher ma dar btum/ mi kha 'jam zhe tsub can nam/ yang na skad cha snyan po bshad nas gnod pa skyel ba'i bya spyod sogs la spyod pa yin/ 121—1 tsha thog grang bzhag bya ba gang yin rung de sa de thog tu ya lan slog pa'am/ yang na thag gcod byed dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /121—2 mdzub mo ri ston/ zhib gnas shod rgyu med par phyogs cha tsam gsal la mi gsal gyis brjod mkhan lta bur spyod pa yin/122 mdze thog phol rtseg mdze nad kyi thog la phol mig rdol ba zhes nyen kha'i steng la nyen kha nyis brtseg ste bcos thabs dka' ba'i bya ba lta bur spyod pa yin/12 2 wa 'dzum stagazus/ blo khog ci yang med par dpa' bo yin khul dang / shes yon gang yang med par mkhas pa yin khul byed pa lta bu de dang de 'dra la spyod pa yin/125 zhwa dpe lham 'gebs/ gnas tshul dngos dang rtsa ba 250

nas mi mthun bzhin du rang gi de snga'i nyams myong rnying pa gzhan zhig lag len bstar ba lta bu la spyod pa yin te/ ma byed dang / byed rtsis 'dug byas pa'i skyon yin/ rtsa ba nas bya mi rung zer ba sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs kyisangabasgyur chog pa yin/125—1 za rgyags spyod gsum/ bag med longs spyod kyis rgyas za rgyas 'thung sogs 'phro brlag chud zos gtong ba'i spyod tshul la dmod pa lta bur spyod pa yin/125 2 zur bltas leb mthong / bya dngos gang yin rung de ni bltas pa tsam gyis de'i ngo bo dang / rjes 'bras sogs sus bltas kyang gsal po mthong thub pa zhig yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /126— 1 za bed brdab gsig mang tshogs la ‘ bsnyad med bsnyad 'dogs ’ dang / ‘6ya la bsnyon 'dzugs ’ 66gzugs med grib bzo nyasogs byas te rgyu nor 'phrog bcom sogs byed pa'i spyod tshul la dmod pa'i tshig sdud la spyod pa'o/ /126— 2 gzugs rjes grib 'brang / yong 'bab rjes 'brel gyi gtong sgo gtong dgos zer ba lta bu'am/ bca' khral ni khe las kyi rjes su 'khri ba zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin/127 gzugs med grib chags/ rgyu med rkyen lhags lta bu'i ma nyes khag g.yogs byung zer ba sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 128 gzongakha gcig sgril/ mi tshang ma ring thung dang ka kor med pa gtam brjod ga cig gyur lta bu la spyod par snang /251

129 bza' ma gdan thog dka' las rgyag mi dgos par za chog chog ste/ yong 'bab blangs chog chog yin zer bar spyod pa yin/120 yas spam mas 'phyong / dper na gong rim gyi dgongs gzhi dang / gsham 'og gi bsam tshul sogaloyas mas gang ci'i gnas lugs chu bab dang bstun dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/121 yog pa gzan sgril/ deng skabs khang pa gsar rgyag skabs rgyu 'gro dang / las ka yongs rdzogs 'gan gtsang sprad palta bur spyod pa'am go ba yin/ 122 yong brgya byung gcig rjes su 'di yong dang de yong sogs ma 'ongs sngon rtsis kyi re ba byed pa ni don thog 'khyol khag po yin pa dang / dngos su lag sonabyung ba ni grangs 'bor mang nyung la ma bltos par don la phan pa zhig yin zer ba lta bu'i tshig sdud cig yin/12—2 g.yag chadagad rdung / 'u thug nas nyen mchongs byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa'i dpe zhig yin/ phal cher g.yag gis gad pa la brdung nas mar rdibs na g.yag dang mi sogs gad 'og tu shor ba'i nyen kha yod pa bstan pa 'dra'o/— / —124 ra nad lug dkri/ rang gis byas pa'i ngan khag gam/nyes chad sogs 'brel ba ci yang med pa'i mi gzhan dag la bkal ba lta bu'am/ yang na de ltar bya mi rung zer ba/ byed kyin 'dug zer ba lta bu sog4skabs bstun tshig grogs bsgyur te spyad chog pa yin/125 rwa ker mjug 'tshub/ bag yod tshul ldan bya dgos pa 252

las/ spyod tshul mi legs pa'i rigs byed mi rung zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang / skabs re spyod pa nyes po gang zhig byed na'ang gyis shog ang zhes sdig mo byed pa lta bur spyod mkhan yang yod/126 rwa co sgye blugs/ phyi ltar gcig pa yin pa 'dra rung nang khul 'cham mthun med pa'am/ gcig gyur ma yin pa mtshon byed lta bur spyod pa yin/ 127 rag gan gser brdzu/ mi ngan pas mi bzang la brdzu ba zer bar spyod cing / brdzu rtsis byed kyi 'dug rdzu bzhin 'dugabardzus pa red sogs skabs bstun tshig sgyur byas chog128 rang mgo chu 'dren/ rang nyid dam/ rang phyogs la gnod pa'i bya ba rang gis byas pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/129 rang thag rang gcod/ bu phrug gi gnyen sgrig lta bur cha mtshon na sngon chad pha ma rgan rabs kyis blo bkod ltar byed pa las/rang thag rang gcod bya mi rung zer ba dang / deng rabs yin na rang gi mi tshe gcig gi don chen de gzhan dbang 'gyur mi nyan par rang thag rang gis gcod dgos zer ba lta bu las spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes la 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba mtshon pa yin/140 rang nad rang sel/ rang nyid kyis sbyar ba'i rnyog gzhi de rang so sos dag sel bya dgos zer ba'am/ nga rang gis sel thabs bya rgyu yin zer ba/ rang gis sel rtsis byed kyi mi 'dug zer ba sogs skabs bstun gyis sgyur chog —253

141 rang 'phung gzhan brlag mi gzhan gyi srog phrogs pa'i byas nyes bsags te rang nyid khrims rar tshud pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / de 'dra rtsa ba nas bya rgyu med zer ba'am/ mtha' 'bras de 'dra zhig las yong rgyu gzhan med zer ba la sogs pa 8‘ma byung sngon 'gog ’ gi kha ta byed pa la'ang spyad na 'grig142 rang med mi med/ mi gti thug can la jus nyes phrad skabs kha gtad de bsad nas rang nyid khrims mun nang 'gro rgyu yin zer ba lta bur spyod mkhan yod cing / de min 'khrug 'dzings phan tshun shi rmas yong gzhi'i rigs bkag 'gog byed dus thabs rdugs de 'dra bya rgyu med zer ba la'ang spyod pa yin/142 ral gri gnam lhung / glo bur thog rgyag gi chag sgo'am/yang na bzlog thabs med pa'i bka' 'bebs btsan po byung ba lta bu la spyod pa yin/144 ral po kha lug 'dzugs skrun gyi dngos po zhig ral du gyur pa'am/ yang na sde tshan gyi sgrig srol thor zhig tu gyur pa la/nyams gso'am/ yang na bcos sgrig sogs gang yang ma byas pa bdag med du bzhag pa lta bu la spyod pa yin/145 ri rdo klung 'bebs/ ma 'os ma 'tshams pa dang /brdabs gsig che ba'i bya ba'am jus bkod cig yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o /146 ri bong cal 'drogs/ gtam 'chal gyis 'ur 254

bslangs nas mi mang po 'drog mgo langs pa lta bur spyod pa yin zhing /dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs gtam rgyud le tshan bzhi pa'i khongs gsal yod/147 ri bong rdo rdzus/ ma yin yin mdog gi brdzu brdzu byed mkhan la ched du spyod pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/148 la kha'i nyi ma/ lo na mthon por son pa'i rgas 'khogs rnams kyis rang nyid ring por rngo mi thogs pa zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin/149 lan dgu chad mthud/ phan tshun dbar la 'grig 'dum bar mol lan mang byas na'ang ma 'grig rung / da dung yi thang ma chad par slar yang 'dum thabs mu mthud bya rgyu yin zer ba'am/yang na 'dum 'grig mu mthud gnang rogs gnang zhes pa lta bu gang la'ang spyad na chog150 lam bzhi mdo kha/ bya ba bzang ngan gang gi phyogs su 'gro rgyu 'dem ga byed pa'i 'gag rtsar slebs yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / rjes su dge skyon ji yong ya yud chen po yod pa'i nyen brda zhig shugs nas mtshon gyin yod/151 sha khu sha thim/ rgyu nor sogs sus bsags pa'am/yang na gang nas byung ba de rang gi don du gtong zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/152 sha thog mar rtseg 'byor pa ha cang che ba'i mi la slar yang yong 'bab chen po yong sa'i las tshan rag pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/255

152 sha lam gris bcad/ sngar nas lam srol gyis gtan 'khel ba'i bya gzhag 'char can gyi rigs yin zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/154 shig sen ra sprod/ bden rdzun gang yin rgyu mtshan dang bden dpang ngo ma'i mdun du ra sprod bya rgyu yin zhes pa'am/ yang na bya dgos zer ba sogs la skabs bstun gyis spyod pa'o/ /155 zhog bu snum zos/ sa cha'am mnga' khongs bdag dbang sogs mngon gsal dod po med pa'i sgo nas ma shes ma tshor ba'i ngang cha shas cha shas byas te mug zos byed pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa mang ngo / /156 rdzog sbyag rlung 'tshang / do bdag gi rang 'gul ma yin par mi gzhan dag gis lkog nas ngan bskul byas te sdod du ma bcug par gyod don nam rtsod gzhi slong ba lta bur spyod pa yin/157 sa 'og dar 'thag gsang thabs mi mngon pa'i sgo nas g.yo jus spel ba la spyod pa yin/158 sa bzhag me 'bar/ lo na'am nad gzhis rkyen nas langs bskyod mi bde ba'am/ yang na sgyid lug sgul 'tsher can gyi mis gdan thog nas 'di ma 'grig dang / de ma 'thus zhes tshang mar gshe gshe gtong mkhan la spyod pa'i ming 'dogs shig yin/159 seng mgo ra gzhug bya ba'am gtam brjod sogs 'go 'dzugs skabs brjid nyams ha cang che rung / rim bzhin je sdug 256

je skyor song mthar mjug bsdoms skabs kha rgyu go rgyu med pa de rig4la spyod pa'o/ / —160 srang rdo khrims med/ mi khyams las ka byed mi 'dod par gang sa gang la rku khram gyi spyod ngan spel bdang / nag chang sho sbag sogs mi tshe khyams myul gyi 'tsho ba skyel mkhan de rigs la spyod pa'i dmod tshig cig yin zhing / srang rdo ni srang lam gyi rdo bzhin gnas yul nges can med pa'i don yin/161 sreg bcad rdar gsum/ tshig 'grel/ gser ngo ma yin min brtag dpyad byed tshul dper bkod do/ /don 'grel/ gal che'i mi dang bya ba gang la yang dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas brtag dpyad zhib 'jug yang nan bskyar nan bya dgos zer bdo'irbu de rigs la spyod pa yin1162 bsam pagru nang / der gtogs pa'i mi tshang ma skyid sdug khe nyen ji ltar byung rung / bsam pa lhad med gcig sgril dgos zer rba lta bur spyorda pa yin/ —— rgya mtsho'am chu chen sgrol skabs gzings sam gru'i nang gi mi rnams pha rol du bde sgrol thub pa dang / gegs bar mi yong ba'i re bsam gcigagyur de dpe la bkod pa'o/ / — 162 bsarma btang dran skyed/ thog ma rnyog dra ci yang med par kha dan byas zin na'ang / bskyar du bsam blo ba tang nas snyad 'dogs rtsod gzhi slong ba zer ba'am/ yang na de rigs byas na mi 257

'grig zer ba sogs skabs bstun tshig bsgyur gyis spyad chog164 lha khog 'dre zhugs/ mi gzhan gyis rgyab nas ngan bskul byas te rnyog gzhi bzo ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/165—1 a 'byog (rna )lteb rtseg phar phyogs nas nan nan ji tsam bshad na yang / snang bar rtsa ba nas zhog gi min zer ba' ma/ yang na nyan gyi min zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/165—2 lha zhi klu grol/ bya ba gang zhig byed skabs 'brel yod tshang mar gnas lugs gsal bshad dang / gros bsdur mos mthun thob pa bya dgos zer ba'am/ yang na gong gsal bya thabs rnams spyad par tshang mas mos mthun dang rgyab skyor thob byung zer ba sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 166—1 lha gsol klu gsol/ bkur sti zhabs tog sogs bya rgyu med na ma gtogs/ yod tshad byas pa yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /166 2 yab rtsi khog bcug zhe 'khon snying la bzung nas/go skabs rnyed 'phral 'khon lan slog rtsis byed mkhan gyi mi de rigs la spyod pa yin/167 ma yong mgo dkar/ don gnas gang yin rung stong bsam gyis re sgug yun ring byed mkhan la zer zhing / gnyen sgrig yun sgug la spyod pa mang 258

le tshan bzhi pa/ dpe sogs 'khyog brjod kyis ma brgyan par phuladu byung ba'i tshigasbyor gyis brjod don thad kur stonapa'igatamadabe'i gas/ 1 kurna la rban pa'i sems dgos/ grogs lajathun pa'i chig dgos/ kun la dgos pa ni phan pa'i sems yin la/ grogs la dgos pa ni mthun pe'i tshig yin zhes bstarna na4phan sems dang mdza' mthun gyi tshig la goms par bya dgos pa ni gal chen po yin zhes gdams pa'o/ / 2 ko gru snga btsan/ bka' gtan rjes btsan/ de snga chu chen po sgrol skabs ko ba'am gru la brten dgo4shing / de'i go rim ni 'byor snga rting gi rim pa ltar 'gro dgoso pas snga ma btsan pa dang /srid gzhung3gi bka' shog ni go rim de las ldorga ste snga mar 'khod pa'i nang don las/ phyi mar 'khod pa de btsan pas de la tshod 'dzin byed stabs rjes btsan zer ba yin/ de ni spyi tshogs kyi lam srol mtshon pa'i sdom tshig cig yin/ 4 2 dka' las ma brgyab pa'i dngos grub/ 4 —de ni stong bsam 'ba' zhig las/ don dngos la 'grubathabasartsa ba nas medaces 259

bstan pa'o/ /4 dka' ba'i las ma byas na/ zhim pa'i zas mi rag de ni go sla ba'i rgyu 'bras kyi gtam zhig yin te/ gal srid dka' ngal ma brgyab par zhim rgu'i zas za ba ni lugs dang mi mthun la/ ha cang ngo tsha ba'i bya ba zhig yin par shugs las bstan pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )5 dkar nag gi dbye ba 'byed dgos/ thag nag gi mdud pa 'grol dgos/ spyi tshogs thog bya ba mang po zhig bzang ngan gyi dbye ba gsal po ma phye bar ngan pa byas rgyal dang / bzang po sdug gyong du 'gro ba de rigs rtsa ba nas bya mi rung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/6 bka' drin bsam shes med par/ drin lan log 'jal/phar phan thabs kyi bya ba sgo kun nas bsgrubs na yang / tshur de las bsam shes bya rgyu phar bzhag rang nus gang thon gyi gnod skyel byed mkhan lta bur spyod pa yin/ (dbus gtsang khul )7 rkang bzhi la kha dang / g.yu chung sgogrob/ rkang bzhi ste sgo phyugs ni la kha nas brnyed kyang rnyed par mi brtsi ba dang / g.yu byur sgo rgyab nas brnyed kyang rnyed par brtsi ba yin zhes de ni spyi tshogs yul srol gyi tshad gzhi'i bshad tshul zhig yin zhing sgo phyugs brlags rnyed kyi gyod gzhi thug skabs bdag pos dpe 'di spyod srol yang yod/ 8 rku༄sa yod kyis rku/ rdzunasgyus med kyis shod/ spyi tshogs thog 'di ltar 'byung mang ba'i nyams myong phyogs sdom byas te phyogs so sor do snang dang / dogs gzon byed dgos pur gdams pa'o/ /260

9 rkun ma ma shor ba dgos/ rkun brtsad ma bcad pa dga'/rkun ma ma shor ba do nan byed dgos shing / gal srid shor zin na brtsad gcod ma byas na dga' zer/ rkun brtsad gnad du ma 'khel na gyod gzhi chags nas rang la chag sgo de bas che ba zhig phrad srid pa dang /gal srid rkun brtsad chod na'ang bod rnying par brkus nor gzhung bzhes gtong ba'i lam srol yod pa'am/ skabs re brkus rdzas zos tshar ba sogs rang rgyu lag son yong dka' zhing / rkun bur mnar gcod btang yang sdig pa'i rgyu yin zer ba sogs kyi bsam blo'i rgyu rkyen mtshon pa yin/10ོ rkyen ngan grogs su shar ba/ rkyen ngan pa zhig phrad na'ang de la brten nas dge mtshan nam/ phan 'bras de bas che ba zhig thob pa lta bu la zer zhing / dper na tshong pa zhig la tshong las kyi gyod gzhi thug rkyen sa thag ring por gyod gtugs la 'gro dgosabyung skabs/yul der bsam yul las 'a das ba'i dngoyozog rin thang can zhig gong khe por rag nas phyug por gyur pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/11 skugs pas sprung bcos byas na/ mngon gsal gzhan las dod/ mi shesasakhan gyis shes khul byas na/ rang mtshang ngo ma de mngon gsal gzhan las dod pa'i sgo nas phyir thon rgyu las med ces bstan pa'o/ / 12 skud 'khelacul po yin rung langs dgos/ skud rmel gla pa yin rung sdod dgos/ gtam dpe 'di las sbyi tshogs rnying par rgyal po 4 261

langs nas sdod mi dgos pa dang / gla pa ni sa la bsdad mi chog pa lta bu'i dbye ba yod pa bstan zhing / skud pa sgrim skabs mi gcig gis langs nas sgrim dgos pa dang / mi gcig gis mar bsdad nas bal gses te gtong ba'i las stangs kyang mtshon yod/ (a mdo khul ) 12 ske rang la yod bzhin du/ mgo mi la 'dogs don med/thod pa sa la ma lhung bar du dgra phyogs te mi gzhan la mgo bo rtsa ba nas mi sgur zer ba'i tha tshig bsgrags pa'o/ /(a mdo khul )14 skya mis da 'gro zer/ rkang thang gis da 'dug zer/ rta bzhon nas 'gro mkhan gyis rkang thang du 'gro ba'i dka' ngal la mi blta zer ba 'dis dbang sgyur pa dang / dbang sgyur myong mkhan gnyis bsam tshul rbad de rgyab 'gal yin pa de ston gyi yod/ (a mdo khul )15 skyid kyi nyi ma shar dus/ sdug gi mun pa sangase dus/dus bab la 'gyur ba yong ba'i go skabs yod zer ba'am/ yang na med zer ba/ de bzhin yong ngam/ mi 'dug zer ba sogs tshig mjug mi 'dra bas don mi 'dra ba so sor spyad chog pa 'di ni bod kyi gtam dpe'i khyad chos shig yin/ ('brog khul ) 16 skyid che ba'i nyin ladagod rgyu mi 'ong / sdug che ba'i nyin la ngu rgyu mi 'ong / sems ha cang dga' drags na gad mo dgad pa'i khyab pa med la/ sdug bsngal tshad med pa zhig byung dus mig chu 'ong ba'i nges pa med pa de ni rgyun mthong zhig— yin/ste de las dgod pa dang ngu ba de dga' skyo gnyis kyi phyi'i mtshon byed spyir btang pa zhig las/262

ngo ma de ma yin par ston pa'o/ /('brog khul )17 skyid rta pho'i gong sayong sha na/ sdug khur po'i 'og nas glu chung len/ mi'i rigs kyi skyid sdug la tshad gzhi zhig med de/ rta bzhon nas 'gro mkhan gyi brla dang pus mo sogs mnar nas sdug bsngal ba'i tshor ba skye ba dang / rkang thang mar khur po lci po khur te 'gro mkhan la rang dbang gi skyid snang zhig 'char nas glu chung len pa la ltos dang zhes pa'o/ /(a65do khul ) 18 skyid thag ring na dga'/ sdug thag thung na dga'/'dir thag ces pa de dus tshod la go ba yin/ dper na bza' tshang rtag tu 'khrug rtsod la bar 'dum yang yang byas rung / mi 'grig par yang bskyar rtsod gzhi thug pa sogs kyi skabs slad skyid sdug tha dad bya rgyu yin zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin zhing / de mtshungs gzhan la'ang 'gre/19 skyid theg dgos/ sdug bsran dgos/ skyid po yin dus skyid po ngos zin nas skyid tshod zin dgos pa dang / sdug po byung dus bzod bsran sgom thub pa bya dgos pa ni mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i nang gal che ba'i 'gag rtsa'i mtha' gnyis yin zhes bstan pa'o/ / (a mdo khul ) 20 skyed dus mgo 'phang ma mtho/ sdug dus sems 'phang ma dma'/ bde skyid ldan dus do snang bya dgos pa ni/ nga rgyal dang khengs dregs ngesi par spong dgos pa de yin/ nyams nyes byung dus do snang bya dgos pa ni skyo snang dang yi chad spangs te blo rgya cher skyed kyis 263

sems 'phang gong mthor 'degs dgos pa yin zhes bstan nas/ de ltar rtogs na skyid sdug gang la'ang bag mi tsha ba yong zhes gdams pa'o 21 skyid 'dod na mi rgan gyi chung ma gyis/ lo khyad che ba'i gzhon nu ma chung mar brten mkhan ni pha la cher 'byor pa ldagopa'i mi rgan dag yin pas/ chung mas rang nyid la ma mgu dogs nas 'dod yon gang ci mo'i re 'dod skong gang thub byed pa la brten nas de ltar grags pa yin/ 22 skyid na nam mkha'i bya yang 'khor/ sdug na rang gi bu yang 'bros/ mi yul gyi snang tshul ni 'di 'dra zhig yin pa ste/ 'dir rgyan sdud kyi phrad gnyis brjod pa des skye bo gzhan rnams de'i khongs su sdud pas spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul dgod bro la/ skyi g.ya' ba de bstan nas gtso bo rang gi dar rgud la rag lus par bstan pa'o/ /22 skyed na tsha ru rtsub snang 'char/ sdug na rtsid pa 'jam snang 'char/ mi'i rigs kyi skyid sdug gi 'char snang ni/ lang shor dang sdug goms gnyis la rag lus pa las/ rang bzhin gyi tshod cig med par bstan nas gtso bor ngan lang mi shor ba dang / sbyong brdar byas nas dka' sdug bzod thub pa zhig bya dgos par gdams pa'o/ /(a mdo khul ) 24 skyid po rang gis ma byas na/ sdug po mi yis btang yong /skyid po bya rgyu yod pa'i skabs su dus tshod dam bzung gis skyid po ma byas 264

na/ sdug po ni rang gis 'tshol mi dgos par mi gzhan dag gis btang yong zer zhing / mi lal dal khoms yod dus kyang skyid po byed yishes mkhan la zur za lta bur spyad na'ang 'grig25 byad po la sgug long dngaka sdug po la sangs dus/ mi tshe'i chos nyid ni skyid sdug ma nges par yong bas skyid po 'dod na de'i rgyu rkyen shes rig sbyang brtson/ dka' spyad hur bsri/ lugs mthun khrims srung sogs rgyun bsrings dgos pa las/ bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub mi srid/ sdug po phrad dus blo rgya cher skyed dang / bzlog med kyi bya ba'i rigs la bsam gzhigs byed mkhas po byas te mya ngan sangs dus yod pa shes dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ / 26 skyid re sdug re ma myangs na/ skyid sdug dbye ba 'byed pa dka'/ mi rnams kyi skyid sdug ni rang gis nyams su myong na/ gzhi nas ldog phyogs kyi bro ba ngo ma de myong thub pa yin te/ gtso bo ni sdug po myangs par brten nas skyid po'i tshor snang dngos de ngos zin pa byung na/gzhi nas mi gzhan gyi sdug bsngal la bsam shes byed thub pa zhig yong bar bstan pa'o/ /27 sbyin pa chu yin yang sla ru mi gtong / don 'grel/dngos po che chung ci 'dra zhig g.yar na yang / tshab skyin 'jal skabs spus tshad sngon ma de las zhan du rtsa ba nas gtong mi rung zer bar spyod pa yin/ tsho 28 skyin pa chu yin yang 'jal dgos/ g.yār ba'i dngos po — — 265

yag nyes dang chung rtsag ci 'dra zhig yin na yang / snang chung zom 'jog mi byed paratshab skyin nges par du 'jal dgos pa de ni spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod cig yin par gdams pa'o /29 skyes drin las/ gsos drin che/ a mas rang lus skyes pa de drin shin tu che na'ang de las kyang so so chung ngu nas bzung lo nar ma son bar du gso skyong byed mkhan ni sku drin lhag par du che ba yin pas/rang mgo thon rjes gso mkhan gyi drin ma brjed pa bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ / 20ོ kha khu byug bzhin du snyan/ khog gzhu mo bzhin du 'khyogakha mkhas zhe gnag pa'i mi la mgo 'khor mi nyan par ya lan 'tshams par 'jal nas brtag dpyad byed shes pa byadagos zhes gdams pa'o/ /(a mdo khul ) — 21 kha mkhas na mkhas pa min/ khog mkhas na mkhas pa yin/ kha nas tshig 'grig po brgya bshad stong bshad byed mkhas pa de mkhas par brtsi rgyu med/ don lag len gyi thog la mkhas shing byang chub pa de ni dngos 'brel mkhas pa yin pas de gnyis kyi dbye mtshams ma nor ba bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /('brog khul )22 kha gar gtad la bkra mi shis/ rkyab gar bzhag la rtsa mi skye/ bsod nams dman zhing / lam 'gro zhan pa'i mi de gang/du phyin na'ang bde skyid mi yong ba dang / byur dang chag sgo g.yol thabs med par 'ong ba yin zhes las dang bsod nams zer ba'i lta ba las 'phros 266

pa'i sdom tshig go /22 kha dgod kyin ngan bco/ ngo gnag gin bzang bco/kha nas gad mo dgod bzhin du bya ba ngan pa slob pa'am bzo ba mang zhing /gdong nag po ston bzhin drang gtam nan po brjod na bya ba bzang po slob pa'am bzo ba yin pas ngo 'dzum dkar nag la bltas nas bzang ngan dbye ba 'byed mi rung bar don la blta dgos zhes bstan pa'o/ /(a mdo khul )24 kha sgor mo/ gyod kyi gzhi ma/ spyi tshogs thog gyod dang rtsod gzhi mi nyung ba zhig kha nas skad cha gang byung bshad pa las byung ba yin pas/ dus gtan du rang gi kha la bdag gces nan po bya dgos par gdams pa'o/ /25 kha mngar lkugs pa'i sems la yod/ byams sdang byis pa'i yid la gsal/ kha nas ma bshad na yang / su dang sus bya ba bzang ngan gang dang gang byas pa de sems nang du gsal po nges yod ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin no/ /26 kha mchu zhag la lus na/ pho las mo rgod/ spyir na gyod kha mchu rtsod par skyes pa rnams rgod par brtsi rung / bsam gzhigs byed pa'i dus tshod mang tsam rag na/ bud med rnams blo rig bkra la dran rgyu mang ba yod zer ba'i chod gtam zhig yin/27ོ kha che'i yul na gur kum ra mas za/ a mdo'i yul na byi tang mardzo mos za/ 'dzam gling ni ha cang rgya che bas sa gnas mang por 267

rin thang ha cang che zhing snyan grags ldan pa'i dngos zog la sa gnas bye brag par spyir btang gi lta stangs las med ces ston pa des lo rgyus thog 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren gyi bya gzhag ha cang rjes lus yin pa de mtshon gyin yod/ (a mdo khul )28 kha mchu yul la med pa dgos/ rtsa ba rang la ma zug dgos/ spyir na gyod kha mchu ni rang yul la med pa zhig dgos shing /yang sgos gyod kyi rtsa ba de rang nyid la ma thug pa zhig nges par du bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ / 29 kha nyes kha dang / lag nyes lag kha nas skur 'debs kha ngan sogs bshad pa'i nyes par skyon brjod dang / gshe gshe gtong ba sogs kyis dma' 'bebs dang / lag pa 'degs pa'i nyes rdung btang ba sogs kyi nyes par lus thog tu bab thob kyi khrims gcod dgos zer ba te/ mdor na nyes pa la dpag pa'i khrims chad 'os 'tshams shig gcod dgos zhes pa lta bur spyod srol yod/40 kha ta zho bsnyal bsnyal/ chag sgo chang lang lang / gnad du ma 'khel ba'am/ bya thabs mi mkhas pa'i kha ta bslab bya ji tsam byas na yang / chag sgo dang rnyog gzhi de tsam gyis mang ba yong zhes bu tsha sogs la slob ston 'os shing 'tshams pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa zhig ma byung na/ phan pa 'byung mi srid par bstan pa'o/ /41 kha bde po mi yi dpon po/ lag bde po mi yi g.yog po/dpon po ni lag len gyi nyams myong gang yang med par mi gzhan la kha 268

nas bkod pa kho na gtong ba dang / lag len ngo ma'i shes rig dang myong byang yod pa rnams ni rtag tu mi'i g.yog rgyug dgos pa yin zhes spyi tshogs de'i lam lugs sam/ snang tshul lugs dang mi mthun pa'i mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba ya mtshan can la 'phya dmod byed pa'o/ /42 kha ba babs na yag kha shul nyi ma dro/ bod sa mtho'i dmigs bsal khyad chos dpyid dus gnam gshis kyi rang byung chos nyid ston pa'i nyams myong gi sdom tshig gi gtam rgyud/42 kha mang gyod kyi rtsa ba/ bya mang byur gyi sna 'dren/ spyi tshogs thog gyod kha mchu mang po'i 'byung rtsa dang / byur chag sgo'i yong rkyen bstan te don med kyi skad cha mang po shod pa dang / dgos med kyi bya ba mang po byed mi rung zhes gdams pa yin no/ /44 kha rma gso dka'/ lag rma gso bde/ tshig 'grel/kha nas tshig mtshon btab pas mi sems la rmas skyon btang ba de gso dka' ba dang / lag pas gzhus nas lus rmas pa de gso bde zhes dper byas/don 'grel/ mi sems la phog thug gtong ba'i tshig ngan de ni lus la gri rmas btang ba las kyang thu bas nam yang 'khon 'dzin sel mi thub pa yin pas/ mi la tshig rtsub kyi rigs gtan nas shod mi rung zhes gdams pa'o/ /45 kha rin po che/ lus bde ru chug mi'i lus kyi nad gzhi mang po zhig ni zas ma 'phrod pa las 'byung ba yin pas/ lto chas rang 269

gi gzugs bab dang mthun min blta dgos pa las/ mig gis mthong tshad za mi rung zhes 'doms pa la spyod pa yin no/ /46 kha bshad chu yi spu ba/ lag len gser gyi thigs pa/ kha nas 'dra chags po ji ltar bshad kyang don la ma 'khyol na stong pa stong rkyang yin zhing / lag len dngos su bstar nas grub 'bras thob thub pa de ni dngos 'brel rtsa ba chen po yin pas gtso bo lag len la blta dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /47 kha so pags pas ma 'dus pa/ sems nang dga' tshor dpag med skyes nas rang dbang med par dga' 'dzum 'gog thabs bral ba'i rnam 'gyur phyir mngon pa de rigs la spyod pa yin no/ /48ོ khas me 'dra blangs/ thebs chu 'dra bcag dang thog khas len dus sems nang dga' tshor chen po skyes rung / 'gag rtsar thebs gcog dus sems 'khyags pa'i tshul mngon par byas shing /don ni khas len lag bstar rtsa ba nas mi byed mkhan gyi mi g.yo khram can de rigs la sting tshig sgrog par spyod pa go sla'o/ /49 khas len len mang na/ mi ngan chags/ rang nus kyis sgrub thub dang mi thub bsam gzhigs ma byas par mis gang mngags tshad tshang ma khas len byas na/ bsgrubs ma thub par mtha' ma rang nyid khas blangs lag bstar mi byed pa'i mi ngan zhig rang shugs kyis chags rgyu las 'gro sa med ces gdams pa'o/ /50 khyim mches du ba gdung 'gel/ mjal 'phrad gser 270

las dkon pa/ 'brel 'dris ha cang che ba'i khyim tshang gi dbar la lab rgyu dang 'khon rtsod mang po yong bas 'gro res sdod res kyi 'brel ba je nyung du 'gro ba yin zhes spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong phyogs sdom byas pa'o/ /51 khyim mches zhe sdang med na/ grong par yaracus med/khyim tshang phan tshun dbar la 'gran rtsod kyi sems shugs med na yar rgyas dang gong 'phel yong mi thub ces 'gran sems ni yar 'phel gyi sgul shugs yin pa'i spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong la phyogs sdom bgyis pa'o/ /52 khyim 'dzugs rgyu sla/ shul skyong rgyu dka'/ khyim 'dzugs pa ni dus gcig yin pas gnyen nye'i rgyab skyor sogs la brten na sgrub sla yang / shul skyong rgyu de ni mi rabs nas mi rabs bar nyams pa gso chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel yong thabs bya dgos pas de ni ha cang gi dka' ba zhig yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /52 khyod rgyus nga dang / nga rgyus khyod/ phan tshun gyi dge dang skyon tshang ma cha rgyus yod pas kha rog sdod tshugs na dga' zhes sdig mo byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ 54 khrims dang sdig pa rang 'khur/ tshe 'dir rgyal khrims 'gal ba'i byas nyes gang bsags pa'i chad pa dang / phyi mar las 'bras khyad du bsad pa'i sdig pa gang byas pa de dag byed po rang gis khur dgos pa las/ mi gzhan la khag dkri dang / yang na bgo thabs sogs med pas rjes yong sngon dran bya dgos par gdams pa'o/ /55 khrims yod na dga' ste/ med na dga'/ yul la 271

khrims yod na dmangs rnams blo bde bag phebs bde skyid 'tsho ba longs su spyod rgyu yong bas los dga' ste/ 'on kyang dpon pos gang 'dod khrims su rtsis na nyes can rnams rgya yan du gtong ba dang / bden yod rnams bdag med yal bar 'dor ba'i khrims 'khyog de rigs yod pa las/ med pa ha cang gi dga' zhes drang po med pa'i khrims lugs kyi skyon mtshang ther 'don byed pa'o/ /54 khrims las 'gal na pang gi bu yang 'dor/ khrims lugs tshul bzhin du skyong dgos na nye ring spu tsam med par khrims kyi gtan 'bebs ji lta ba bzhin lag len mthar phyin pa bstar dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /57 khyel med gson pa las/ bag yod shi ba dga'/ ngo tsha khrel yod ni mi'i rigs kyi kun spyod bzang po srog las kyang rtsa ba che ba zhig yin pa gsal bstan te/ 'chi ba srog la thug na'ang khrel med kyi bya ngan nam yang bya mi rung bar gdams pa'o/ /58 mkhas pa 'phyugs na 'dom gang / glen pa 'phyugs na mtho gang / gal te mkhas pas nor na de'i rjes su 'brangs mkhan mang bas de dag tshang ma lam log tu song nas nor tshabs chen por 'gyur srid cing / glen pas nor yang de'i rjes su 'gro mkhan med pas mi gcig nor ba tsam du zad ces bstan nas mkhas pa'i grags pa thob pa rnams kyis de bas gzab dgos par bstan pa'o/ /59 mkhas pa mi gtso/ rgyus yod gtso/ rang byung khams kyi 272

dmigs bsal yul khams kyi gnas lugs sam/ mi rigs so so'i dmigs bsal sems khams dang yul goms sogs dang 'brel yod kyi bya gzhag shes rtogs byed pa sogs lta bur grags can gyi mkhas pa las/don dngos de dang de la cha rgyus yod pa'i mi 'ba' zhig gtso che ba yin zhes lag len ngo ma'i sdom tshig go /60 mkhas pa brgya la lan thebs kyang / u tshugs can la lan mi thebs/ blun rmongs rang shed can la go bskon blo 'gug bya rgyu de ni dka' ngal ha cang che ba'i bya gzhag cig yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /61ོ mkhas pa mkhas par sdang / 'phyon ma 'phyon mar sdang /las rigs gcig pa gang yin pa de nang khul sdang zug che ba de ni spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul bzlog tu med pa zhig yin zhes pa gdams pa'o/ /62 ོ mkhas pas mkhas pa shes/ dpa' bos dpa' bo thos/mi rnams rang nyid gang dang gang la dga' zhen che ba de dang de'i cha rgyus rang shugs kyis lon pa de yang spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul nges pa can zhig yin par bstan pa'o/ /62 gang la mi 'cham/ za la 'cham/ nam rgyun bya ba byed skabs sogs gang gi dus su'ang mi 'cham par gcig gis gcig la skyon brjod rdzogs rgyu med na yang / mnyam du bza' rgyu gcig rag na de za ba la phan tshun 'cham mthun gyis lab rgyu gleng rgyu med par mnyam za mnyam spyod byed mkhan de rigs la sting tshig sgrog pa'o/ /64 go kha'i dpa' gtam byes na med/ 'grangs pa'i 273

'grangs gtam ri na med/ rang khyim gyi nang du/ btang btang 'jon 'jon 'ur gtam dam/ phyi logs su bya ba ngo ma'i nang mngon rgyu med pa'i mi de rigs spyi tshogs thog mthong rgyu nyung nyung min/ nang mi'i mdun du 'ar gtam dang / lto rgyags dus kha bde po de rigs byed mi nyan zhes gdams pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )65 go kha'i rgan mo kha bde ma/ kha los bde go kha dro ni red/rgan mo rgyal khams kyi don la the jus byas te kha dal por mi sdod mkhan de rigs la zur za byed par spyod par snang / (a mdo khul )66 go rang gis ma chod/ yus phyogs bzhir 'dren/ las ka ma grub pa de rang gis go ma chod pa mthong bzhin du khas mi len par/ma 'grig ma 'thus pa'i sdug yus phyogs gang sar shod mkhan gyi mi de 'dra dngos su mthong rgyu yod ces bstan nas tha shal de lta bu bya mi rung bar gdams pa'o/ /67 goms pa thams cad sdug goms yin/ shor ba thams cad lang shor yin/ spyi tshogs thog goms gshis bzang po yod tshad ni dang thog rang rtogs kyis goms su 'jug pa la brten nas chags pa sha stag yin zhing / kun spyod mi legs pa mtha' dag kyang thog mar chung rtsag la do snang ma byas par brten rim bzhin ngan lang du shor nas mtha' ma ngan 'bras tshabs chen phog pa de dag lang shor la brten nasu byung ba yin zhes gdams pa'o/ /68 gos la gyon mkhas byas na/ a yag rgyun mi 'chad/274

rgyun du gyon gos la bzo po byas na rtag tu gos gsar pa gyon pa lta bu'i mdzes mtshon yong ba yin zhes gyon mkhas bsri tshags byed dgos par gdams pa'o/ /69 gos zadakyi mtha' ma/ mchor la thug mi la la'i khyim tshang nyams gud du song na yang / gyon chas je gzab tu 'gro ba de rigs la zer ba yin zhing / skabs re gyon chas la bstod bsngags thob pa'i lan du ku re'i ched gong dpe spyod mkhan yang yod/70 nga gyod 'go ri las che/ gyod gzhug chu las ring / pha mes kyi thog nas gyod gzhi chags te gyod thog gyod brtsegs kyis 'khon 'gras dang rnyog dra je cher gyur pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/71 gyod lo dgu songayang so ma/ gos zla dgu gyon na rnying pa/rtsod gzhi'i gyod don ni yun ji tsam ring yang rnying rgyu med pa ga dus rtsod na'ang gsar pa yin pa dang / gos ni zla ba 'ga' shas gyon na rnying par 'gro ba de gnyis mi 'dra zhes don la gyod gzhi gsar rnying la khyad par med par smra ba 'di yang sngar gyi yul srol zhig tu snang /72 grogs po nye na skyon la mdzub mo tshugs/ grogs po ngo ma yin na/ rang la yod pa'i skyon cha de dngos su bton nas phan 'dogs thub min la blta dgos pa las/ kha mkhas ngo bstod byed pa ni grogs po min zhes gdams pa'o/ /72 grogs pos bslu dus dgod bzhin bslu/ khram pas bslu dus ngu bzhin bslu/ spyi tshogs thog mi la bslu brid byed mkhan nye rgyang 275

gang sar yod la/ de dag gi bslu thabs kyang rnam pa sna tshogs yod pas dus rtag tu sgrim po'i blos dpyad de rang nyid mi gzhan gyi mgo skor bslu brid 'og mi tshud pa nges par bya dgos zhes bstan pa'o/ / 74 grod pa stogs na/ zas la yag nyes med/ zas zhim dang mi zhim la sogs pa 'dod yon longs spyod kyi rigs de cha rkyen la bltos pa zhe cig yin pa las/ mi'i 'dod pa la mtshams tshigs med pas gang la'ang rang rtogs dgos zhes bstan pa'o/ /75 gros mi la dris/ thag rang gis gcod/ bya ba sgrub skabs rang bsam bden rlom ma byas par nyams myong dang cha rgyus yod pa'i mi la 'dri bsdur legs par bya dgos/ 'on kyang mtha' ma'i jus thag gcod dus gzhan gyi zer dbang du ma btang bar gros don la dbye zhib byas te rang nyid kyis thag gcod byed dgos par bstan pa'o/ /76 dga' dus snying gtam bshad pa/ sdug dus shags la 'khur/ spyi tshogs thog bag tsha ba dang / skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas tshul skyug bro ba 'di rigs yang yang mthong thos yod pa'i nyams myong phyogs sdom gyis gsang ba byed 'os pa'i skad cha gang byung bshad na mtha' 'bras bzang po mi yong bas nges par gzab nan dgos par gdams pa'o/ /77 dga' po dga' tshod ma zin/ nam phug 'khon/ spyi tshogs thog gang sar mthong rgyu yod pa'i nyams myong bslab bya zhig yin te/bya ba gang la'ang tshod ran po dgos pa las/ thal drags na ldog phyogs kyi ngan 'bras thon nges yin zhes gdams pa'o/ / 276

7ra dge ba nye phyogs dang / gtor ma dgra phyogs/ dgra gnyen dang bzang ngan kha phyogs ma log par de lan de 'jal byed dgos pa ni 'jig rten gyi spyod tshul gal che ba zhig yin zhes ston pa'o/ /79 dgra gcig yin yang mang skyon/ gnyen brgya yod kyang nyung skyon/ spyi tshogs thog mi dang 'brel ba byed skabs mthun pa'i cha gang yin spel thabs dang / 'gal ba'i cha rnams la g.yol thabs sam/yang na sel thabs byas te mthun phyogs gang mang dang / 'gal phyogs gang nyung yong ba bya rgyu de gal ha cang chen po yin par bstan pa'o/ /80 dgra gnyis langs dus/ dgra gcig pang du longs/gal te mi mthun pa byung tshad dgra ru bzung na/ dgra mang mnyam rub kyis rang nyid pham par byed pa gdon mi za bas/ 'gal zla chung ba dag sel thabs kyis mthun 'grig yong ba byas te/ dgra bo gtso bo der stobs shugs gcig sgril gyis phar rgol byas na rang nyid nam yang mi pham pa'i gnas su langs thub ces bstan pa'o/ /81 dgra phar 'gro lag tu mi len/ gyod tshur bkal 'gyod pa mi skye/ dgra phar snyad kyi zing cha rtsa ba nas slong rgyu med pa dang /gal srid gyod gzhi tshur 'gel gyi 'khrug rtsod bslang na blos gtong ji tsam bya dgos byung rung / 'gyod pa med par mtha' 'khyol ba zhig 'dzing rgyu yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /(khams khul )82 dgra phyi nang 'dres na/ rdzong btsan pos mi thub/ dgra bo nang du 'dzul ba de nyen kha che shos yin pas rtag par nang khul du 277

dogs gzon dang gtsang bsher bya rgyu lhod g.yeng shor na/ 'thab jus kyi gra sgrig gzhan ma thams cad nus med du 'gyur ba yin zhes nan tan gyis gdams pa'o/ /82 dgra sha pha'i dus su sha pha/ chos ma ṇi'i dus su ma ṇi/'jig rten na dgra gnyen dang / yul dus gnas skabs sogs 'gyur ba ha cang mang bas skabs so so dang bstun pa'i spyod tshul 'dzin mkhas po dgos pa las/ gang dang gang la'ang rengs por gyur pa'i lta stangs 'dzin mi rung zhes spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong bshad pa'o/ /84 mgo stong phyi la bstan/ klad rlon mi yis blug rang tshugs kyi bsam blo ci yang med par don yongs rdzogs mi gzhan la bshad nas gros dris na/ mi tshos skabs dang bstun nas kho tsho'i re 'dod ltar sgrub tu 'jug srid ces mi la rang tshugs kyi bsam blo yod dgos par bstan pa yin/85 mgo ril ril yodatshad dge 'dun/ gos ser ser gyon tshad bla ma/ bod rigs sa khul du khyab gdal che ba'i phyi'i cha byad kho nar bltas nas yod tshad la rmongs dad byed pa'i mgo rmongs nang tshud mi nyan par spang rtogs kyi yon tan ldan dang mi ldan sogs dbye 'byed gzab nan bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /8khyi mgyogs mgyogs byas na 'gor 'gor/ bya ba gang byed na'ang 'tshab 'tshub brel zing che drags na las 'dzol yong sla bas ji tsam gyi brel khyad che na/ de tsam gyis gzab nan che ba byas na myur sgrub byed 278

thub ces gdams pa'o/ / 87 mgron porgyus che yang / bdag po'i tshab mi yong / rgyun gtan 'brel 'dris ji tsam che na'ang mi gzhan gyi don gnad thag gcod pa'i tshab byed mi rung zer ba'am/ yang na mi gzhan dag gis de ltar byed pa la'ang cha 'jog byed mi nyan zhes gdams pa'o/ /88 'gyel sa nas langs dgos/ bya bar pham nyes dang bar chad thengs re zung byung dus yi thang chad nas re med spobs med du sdod mi rung bar slar yang snying stobs dang 'bad brtson sngar bas che ba byas te/ mthar thug gi grub 'bras nges par du 'thob pa bya dgos zhes bskul ma byed dgos/89 'gro phyogs yid bzhin nor bu ma shes na/ gtam yig rtsis stug dri'i bang chen yin/ 'di ni sa gnas srid gzhung rnying pa'i dpon rigs nang khyab pa'i bshad rgyun zhig yin/ dbang sgyur pa tshos mi so so'i shes yon 'jon thang sogs la mi blta bar chags sdang phyogs ris dang / rgyu rngan/ ngo dga' sprel lad sogs rang gi snang bar 'gro min gzhir bzung ste go gnas spar 'then sogs byed par yi ma rangs pa'i sting tshig cig yin/90 'gro 'gro mang na/ sdod sa shor/ rang gi gnas gzhi brtan por ma bzung bar gang sar 'khyams myul bya byed mang drags na/mthar thug rang nyid rkub 'dzugs sa med pa zhig chags yong zhes gdams pa'o/ / 〉279

91 rgya gar a tsa ra'i ro gos de/ bod bstan pa dar ba'i dar lcog byed/ bod rigs kyi goms srol dar ras 'bor chen dgos par brten de snga rgya gar ba'i dkri gos rnying pa rnams bkrus nas tshos sna tshogs brgyab ste bod la 'tshong ba de dar lcog tu btsugs pa la 'phya dmod byed pa yin/ 'dir sngon chad rgya gar ba'i yod tshad bzang po yin par brtsi srol de la zur za byed pa'i go don yang mtshon gyi yod/92 rgya gtam bod la mi bshong / bod 'di yun ring sgo bkag kher rkyang du gnas pa'i rkyen gyis yul gzhan gyi gsar dar dang yar rgyas kyi bya gzhag gsar pa'i gnas tshul rnams rna bar mi bshong ba ste/ mi rnams yid ches dka' ba yin zhes bod rnying pa'i rjes lus bag khum gyi gnas lugs mtshon byed cig yin/92 rgyal khams kyi kha la/ ye shes kyi sprun yod/ mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi gleng phyogs la bden don gyi cha nges can zhig ldan yod ces de la nges par do snang bya dgos par gdams pa'o/ /94ོ rgyal po rgyal gzhis bzhag nas 'gro zang po ber ka bzhag nas 'gro spyi tshogs thog gi mi rnams 'dod yon longs spyod che chung la khyad par chen po yod na'ang / nam zhig 'chi bdag slebs dus yod tshad thams cad shul du bzhag nas 'gro skabs gcig pa gcig rkyang yin pa ma zad/ da dung dbul po rnams chags zhen bya yul med pas sdug bsngal chung ba yod ces pa'o /95 rgyu drang pos ma rtsis na/ kha 'jam pos go mi chod/280

'dir rgyu drang po zhes pa ni sems rgyud la go dgos shing / kha mkhas tshig snyan la mgo ma 'khor bar/ lag len thog drang bden ji ltar byed min blta dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /96 rgyu med na/ khram pa rang shugs/ bod rnying si ra khral dang bu lon gyis mnar ba'i dbul phongs rnams g.yas len g.yon 'jal mi byed ka med yin stabs/ sang sprod gnangs sprod ces kha dan tshig la gnas pa zhig sgrub thabs med pa lta bur zer ba yin/97 rgyun gzab pa la mchor med/ dus rgyun du gzab gos gyon rgyur dga' ba'i mi la dus chen sogs mi tshang mas gzab mchor spros skabs/ kho la dmigs bsal gyi mchor gos gyon rgyu gang yang med ces rgyun gtan gzab mchor bya rgyu med ces bstan pa'o/ /98 rgyus med mkhas kyang / lan gcig 'phung / cha rgyus med pa'i bya ba zhig sgrub skabs shes yon che yang rgyus ma lon par thengs dang po pham nyes 'khur dgos pa mang zhes spyi tshogs kyi bya gzhag rnyog 'dzing che bar rgyus mnga' med par gya tshom gyis gzhug mi rung bar gdams pa'o/ /99ོ sgom chen ri la sdod kyang / bsod snyoms grong nas len/dben gnas ri khrod la sdod na'ang / rgyun gtan grong chog la rem mkhan chos pa'i gzugs brnyan can de rigs la zur za byed pa la spyad na yang chog100 nga rgyal gyi blo la/ yon tan gyi g.ya' mi chags/ yon 281

tan don du gnyer bsam na/ nges par du nga rgyal khengs dregs spangs te sems chung brtson zhib kyi kun spyod bzang po la dus rtag tu gnas pa'i 'bad pa bya dgos zhes nga rgyal ni rang nyid yar rgyas 'gro ba'i gegs bar gtso bo yin par bstan pa'o/ /101 nga rgyas kho dang / khosgyus nga / 'dris gshibs che ba'i mi phan tshun mi mthun pa'i klan ka byung skabs spyod pa mang zhing / yang 'dris che ba'i mi phan tshun skyon mtshang 'don res byas na bshad rgyu mang po yong srid pas de 'dra bya mi rung zhes go bskon slob gso byed par spyad na'ang chog102 ngan pa rgyags na shing las rtsub/ bzang po gud pa dar las 'jam/ skye bo rang bzhin bzang ngan gyi khyad par bshad de/ rang nyid dar rgud ji ltar gyur na'ang / spyi tshogs thog mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba byed skabs des shing dul ba'i spyod tshul skyong dgos pa las/ ma rabs rtsing spyod kyi gshis rgyud rtsa ba nas 'dor dgos par bstan pa'o/ /102 ngan pa dpon la gyur na/ rang gi sde la sdang /rang gi ngan mtshang 'don par skrag ste cha rgyus yod pa'i phyogs khag la dmigs bsal sdang zug dang / gnon shugs sprod kyi yod ces spyi tshogs kyi myong ba phyogs sdom bgyis pa'o / /104 ngan pa ma rig na/ bzang po mi dran/ mi ngan pa'i spyod tsub ma mthong na/ mi bzang po'i kun spyod dang gshis rgyud rnams 282

ngo mtshar bsngags par 'os pa zhig yin par dran mi thub ces mi dang bya dngos mtha' dag phan tshun bsdur nas bltas na gzhi nas khyad par gsal po rtogs thub ces bstan pa'o/ /('brog khul )105 ngan pa tshar ma bcad na/ bzang po spro ba mi skye/ spyi tshogs gnod skyel mkhan gyi mi ngan rnams khrims lugs kyis tshar gcod ma byas par ngan pa byas rgyal du btang na/ spyod bzang dar spel gtong mi thub pa 'di ni spyi tshogs bde 'jags yong min gyi rag las sa'i rgyu rkyen gal chen po zhig yin par gdams pa'o/ /106 ngan pa zas kyis rgyags na/ skad gsang mtho/ mi ngan pa lto ba rgyags na/ don med skad cor gzhan las tsha ba de ni ma rabs kyi rang rtags shig yin zhes bstan nas/ mi gzhan la brtsi 'jog dang gus zhabs kyi rnam pa mtshon ched bag med pa'i ku co sogs —bya mi rung bar bstan pa'o/ /107 ngu dgos pa'i dka' las ma brgyab na/ dgod shor ba'i za ma ga la rag bde skyid dpal yon 'dzoms pa'i 'tsho ba zhig longs su spyod bsam na/ thog mar dka' spyad 'bad 'thab kyi thon skyed ngal rtsol la rtag 'grus bya rgyu'i chod sems don thog tu 'khyol ba bya dgos pa las/ dka' ba ma spyad par bde skyid la rol 'dod byed pa ni stong bsam 'ba' zhig yin par gdams pa'o/ /108 ngo bstod kyis gnyen mi 'khyongs/ chig rtsub kyis dgra mi 'thul/ spyir btang gi mi'i gshis lugs ni rang phyogs la bstod 283

gang thub dang / dgra phyogs la tshig ngan gyis smad gang thub bya rgyur dga' ba zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang yang dag pa'i spyod tshul dngos ni de las yongs su ldog pa zhig yin pas 'jig rten lugs kyi rtsod sgrub rig pa 'di khong du chud pa na/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshul bzhin du sgrub nus zhes bstan pa'o/ /109 ngo shes pa las yag pa med/ rgyus yod pa las sdug pa med/ mi phal che ba gsar 'grogs la dga' bas ngo shes tsam gyi skabs su rogs ram gang thab byed pa yin/ yun ring mnyam gshibs kyis /spu(( tsho ga zu rig ririg zurang pha ga rtag pa 'jugargyus na pa' mas bstan pa rgyus bshag byas ta gnad bskyal ba' byung tshul mang ngo zhes spyir mi'i rigs 'di la a gsar che zhing / rtag mi thub pa'i zhan cha zhig yod par bstan pa'o/ /110 dngul bcol dgra yin/ dngul bcol sa ni rang gi nye phyogs la ma gtogs mi bcol zhing / de yang dngul bcol rjes rang la lag thogs dus de nas snga 'don bed spyod byed par brten mthar thug bu lon zug gzhi chags 'gro ba de la btags pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/111 snga ma gar 'gro sbyi ma'i lam/ bya ba gang yin rung rjes snyeg cig yin pas snga ma des lam drang por bskyod pa na/ phyi ma dag kyang de'i rjes su 'brangs nas drang lam du 'gro ba dang / gal te snga mas lam 'khyog po zhig la phyin tshe phyi ma rnams kyang lam 'khyog tu 'gro srid ces bstan te/ lam bzang ngan gang zhig gtod pa de ni gal ha cang che ba yin par gdams pa'o/ / 284

112 sngar gyi lam dang / rjes kyi shul/ sngon chad bya spyod kyi lam ci 'dra zhig brgyud pa dang / de la brten nas rjes 'bras bzang ngan ji lta bu thon yod pa'i shul rjes la bltas nas da phyin gyi bya thabs gtan la 'bebs dgos zhes spyi tshogs thog gi bya gzhag sgrub thabs la phyogs bsdoms byed pa'i gdams ngag cig yin/112 gcig dang ma 'grig na gzhan gyi skyon/ kun dang ma 'grig na rang gi skyon/ mi gcig dang ma mthun pa byung na de ni phar phyogs kyi skyon yin par brtsi chog cing / gal srid mi gshibs tshad dang ma mthun na de ni so so rang ngos kyi skyon yin pa ra 'phrod pas/ sems rnal du phab ste rang skyon la zhib bsher gyis nges par du spong thabs bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /114 gcig bshad don la ma gnas na/ brgya bshad stong bshad stong pa yin/ kha dan tshig la gnas pa de ni spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod nang drang bden dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gal che'i rtsa don zhig la brtsi ba gsal por bstan te/ don gnad che chung gang yin la ma bltos par rang gis bshad pa'i skad cha de nges par don thog tu 'khyol ba zhig cis kyang bya dgos par nan tan gyis bstan pa yin/115 chag sgo byung na 'go chu ge byung na tha/ spyi tshogs sam/ yul tsho/ sde tshan gang yin rung / chag sgo tshabs chen byung tshe dngos 'brel byas na 'gan 'khri 'go gtso kho nas 'khur dgos pa las/khongs mi phal pa la med pa dang / gal te mu ge byung ba yin na dbul 285

phongs tha zhan la sdug bsngal yong nges las/ gong rim 'byor ldan rnams la do phog 'byung mi srid pa bcas spyi tshogs kyi rim gras dbye ba brjod pa'i sdom tshig go /116 chag sgos ded na/ bya byed mang / byed mi 'os pa'i bya ba byed byed mang ba de ni chag sgo chen po yong ba'i snga ltas shig yin zer ba'am/ 'di ni rnying zhen srol rgyun gyis bcings pa'i goms gshis bsam blo dang yang 'brel ba nges can yod pa'i bshad rgyun zhig yin snyam mo 117 chags sdang bu mo kun la yod/ kun la med de spun la yod/ 'dir chags sdang zer ba ni 'gran sems la go dgos shing /de bu mo kun la yod par grags kyang / 'byor pa dang gnas bab sogs kyi he bag shor na 'gran sems kyi yul las 'das mod/ 'on kyang bu mo spun mched kyi bar la gang thad nas khyad par che ba mi 'byung skabs 'gran sems yong ba yin zhes bshad pa'o/ /118ོ chu khar mnyan pas gang bshad/ la khar jag pas gang bshad/ yul dus gnas skabs mi 'dra ba so sor de gar dbang ba'i re ltos 'cha' yul tshang mas rang rang la yod pa'i khyad dbang bed spyad de za bed brdab gsig ji ltar byas na'ang mi 'khur ka med yin zer ba de thog nas/ ṣṭhatshogs kyi khrims lugs cha mi tshang ba'am/ yang na khrims don la lag bstar mi byed pas gang sar mi rnams brnyas bcos 'khur dgos pa de mtshon gyi yod/286

119 chu tshogs pa'i snod yod kyang / gtam tshogs pa'i snod med/ gtam ni bshad tshar ba'i rjes su de gzhan la mi gyar ba'i thabs mchog med ces spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong dpe yi sgo nas bstan te/gsang bya'i don zhig yin phyin nye phyogs ci 'dra zhig yin na'ang rtsa ba nas shod mi rung zhes gdams pa'o/ / 120 chu la sder mo med kyang / sa gzhi grog rong 'dru/ chu chung chung tsam la'ang snang chung bya mi nyan par 'gog bcos dus thog tu ma byas na/ phugs char gnod skyon bsam yul las 'das pa zhig bzo ba'i dpe yod ces khor yug srung skyob sogs la do snang bya dgos pa'i nyams myong bslab byar bstan pa'o/ /121 chos kyis sangs ma rgyas/ dril bus snying rlung slong / sems rgyud chos dang ma 'brel bar dril bu'i sing sgra ji tsam che na yang /sangs mi rgyas pa'i thog la rang gzhan gyi rna ba gtses pas snying rlung slong ba las/ phan pa ci yang med ces tshul chos mkhan la sting tshig smra ba dang / dad ldan tshor bskul lcag byed pa'o/ /122 chos bdag med snying rus su che/ rgya bdag yod ca ga su dag chos byed pa la snying rus chen po dgos pa dang / rgyu nor bzang po la bdag gces dag po dgos pa yin zhes bstan nas/ snying rus med par chos bya rgyu zer ba dang / bdag tshags gces spras byed mi shes bzhin du rgyu nor gtsigs chen dgos 'dod byed pa sogs kyi re 'dun 'grub mi srid pa shugs la ston pa'o/ /287

12 2 chos shab shub kyis mi che rlung la bskur/ chos kyi don snying ci yang mi rtogs par 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rjes su 'brangs nas chos min chos su rloms pa'i bya byed mang pos/ mi tshe stong zad du 'gro ba mang ngo zhes bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i goms srol lad mo'i lad mo byed mkhan mang ba de rnams la snying po ma mchis zhes bslab bya'i tshul du bstan pa'o/ /124 jus dpon mang na/ jus nyes shor/ bya ba sgrub skabs 'brel yod la gros bsdur bya dgos pa gal che yang / mi mang pos rang 'dod gzhir bzung gi bkod jus byed mkhan mang drags na/mthar thug jus nyes yong srid pas de rigs ma byung sngon 'gog bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /125 cas mi la dris/ jus thag rang gis gcod/ bya ba byed skabs rgan rabs rgyus can sogs la thabs jus nges par du 'dri dgos pa dang / 'on kyang jus gzhi gang mang nyan rjes don dngos dang zhib bsdur gyis mtha' ma'i jus thag de rang nyid rang gis gcod dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /126 'ju tshod kyi lto dang / theg tshad kyi las/ spyi tshogs thog gi 'tsho ba gang la'ang tshad gzhi yod pas de dang mi 'gal ba bya dgos/ lto za tshod ran na gzugs gzhi bde ba dang / theg tshad kyi las byas na rang nyid spyi tshogs kyi snyigs ror mi 'gyur ba/ yang na mi gzhan la'ang theg tshod kyi las bskul na lugs dang mthun pa bcas yin 288

zhing / gal te de las ldog na 'bras bu bzang po 'thob mi srid ces bstan pa'o/ /127 rjes su bster rgyu zer bar dga' mi dgos/ rjes su brdung rgya zer bar skrag mi dgos/ 'jig rten pa'i dga' khro'i sems skad cig ma de ni 'gyur ldog 'gro sla ba zhig yin/ byung rgyal du bshad pa'i bzang ngan gyi gtam de dag gang la'ang yid rton mi rung ba de ni spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong phyogs sdom byas pa las byung ba zhig yin no/ /128 nyal khar chu ma mang / 'chi khar gtam ma mang / nyal khar chu 'thung rgyu mang drags na gcin pa yang yang bro nas gnyid skyid po zhig khug mi thub pa dang / mi 'chi khar skyid sdug gi gtam mang drags na 'das por sems sdug dang dngangs skrag skye ba'i rgyu las phan pa gang yang med par bstan pa'o/ /129 nye ba kha thag ring na bzang / khrim mches bar gyang mtho na bzang / gnyen nye rtag par mnyam gshibs che na mtha' mar 'khon pa'i rgyu 'byung sla bas rgyang thag ring tsam byas na 'cham mthun yong ba dang / khyim mtshes dbar gyi bar skya dma' drags na phan tshun brlag stor sogs byung skabs dogs bzo sla bas bar bcad kyi rtsig pa de mtho tsam zhig bslangs na legs par bstan pa'o/ /120 nye sa dang tshong ma rgyag rgyang sa dang gtam ma glengs/ tshong ni khe spogs len pa'i don du yin pas na nye sa dang rgyag mi 'os pa dang / gtam ni rnyog gzhi slong ba'i rgyu yin pas mi mthun phyogs dang 289

gleng res byed mi nyan zhes spyi tshogs thog nye rgyang dbar la 'dzin pa'i spyod tshul gyi 'dor len bstan pa'o/ /121 nyes pa can la chad pa ma bcad na/ yul gyicul po de la chad pa thob/ khrims las 'gal mkhan nyes can pa rgya yan du btang na/ khrims med byed mkhan je mang du gyur nas spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags zang zing chags te mang tshogs la chag sgo mang po yong nges yin/de lta bu'i nyes 'gan ni rgyal po'am/ yang na khrims kyi dbang cha dngos su bzung mkhan de rang la chad pa thob nges yin par bstan pa'o/ /122 gnyid gung gi g.yag chang 'thung gi gtam/ gnyid khug pa'i dus kyi rtug dri dang / chang 'thungs nas ra bzi dus bshad pa'i skad cha ci 'dra yin pa bcas la cha 'jog dang ngo tsha 'khur dgos don med zer ba 'di las/ rtug dri shor ba ni bod rigs kyi yul goms la ngo tsha chen po yin par brtsi ba mtshon gyi yod/ (a mdo khul )122 gnyen dang nyi ma/ rgyang nas lde/ gnyen nye ba dang nyi ma gnyis ni rgyang ring tsam nas lde ba'am/ bsten na dro zhing 'jam la 'cham mthun 'ong ba yin zhes bstan nas/ shugs las nye drags na nyi mas sreg cing tshig par byed pa bzhin du gnyen nye ba yang 'khon zhing sdang bar 'gyur srid do zhes bstan pa'o/ /124 gnyen mi gtso/ 'grul gtso/ pha phyogs sam ma phyogs gang rung nas gnyen tshan 'gro stangs nye rgyang de gtso bo ma yin par/ dus rgyun du phan tshun rogs res kyi 'gro 'ong byed mang nyung de 290

gtso che ba yin zhes bstan pa ni/ spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba ngo ma'i nang de rang don la gnas pa zhig yin no/ /125 gnyen ya ma dma'/ tshong ya ma mtho/ gnyen ya mtho sa bsgrigs na rang khyim gyi gtam don la rgya gang sar phan pa yong srid pa dang / tshong ya mtho sa la byas na gang ltar rang la gyong gun phog srid ces spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba 'dzugs rgyu de'ang bya ba so so'i dgos don dang bstun shes pa zhig dgos par gdams pa'o/ /126 gnyom chunga'adug shes na/ btsan pos sgul mi thub/rang ngos nas tshul mthun 'gro gzo sdod mkhas byed shes na/ che btsan su zhig gis kyang sdod gzos mi bde ba bzo mi thub zer ba 'di la spyi tshogs kyi khrims srol drang nan don thog tu 'khyol ba zhig yod dgos pa ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin/127 snying gtam bu la bshad/ dgra bo'i rna bar 'khyol/gsang dgos pa'i gtam de rang gi bu la'ang shod mi nyan/ bsam yul las 'das pa'i gegs bar dang chag sgo yong nyen yod ces gdams pas na/ mi gzhan dag la de bas kyang shod mi 'os pa brjod ma dgos/128 snying med gri ring phred gzer/ 'gram lcag rin gyis nyo ba/ rang la dpa' blo khog med bzhin du mi gzhan gyi lad mo byas te gri ring po sked par phred gzer sogs krog krog dang rgod mdog byas na/mi gzhan gyi mig la mi 'gro bas don med rang nyid la dma' 'bebs rag pa'i rgyu rkyen du 'gro ba yin par bstan pa'o/ / (khams khul )291

129 snying rus can gyis rdo la i khung 'brag shes rab can de spang la me shor 'dra/ shes rab che yang nan tan mi byed pas shes 'phral brjed sla ba dang / snying rus can gyis cha shas cha shas byas nas shes zin rnams mi glod pas dka' ba'i gnad dag kyang nam zhig mthar son pa yin zhes slob sbyong ngam/ bya gzhag gang yin rung 'bras bu chen po zhig 'thob pa la rig rno ba las kyang / brtson 'grus che ba de gal che bar bstan pa'o/0/140 rgetam ku re med pa bshad srol med/ zas mchod kha ma phul za srol med/ de dag ni bod mi rigs kyi yul srol goms gshis kyi gras shig yin pa bstan nas/ gtso bo phan tshun skad cha shod res byed skabs ku re ste kha mtshar bshad nas 'dzum gyis bsu dgos par bstan pa'o/ / ('brog khul )141 gtam gyi mgo brtsams te/ las ga'i mjug skyel dgos/ rang gis bshad pa'i skad cha de nges par du lag len la 'khyol ba bya dgos zer ba'am/ yang na las ka gang yin rung 'go btsugs pa'i rjes su mjug 'khyol ba zhig cis kyang bya dgos zhes bstan pa'o/gong gi bsdus tshig la 66gtam 'go las mjug ces kyang brjod srol yod/142 gtam 'go 'dzum gyis bsu/ gtam mjug 'dzum gyis sdogs/ skad cha ni mi dang mi'i bar la 'brel ba byed pa'i yo byad lte ba de yin pas rang gzhan su yin rung / zhi dul dga' 'dzum gyis 292

gtam 'go btsugs thog bar du brjod dgos pa'i don rnams ran par bshad de slar yang zhi 'jam gyi sgo nas gyes 'dzum dang mjug bsdu dgos zhes spyi tshogs mi chos kyi kun spyod bzang po skyong shes dgos par bstan pa'o/ /142 gtam mchil ma gnyis de len rgyu med/ gtam kha nas thon pa dang mchil ma kha nas g.yugs pa de gnyis slar tshur len thabs med ces pa ste/ skad cha shod dus nam yin yang gang dag bshad dgos pa dang gang dag bshad mi dgos pa rig pa sgrim nas btang 'dzin bya dgos pa las/ shor zin pa'i tshig la bskyar bcos byed thabs med par bstan pa'o/ /144 gtam dang nyag phran drang na dga'/ lam dang gzhu mo 'khyog na bde/ spyi tshogs thog bya dngos sna tshogs ji snyed par brten rang rang la mtshan nyid dang khyad chos mi 'dra ba so sor yod pa las/tshang ma gcig ltar ma yin par shes dgos par bstan/ 'dir lam 'khyog na bde zer ba ni gna' bo'i rkang lam phra mo rang byung khams kyi chags tshul la bstun nas bskor na bde ba der go dgos/145 gtam dris na mi shod/ bsgug na shod/ gal che'i gnas tshul zhig shes dgos na de dang 'brel yod mi snar thad kur skad cha dris na/ kho yang dogs pa za nas drang po shod mi srid/ ci sgros mol sgros kyi zhor la gnad don de'i mtha' skor gyi 'brel ba gleng nas sgug bsdad na/ snang med kyi skabs gzhi nas shod srid ces pa ni nyams 293

myong rgad po'i jus cha zhig yin/146 gtam mdun dang / pa locub/ skad cha bzang ngan gang yin na'ang brjod yul gyi mi de rang gi mdun du shod dgos pa dang /skra lhas pa'i pa lo ste de ni rgyab tu glod dgos pa bcas yul lugs dang mthun pa yin zhes mdor na/ skad cha rgyab bshad rgyag pa ni tha shal gyi spyod tshul lugs dang 'gal ba zhig yin par bstan pa'o/ /147 gtam rnams thams cad 'dod pa'i phyogs nas yong /mi rnams thams cad phyug po'i bu la byams/ 'di ni mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs kyi gnas lugs la phyogs bsdoms byas pa zhig yin zhing / rgyun ldan phyogs lhung can gyi gleng phyogs sna tshogs sam/ yang na 'byor ldan pa la phyogs pa'i gtam spyod sogs yang yang 'byung ba'i skabs su gtam dpe 'di gleng nas dbye zhib byed pa yin no/ /148 gtam la mtshon cha med kyang / mi snying dum bur gcod/ tshig rtsub mo'i gtam ni rang nyid la phog skabs bzod par dka' na'ang mi gzhan la shod rgyur dga' bas tshig rtsub kyi gnod tshabs shin tu che ba gsal rtogs byas te/ don med la tshig ngan nam yang mi smra zhing / skad cha zhi 'jam du smra ba'i goms gshis bzang po 'jags pa byed dgos par gdams pa'o/ /149 rta rnga tsam yang yong rgyu med na/ ri rab tsam la spyod shed med/ 'tsho ba'i longs spyod ni yong 'bab la brten nas gtong dgos pas gal te tshur yong sa'i yong khungs med pa'i rjes su/ da yod 294

kyi 'byor stobs ji tsam che na yang mig yug tsam zhig la rdzogs 'gro bas gtong yong la 'char gzhi yod pa zhig bya dgos par gdams pa'o/ /150 btang na rgyal sgor mi thar/ gcur na 'jur mig la tshud/ spyir na rang rtogs zhan pa'i mi rnams bag yangs su bzhag na/rang snang gang shar byed sla ba dang / gal srid sgrig khrims kyis tsha gcun byed skabs dbugs kyang gtong mi phod pa byed pa'i snang tshul la bsun 'byin byed pa'o/ / 66'jur mig ’ ces pa ni phyugs kyi ko bar 'breng thag bzo skabs lcags kyi 'jur khung phra mo de'i ming yin no/ /151ོ rta gcig byung na/ sga gcig dgos/ mi'i 'dod pa ni nam yang tshim rgyu med pa zhig yin/ 'dod yon longs spyod ji tsam chen po chags na/ dgos mkho yang de tsam gyis mang zhing 'dod ham je cher 'gro ba yin zhes rang rtogs kyi sgo nas chog shes bsten dgos par gdams pa'o/ /152 rta shor yang 'jin thabs yod/ tshig shor na 'dzin thabs med/ tshig zin go sla ba ltar shor ba thams cad kyi khrod nas kha thal tshig thal shor ba de nam yang 'dzin thabs med pas/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu tshul 'di la yid 'jog nan tan bya dgos par bstan pa yin/152 lta phyogs gcig la/ mthong phyorges gnyis/ blta yul gyi bya dngos gcig yin na yang / lta mkhan so so'i lta ba dang /'dod tshul/ khe phan sogs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis mthong phyogs mi 295

mthun pa yong srid pa de ni rgyun ldan zhig yin stabs/ rang bsam mtha' gcig tu bden rlom bya rgyu med ces bstan pa'o/ / (gtsang khul )154 ltas ngan la rang gsang med par/ byur la ngo so/rang gis nor 'khrul lam bya ngan byas par mnong 'gyod kyi 'dzem bag tsam med pa'i thog la/ da dung rang gzhan kun la gnod pa'i byur dang chag sgo ngom ngom 'phyar 'phyar byed pa ni ches tha shal gyi spyod tshul lo zhes ched du smad pa'o/ /155 lto 'dun can la ci yang zas/ 'dod sred can la ci yang nor/ spyod tshul de rigs phyogs gcig nas ltogs sla dang 'dod rngams can la smad pa lta bur snang mod/ 'on kyang phyogs gzhan zhig nas spyi tshogs kyi lag len dngos kyi nang gron chung sri tshags kyi spyod tshul ni phan pa ldan pa zhig yin pas/ 'di gras kyi brjod gzhir dbye zhib dgos pa 'dug snyam mo/ /156 ltogs na la phug rtsa ba'ang zhim/ rgyags na sha yi skyi spags bshu/ mi ni dran shes yod pa zhig yin rung / 'tsho ba longs spyod kyi thad la mtshams tshod med pa'i sems can zhig shes su bcug ste/rang rtogs rang bcun gyi bsam shes cung zad tsam ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur thub pa'i 'bad brtson bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /157 ོ stod gangs ri nyi mas mi bzhu/ bya rma bya dug gis mi 'chi/ dngos po so sor rang nus dang khyad chos mi 'dra ba ci rigs yod pa las tshang ma gcig ltar ma yin pa bstan nas/ dgos med kyi blo 296

g.yeng dang sems nad bya dgos don med par gdams pa'o/ /158 ston rta sgo nga yin pas 'dzem dgos/ dpyid rta rgyus pa yin pas shad dgos/ ston gyi dus su rta sha shed yag kyang rgyugs drags na khrag rgyun 'gag pa'i nyen kha yod pas 'dzem bya dgos pa dang /dpyid dus rta sha shed zhan na yang rgyus pa bzhin du mkhregs po yod par brten shad dgos pa ste/ mang tsam bkol dgos zhes bzhon rta bdag skyong byed stangs kyi nyams myong bshad pa'o/ /159 ston pa gar song ston ga ston pa'i yul na dpyid kaston pa ste chos gzugs kyis grong chog rgyug mkhan de tsho sa cha gzhan dag gang du phyin kyang bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu 'bel ba ston ka shar ba nang bzhin yod na'ang/ ston pa kho rang gi pha yul du log dus mchod gnas su 'bod mkhan med stabs/ bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu dkon pa dpyid ka slebs pa dang 'dra zhes zog brdzu can gyi chos pa rdzus ma de rigs la ther 'don dang / dad ldan mang tshogs la rmongs gnyid sad dgos pa'i bskul ma gtong ba'o/ /(a mdo khul/)160 thag ring thung gnyis gar bro dgos/ dgra yod med gnyis gar gzon dgos/ lam thag ring thung ji ltar yin rung lam bar bza' btung gi bro chas 'khyer dgos pa dang / dgra nyen yod med la ma bltos par dogs gzon gyi gra sgrig kyang tshags su 'tshud pa dgos zhes bstan cing / mdor na gang gi dus su'ang gra sgrig yod pa zhig bya rgyu de gal che bar gdams pa'o/ /297

161 thag ring gtam de rgyang yang go thag nye'i gtam de thos pa dka'/ gsang ba'i gnas tshul mang po zhig thag nye sar thos mi thub kyang / rgyang ring ba'i sa gnas su de'i dogs gzon dang / nyen 'gan yol ba'i stabs kyis bde blag tu thos pa'i gnas lugs de lta bu rtag tu yong gi yod par bstan pa'o/ /162 thag ring gi gnyen las/ khyim mches kyi dgra dga'/'di ni go don nges can zhig gi thog nas bshad pa yin te/ gnyen tshan ji ltar nye rung / skabs 'phral gyi bya bar phan 'dogs mi thub pa dang / khyim mtshes zhe nas mi mthun na yang / skabs 'phral gyi g.yar po skyin 'grul lam/ glo bur gyi don rkyen byung dus phan thogs res yong bar bstan pa yin/ de las bod du khyim mtshes rogs res kyi dar srol bzang po yod pa de mtshon gyin yod/162 thos pa'i don la ma dpyad na/ ma thos pa dang khud par med/ thos don brtag cing dpyad nas nyams su ma blangs na/kha nas bshad yams ji tsam byas kyang don la mi phan pas/ ma thos pa dang khyad par med ces rigs pa'i gzhung lugs don dngos dang zung du sbrel nas lag len du ma 'khyol na/ stong pa yin par gdams pa'o/ /164 mtho na dga' ste/ dma' na brtan/ spyi tshogs thog mi rnams dbang grags dang go sa mtho ba 'thob rgyur dga' na yang /don la dbang grags go sa ji tsam mtho na de tsam gyis dgra zla mang la nyen 'gan che ba yin pas/ rang nyid gang du bzhag pa der dma' sa bzung 298

na mi kha byams shing / snang bzos bde zhes bstan no/ / tsho165 don chen sgug pa la/ ngang ring / ngang thung 'tshab 'tshub kyi spyod tshul bzung na/ 'gangs che ba'i don dag sgrub mi thub pas lan brgyar pham yang yid thang mi 'chad par ngang sring lhod med kyis 'bad 'thab bya dgos par gdams pa'o/ /166 drang po dgra la mi 'gro g.yo sgyu gnyen la mi 'gro'adir mi 'gro bya ba ni/ mi rung zhes par go dgos/ dgra bo la drang po bshad na rang jus brlag 'gro ba dang / gnyen phyogs la g.yo sgyu brtsams na zhe 'khrel zhing / rang nyid mi khyur mi tshud pa yin pas dgra gnyen go ldog byed mi nyan pa gdams pa'o/ /167 dran rgyu mang na/ yong rgyu mang / mi dran rgu dran mang drags na/ mi yong rgu yong mang po yong zhes dran rgyu rgod po byed mi rung bar bstan pa yin/ 'di la 'a phel med sor gnas byed pa'i rnying zhen gyi bsam blo'i 'ching rgya'i phyogs shig kyang yod pa ni smos ma dgos/168 drin pha ma bzang po'i kha ta/ bsam ma shes bar du mi go rang snang can gyi lo chung rnams la pha ma bzang po tshos blang dor gyi kha ta bdud rtsi lta bu yang yang byas na yang / rna ba'i ltag rgyab tu skyur gtong ba de ni shin tu ma 'os pa zhig yin rung / sna bsun kha shas phog ste bsam shes ma 'khor bar du phan pa'i go ba lon mi thub pa yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /169 gdong pa khrag med kyi gnyen las/ ngo tsha khrel yod kyi 299

dgra dga'/ ngo tsha shes shing / khrel yod pa ni spyi tshogs kun spyod kyi rmang gzhi yin/ de dang ldan mi ldan de ni dgra dang / gnyen gyi khyad par las kyang gal che ba yin par bstan pa 'di ni bod mi rigs kyi kun spyod tshad gzhi'i khyad chos chen po zhig yin pa mthong thub bo/ /170 bdag pos byed byed/ g.yar pos mi byed/ phyi nor g.yag rta lug sogs yin na'ang 'dra/ nang rdzas mkho rgu'i spyod chas yin na'ang 'dra/ bdag po ngo mas gces spras byed pa nang bzhin g.yar ba pos byed mi srid ces mi rnams kyi bdag 'dzin gyi bsam nga/'i spyod tshul ltar nyams myong phyogs bsdoms byas pa zhig go /171 bden yod 'gro sa'i lam/ bden med gcur sa'i 'phrang / khrims lugs ni bden pa'i don yod pa'i mi rnams 'gro sa'i lam phye ba dang / bden pa med pa'i mi rnams gcur sa'i 'phrang dog po yin pas bden rdzun rnams dbye ba gsal por 'byed dgos par gdams pa'o/ /172 bden lung pa gnyis de phu thag ring / rdzun a bra gnyis de rnga ma thung / spyi tshogs nang bden rdzun gnyis 'dres kyi rnyog 'dzings rtag tu thon na yang / brtag dpyad zhib 'jug nan tan byas na bden par khungs gtugs sa yod pa dang / rdzun ma ni gang ltar khungs 'khyol thabs med pas mthar thug dbye ba gsal po 'byed thub par bstan pa'o/ /172 'dod pa'i nam langs/ shes bya'i mun rub/ 'dod 300

rngams kyi ham sems chen po bcangs na yang / bya ba sgrub thabs kyi blo gros mi ldan pa'i mi dang / bya ba sogs la spyod pa yin/174 sdug khog la bcug na skrangs pa yin/ skyid kha la phud na rlangs pa yin/ sems sdug gang yod khog tu ma nyar bar kha nas bshad na sangs 'gro ba yin zhing / sems nang gi skyid snang de kha nas bton na rlangs pa ltar yal 'gro ba yin pas khog nang nyar na bde ba yun du gnas pa yin zhes gdams pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )175 sdug khong la bcug na dug kha la phud na sman/sems sdug khog par bcug nas bsdad na nam zhig dug zos pa ltar nad du 'gyur ba dang / kha nas phyir bton na rim bzhin sems sdug je yang du gyur pas sman dang 'dra ba yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /176 sdug po/ skyid po'i mdog 'don yin/ sdug po myangs myong ba'i mi des/ skyid po'i bro ba de gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig tshor thub pas/ mi su yin rung sdug nges can zhig myangs pa yin na/gzhi nas skyid po dngos longs su spyod thub ces gdams pa'o/ /177 sdug ma myangs na/ skyid mi tshor/ skyid sdug gnyis ni mi yul gyi 'tsho ba dngos kyi yongs khyab tu gnas yod/ 'on kyang sdug po myangs ma myong ba'i mis skyid po yod pa de skyid po yin snyam pa'i tshor ba skye mi srid ces pa'o/ /178 sde pa'i dkyil skyid/ dgon pa'i mtha' skyid/ ru sde'am/ sde tsho'i mtha' la 'khel na rkun jag gi nyen che bas dkyil ngos 301

skyid pa dang / dgon par rkun jag yong nyung la 'dul khrims ltar byed mi chog pa mang baṃs/ mtha' khul du bsdad na rnam g.yeng gi bya spyod rigs spel bde ba sogs kyis skyid pa yod zer/179 sde 'go mi non dpon po las/ sems khur med pa'i 'bangs mi skyid/ 'jon thang med pa'i 'go gtso yar rgyug mar rgyug byed kyang / las lar phan nus mi thon par sems 'tshab kyis mnar ba dag la zur za byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyad na'ang chog pa yin la/spyir na mi 'jon par dpon po byed pa las/ mang tshogs byas na skyid ces bstan pa'o/ /180 bsdad nas zos na ri yang 'dzad/ las la brtson na zas mi 'dzad/ thon skyed sogs kyi 'bad brtson ci yang mi byed par bsdad nas za rkyang byas na/ bza' rgyu ri tsam yod kyang 'dzad 'gro nges dang / las la 'bad brtson bgyis na bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu nam yang mi 'dzad ces bstan nas/ le lo sgyid lug spangs te las kur hur brtson bya dgos par gdams pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )181 nang bkra ma shis na/ phyi'i don mi 'grub/ khyim tshang ngam/ tsho khag gang zhig yin rung nang khul blo kha gcig mthun bsam pa ring thung med pa zhig yong ba bya rgyu ni/ phyi phyogs kyi don chen legs 'grub yong ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen gal chen zhig yin par gdams pa'o/ /182 nad pa rgad po em chi yin/ nad mang po mnar myong 302

ba'i mis nad sna tshogs kyi brgyud rim dang / bcos thabs sogs cha rgyus yod pas/ em chi gsar bu ba las lhag zer/ gzhan yang rang nyid byang chub pa'i bya ba zhig la 'jug skabs gtam dpe 'di spyod srol yod/182 gna' dang da mi 'dra/ pha dang bu mi 'dra/ spyi tshogs ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ldog 'gro zhing / de dang mthun par mi rnams kyi bsam blo dang spyod tshul yang 'phel 'gyur 'gro ba bcas ni bzlog tu med pa'i chos nyid yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /184 mnong ngos blangs na/ kha mchu gcod bde/ phyogs so sos rang rang gi ma 'grig pa rnams khas blangs pa yin na/ 'dum khrims gang yin rung / gyod gzhi de thag gcod byed bde po yong bas phan tshun nga/nyis ngal mi 'byung ba bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /185 pad lad lce bde'i 'gro rgyug ma shes na/ drang pos sa lam bgrod pa nyin skar tsam/ dbang 'dzin pas kha mkhas ngo bstod byed mkhan la dga' po byed pa las/ drang po drang bzhag gis bya ba sgrub mkhan la bdag po mi rgyag pa de ni mi rnams yid thang chad cing /spyi don nyams dmas su 'gyur ba'i spyod tshul gnod pa che la/ rtag tu mthong rgyu yod pa zhig yin pas tshang mas do snang byed dgos par gdams pa'o/ /186 dpa' dus dpon la ya bo bzung / sdar dus khyi la phyag 'bul zhu/ mi rnams kyi spyod tshul ni tshad 'dzin dka' ba zhig yin 303

te/ dpa' skyed dus kun la khyad gsod ya bzung byed pa dang /nyams dma' dus khyi la'ang gus 'dud byed pa sogs mi rnams gad mo shor ba'i spyod lam 'di rigs bya mi rung zhes gdams pa'o/ /187 dpon mnga' thang che na/ g.yog sdug thang che/dpon po mnga' thang ji tsam che na rgyas spros kyi bya rgyu dang byed rgyu de tsam gyis mang bas g.yog po rnams sdug bsngal ba'i dka' las kyang de ltar du che ba yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /188 dpon snyan 'byog ma srab/ g.yog zhu zhu ma mang /dpon po'i dge mtshan zhig ni skad cha yod tshad mi nyan pa'am/ nyan yang brtag dpyad ma byas par yid ches mi byed pa de yin pa dang /g.yog po'i dge mtshan zhig ni gsham 'og gi gnas tshul yod tshad dpon por zhu zhu mi byed pa de yin zhes dpon 'bangs dbar la mi dgos pa'i rnyog gzhi ma chags pa byed dgos par gdams pa'o/ /189 dpon dang 'dra ba'i gtam yod kyang / dpon dang 'dra ba'i dbang med/ dpon dang 'bangs kyi dbar la bde sdug sogs khyad par chen po de lta bu yong ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bden don yod med la rag lus pa ma yin par gnas lugs rgyu rkyen shod pa'i 'dra mnyam gyi dbang cha med pa de rang la thug pa yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /190 dpon rngung la gcor/ g.yag rdung la g.yol/ dpon pos rdung dus 'gram la bcar na khong khro zhi 'gro ba yin/ g.yag gis rdung na g.yol gang thub byas na legs pa yin zer/ mdor na bya ba'i 304

rnam pa gcig mtshungs yin na'ang gnas lugs dang bstun nas bya thabs mi 'dra ba 'dzin dgos par bstan pa'o/ /191 dpon po ngo bstod la dga'/ bla ma 'bul bar dga'/spyi tshogs de'i snang tshul dngos la ma rangs pa'i sdom tshig bzhag ste bla ma bzang po dang / dpon po drang po zer ba ni nyin mo'i skar ma ltar yin zhes ther 'don byed par spyod pa'o/ /192 dpon po'i gsung de dbril dbril/ g.yog po'i chig de gru bzhi/ dpon pos gang bshad pa'i skad cha la cha 'jog med par gang du bsgyur kyang bsgyur chog yin pa dang / g.yog pos bshad pa'i skad cha de 'gyur ba spu tsam med pa lag len bstar dgos par zer/'go dpon gyi skad cha snga tshig phyi 'gal de 'dra shod skabs byung ba'i dpe 'di spyod bzhin mi 'dod pa'i zur za byed pa mang ngo /192 dpon por gnang rgyu bka' brkyan/ g.yog por bshad rgyu zhabs 'dren/ dpon g.yog gi dbar la bkra shis pa zhig yong thabs med pa ni/ rtsa ba'i khe phan kha gtad du langs pa las byung bar bstan pa'o/ /194 dpon btsan drag che na 'bangs kyis 'dul/ dpa' glen rtags che na dgra khar 'chi/ dpon po btsan drag gi gdug rtsub che drags na/ 'bangs mi rnams 'u thug nas gyen log byas te 'dul nges yin pa dang / dpa' bo yin khul glen rtags che drags pa rnams kyang dgra bo'i lag 'og tu 'chi 'gro ba yin zhes tshul bzhin ma yin pa de 305

rigs la 'bras bu ngan pa 'byung bas spang byar bstan pa'o/ / (khams khul ) 195 dpon rab gcig byed pa la/ g.yog rab gcig shes dgos/ dpon po rab gcig byed bsam na/ thog mar rang gis g.yog po rab gcig gi byed sgo rnams bslabs te shes pa zhig bya dgos/de ltar bya thub na g.yog po la las ga'i bskul 'doms yang dag pa zhig gzhi nas byed shes zhes gdams pa'am/ 'di dang 'brel yod kyi lo rgyus shig le tshan drug pa'i nang gsal yod/196 dpon la dgos pa dus gcig g.yog la dgos pa che gang / gtam dpe 'di ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin pas bran g.yog bslu brid byed pa'i log bshad cig yin zhing / de dus mi dmangs rgyal khab kyi don du byas rjes rlabs chen zhig bzhag na/ rang gi tshe gang gtam don rang shugs kyis 'grub yong zer ba lta bur spyad na chog pa tsam yin snyam/197 dpon la mi skrag dbang la skrag mi rnams kyis dpon la skrag snang byed pa de/ mthar gtugs nas bshad na dpon po tshor gzhan la med pa'i dbang cha zhig yod pa de la skrag pa las/ de min skrag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan dag gang yang med ces pa'o /198 dpyid thal ba 'tshub 'tshub ma 'khrab na/ ston snum zhag chil chil ga nas 'ong / dpyid dus ni zhing 'brog so nam gyi 'gag rtsa yin pas dka' ba khyad bsad kyis dus tshigs de dam por bzung rgyu 306

mi lhod pa bya dgos/ ston dus 'bras bu ci 'dra zhig 'thob thub min gyi rag lus sa yin zhes gdams pa'o/ /199 spun zla gnyis sgrig dgra yi tho ba/ rgod ma gnyis sgrig phyugs kyi ru ma/ a mdo'i 'brog khul gyi gtam dpe ste/ bu spun kha yu ma 'thor ba dang / ma phyugs gso skyong gal cher bzung na/ khyim tshang de'i mnga' thang phun sum tshogs po yong zhes gdams pa'o/ / ('brog khul )2 00 sprang po nang la bzhag dge ba phyi la gtong / spyi tshogs rnying par 'byor ldan tshos/ grang ltogs kyis mnar ba'i bran g.yog rnams rang khyim du bzhag nas/ dgon pa'i grwa pa dang / phyi logs kyi slong mo ba tshor dge ba mchod sbyin gtong ba de rigs la zur za byed pa zhig yin no/ /201 pha khu sbyi gros/ ma sru sger gros/ pha khu tshogs na yul sde'i spyi'i gros byed pa dang / ma sru tshogs na khyim tshang sger don gyi gros byed zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na don 'di'i skor pha khu tshos spyi la bsam pa'i gros mol dang / ma sru tshos sger la bsam pa'i gros mol gnang dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /202 pha sdug le'i (pa'i )bu de/ sdug rgyu med/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rigs rgyud smra bar ngo rgol byed pa zhig yin/ pha rgan gyis sdug sna dgu myangs pa'i bu de chung dus nas rang mgo rang thon dang / dka' spyad bzod thub pa sogs dge mtshan du ma ldan srid zer/307

skabs re rang gi tshod dpags dang mi mthun pa'i ngo mtshar 'byung srid zer ba lta bur yang spyod/202 pha ma shi na/ bu mi 'tshar/ bu phrug lo na 'tshar longs dang bstun nas theg tshod kyi las 'gan sprod dgos zer ba'am/ slob ma dang / las rogs sogs gang yin rung / bab bstun gyis bya ba gang 'os 'gan sprad de byed 'jug dgos/ de ltar byas na rim bzhin rang skya 'pher thub pa las/ rtag par slob khrid rogs gsum byed rkyang byas na nam yang rang mgo mi thon zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/204 pha med par a khur re dus/ chig snyan pa rna bar mi thos/ pha ma med pa'i rjes la mi gzhan dag lta ci/ a khur re dus kyang tshig snyan po zhig rna bar thos mi thub ces spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul de rigs bstan te mi la re mi dgos pa'i rang mgo thon pa zhig bya dgos par bskul ma gtong ba'o/ /205 pha bzang po/ bu'i seg rdar/ pha 'jon po dang rgod po byung na/ mi mang po dbang du bsgyur cing 'dul thub kyang /pha shi rjes tshang mas bu'i thog la sdang po byas te 'khon lan slog pa sogs bu la gzan po yong ba yin zhes ston pa'o/ /206 pha zhig la bu gcig med na/ bya rgod po gshog sne chad 'dra/ rang nyid la bu rgyud med na/ thabs rdugs po zhig la brtsi srol yod pa de ni bod rigs kyi yul srol zhig yin pa mtshon gyi yod/ (khams khul )308

207 phu ru dgon pa btab pa las/ mda' ru kha mchu 'dum pa dga'/ 'di ni gyod gzhi chen por bar 'dum gnang rogs zer skabs spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re bar 'dum pas gyod ya phan tshun la so sos bsam gzhigs kyis 'grig thabs bya dgos zer ba'i skabs su spyod pa'ang thos/208 pho khyo ga'i khog par/ mda' shong mdung shong / don chung la mi khro ba dang / phra dog chung gzon sogs mi byed par khog yangs dkyel che dgos pa ni pho khyo ga'i mtshan nyid yin zhes lcag 'debs byed skabs sogs la spyod pa yin/209 pho ba rgyags na dpa' gtam mang / nyi ma dro na stong gtam mang / spyi tshogs thog mi mi nyung ba zhig gi spyod tshul ni/ grod pa rgyags pa dang / nyi ma dro po byung dus kha bde lce bde byed pa de dag ni col chung mtshon pa yin pas spang byar gdams pa'o/ /210 pho zas nas mi phung / nyal nas phung / 'di ni sgyid lug le lo byed pa de rang gis rang nyid phung ba'i rtsa ba yin pas/ hur thag rbad thag rgyun sring byas na longs spyod kyis phongs pa nam yang yong mi srid ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin/211 pho rab gcig gi blo rtse las/ pho 'bring gsum gyi gros bsdur lhag mi gcig gi blo rig ni ji ltar gsal na'ang / de la rang snang gi tshad bkag yod pas/ bya ba sgrub skabs mi gzhan la gros bsdur byas na tshad bkag de rigs sel thub pa yin gshis/ gros 'dri bya rgyu 309

de gal chen po yin pa ston pa'o/ /212 pho rog sha khyer lung pa'i phu/ sprang po gtam khyer lung pa'i mda'/ skad cha ni mi gang du mang sar khyab 'gro ba zhig yin pas/spyi tshogs kyi gleng phyogs bzang po yong thabs la do snang bya dgos/ sprang po la zas nor gyi sbyin pa legs nyes ji thob des khyim tshang de'i snyan grags bzang ngan ji yong la shugs rkyen thebs kyi yod zer/212 pho la ngar sha med na/ zan gyi rkyal pa/ 'gran rtsod kyi sems shugs dang / yang rtse lhur len gyi snying stobs med na mi'i mtshan nyid tshang med zer ba lta bu yin/214 pho gsar blo dang la kha'i dar/ rlung phyogs gar ldang phya la la/ lo gzhon la spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong med pas/ mi gzhan gyis gang bshad kyi rjes su rgyugs sla po yod ces bstan nas rang tshugs kyi blo rtsa brtan po zhig 'dzugs dgos par gdams pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )215 phyug po nor gyis mi zhog dbul po grod pas mi zhogami rnams lto gos 'tsho ba'i don du brel brel 'tshub 'tshub byed pa 'dra mtshungs lta bur snang yang / don dngos la mi 'dra ste dbul po rnams ni grod pa ltogs par sdod thabs bral bas khag med pa dang / phyug po rnams ni rgyu nor ji tsam rag na de tsam gyis ham sems je cher gyur nas smyo ba ltar rgyug pa'i dbye ba bstan pa'o/ /216 phyug po gsog 'dod za mi nus/ dbul po 'u thug 310
