las mi byed/ spyi tshogs thog snang tshul 'gal ba can 'di lta bu'ang mthong rgyu yod pa ni ya mtshan med/ 'on kyang so sor rgyu mtshan dmigs bsal can re ldan yod ces pa'o /217 'phya kha nang nas btags na/ mi khar sangs dus med/nang khul nas dma' 'bebs yongs grags su bya mi rung ba ma zad/ de las ldog ste ming grags la srung skyong bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /218 bag ma rta thog nas 'gyur/ bag ma ste mna' ma la zer/ gnyen sgrig pha mas byas te gtan 'khel yang / bster sa de las dbang dang 'byor pa che ba zhig rag na/ kha dan rgyab bskyur gyis 'gyur ldog gtong ba de la yul srol gyi ming sbyar nas lugs mthun yin khul gyi dpe ngan zhig yin/219ོ bu bar pa dang / zhing tha zhing / bu rgan pa gtso che ba dang / bu chung shos gces par 'dzin pa'i srol yod pas bu bar pa la zhing tha zhing ltar mthong chung ba zhig rang shugs kyis yong gi yod par zer/ 2 2 0 bu ma smyo tsam dgos/ bu mo ma skugs tsam dgos/ bu ni ji tsam gyi 'tshub po dang rgod po yod na legs par brtsi ba dang / bu mo ni ji tsam gyi gnyom chung dang kha nyung ba legs par brtsi ba'i dgos 'dun mtshon pa 'di thog nas pho mo 'dra mnyam ma yin pa'i goms sro la ngan pa de mthong thub pa yin/ 2 21 bu rang dga'/ zhing mi'i dga'/ bu phrug ni rang gi 311

bu phrug legs pa mthong ba dang / sa zhing gi lo tog ni gang ltar gzhan gyi lo tog legs pa lta bu mthong ba de ni mi rnams kyi chags sdang gi 'dod phyogs mtshon pa yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /222 bu e bzang brgya sde'i kha/ 'bab ci yod khug ma'i zhabs/ mi yag nyes brtag dus 'brel yod mang tshogs kyi bshad tshul nyan dgos pa dang / bya ba gang bsgrubs par 'bab yong ci 'dra yod pa ni gzhan la 'dri mi dgos par dngul khug gi nang du blta dgos zhes brtag bya mi 'dra bar brtag thabs kyang mi 'dra ba brgyud dgos par bstan pa'o/ /222 bya gdang 'dzegs kyi yar lta med par/ zhi mi skas 'bab kyi mar lta/ kun spyod bzang por mig ltos yar 'dren mi byed par/ ma rabs kyi spyod ngan yod tshad lag len byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/224 bya mang byur gyi sna 'dren/ kha mang gyod kyi g.yab mo/'di ni da cha mi rnams kyi bsam blo 'dem 'ching gi ldog dpe zhig yin par the tshom med mod/ 'on kyang gnas tshul dang cha rkyen nges can zhig gi 'og tu dpyad gzhir bzung na skabs re ya mtshan yang yong srid snyam/225 byams skyong thal ches na/ khong khro rgyun mi 'chad/rang gi bu phrug dang slob ma sogs byams thal shor na gces lang du gyur nas mthar thug srol la mi tshud pa chags te khong khro rgyun mi 'chad pa slong ba'i rgyur 'gro bas chung dus nas gces thal du ma shor ba bya dgos zhes 312

bstan pa'o/ /226 byas na byung na yod na gsum/ de gsum gtam gyi tha ma yin/ 'das zin pa'i bya bar phan med kyi phyir bsam sna tshogs dran gso byas te blo 'gyod byed pa ni las kyi tha ma yin pas bya mi rung zer ba bstan pa'o/ /227 bla ma la mi shi dgos/ dpon po la gyod gzhi dgos/bod rnying par bla ma la mi shi byung na 'bul ba mang po yong ba dang / gyod kha mchu byung na dpon po tshor za rgyu'i lkog rngan chen po rag pa bcas gong rim dang mi mang gi skyid sdug rbad de rgyab 'gal yin pa ther 'don byed pa'i dmangs gtam rno ngar can zhig yin/22rnga blun pos nor na gcig nor/ mkhas pas nor na brgya nor/ spyir na blun pos mi shes pas nor 'khrul mang po yong ba dang /mkhas pas mang du shes pas nor 'khrul mi yong ba'am nyung ngu las mi 'ong bar brtsi mod/ don dngos la nges pa med de gal te blun pos nor na yang kho rang gi bya ba gcig gam chung rtsag tsam yin zhing / gal srid mkhas pas nor na de'i rjes su 'brangs mkhan mang bas nor 'khrul brgya phrag gam/ yang na nor tshabs chen po yong ba yin pas de bas gnod pa che bar bstan pa yin no/ /229 blos phyed ka bkal na phyed ga sgang po bkal na sgang po/ spyi tshogs thog mi dang bya ba gang yin rung / pha rol po'i bsam spyod ngo ma gang yin la bstun nas dgos sar ma chad pa dang / ma 313

dgos sar ma lhag pa'i spyod tshul sgrin po'i blo rig dang ldan pa zhig 'dzin dgos pa las/ legs nyes dang bden rdzun dbye ba ma phye bar gcig mtshungs kyi rnam 'gyur bzung na mi 'grig par gdams pa yin no/ / (gtsang khul ) 2 20 dbang yod pa la jus med/ jus yod pa la dbang med/ spyi tshogs thog dbang cha yod mkhan la shes yon dang 'jon thang med pa dang / cha rgyus dang shes yon 'dzoms pa'i mi la dbang cha med pa'i snang tshul de 'dra nam yin na'ang mthong rgyu yod/ de ni spyi pa'i bya ga'ag lam du mi lhongs pa'i rgyu rkyen gal chen zhig yin par bstan pa'o/ /2 21 'brog pa mi'i bong bu/ ral pa khyi'i gzhu gu bod rnying par byang thang gi 'brog las byed mkhan dka' spyad 'bad 'thab byas te spyi tshogs kyi rgyu nor thon skyed byed pa po tshor khrel med mthong chung dma' 'bebs kyi bshad tshul ngan pa zhig yin/2 22 —1 ma kha bde na/ bu sku skye 'khrungs/ a mas rmi lam dang / ltas rten 'brel mang po byung tshul sogs shod mkhas po byed shes na/ bu de bla ma'i sku skye 'gro ba yin zhes bod kyi bla sprul ngos 'dzin gyi lam srol la mos mthun dang yid ches mi byed pa mtshon par byed pa'i gtam dpe khyad par ba zhig yin/2 22 2 ma nyes pa'i nam mtha' nas gsal yong / rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten re zhig ma nyes khag g.yogs kyi chag sgo 'phrad 314

skabs rang nyid la nyes pa med pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal byed du spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re gnyen grogs kyis sems gso gtong ba la spyod srol yang yod/2 2 2 ma byams pa drin che/ ma zhim pa phog chung / byis pa chung dus gces lang du ma shor ba'i gso skyong bdag gnyer byed stangs de rigs kyi 'bras bu bzang po thon zhes par spyod pa yin zhing / byams po tshad brgal gyis gces lang du gtong ba ni don la drin chung yin zhes ston pa'o/ /2 24 ma med par a ner re dus/ zas zhim pa kha la mi raga.a ma med par mi gzhan la re dgos byung na/ rang gi a ne yin rung /zas zhim po phor pa gang tsam yang kha la rag mi thub ces rang mgo rang thon byed ma thub na mi la re rgyu ni ka med 'u thug yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /2 25 ma 'gyur na blo min/ ma khug na sems min/ mi'i blo dang sems ni/ bem dngos gzhan dang mi 'dra bar phyi yul la brten nas rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ba dang / rang rtogs yong thub pa ni de'i khyad chos yin zhes bstan nas dus las mi yol ba'i ngang rengs por mi 'gyur ba zhig bya dgos pa'i bskul ma gtong ba la spyod pa yin/2 26 ma shes shes khul byed pa mtshang yin/ shes nas khong du sbed na skyon yin/ spyi tshogs thog mi khag cig ma shes shes khul dang /ma yin yin khul byed mkhan yod pa de tsho ni rang mtshang rang gis ston pa zhig yin pa dang / yang mi la la shes kyang khog par sbas nas sdod pa 315

de'ang skyon yin pas de gnyis ka bya mi rung bar bstan pa'o/ /2 27ོ mi skyon gram pa'i rdo 'dra/ rang skyon ri bong rwa 'dra/mi su yin rung mi gzhan gyi skyon cha che chung mang po mthong ba las rang nyid kyi skyon cha chung ngu phar bzhag chen po yang mthong mi thub pa yin pas tshul de rtogs pa byas te rang skyon la zhib bsher mang tsam bya dgos pa shugs la bstan pa'o/ /2 2ra mi go med cig la shod pa las/ las dka' mo gcig la 'bad na dga'/ bslab bya ji tsam byas na'ang drag skyed mi thon pa'i mi la 'u thug nas tha tshig sgrog pa lta bu'i skabs spyod pa'ang thos/ (a mdo khul )2 29 mi rgan rta rgan khyi rgan gsum/ byas pa che yang kun gyis sdang / 'di yang spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul la ma rangs pa'i sdom tshig cig yin zhing / da dung de'i ldog zlar/ ‘6a nyog rte'u khyi chung gsum/byung ba med kyang kun gyise byams ’nyazhes pa'ang brjod srol yod/ (khams khu95 )240 mi rgyu za bar/ lcags kyi 'gram so dgos/ mi gzhan gyi rgyu nor bag med du ham za byed pa ni rtsa ba nas mi 'os par ston pa ste/gal te lcags kyi 'gram so med na pho bar 'ju thub thabs rtsa ba nas med ces sting tshig smra ba'o/ /241ོ mi ngan pa'i dri ma/ shing rlon pa'i du ba/ mi ngan pa'i spyod ngan gyi dri ma ni/ shing rlon pa'i du ba bzhin du kho rang rtsa med ma 316

phyin bar du sangs thabs med ces mi ngan la yid ches mi rung bar gdams pa'o/ /242 mi ngan la bzang bca' ba las/ khyi rgan la lho ster ba dga'/ mi ngan pa la phan btags na phan lan gnod pas 'jal ba mang bar brten/ de las khyi rgan la lto zhig bster na mjug ma ril ril byed pas de dga' zhes mi ngan la 'brel ba byed mi rung bar bstan pa'o/ /242 mi 'jam pos 'dul/ rang rtsub pos 'dul/ mi gzhan la bstun thabs kyi mthun po yong ba bya dgos pa dang / rang nyid la nan po byas te dka' spyad sdug 'khur thub pa'i sbyong brdar bya dgos zhes pa 'di 'jig rten lugs kyi bslab bya don snying ldan pa zhig go244 mi nyan pa la gros ma 'debs/ mi 'jon pa la las ma skul/ mi so so'i shes yon dang 'jon thang gi tshad las brgal ba'i las ka sprad na/ byed pa po ngal ba ma zad bya ba yang yag po sgrub mi thub zhes pa lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / bshad nas mi nyan mkhan la spyad kyang chog245 mi rnying pa dga'/ gos gsar pa dga'/ mi ni 'dris shing cha rgyus yod pa'i rnying pa rang legs pa dang / gos ni gsar pa yang zhing dro la bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa yin zhes bstan nas/gtso bo rgyus med kyi mi la gsar 'grogs bya rgyur dga' po byed mi rung ba dang / 'dris pa'i mi la gzhung dang phyi thag bya dgos pa ni bod mi 317

rigs kyi goms gshis kun spyod yin par gdams pa'o/ /246 mi ltogs kyi khog par me 'bar na/ rgyal po'i khrims la bag mi tsha/ mi ser dbul po rnams lto chas bza' rgyu med par gyur na/ yul der rkun ma dang jag pa sogs rgyal khrims las 'gal ba'i bya ngan thon nges yin pa de ni g.yol thabs med pa'i ngan 'bras shig yin zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin/247 mi dang mi 'dra na/ mi g.yog sus rgyug 'di ni gtso bo bod rnying par bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rim mang lam lugs kyi dril bsgrags kyi thon dngos shig yin rung / phyogs gzhan zhig nas tshan rig dang thon skyed kyi lag rtsal sogs byang tshad mi 'dra bar yong 'bab kyang de bzhin he bag je cher 'gro ba'i don dngos dang sbyar na rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig yin no/ /248 mi dang zhing la/ skye khungs dgos/ 'di ni b.las bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rigs rgyud mchog dman smra ba'i bshad tshul zhig yin zhing / 'on kyang khyim tshang gi mig ltos goms srol dang / pha ma'i kun spyod kyi bslab bya sogs legs nyes las byis pa rnams kyi bsam spyod la shugs rkyen chen po thebs nges pa de ni dngos yod do/ /249 mi bden pa mi brin/ khram pa brin/ spyi tshogs kyi sro'/ lugs bzang po 'chol ba'i dus skabs su 'di ltar 'byung ba yin mod/'on kyang 'phral sel gyi dgos pa tsam la bltas nas tha shal gyi spyod tshul rigs nam yang 'dzin mi rung zhes gdams pa'o/ /318

250 mi 'dra 'dra yod na dgod kha slong / zog 'dra 'dra yod na kha mchu slong / mi gdong dbyibs dang gzugs stobs sogs ha cang 'dra ba gnyis mthong na tshang ma gad mo shor ba'i rgyur 'gro ba dang /sgo phyugs gzugs stobs dang spu kha ha cang 'dra ba gnyis yod na/gcig brlag gtor sogs byung dus bdag po gnyis kha mchu slong ba'i rgyur 'gro ba yin zhes zer ba yin/ ('brog khul )251 mi 'dris na skyon mthong / phyugs 'dris na dri zhim/mi 'grogs yun ring na phan tshun gyi skyon mtshang bsngogs nas gnod pa skyel res byed pa de ni/ dud 'gro las kyang zhan pa'i kun spyod ngan pa zhig yin par ston pa yin/ 'on kyang tshang ma de 'dra ma yin pa ni ru mi rnying pa dga' ’ zer ba sogs kyi gtam dpe gzhan mang po las mtshon pa ltar spyi tshogs thog mi mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa'i 'tsho ba dngos gson nyams ldan pa bstan pa'o/ /252 mi rnam rtog can la/ 'dre rgya 'khor/ gza' tshes skar ma sogs dang / rtags rten 'brel/ lha 'dre phan gnod sogs la dogs pa dang rnam rtog mang po byed mkhan la/ sems dogs rjes 'brel gyi ltas dang 'dre sogs tshang ma 'khor yong ba yin pas blo dogs mang po bya mi rung zer ba la spyod pa yin/252 mi mang gi kha de dug mi mang gi lag de gser/ mi mang por lto ster dgos byung na 'dang tshod kyis mi 'dang bar 'gro sgo chen po yin pa dang / mi mang po'i lag pa bsgul na bya gzhag rin thang 319

can bskrun thub par bstan zhing / yang la las mi mang gi kha ni gcig gyur yong mi thub la/ gleng phyogs mi 'dra ba mang po thon pa der zer ba yin zhes 'grel mkhan yang thos/2 54 mi 'u thug nas lha la dris/ lha 'u thug nas rdzun bshad/bod rnying par bya ba che phra gang ci mi khog tu lha zhugs par lung bstan zhu srol yod/ lung bstan zer ba 'ol tshod kyis bshad stabs don dang mthun dka' bar mi rnams kyis zur za byed pa'i ther 'don zhig yin/255 mi yi khra khra khog kha yod/ zog gi khra khra phyi la yod/phyugs zog gi spu kha khra khra ji ltar yin pa phyi la yod pas mig gis mthong thub na yang / mi yi bsam tshul bzang ngan ci 'dra yin pa de khog nang du yod pas mig gis mthong mi thub ces mi'i phyi'i rnam 'gyur dang kha mkhas tshig snyan tsam la yid rton mi rung bar lag len ngo ma brgyud nas shes rtogs bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /256 mi rig na sgang la bud/ mi shes na rgan la dris/ mig gis mthong mi thub na mtho sar 'dzegs nas ltos/ don gnas rang gis ma shes na rgan rabs rgyus ldan tsho la skad cha dris zhes pa ste rang bsam bden rloms ma byas par shes ldan gzhan la 'dri dgos par gdams pa yin/ (a mdo khul )257 mi la ngo tsha med na khyi yin/ khyi la rnga ma med na 'dre yin/ mi la ngo tsha rgyu med na mi'i mtshan nyid ma tshang bas khyi la ma gtogs brtsi rgyu med ces pa gtso bo'i brjod don yin zhing / gal te 320

khyi de la rnga ma mi 'dug zer na de ni gdug 'dre yin zhes khyi las kyang 'bod par smad pa yin no/ /2 58 mi la nyog spyor/ phyugs la mug spyor/ mi la zas gshom skabs lto chas phon chen po dus gcig tu sbyar ba na mi rnams zhe kha log ste mang po za mi thub/ phyugs rigs la lto ster skabs nyung zad tsam byin pa na mnga' ma ngoms par za 'dod med pa chags 'gro ba yin zhes bstan nas don la ldog pa ste mi zas nyung tsam sten dgos pa dang /phyugs zas ni mang tsam ster dgos zer/2 59 mi la gnod pa'i gtam spongs/ rang la gnod pa'i zas spongs/ rang gi lus la gnod pa'i zas nges par spong dgos pa dper bzhag ste/ mi gzhan gyi sems la gnod pa'i skad cha ni do snang chen po'i sgo nas spong ba ste ci nas kyang shod mi rung zhes 'doms pa'o/ /260 mi la mi khud 'bum 'gyur/ lcags dang ko bar brgyad cu ldab/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rim mang lam lugs kyi dril bsgrags su spyod pa zhig yin zhing / lcags dang ko ba gnyis zad tshad ni ko ba brgyad cu zad pa'i tshad la lcags gcig zad pa'i khyad par brtsi thub na'ang / mi dang mi'i bar khyad ni brjod kyis mi lang ba yod zer ro/ / 261 mi la 'phya gsum 'phya ba la/ rang la 'dzoms gsum 'dzoms pa dgos/ mi gzhan la 'di ma 'grig de mi legs zer ba sogs smad bshad mang po byed mkhan la de ltar mi byed par 'doms ched/321

dang thog rang so sor skyon de dang 'di sogs yod med la zhib bsher bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'am/ yang na gzhan gyis 'phya bar thad kur lan du spyod pa'ang yod/262 mi sems 'jin na khab dang skud pa/ mi sems gsod na chig ka skam po/ mi'i sems kyi tshor ba ni ha cang rno ba yin pas/dngos po phra mo khab skud g.yar ba tsam gyis phan btags na'ang sems 'gug nus pa yin zhing / de bzhin rnam 'gyur ngan pa'i tshig ka skam po tsam gyis kyang mi sems rbad de gsod thub ces bstan nas/ mi la mthun sbyor gyi 'grogs thabs shes pa bya rgyu de gal chen po yin par bstan pa'o/ /262 mi'i ri mo nang / stag gi ri mo phyi/ mi'i rigs ni srog chags gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar nang gi blo rig dang / snying stobs sogs la phyir mi mngon pa'i khyad par chen po yod/ der brten phyi tshul kho nar blta mi rung bar rtog dpyod zhib mor byed dgos pa las/gya tshom gyi spyod tshul 'dzin mi 'os par bstan pa'o/ /264 mig ltos ngan pas/ rgyal khams brlag spyi tshogs kyi sgrig srol dang / bde 'jags/ yar rgyas sogs la gnod pa'i spyod ngan gyi rigs rgya yan du khyab bcug na/ mtha' 'bras rang gzhan yongs kyi bde rtsa la chag sgo chen po yong nges yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/265 mig ldan kun gyis sngun rig mkhas pa yin na gzhug 322

rig mdun du yod pa'am/ sngon la byung zin pa'i bya dngos ni mi tshang mas mthong thub pa yin pas de shes pa sla yang / mjug 'bras bzang ngan ji yong thog ma nas shes thub pa de ni dngos 'brel mkhas pa yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /266 mis bshad tshad kyi gtam la ma nyan/ rta gang mthong gi rgyab la ma zhon/ rna bar thos tshad kyi skad char yid ches bya mi rung ba dang / mig gis mthong tshad kyi bya ba lag tu mi len par bsam gzhigs dang / brtag dpyad nan po bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /267 mo ngan gyi kha dang / pho ngan gyi lag khyim tshang gi rtsod gzhi phal che ba khyim bdag mo'i kha nas tshig ngan thal ba dang / khyim bdag gis lag pa btegs pa las byung ba zhes bza' mi pho mo so sos kha dang lag pa 'degs rgyur sngon 'gog byed dgos par gdams pa'o/ /26rnga dmag dang ser ba rgyang grags che/ dmag 'khrug dang /ser ba babs pa sogs kyi gnas tshul de rgyang ring sar 'ur grags chen po yong na yang / sa gnas de rang du de tsam gyi tshabs che ba rang byung med ces mdor na thag ring gi sbir grags de don dngos la de nang bzhin yin pa'i nges pa med par bstan pa'o/ /269 dman sa bzung na mtho sar slebs/ mtho snyeg 'dod na dma' sar lhung / 'jig rten gyi bya ba ni mi so so'i 'dod don ltar mi 'grub pa ma zad/ ldog phyogs su 'gyur ba mang po yod ces bstan nas mi su yin rung mtho 'dod kyi ham sems bya rgyu med par rang nyid 323

rang rtogs yod pa zhig bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /270 dmyal ba ma mthong na/ sangs rgyas la yid mi ches/sdug bsngal drag po zhig dngos su ma myong na/ bde skyid chen po la yid ches skye mi srid ces pa lta bur spyod par snang zhing / tshig zin las dmyal ba dang sangs rgyas zhes pa rnams dngos su ma mthong na yid mi ches zer bar yang spyod pa yin/271 rma 'og tu gtam shi/ ro 'og tu rma shi/ bod rnying pa'i khrims srol zhig ste/ mi gcig gis gcig brdungs te rma bzos na/rdung mkhan la bden pa yod kyang brtsi med dang / rgyag res btang nas mi gcig bsad na/ gsod mkhan phyogs la rmas skyon ji tsam phog na'ang brtsi med yin zhes pa'o/ /272 skyon pa'i snang ba dgung las mtho/ 'phung rgan byed rgyu gzhan las mang / spyi tshogs thog mi 'os mi 'tsham pa'i snang tshul bzlog tu med pa 'di dang 'di 'dra ba mang po yod ces bstan nas mi rnams la tshang mas rang rtogs kyis do snang bya dgos par gdams pa'o/ /272 gtso a pha che yang / gzhis a ma gtso/ bod rnying par pho mchog mo dman gyi lta ba shugs che tsam yod kyang / khyim tshang nang gi bya gzhag rnams a mas gtso bo byed pa mang bas/ phyi don pa pha dang /nang gi don rnams a mar brten dgos par bstan pa'o/ / 274 btsan po'i gnya' shing / nyam chung gi pha ma/ khrims dang dpon po sogs la ngo bstod byed skabs spyod pa'am/ yang na de 324

gnyis kyi mtshan nyid shod skabs su spyod pa yin/275 btsan rang chod bzung na mtha' brtan/ blo rgan la dris na phugs brtan/ bya ba gang la'ang tshod 'dzin mkhas pa dang /blo 'dri gros bsdur sogs bab lhing brtan gsum 'dzom dgos par gdams pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )276 rtsod pa rgyag par khog pa yangs dgos/ gyod gzhi sogs thug skabs blo chung nga rgyal gyi kha lan tshig rtsub sogs smra ba mang drags na skyon du 'gyur bas/ blo rgya chen pos phar phyogs nas gang bshad rnams legs par nyan nas 'phral phugs kyi dge skyon rnams bsam gzhigs nan tan byas te dgos nges kyi lan gnad du phigs pa rgyag dgos par gdams pa'o/ /277 che gang skyid mi 'dod na/ chung ma nyis 'dzin 'tshol/chung ma che chung gnyis mnyam du bsten na dus nam yang skyid pa'i go skabs mi yong bas de lta bu rang sdug rang nyo'i bya ba byed mi rung zhes ldog phyogs nas bstan pa'o/ /27ra ches bcu re la ra re bsad/ zangs mdog dpal ri ra ros bskyangs/ tshes bcur ming btags nas sems can srog gcod kyis za rgyag spyod gsum byed mkhan la ther 'don byed pa ste chos dang chos min dbye ba 'byed shes dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /279 tshong nyes 'dod na/ mi rgyag kha nas mi thon/ tshong nyes shor dus khe gyong rtsis gzhi legs par ma bskor bar tshong zho langs 325

nas kha nas gang thon la rgyag rkyang byed mkhan yod ces tshong rgyag par nges par du khe bzang yod pa zhig bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /280 tshong dang bla ma gang bzang / tshong rgyag dus rin gong sus mtho ba sprad kyang de la tshong ba dang / bla ma bsten dus bla ma gang zhig bzang ba yod rung de la bsten rkyang byed pa de gnyis la tshad gzhi gzhan gang yang med ces bstan pa'o/ /281 tshong slog tshong gi bzhi zur/ bod rnying par tshong brgyab zin nas dngos zog sprod len sogs tshar rjes phyogs gcig gis tshong slog rogs zhes bshad na/ tshong zog rin gnad kyi bzhi zur gcig slog rogs zer mkhan gyis gyong 'khur te phan tshun so so'i tshong zog sngar ma ltar phyir slog byed srol yod pas de ltar grags/282 'dzing mo thengs gsum brgyab na/ shag po snying 'dra chags/ 'khrug 'dzing blo thag chod pa thengs kha shas byas pa'i nang du phan tshun blo mos byung ba'i grogs po de ni snying gcig lta bu chags thub ces bstan pa'o/ / ('brog khul )282 'dzum mer mer/ pags pa'i 'then phyogs/ mi gzhan gyis kha yag ngo yag ston pa kho nar yid ches bya rgyu med/ lag len dang bsam tshul ngo ma rtogs pa bya rgyu de gal chen po yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/2rnga4 'dzoms na skyid theg pa/ dbul na sdug theg pa/skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung na'ang bzod thub pa zhig bya dgos pa las 326

cung zad tsam gyis rang gshis 'gyur mi 'gro ba gcig bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ / 285 rtsa che ba/ dpon gyi yon tan/ bod rnying par bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dpon po rnams la shes yon dang / 'jon than gang yang med stabs cha rgyus med pa'i mi'i sar skad cha mang po mi shod pa dang / rnam 'gyur gsal po mi ston pa sogs spam rdzu gang che bya rgyu de gal chen po yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /286 zhag gsum ar po rgyag par/ lo gsum bsam blo gtong dgos/ ar las ni phugs kyi yun gnas bya gzhag cig yin pas las 'go ma btsugs gong nas/ khang pa'i phyi dbyibs dang nang gi bkod pa gang sar dus yun ring po'i nang bsam gzhigs yang bskor bskyar bskor byas te ar po brgyab zin pa'i blo 'gyod mi yong ba zhig bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /287 zhe ma mthun na/ chig mi mthun/ nang blo sems kyi zhen phyogs ma mthun na/ gcig mthun gyi skad cha zhig yong mi srid ces bstan pa'o/ (a mdo khul )2ra8 za ran dus khrung khrung ske ring skyong / las ran dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku/ mi la la bza' rgyu gang yod kho nar rtsod cing bsher rgyag pa dang / las ka yod na g.yol thabs sam yang na bsgul bskyod tsam mi byed mkhan de rigs la zur za dang ther 'don byed pa'o/ /289 za rogs ngan pas/ 'phya rogs byed/ za dus 327

mnyam du zos kyang / zos tshar nas de mi zhim dang 'di ma 'grig ces 'phya ba'am/ lkog za mnyam du byas nas ther 'don byed pa lta bu sogs la 'jug pa yin/290 za e lo sna/— rgyan e lo mig bya ba gang yang ma byas gong nas bsam gzhigs dang brtag dpyad legs par bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyad na'ang 'grig(mdo khams khul )291 zas chen zos pa'i gcong can/ mi gzhan gyi lag nas rgyu rngan chen po zos tshar ba'i rjes su mi des khrims med lugs med ji ltar byas na'ang / rang nyid kyis lkog rngan zos par brten kha grag mi thub par mthong yang ma mthong ba lta bur mi 'jog ka med byed mkhan de rigs la spyod pa yin/292 zas thog 'khel na kham gang zo/ las thog 'khel na khyem gang las/ yul srol ltar za ma za sar slebs na za mi dgos rung kham gang za tshul byed dgos pa dang / las ka byed sar slebs na las rogs mi dgos kyang sa sbyag ma kha shas dbyugs dgos zhes yul mi khyim mtshes 'cham mthun gyi kun spyod la brtsi srung nan po bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )292 zas zhim po lto thengs gcig gtam mi kha bskal pa stong / mi gzhan gyi bslu brid dbang du gyur na bza' rgyu phran bu zhig gis zhabs 'dren mi rabs nas mi rabs bar mi dag pa zhig bzos yong zer ba lta bur spyod par snang zhing / mdor na ltogs sla tsha po dang /328

kha snyan tshig snyan la dga' po byed mi nyan zhes pa'i don yin/294 zas mi lag bzhag na je nyung / gtam mi kha brgyud na je mang / zas mi lag tu bzhag na tshang mas kha re bro ba blta bas je nyung du 'gro na yang / gtam mi gzhan gyi kha brgyud na tshig snon rgyag gan rgyag gin je mang du 'gro ba yin zhes bstan nas/ bshad dgos don med pa'i skad cha su la'ang shod mi rung ba de gtso bor ston pa yin no/ /295 zas bza' tshang 'tshogs na tshar/ gtam bza' gros byas na lus/ zas khyim mi 'dzoms ma thag zos tshar 'gro ba yin rung /gtam bza' mi mnyam gros byas na phan tshun de min 'di yin zhes shod bde yod stabs ji tsam bshad tshe de tsam gyi phyogs 'gal du gyur nas thag chod mi thub ces bstan nas/ don chen yod na nye ba rgan rabs dang mnyam du gros bsdur byas na legs zhes pa lta bu'o/ / (a mdo khul )296 zas slong na ya rabs mi la slongs/ ya rabs mi de zas rtsis chung / mi gzhan la re dgos na pha rol gyi bsam spyod dang bstun nas re ba bcol dgos pa las/ gnad du ma 'khel na rang nyid kha skyengs dgos pa zhig ma gtogs mi yong bas brtag dgos par bstan pa yin/ (a mdo khul )297 zas la ngo yod pas byin/ nor la dgra yod pas sba/zas za dus nye 'khor na mi gang yod bos nas byin dang rang la ngo so yong ba yin/ 'on kyang rgyu nor rtsa chen gyi rigs la dgra yod pas gzhan la 329

mi ston par gsang dgos zhes bstan nas bya dngos gang la'ang rang rang gi khyad chos dang bstun shes dgos pa las tshang ma gcig pa ltar bya mi rung bar bstan pa'o/ /29ra zin dka' ba de chod yin/ theg dka' ba de skyid yin/ 'di ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi spyir btang gi mtshan nyid tsam bstan nas spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong dang / kun spyod kyi blo sbyong 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi zhig yin/ gtso bo ni bya ba gang la'ang rang tshod rang gis bzung dgos par gdams pa'o/ /299 gzu pa gral sgrig sa/ gyod pa ngo bsher sa/ bden rdzun gyi rnam dbye 'byed sa 'di 'dra bar skad cha yin la ma yin dang /snga tshig phyi 'gal sogs shod sa min zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )200 gzu pa ra rtsag can gyis bshad pa de/ gyod pa gos ser can gyis bshig mi chog 'dum pa nyam chung zhig gis bshad pa'i gtam yin na'ang / gyod ya 'byor ldan yin rung / rgyab 'gal byed mi chog ces pa ste gzu'am 'dum byas pa'i don gnad ni khrims dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin par ston pa'o/ / ('brog khul )201 bzang po dma' babs 'dod na/ ngan pa'i kha ya gyis/rang nyid spyi tshogs thog gi cha mthong dang mtshan snyan brlag 'dod na/mi ma rabs can gyi kha ya byas te tshig rtsod dang 'dzing mo gyis zhes don la mi tha shal la ya lan 'degs mi rung bar gdams pa'o/ /330

202 bzang po ming can min yang / ngan pa rtags can zhig ma yin/ rang nyid spyi chogs thog cha 'jog dang thob thang mi dman tsam yod ces nga/ lta bur spyod pa yin/20 2 bzang pos las byed sar/ ngan pas ltad mo lta/tshul ldan gyi mi rnams spyi phan gyi las ka byed sar/ tshul min gyi mi rnams pag mgos lag mgo bzung nas ltad mo blta zhes mi bzang ngan gyi dbye ba spyi yi bya bar rnam 'gyur 'dzin stangs las 'byed thub par bstan nga/'o/ / 204 bzang lan 'jal bar lo zla/ ngan lan slog par zhogs gang / bzang por bzang lan 'jal thub pa ni ha cang gi dka' mo yin na yang / ngan par ngan lan slog rgyu ni las sla po yin zhes don rṣa/ bya ba bzang po ni bsgrub dala' ba dang / ngan pa ni bde blag gis bsgrub thub pa yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /205 bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu mang na dga'/ lab rgya gleng rgyu nyung na dga'/ tshis zin ltar go sla zhing / rnam kun nas grogs po mang tsam sgrig pa dang / don med kyi skad cha mang po mi shod pa/ lhag pa ra mi sa/'an la phog thug mi gtong ba sogs spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod bzang po lag len dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ / 206 bza' las gal ta mgo 'brel/ bza' rgyu ma gtogs 2 sa rgyur bsam gzhigs ma byas na mi 'grig de gnyis ni kha bral thabs/ med pa zhig yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin331

207 bzo pa thig la ma 'jems/ thig gis bzo pa mi bslu/thig rgyag dus las rnyog ji ltar che yang ngal dub la 'dzems mi nyan/thig tshad yang dag pa byung na bzo las de legs 'grub yong nges yin pa ltar/ bya ba gzhan la yang thog ma'i 'char gzhi'am jus 'god byed dus ca sun la ma 'dzems pa tan tig byas na mtha' 'bras legs po yong nges zer ba lta bur sbyar yang chog208 ya rabs khog pa yangs/ ma rabs sems pa nagaya rabs ma rabs gnyis kyi bsam blo'i khyad chos bshad pa ste/ mi rnams la khog yangs dkyil che bya dgos pa dang / sems ngan rtsa ba nas bya mi nyan par gdams pa'o/ /(a mdo khul )209 ya rabs ma rabs ma shes na/ skyid sdug snga lag 'jal dus stos/ ya rabs dang ma rabs kyi spyod pa'i khyad par ni skyid sdug snga lag 'jal stangs la brtags na gsal po shes thub ces mi rnams la drin lan 'jal dus ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba zhig las/ zhan pa bya mi rung zhes gdams pa'o/ /(a mdo khul )210 ya rabs phyag dang zhe sa mkhas/ ma rabs gnyid dang grod pa che/ spyod pa'i khyad par las ya rabs dang ma rabs brtag par bshad de mi rnams gus srol bkur sti sogs spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod bzang po rnams la sbyang goms bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /211 ya rabs ngo tshas 'phung / ma rabs ham pas 'phung /'phung stangs mi 'dra ba gnyis bshad de/ dgos nges kyi skabs su ngo tsha 332

che drags pa bya rgyu med pa dang / ham pa ni dus dang rnam pa kun tu de bas bya mi rung bar bstan pa'o/ /212 yang na hob ste bltas pas shes/ yang na zhag gsum gshib pas shes/ mi'i rang gshis rtogs thabs bshad pa ste/ tshang ma gcig ltar ma yin pas gnas lugs dang bstun nas brtag zhib bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /212 yul chu 'thung nas/ yul khrims 'khur dgos/ rgyal khab bam srid 'dzin sa khongs sogs gang du gtogs na yang / sa de ga'i yul srol spyi khrims gang yod pa rnams srung brtsi zhu dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/214 yod pa'i thog la gsog 'dod/ med pa'i thog la gtor 'dod/ 'byor pa ni ji tsam rgyas na de tsam gyis spel 'dod je cher 'gro ba dang / phongs pa ni gsog rum gyi re ba med pas gang byung de 'phral longs su spyod pa'i goms ngan zhig yod/ de gnyis ka don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i bsam spyor yin zhes smad pa'o/ /21 / yod por sdug bsngal brgya/ med por sdug bsngal gcig rgyu nor mang po yod mkhan la gsog nyar dang spel thabs sogs sdug bsngal ha cang mang po yod cing / dbul po la ni med pa'i sdug bsngal gcig rang yin zer ba de ni chos lugs kyi bshad tshul dang 'brel ba zhis yin la/ zhib tu bsam na rgyu mtshan cung zad yod snyam/216 rang skal rdo yin yang mur/ rang nyid la 'khri ba'i las 333

'gan nam/ skal ba de dka' tshegs dang ngal dub ji tsam che na yang 'bad brtson ldab 'gyur gyis legs sgrub bya rgyu yin zhes pa lta bur spyod pa'o/ /217 rang skyon sbar mos bkab/ gzhan skyon sen mos 'khru/rang gi skyon cha 'gebs g.yol kho na byed pa dang / mi gzhan gyi skyon bsngog 'tshol bya rgyur dga' mkhan gyi mi de 'dra ni/ tha shal smad 'os kyi ma rabs shig yin par bstan pa'o/ /218 rang skyon ri tsam bzhag gzhan skyon shig tsam bshad/spyir na mi phal che bar rang skyon mi mthong bar gzhan skyon mthong sla ba'i phyogs ris shig yod kyang / ched mngags go ldog 'di ltar byed pa ni ha cang ma rabs tha shal gyi spyod ngan yin par bstan pa'o/ /219 rang kha sbar mos khe/ bas kyang / mi /tsā phyar bas mi khebs/ bya ba gang 'ig yin rung / gsang thabs byed pa ni rtsa ba nas yong thabs med pa zhis yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/22 0 rang mabo sbar mos mi khebs par/ gzhan mgo 'don rgyu phar tshad/ mi de 'dra bar re ba bco'/ na bya ba gang la'ang 'bras bu 'thob mi thub zer ba lta bur spyod cing / skabs re khyod rang gi kha tshul de las med par mi ga'am la skyabs rosas bya rgyu ni gang mo slong ba zhig yin zhes thad kur spyod mkhan yang yod/ 221 rang rgyu sman dang / mi rgyu dug rang gi rgyu nor chud zos su mi gtong ba bdag gces legs par byed dgos pa dang / mi 334

gzhan gyi rgyu nor khab skud tsam yang ham len bed spyod rtsa ba nas byed mi nyan pa de gnyis sman dang / dug ltar blta dgos zhes mi'i kun spyod kyi gnad che sa zhig gsal por bstan pa'o/ /222 rang rgyud la dpe blangs nas/ gzhan rgyud la bsam shes gyis/ bya ba gang zhig yin rung / rang la byung na ji ltar 'gyur bsam blo btang thog gzhi nas de la gzhigs te gzhan gyi bde sdug la bsam gzhigs byed thub na spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod dang mthun pa zhig 'ong bar gdams pa'o/ /222 rang thag rang gis chod kyang / dpon thag g.yog gis mi chod/ dpon g.yog gi khyad par la spyod pa ma zad/ rgyal khab kyi gzhung don nam/ thun mong gi spyi don la spyad kyang chog la/ skabs re byed 'dod med pa'i khag 'dogs la spyod mkhan yang yod/224 rang med bzo bar rogs mi dgos/ rang srog gcod par gri mi dgos/ rang gis rang brlag par byed pa ni/ bya ba thams cad kyi nang nas sgrub sla shos shig yin par gzhan gyi rogs ram sogs 'tshol mi dgos zhes ldog phyogs nas dpe dang bcas bstan te rang gis rang gcun rgyu 'di ni 'jig rten gyi bya ba legs sgrub yong ba'i rmang gzhi yin par gdams pa'o/ /225 rang tshod mi zin/ gzhan tshod 'dzin rgyu/ kho rang gi tshod kyang kho rang gis bzung mi thub pa la/ mi gzhan la tshod 'dzin byed rogs bya rgyu zer ba ni gad mo slong ba zhig red ces pa lta bur spyod 335

pa'o/ /226 rang yul rgyab tu skyur/ mi yul pang du blangs/ sngon chad sdug bsngal chen po myangs pa'i tshul bgrang ba'am/ yang na spyi don la dka' ngal mang po spyad pa'i yus bgrang ba lta bu'i skabs spyod pa yin/227 rang rang gtsang / mi mi gtsang / 'di ni kha dang zhwa gos lham gsum sogs mi gzhan dang ma 'dres pa bya dgos par gdams pa yin zhing / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi skye khungs mtho dman dang rigs rus gtsang btsog sogs smra bar dgag pa rgyag pa'i zur za zhig yin pa ma zad/ deng rabs 'phrod bsten gyi blang bya tshan rig dang mthun pa zhig kyang yin snyam mo/ /228 rang la blo yod na/ mi la mig yod/ rang so sor blo dang jus yod par rloms mkhan tshor/ mi gzhan la yin min blta byed kyi mig gsal po ji snyed cig yod pa de brjed mi rung zhes nan po'i sgo nas gdams pa'o/ /229 rang lus la gces dgos/ rang sems la dpyad dgos/ mis rang gi gzugs po bde thang rgyun 'khyongs yong ba'i don du gces spras bya dgos shing / 'on kyang rang gi sems la dran tshad yang dag pa gtan nas ma yin pas nges par du sgam nan gyi thog nas dpyad pa yang yang byas te brdar sha gcod dgos par gdams pa'o/ /220 rang lus la bltas nas/ gzhan lus la bshad pa rgyobs/ thog mar rang nyid la tshur bltas thog gzhi nas mi gzhan gyi 336

gnas lugs shod dgos zhes pa 'di ni spyi tshogs kun spyod kyi blo sbyong phan nus ldan pa zhig go /221nga ri mtho na kha ba dbyar yang 'bab/ klung dma' na ljang pa dgun yang skye/ phyi rol yul gyi dngos po'i cha rkyen ni ha cang chen po yin/ khor yug gi mthun rkyen 'dzoms na 'jig rten du yongs grags kyi gnas lugs las brgal ba'i don gnad ngo mtshar can gang yang sgrub srid par bstan pa 'di ni dmangs khrod kyi dngos gtso'i lta ba bab chags pa zhig yin no/ /222 rig pa dwangs na/ ngo tshul nag kyang nag nang shes rig gi me long dwangs gsal ldan na/ phyi ngo tshul nag pa ste gzhan gyi snang ngor mi mdzes kyang skyon med ces phyi tshul las nang rig gal che bar ston pa'o/ /222 re che sa nas/ bslus pa/ re ba chen po bcol sa nas bslus pa ste phan ma thogs zer ba yin zhing / rang phyogs la ltos na blo pham pa dang / kha gtad phyogs la ltos na snying tshims pa'i rnam 'gyur lta bu tshig grogs dang shod gdangs kyi thog nas mngon pa'ang yod/224 rogs dad can de/ rogs kyis 'phung / pho mo mdza' grogs kho nar dga' ba'i mi de mdza' grogs kyis 'phung la sbyor ba'am/ mdza' grogs kyi don du 'phung ba mang zhes mdza' grogs 'ba' zhig la zhen chags che drags bya rgyu med par gdams pa yin no/ /225 lam nor ldog shes/ bya ba 'phyugs pa'am/ nor 337

'khrul chen po shor mkhan gyi mis nor 'khrul ngos zin nas/ phyin chad de rigs rtsa ba nas mi byed pa'i sdom sems la zer ba yin zhing / byed dgos dang / bya rgyu yin/ bya rgyu yod na zhes pa sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs bsgyur chog pa gzhan rnams 'dra/226 las ka thams cad lad mo yin/ lad mo'i nang nas su mkhas yin/ spyi tshogs kyi las ka tshang ma spyir na gzhan gyi byed stangs la bltas nas de ltar bslab shes sbyang brtson byed pa brgyud byang tshad su bzang bsdur ba yin zhes bya ba gang yin rung / slob sbyong byed mkhas po dgos par bstan pa'o/ /227 las drags nas shi ba med/ dal drags nas rul ba mang / mi rnams rang nus la dpags pa'i sgul yang las brtson bya dgos pa las/ sgyid lug sos dal kho nar dus tshod chud zos su btang na rang lus bde thang la'ang gnod pa chen po yod par bstan pa'o/ /228 las byas dang ma byas/ rjes la ltos/ bya ba gang yin yang kha bde pos byas byas byung byung la blta rgyu med par dngos su bsgrubs zin pa'i las rjes la bltas nas gtan 'khel bya rgyu de gal chen po yin par gdams pa'o/ /229 las tshan shig la/ bza' sgo sro ma/ bod rnying par dbang sgyur pa'i 'og gi las byed chung rtsag tshos kyang / rang rang gi ming thob la dpags pa'i mi ser gyi lag nas za bed 'phrog len byed pa de ni lugs mthun yin par brtsi ba'i srol ngan de mtshon pa yin no/ /338

240 las la byas yus che na/ ngo so chung / bya ba gang sgrub na'ang byas lus bgrang mi rung bar bstan zhing / mi la las bya ba phran brtseg tsam bsgrubs par dka' ngal che tshul mang po shod dus dngos su gong dpe drangs nas skyon brjod byed mkhan yang yod do/ /241 legs pa brgya la skor phyogs/ nyes pa brgya la zlog thabs/ 'gal rkyen sel thabs sam/ mthun rkyen sgrub thabs sogs gang zhig gnang 'os yod na yang / khyed rang nas gnang rogs gnang zhes pa lta bur spyod pa'i yid ches blos 'gel gyi rnam pa mtshon pa zhig yin/242 lo brgya lon pa'i mi dkon yang / lo khri song ba'i gtam bsdad yod/ mi'i tshe tshad ni ring po ma yin rung / mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rim gyi gtam rgyud kyi dus yun ha cang ring po'i gong nas rim bzhin bzhag yod ces lo rgyus la shes rtogs bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /242 lo nyes lo gcig gtam ngan che gcig lo nyes sam tshong nyes sogs dpal 'byor thog gi gyong gun ni thengs gcig tsam las/rtag par jus nyes mi srid cing / spyi tshogs thog yongs su grags pa'i gtam ngan ni mi tshe hril po gcig la dag thabs med ces bstan nas rgyu nor khe phan gyi don du kun spyod bzang po blos gtong ba'i rigs gtan nas bya mi nyan zhes gdams pa'o/ /244 long ba mthong rgyargod/ 'on pa thos rgya che/ de ni rang 339

gis mthong ma thub pa dang / thos ma thub par brten ci 'dra yin nam snyam pa'i bsam blor shes 'dod chen po zhig yod par brten 'dri rgya chen po gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa'i rkyen gyis yin/ dpe 'di ltar grags pa ni 'jig rten na go ldog pa'i gnas lugs mang po yod ces bstan pa'o/ /245 sha tsha'i kha na/ gtam snyan med/ skad cha nyan dus rang 'dod dang mthun min la bsam blo gtong rgyu med par/ go don de bzhin lag len bstar na rang la phugs yul phan gnod ji yong de gtso bor bzung dgos par bstan pa'o/ /246 sha shor gyi sha lan dang / rgyu shor gyi ra mda'/ bod sil bu kha thor gyi dus gcig gyur gyi khrims srol med pa'i skabs mi bsad na dgra sha len pa dang / rgyu nor 'phrogs na ra mda' jag lan slog pa bcas kyi yul srol 'di nye rabs bar 'brog pa'i sa khul mang por lugs mthun lta bur brtsi ba'i srol rgyun las lhag pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/ ('brog khul )247 shi bar ma gtogs/ tshod lta gyis/ shi ba la tshod lta byas na lang rgyu mi yong bas de phud/ spyi tshogs kyi bya ba gang la'ang dang thog chung sa nas che sa dang / dma' rim nas mtho rim/ sla ba nas dka' ba bcas kyi bar rim pa bzhin tshod lta bya dgos zhes bskul ba 'di las bod rigs la bya ba gsar gtod bya rgyu'i snying stobs sngar nas ldan pa gsal bshad byed kyi yod/340

248 sa gar song zer na 'dir song / las ci byas zer na 'di byas/ bya ba gang la'ang mthar thug gi 'bras bu zhig yod dgos pa las/ de med na stong zad yin zhes ston pa'o/ /(khams khul )249 sa dog mo sde pa'i gnas sa/ sbra ma 'bub zer na btsan gtam/ spyi pa'i sa char lugs mthun gyi 'tsho gnas byed mi chog zer ba ni btsan gtam ya med rang yin zhes sting tshig brjod pa go sla/(a mdo )250 sa ma 'brog las skyid pa med/ ngo ma g.yog las sdug pa med/ sa ma 'brog ni zhing 'brog las kyi thon rdzas gnyis ka 'dzoms pas gnas yul de las skyid pa med pa dang / ngo ma g.yog ni ngo ma 'dra ba'i thob thang med la g.yog po lta bu'i gla cha'ang len rgyu med pa ma zad/las gar g.yo zol yang byed sa med pa bcas de las thabs rdugs pa ma mchis zhes bstan pa'o/ /251 sems dkar gyi zas dang / yid mug gi gtam/dga' po skyid po'i skabs su za res 'thung res dang / sdug po skyo po'i dus snying gtam shod res byed sa zhes phan tshun blo dkar dam gtsang yin lugs mtshon par byed pa la spyod pa snang /252 sems dkar gyi zas la che chung med/ mi dga' ba'i gtam la mang nyung med/ spyi tshogs thog bza' 'thung gi 'brel ba de che chung la ma bltos par rgya gang che byas na mthun sbyor la phan pa dang / mi la phog thug gtong ba'i skad cha'i rigs mang nyung la ma bltos par shod 341

mi rung zhes legs par gdams pa'o/ /252 sems ngan mi la byas na/ bya ngan rang la 'khor/'di ni chos lugs kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sgo nas bshad pa zhig yin zhing /des spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod thad la phan nus bzang po thon gyi yod/254 sems chung la chag sgo mang / ham chen la bza' sgo mang / 'di ni spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod dang / lam srol je ngan du gyur te dkar nag phyin ci log pa'i ngan 'bras bzo ba des slar yang spyi tshogs kyi dar srol de bas je sdug tu 'gro bar yi ma rang ba mtshon pa'o/ /255 ser sna can gyis bsags pa de/ ham pa can gyis za ba mang / 'di yang spyi tshogs thog mthong rgyu yod pa'i snang tshul ya nga ba zhig yin pa bstan nas rang nyid ma shi gong la rgyu nor rnams spyi phan gyi bya bzang la sman pa byas na legs zhes zhen bskul mtshon pa'o/ /256 ོ ser sna can la spun mi 'khor/ g.yo sgyu can la grogs mi rag rgyu nor kho na ma gtogs bsam rgyu med pa'i mi nam zhig spun gnyen nye rnams kyang zhe 'khrel nas 'brel ba mi byed pa dang / g.yo khram gyis dus 'da' ba'i mi la grogs po rnams kyang zhe log nas g.yol 'gro ba zhes bstan nas rgyu nor la skam chags che drags pa dang / khram g.yo sgyus mi mgo bskor ba'i rigs bya mi rung bar gdams pa'o/ /257 sems pas slebs sar/ lus pos ma slebs/ 'di ni spyir na lo na rgas shing dbang po rgud pa rnams kyis gzhon dus dang bsdur nas spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re rang rang gi nus pas lcogs 342

tshod las/ bsam blo don dngos dang mi mtshams pa'i rigs gtong rgyu med ces zhen bskul byed pa la'ang spyod pa thos/25ra gsung mkhas pas gsung na/ gang nas gsung gsung /phyag mnyen pos gnang na/ rdzakrog sked pa ldem ldem/ spyi tshogs kyi bya ba gang la'ang de nyid byang chub pa zhig yin na/ mi rnams la yin min dang bzang ngan sogs ga phyi slog na yang mi tshor ba'i 'khrul snang ster thub pa'i sgyu rtsal ldan yod ces ston pa'o/ /259 gso skyong pha mas byas kyang / lus srog dpon la bdagabod rnying par zhing bran rnams la rang lus rang dbang med pa'i ra sprod gtam dpe ngar lcags lta bu zhig yin/260 bsad na che/ brdung na chung / ji ltar bshad na'ang kha la mi nyan mkhan ngan pa lang shor gyi mi lta bu la spyod pa yin/261 bsam ngan gyis ma ṇi 'don pa las/ bsam bzang gi nyi ma lde na dga'/ phyi tshul gyi dge ba sgrub khul byed mkhan don dge sems med pa'i mi la zur za byed par spyod pa zhig yin/262 bsam ngan mi la byas na/ spyor rtsub rang la 'khor/'di'ang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rgyu 'bras skor nas bshad pa zhig yin zhing / mi la bsam ngan bya mi rung zhes tha tshig sgrog pa lta bur spyod pa yitsha/262 bsam blo sngon la 'khor na mkhas pa/ 'gyod pa rjes la skye ba glen pa/ bya ba gang zhig kyang ma brtsams gong nas rjes yong 343

sngon dran gyi bsam gzhigs legs par bya rgyu de gal ha cang chen po yin zhes gdams pa'o/ /264 bslab bya brgya las/ sna bsun gcig lhag kha la mi nyan pa'i mi la bslab bya yang yang byas pa las/ sna gug thengs gcig brdabs pa de phan thogs che ba yong gi yod ces sdom tshig bzhag pa yin no/ /265 lha sku chung dka'/ yi ge che dka'/ lha'i sku bzo rgyu ji tsam chung na de tsam gyis bzo dka' ba dang / yig gzugs 'bri skabs ji tsam che na de tsam gyis dka' ba yod ces bstan nas bya ba so so'i khyad chos dang bstun nas dka' khyad 'byed dgos par bstan/266 a mas bu mo ma byas pa dang / bu mos a ma mi byed pa med/ a ma dang / bu mo gnyis thad nas rang sar mi bzhag gi bsam shes bya dgos pa bstan nas bu mos a mar brtsi bkur dang / a mas bu mor byams skyong bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /344

le tshan lngapa/ tshig rkangagacigargas donadang tshig rkang gcigargasadape bstan nasadaperdan zungadu sbrel bas brjod bya'i don snyingagasal bar ston pa'igatamadabe'i gras/1 bka' shog go ma chod de rgyal po'i phyag bu mo go ma chod de pha ma'i go dpe bu mo mna' ma go log na pha ma'i khyim du log pa bzhin du/ don brtsi go mi chod pa'i bka' shog de rgyal po rang gi phyag tu phyir slog 'bul rgyu zhes dpe don sbyar te kha gtad phyogs kyis bka' shog la rtsis 'gro gtong gi mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang zhing /skabs re dpe don go ldog nas mna' ma ma 'grig na pha ma rang gis rtsis len dgos zer ba la spyod mkhan yang yod/2 chung pho hreng la chu mi rag mi pho hreng la ja mi rag dpe rkyang pho hreng ni rkyang khyu la dgra yong dogs bya ra byed par sa mtho sar rgyug 'gro bas chu mi rag pa de bzhin du/ don mi pho hreng la nang las byed mkhan med pas ja rag mi thub ces dpe don sbyar te na tshod la babs na gnyen sgrig gis khyim gzhi 'dzugs dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /2 skad cha nyung rung mgo rnga tshang / lung pa chung yang rtswa chu 345

'dzoms/ dpe lung pa chung yang rtswa chu 'dzoms pa bzhin du/ don skad cha nyung rung mgo mjug yongs su tshang ba zhes dpe don sbyar nas/ nga tshos skad cha 'od skabs tshig nyog mang po mi shod pa ra mgo mjug tshang la mdo kha dril ba zhig shod dgos par bstan pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )4 skad cha mang na 'chal 'gro/ skud pa ring na chad 'gro /dpe sku da pa ring drags na 'chad sla ba bzhin du/ don skad cha bshad rgyu mang drags na 'chal nas don snying brlag 'gro ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar te skad cha dgos med mang po bshad mi rung bar bstan pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )5 skad cha bsam nas bshad dgos/ rtsam pa lngad nas za dgos/ dpe rtsam pa za dus ldan nas za dgos pa bzhin du/ don gal 'gangs che ba'i skad cha shod dus kyang bsam blo legs par btang nas shod dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te bsam gzhigs ma byas par byung rgyal du skad cha bshad mi rung bar gdams pa'o/ /6 skyid kyis sdug nyos/ mar gyis chil nyos/ dpe mar phar sprad nas tshil tshur nyos pa bzhin du/ don skyid po phar g.yugs nas sdug po tshur nyos pa zhes dpe don sbyar te mi la la ched mngags rang sdug rang nyo byed pa/ la spyod pa'ang yod/7 skyes pho rab cig la blo zhig rta byang ma zhig la rgyug cigadape rta byang ma zhig la rgyug rgyu gzhan las lhag pa zhig yod pa de bzhin du/don mi pho rab cig la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i blo gros shig yod ces dpe 346

don sbyar nas blo 'dzin pho rab cig la 'dri dgos par bstan pa'o/ /8 bskos pa'i las la bros pas thar sa med/ thod pa'i gnyer ma phyis nas dag thabs med/ dpe thod pa'i gnyer ris phyis nas dag thabs med pa de bzhin du/ don tshe rabs snga ma nas byas bsags kyi 'bras bu gang zhig bskos pa'i las la bros pas thar sa gtan nas med ces dpe don sbyar te chos lugs nas bshad pa'i las rgyu 'bras la bslu ba med zer ba ston pa yin no/ /9 kha kha rog bsdad na kha mchu med/ mgo rum la bcug na lhags pa med/ dpe mgo btum brgyab na lhags pa med pa bzhin du/kha rog bsdad na kha mchu yong don med ces dpe don sbyar te/ don med kyi skad cha gang byung shod mi nyan zhes gdams pa'o/ /10 kha bzang bshad nas phan mi thogs/ dar ba 'thung nas skom mi sod/ dpe dar ba 'thung nas kha skom pa sel mi thub pa de bzhin du/ don kha mkhas tshig bzang bshad pa tsam gyis phan mi thogs zhes dpe don sbyar nas mkhas po snyan po bshad nas dus tshod 'bud mkhan la yid ches dang re stong bcangs mi nyan zhes bstan pa'o/ /11ོ kha shor na phyir 'then byed thabs med/ lam nor na phyir log byed sa yod/ dpe lam nor na phyir log byed sa yod kyang /don kha nas tshig thal shor na de phyir 'then byed thabs med ces bstan nas skad cha shod skabs bag med lhod g.yeng gtan nas bya mi nyan zhes gdams pa'o/ /347

12 kha sangs na go bde/ nam gsal na 'gro bde/ da pe nam langs na rgyus med kyi lam ci 'dra zhig yin rung 'gro bde ba bzhin du/ sems nang gi gnad don gang yod pa de kha sangs nas bshad na/go ba lon bde la dka' gnad thag gcod byed sla zhes gdams pa'o/ /12 khyi ngan bkag na mi khogs/ mi ngan bzung na mi thub/ma byed ma rgyag ces dge skyon go gsed byas kyang mi nyan par ngar ngar rbad rbad byed mkhan sogs de rigs la spyod pa'i sting tshig nan po zhig go14 khyi bdag pos khog pa/ mgron gnas pos 'chun pa/dpe khyi bdag po rang gis 'gog dgos pa bzhin du/ don mgron po gnas po rang gis 'chun pa zhig dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas 'grul pas khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod spel nas bros pa'am/ gyod gzhi bzos na gnas tshang gi bdag pos brtsad 'tshol lam/ yang na 'gan 'khri gang yod 'khur dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/15 khyed kyis ma mthong shes bya mang / bong bus ma phyin lam 'phrang mang / dpe bong bus 'gro ma myong ba'i lam kha da dung yod pa de bzhin du/ don khyed kyis ma shes pa'i shes bya de bas mang po yod ces dpe don sbyar te thos chung rang rloms can tshor zur za byed par spyod pa yin no/ /16 khra chung mig la rdul/ dam pa'i chos la rdzun/ dpe khra chung mig la rdul 'gro sa med pa bzhin du/ don dam pa'i chos la rdzun 'gro sa med ces dpe don sbyar nas tshul chos mkhan la zur za byed par 348

spyod pa'o/ /17 khrims thig shing gnyis de drang dgos/ rgyan ri mo gnyis de mdzes dgos/ dngos po so sor nges par ldan dgos pa'i mtshan nyid re yod de dper na rgyan dang ri mo yin phyin nges par mdzes po dgos pa bzhin du/ don khrims dang thig shing gnyis de nges par du drang po zhig dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te gtso bo khrims zhes pa de'i mtshan nyid ni mtha' gcig tu drang po dgos pa de rang yin/ gal srid de dang mi ldan na khrims ma yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang /18 khrims sa'i chig dang / gong ba'i khab/ gong bar 'dzer ba'i khab bzhin du/ khrims sar bshad pa'i tshig de bor brlag 'gro sa med ces dpe don sbyar nas khungs skyel ra sprod dgos zer bar spyod pa yin/19 khrel phyi thag ring ba'i grogs po dkon/ khe drang por shod pa'i chong pa dkon/ dpe ma gnad 'di tsam dang khe bzang 'di tsam byung zhes drang por shod mkhan gyi tshong pa shin tu dkon pa de bzhin du/ khrel dang phyi thag ring por brtsi ba'i nam yang mi bslu mkhan gyi grogs po yang ha cang dkon po yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas su la'ang yid rton che drags pa bya mi rung bar bstan pa'o/ /20 gal po che la nan tan/ dam pa'i chos la brgya tshar/dpe chos lugs kyi gzungs sngags dang cho ga sogs la brgya tshar dang stong tshar sogs dgos pa de bzhin du/ don gal che'i rigs la sla bcos ma 349

yin par gzab nan tan tig gi yang bskor bskyar bskor bya dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te gdams pa'o/ /21 gos gong ba med na bzo 'phro/ chig rnga ma med na bshad 'phro/ dpe gos la gong ba med na bzo 'phro yin pa bzhin du/ skad cha la tshig mjug med na bshad 'phror brtsi ba los yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas skad cha shod skabs nges par du tshig mjug cha tshang ba zhig yong ba bya dgos zhes bstan pa'o/ /(a mdo khul )22 gyod kyi sdong po/ rnag gi 'thum bu/ dpe zug gzer gyi 'byung gzhi rnag gi 'thum bu la thug pa de bzhin du/ don gyod kyi sdong po'am rtsa ba gang la thug yod pa brtsad gcod dgos zer ba'am/ yang na 'di la thug yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ ('brog khul )22 za byas dug 'ju/ grwa pas dkor 'ju/ dpe rma byas dug zos kyang 'ju nas mi gnod pa bzhin du/ don grwa pa rnams kyis dkor te dad ldan gyis bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i dngos rdzas rnams 'ju thub ces grwa pas dkor za ba de 'os pa yin tshul gya tshom du smra ba'am/yang na grwa pa 'di tsho dkor ji tsam zos kyang rgyags rgyu mi 'dug ces ldog nas zur za byed pa'i dpe don sbyar ba'o/ /24 gri rno med lag la gzan/ gtam don med rna bar gzan/ dpe rno po med pa'i gri de lag par gzan pa bzhin du/ don dgos med phan pa ma mchis pa'i skad cha mang po de mi'i rna bar gzhan las gzan pa yod ces dpe don sbyar nas/ rgyu mtshan dang dgos don 350

med pa'i gtam nyog gi rigs 'di nam yang shod rgyu med ces bstan pa'o/ /25 dga' po 'khon srid/ zhim po skyug srid/ dpe zas zhim po ci 'dra zhig yin rung zos drags na skyugs srid pa bzhin du/don phan tshun dga' po byed pa'ang dga' tshod ma zin na nam zhig 'khon pa'ang yong srid ces spyir 'jig rten gyi bya bar nges brtan med pa'i dpe don sbyar te/ gtso bo gang dang gang yin rung tshad las brgal na ldog phyogs su 'gyur 'gro ba'i bya dngos kyi chos nyid bstan pa'o/ /26 dge bshes lags dang rtsod pa/ ka ba lags dang rdung gdape khang pa'i ka bar rdung ga rgyag pa bzhin du/ don dge bshes lags te rtog ge smra ba dang rtsod pa rgyag pa de ni pham kha 'phel rgyu las med ces dpe don sbyar nas mi kha bde po dang mnyam du don med kyi gtam la rtsod 'then bya mi rung zhes gdams pa'o/ /27 dgra kha gshom che na 'grig 'dod/ 'brug 'ur sgra che na than rtags/ dpe dbyar dus 'brug sgra drag po sgrog pa de gnam dwangs nas than pa ston pa'i rtags mtshan yin pa bzhin du/ don dgra phyogs nas 'phyar rgyag gi 'bor shog chen po byed pa de yang snying 'dum 'grig byed 'dod kyi rtags yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas dgra bo'i 'ur gshom byed par skrag mi rung bar bstan pa'o/ /('brog khul )28 mgar ba rang gi ral gris bsad/ pha ma rang gi bu yis mnar/ dpe mgar ba rang gis bzos pa'i ral gris rang bsad pa 351

bzhin du/ don pha ma rang gis gsos pa'i bu phrug gis rang nyid sdug bsngal myong du 'jug mkhan yod ces dpe don sbyar nas/ pha mas bu phrug gso skyong dang sbyong brdar bya rgyu byams sdang mtha' gnyis su ma lhung bar ran par skyong dgos zhes bstan pa'o/ /29 'grul pa dgong slebs sdod pa'i rtags/ kha ba zhogs babs 'gro ba'i rtags/ dpe 'grul pa dgong dro slebs na do nub yul der zhag pa byas te sdod pa'i rtags gsal po bstan pa de bzhin du/don zhogs pa kha ba 'bab pa de ni sprin pa 'gro ba ste nam mkha' dang ba'i snga ltas yin zhes sa mtho'i gnam gshis 'gyur tshul gyi nyams myong brjod pa yin no/ /20 rgan pas gang byed gzhon pas byed/ gla ba'i phru gus brag la 'dzegs/ dpe gla ba'i phru gus brag la 'dzegs pa bzhin du/rgan pa4ji ltar byed pa de bzhin gzhon pa tshos byed pa yin zhes bstan nas/ rgan rabs tshos kun spyod bzang po rgyun 'khyongs byas te mi rabs rjes ma tshor mig dpe 'jog rgyu de spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod dar 'phel yong ba'i 'gag rtsa zhig yin par bstan pa'o/ /21 rgya la 'gro bar rgyu dgos/ rgyu ma skyong bar khrag dgos/dpe bza' bya'i phyugs kyi rgyu ma sgyong ba la khrag dgos pa bzhin du/don rgya gar rgya nag sogs thag ring yul gru chen por 'gro ba la rgyu nor dgos pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas spyi tshogs thog bya ba gang zhig byed na yang / de gtso bor dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen la brten dgos par 352

bstan pa'o/ /22 rgyalakha blon pos sgyur/ rta kha srab kyis sgrur/ dpe rta'i kha lo srab kyis sgyur ba de bzhin du/ don rgyal po'i kha lo yang blon pos sgyur gyin yod ces dpe don sbyar te rgyal po 'dod yon la g.yengs nas gnas lugs ci yang mi shes par brten/ skabs dang bstun nas blon pos rang 'dod ltar rgyal srid kyi dbang cha 'dzin pa yin par bstan pa'o/ /22 rgyal khams pho phyed mo phyed/ lung pa rtsa phyed chu phyed/ dpe lung pa gang sar rtsa kha dang chu phran phyed 'dres yin pa bzhin du/don rgyal khams te spyi tshogs thog skyes pa dang bud med phyed 'dres yin zhes dpe sbyar nas/ dga' rogs gnyen ya gang nas gdam na'ang rnyed thub pa yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/24 rgyal po chags par 'bangs/ bya chags par shing /dpe shing sdong med na bya rigs chags sa brten sa med pa bzhin du/don chab 'bangs med na rgyal po chags sa med ces dpe don sbyar te rgyal pos nges par 'bangs kyi 'tsho skyong la bsam gzhigs bya rgyu ni/rang nyid chags 'jig la thug pa'i gnad don zhig yin par bstan pa'o/ /25 ོ rgyal po chags pa'i rten dang / the rang 'khor ba'i yos/'dir bshad pa'i rgyal po ni dregs pa sde brgyad kyi gras lha 'dre'i nang gi rgyal po zer bar go dgos/ dpe the'u rang zer ba'i 'dre de 'khor 353

ba la yos khra ste nas 'bru sreg ma gtor dgos pa bzhin du/ rgyal btsan chags pa la rten mkhar dgos pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar zhing /skabs re mi ser rnams gnas dgos na sa zhing sgo phyugs sogs med thabs med zer ba lta bu la'ang spyod srol yod do/ /26 rgyal po'i bka' khrims nor gyis bshig sgom chen phyag rgya shig gis bshig dpe sgom chen sgom rgyag pa'i lus kyi phyag rgya de shig gis zos nas bshig pa bzhin du/ don rgyal po'i bka' khrims ji ltar btsan na'ang rgyu nor lkog rngan gyis bshig mi thub pa med ces dpe don sbyar nas/ spyi tshogs lam lugs ci 'dra zhig la'ang rgyu rngan la mgo mi sgur ba'i khrims dpon zhig mthong dkon par bstan pa'o/ /27 rgyal po'i bka' dang ri gzar rbab/ dpe ri gzar po'i ngos las thur du 'gril ba'i rbab rdo bzhin du/ don rgyal po'i bka' yang phab zin pa'i rjes su bden rdzun nam don dngos dang mthun mi mthun la ma bltos par rgyu mtshan bshad de bka' 'gog byed sa med ces ha cang btsan po yin pa'i don sbyar ba'o/ /28 rgyu 'bab sa rgyal po'i bang mjod/ chu 'bab sa lung pa'i sum mdo/ dpe ri g.yas g.yon gyi chu phran thams cad 'bab sa de lung pa'i sum mdor yin pa de bzhin du/ don mi ser gyi rgyu nor thams cad mtha' ma'i 'bab sa de rgyal po'i bang mdzod kyi nang du yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas bstan pa'o/ /29 rgyu med gshom la dga'/ da dig bshad la dga'/354

dpe ngag da dig can gyi mi de skad cha bshad rgyur dga' ba de bzhin du/don rgyu nor med pa'i mi de rgyas gshom bya rgyur dga' po yod ces dpe sbyar nas/ rang gi dpal 'byor dang mi 'tshams pa'i gshom ra bya mi nyan zhes gdams pa'o/ /40 rgyu ma rlon pa gris mi chod/ le lo can gyi las mi tshar/dpe nor phyugs kyi rgyu ma rlon pa gri yis mi chod pa de dang 'dra bar/don mi le lo can gyi las ka la tshar ba'i dus med ces dpe don sbyar te/bya las gang yin rung dus thog legs sgrub byed dgos par bstan pa'o/ /41 sgog par thug na sgog dri 'jags/ ngan par 'grogs na spyod ngan 'go dpe sgog pa la reg na sgog dri rang bzhin gyis 'jags pa bzhin du/ don skye bo ngan pa dang 'grogs na de'i spyod tshul ngan pa rnams ched du ma bslabs kyang shugs kyis 'go ba yin pas grogs po ngan pa rgyang ring du spong dgos par gdams pa'o/ /42 ngan pas rang bstod/ rul mas bu bstod/ dpe a ma rang shed can gyis rang gi bu la ngo bstod byed pa de bzhin du/ don mi ngan gyis rang gis rang la bstod pa byed pa zhes dpe don sbyar nas de dag ni ngo tsha med pa'i rang gshis yin pas/ mi rnams zhe nas khrel dgos pa zhig yin par bstan te gang dang gang la'ang khengs skyungs bag yod kyi spyod tshul skyong dgos par bstan pa'o/ /(mdo khams khul )42 ngan pas rang bstod/ kha tas sgro bstod/ dpe bya kha 355

tas rang gi sgro la bstod pa de bzhin du rang gis ra la bstod pa byed pa ni skye bo ngan pa'i rang rtags phyir mngon pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas/mi gzhan la bkur sti gus zhabs kyi kun spyod 'dzin dgos par ldog nas ston pa 'di las bod rigs kyi goms gshis mtshon pa yin/44 bcad pa'i sdong po skye mi thub pa dang / mnan pa'i dgra bo langs mi thub pa zhig dpe bcad zin pa'i shing sdong po de nam yang skye mi thub pa zhig bzo dgos pa de bzhin du/ don mar mnan zin pa'i dgra bo de dus gtan du yar langs mi thub pa zhig bzo dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te/ lan gcig pham par byas pa'i dgra bo de gal srid yar langs pa yin na rang nyid la 'khon lan drag po zhig slog nges yin zhes gdams pa'o/ /45 chang lan chu mjal/ bzang lan ngan 'jal/ dpe chang gi lan chu yis 'jal ba bzhin du/ don phar la bzang po byas pa'i lan la tshur ngan gnod bskyal ba zhes dpe don sbyar nas tha shal gyi spyod tshul de lta bu nam yang mi bya bar gdams pa yin zhing / yang skabs re phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa byas byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la dpe nyis rtseg gi tshul du spyad na'ang 'grig go /46 char sne rlung khrid/ dgra sne gnyen khrid/ dpe char gyi sna rlung gis khrid pa bzhin du/ don dgra bo'i sna gnyen gyis khrid pa zhes dpe don sbyar nas de ni gzhan las thabs rdugs pa zhig dang / snying na ba zhig yin par bstan pa'o/ /356

47 chu rka nang du mi tshud pa dang / mi khrims 'og tu mi 'dus pa/ dpe chu rka'i nang du mi tshud pa med pa de bzhin du/ don mi su yin na'ang khrims lugs kyi 'og tu mi 'dus pa med ces dpe don sbyar te/ khrims lugs ni spyi tshogs bde 'jags su 'god pa'i thabs mchog bla na ma mchis pa zhig yin par brten/ che btsan ci 'dra zhig yin na'ang de las rtsa ba nas 'gal du 'jug mi rung bar bstan pa'o/ /48 chu mgo chad pa'i rdzing bu/ dpung rogs med pa'i dpa' bo/ dpe chu rgyun 'bab sa'i chu 'go chad zin pa'i rdzing bu bzhin du/don rgyab phyogs nas dpung rogs yong mkhan med pa'i dpa' bo zhes dpe don sbyar te/ de rigs ni pham nyes yong rgyu nyag cig las bzlog thabs med par bstan pa'o/ / (mdo khams khul )49 chu chen po brgal dus ngo tsha med/ gtam chen po lab dus ngo tsha med/ dpe chu chen po brgal ba'i skabs su de snga ched bzos mdoms ras sogs med rkyen mi tshang ma gos yongs rdzogs phud de brgal bar ngo tsha mi byed pa de bzhin du/ don gal 'gangs che ba'i skad cha'i rigs shod dus ngo tsha dang / 'dzem gzon sogs bya rgyu med par gnas lugs kha gsal shod dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te/ ngo tshalam 'dzem bya la'ang tshad gzhi yod par bstan pa'o/ /50 chu drod 'jam gyis sha mi chos/ gtam nyag nyog gis don mi go dpe chu drod 'jam nang sha btsos na dmar log thebs nas ji tsam btsos na yang sha yag po mi tshos pa bzhin du/ don gtam 357

kha gsal med pa'i nya ge nyog ge ji tsam bshad kyang go dgos nges kyi don dag gsal po go mi thub ces dpe don sbyar te/ bya ba gang yin rung skad cha gsal po go don 'phrod pa zhig shod dgos par bstan pa'o/ /51 chu ma shor gong nas rags/ rkyen ma byung gong nas zlog pa/ dpe chu ma shor ba'i snga rol nas chu rags rgyag dgos pa de bzhin du/ don bya ba gang yin yang rkyen ma lhags gong nas bzlog thabs bya rgyu gang yod bya dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te/ ma byung sngon 'gog gi bya thabs spyod rgyu ni gal 'gangs ha cang che ba zhig yin par bstan pa'o/ /52 chos med kyang bla ma'i tshul/ spu med kyang pags pa'i tshul/ dpe spu med na'ang pags pa yin khul byed pa bzhin du/ chos med na'ang bla ma'i tshul bzung ba zhes dpe don sbyar te/ rang nyid la cha rkyen de lta bu med kyang ming chen po zhig 'khur dgos byung zer ba lta bu khengs skyungs la spyod pa mang zhing / yang skabs re kho la de 'dra'i cha rkyen med na yang ming stong tsam khur ba yin zhes 'phya dmod lta bur spyad kyang chog52 ja tshwa med dang / gtam don med/ dpe ja la tshwa med na bro ba med pa bzhin du/ gtam don med la snying po ci yang ma mchis zhes dpe don sbyar te/ don dag med pa'i skad cha shod pa ni rang gzhan gnyis kya'i dus tshod chud zos kyi rgyu las/ dge mtshan ci yang med par bstan pa'o/ / 54 'ja' gar zug la nyi ma/ bu gar song la mna' ma/358

dpe 'ja' gang du zug sa der nyi 'od yod pa bzhin du/ don bu gang du song yang sa de gar mna' ma yod ces dpe don sbyar ba ste/ pho khyo ga gar bskyod sar chung ma 'tshol ba de lugs mthun lta bur bshad pa 'di las lam lugs rnying pa'i pho mo 'dra mnyam ma yin pa'i bsam blo'i shugs rkyen mtshon pa yin no/ /55 nyam chung chig gis nus mi thon/ dbul po'i nor la rin mi khug dpe dbul po'i rgyu nor la ri nges kyi gong mi rag pa bzhin du/ don mi nyam chung gi tshig la bden pa'i don snying yod na'ang nus pa ci yang thon mi thub ces dpe don sbyar te/ spyi tshogs thog dbang dang rgyu nor med na bya ba gang zhig kyang 'grub mi thub par bstan pa'o/ /56 nyi ma rgas khar dro/ mi che gas khar skyid/ dpe nyi ma nub ri brgal khar dro ba bzhin du/ don mi tshe rgas pa'i skabs su skyid pa zhig dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas/ pha ma tshos dka' sdug du ma spyad de bu tsha rnams gso skyong byas pa yin pas lo na mtho por slebs dus dal skyid du gnas thub pa zhig bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /57 nyi ma shar na mun pa 'gro/ bden pa bdar na rdzun pa gsal/ dpe nyi ma thar na mun pa rang bzhin du sangs 'gro ba ltar/don bden pa'i bden khungs ra sprod byas na rdzun ma gsal por ther 'don byed thub ces dpe don sbyar nas/ rang la bden pa yod phyin bden don rnams mthar phyin pa gsal bshad bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ / (khamaca khul )359

58 nyin brgya thub pa'i me tog med/ phyi thag ring ba'i grogs po dkon/ dpe nyi ma brgya'i ring la bzhad nas sdod pa'i me tog med pa bzhin du/ don tshe gang ring mdza' gcugs 'gyur med kyi gzhung phyi thag ring ba'i grogs po dkon zhes dpe don sbyar te/'grogs 'dris byas pa'i grogs po yin phyin skyid sdug khe nyen ji ltar 'phrad na'ang 'gyur ba med pa'i grogs po dam pa zhig bya dgos par bstan pa 'di ni bod rigs kyi kun spyod gal chen zhig yin/59 gnyom chung byas nas dgra ngo mi lon/ med mug bshad nas 'grul ngo mi lon/ dpe gnyom chung sems chung byas nas dgra bo'i ngo len byed mi thub pa bzhin du/ don med rabs dang mu ge byung tshul sogs bshad nas 'grul pa'i ngo ya lon mi thub pa dpe don sbyar te/rtag par gnyom chung dang sdug skad kho na brgyab kyang don 'grub mi srid pas skabs dang bstun shes pa gal che bar bstan pa'o/ /60 gtam kha nas shor/ rdza lag nas shor/ dpe rdza ma lag nas shor na chag thor 'gro rgyu las skyob thabs med pa de bzhin du/don gsang dgos pa'i gtam kha nas shor ba'i rjes tshur bsdu thabs med ces dpe don sbyar te/ skad cha shod dus shod 'os dang mi 'os bsam zhib bya dgos pa las/ thos tshad gang dran bshad na rjes su 'gyod kyang bzlog thabs med par bstan pa'o/ /61 gtam go ba log pas rgyal khams 'khrug zas go re skam pos mid pa dbral/ dpe bag sreg skam po za nyes na mid pa dbral ba 360

bzhin du/ don skad cha go log thebs nyes kyis rgyal khab 'khrug gzhi'i ngan 'bras bzo ba zhes dpe don sbyar te/ skad cha nyan bshad gang gi skabs su'ang go ba ma log pa zhig yong thabs nges par du nan tan bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /(a mdo khul )62 gtam gyi mgo ma ku re/ chos kyi mgo ma skyabs 'gro/dpe chos kyi 'go 'dzugs de skyabs 'gro nas byed pa bzhin du/ don gtam gyi 'go 'dzugs skabs kyang kha mtshar bzhad gad thag ge ba zhig yong ba byas na/ phan tshun blo bag phebs shing sems sgo yangs por bye ste brjod don gang zhig bshad dgos na'ang gros mol bde blag ngang lhug por byed thub par bstan pa'o/ /(a mdo khul )62 gtam brgya bshad kyi snying po don/ zho brgya dkrog gi snying po mar/ dpe zho thengs brgya phrag dkrog pa'i dgos pa mar 'don rgyu de kho na yin pa de ba zhin du/ skad cha brgya bshad stong bshad kyi snying po dgos don go bar bya rgyu de yin zhes dpe don sbyar te/ don med kyi gtam 'chal mi shod par gang bshad de don go chod pa zhig shod dgos par bstan pa'o/ /('brog khul )64 gtam don can zhib tu nyan na mtshar/ gos bkrag can rgyang nas bltas na dga'/ dpe tshig zin ltar go sla zhing / mdor na dbang po lnga'i spyod yul tha dad par rang rang gi khyad chos dang byed las mi 'dra ba yod par bstan cing / 'dir don gtso bo gtam rgyu mtshan ldan pa de rna bas nyan pa kho na tsam gyis mi chog par bsam zhib legs 361

par bgyis na/ gzhi nas ngo mtshar can gyi don snying rtogs thub par bstan pa'o/ /65 gtam bden rdzun dpyad na shes/ lug cho rjid reg na shes/ dpe lug rgyags lod lag pas reg na gsal por shes pa bzhin du/ don skad cha bden pa yin rdzun ma yin de brtag dpyad zhib nan byas na shes thub ces dpe don sbyar te/ bden rdzun dbye ba 'byed skabs don dngos la brtag dpyad zhib 'jug bya rgyu de ha cang gal che bar bstan pa'o/ /(a mdo khul )66 gtam mi'i mdun la shod/ mchon dgra'i mdun la 'phyar/ dpe don tshig zin ltar go sla ba bzhin ldog nas bsam na/skad cha mi'i rgyab ngos su shod pa ni mtshon cha dgra bo'i rgyab tu 'phyar ba ji bzhin ngo tsha la zhe khrel ba'i tha shal gyi spyod tshul zhig yin pas/ de ltar ci nas kyang bya mi rung bar bstan pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )67 gtam shod sar kha bde dgos/ dgra 'thab sar lag myur dgos/ dpe dgra bo dang 'thab sar lag pa myur dgos pa bzhin du/ don skad cha shod sar kha bde po byed thub pa dgos zhes dpe done sbyar te/ ldog phyogs nas skad cha shod mi dgos sar kha bde po bya rgyu med par shugs la bstan pa'o/ /68 rta kha srab kyis sgyur/ mi sems gtam gyis sgyur/ dpe rta'i kha lo srab kyis sgyur nus pa de bzhin du/ mi rnams kyi sems kyang gtam gyis sgyur 'gro ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar te/ dril bsgrags dang /36 2

spyi tshogs kyi gleng phyogs sogs mdor na skad cha shod phyogs kyis mi'i sems khams la 'gyur ldog gtong ba'i nus pa chen po ldan yod par bstan pa'o/ /69 rta sga 'og tu mi 'dus pa/ mi khrims 'og tu mi tshud pa/dpe rta ci 'dra zhig yin rung sga 'og tu mi 'dus pa med pa bzhin du/don mi su zhig yin na'ang khrims lugs kyi 'og tu mi tshud pa med ces dpe don spyor ba mang / 'on kyang skabs re mi khrims 'og tu mi tshud pa zhig 'dug ces tshig bsgyur gyis spyod pa yang yod do/ /70 rta chung la bzhon bde/ mi chung la bskul bde/ dpe rta gzugs chung la bzhon bde po yod pa bzhin du/ mi nyam chung las 7 bskul bde po byed kyin 'dug ces dpe don sbyar te/ mi gzhan gyis mthong chung dang rtag par brnyas bcos byed pa 'khur 'dod med pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig shugs la mtshon par spyod pa'o/ /71 rta thar sar sga thar/ dpon thar sar g.yog thar/dpe rta gang du 'gro sar rta sga yang mnyam du slebs pa bzhin du/dpon po gang du phebs sar g.yog po yang mnyam du thar dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te bod rnying par dpon po tsho ni g.yog po dang kha 'bral thabs med na yang / skabs re dpon po rnams 'dod yon longs spyod byed sar g.yog po tshor spyod skal med par ma rangs pa'i 'phya dmod byed pa mtshon/72 rta sha shed rgyas dus 'tshong dgos/ mi snyanagrags che 36 3

dus gzab dgos/ dpe rta shed mo yag dus 'tshong dgos pa bzhin du/mi snyan grags che ba'i skabs su gang sar gzab gzab bya dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te/ ming grags thang che dus khengs dregs lhod g.yeng gi bsam tshulang 'chang ba ni nyen kha ha cang chen po yin pas rig pa sgrim nas dogs gzon lhod med bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /72 rta har mas srab kha mi len/ dman dred mos kha ta mi nyan/ dpe rta rgod kyis srab kha mi len pa bzhin du/ 'dzem 'tsher mi shes pa'i bud med rang shed can gyis kha ta bslab bya rna bar mi nyan zhes dpe don sbyar te ma myong dgu thug gi bud med byang mar rgyu mtshan bshad kyang / phan pa med par bstan pa'o/ /74 lto 'grangs tshod la zhog gtam go tshod la zhog dpe lto 'grangs tshod la za mtshams bzhag na lus phung bde ba bzhin du/don bshad dgos pa'i skad cha de phar phyogs kyis gas4po go ba'i tshod la shod mtshams bzhag dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas/ gtam go nas kyang bskyar bshad yang bshad mang drags na nyan mkhan gyi zhe la phog pa las/ phan pa gzhan med par bstan pa'o/ /75 thob go sa don du gnyer ba de/ 'bu bse sbyar gyang la 'go ba 'dra/ dpe 'bu bse sbur gyang ldebs su 'dzegs bzhin mar lhung 'gro ba bzhin du/ don thob thang dang go gnas kho na don du gnyer ba de ni ngal ba 'bras med kyi bya ba zhig yin par bstan nas/bsam blo de rigs gtong mi rung bar gdams pa'o/ /(a mdo khul )364 —

76 drang po sus byed dpon po/ byams po sus byed pha ma/pha ma'i mtshan nyid ni rang gi bu phrug la byams skyong byed pa de yin pa bzhin du dpon po'i mtshan nyid ni mi drag zhan su yin la ma bltos par drang po drang bzhag byed pa de yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /77 drang po bshad na mi mi dga'/ rgyag pa 'khur na khri mi dga'/ dpe lag tu rgyug pa thogs na khyi rnams rdung bar dogs nas mi dga' ba de bzhin du/ mi rnams ngo dga' sprel lad la dga' bas skad cha drang po thad kur bshad na mi dga' ba'i spyi tshogs kyi goms gshis ngan pa zhig chags yod ces bstan pa'o/ /78 bdenardzun bsdur sa khrims ra/ gser rag brdar sa ka shu ga dpe gser dang rag gang yin rdo ka shu ka la brdar na dbye ba chod pa de bzhin du/ don su bden dang su rdzun gang yin de khrims ra'i nang bsdur na gsal po mthong thub ces dpe don sbyar ba'o/ /79 rdo ril ril rtsig pa'i dkrug shing / mi ril ril khrims kyi dkrug shing / dpe rdo ril ril gcig brtsigs na de rtsig pa'i dkrug shing du 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ don mi ril ril te yid brtan rtsa ba nas med par mgo nas gang mtho'i phyogs su phar ril tshur ril byed mkhan de rigs ni khrims kyi dkrug shing rang yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas mi de gras la spyi tshogs yongs kyis ther 'don dang / gnon shugs sprod dgos par bstan pa'o/ /80 ldum bu mang sar lo tog nyung / kha lab mang sar blo gros 365

dkon/ dpe sa zhing rtsa yan mang po yod sar ston thog nyung nyung las mi yong ba de bzhin du/ gtam nyog rdzogs rgyu med pa bshad nas sdod sar don dang ldan pa'i blo gros thon dkon pa yin zhes dpe don zung du sbrel nas spyod pa'o/ /81 sde mgo skyong na khog rgya che dgos/ rta rgod khrid na mthur thag ring dgos/ dpe rta rgod ri shor khrid na mthur thag ring tsam dgos pa bzhin du/ don sde tsho pa'i 'go 'dzin byed na phra dogs chung gzon ma yin par khog yangs dkyil che'i bsam blo 'dzugs dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas dpom po'am 'go 'dzin ji tsam gyis che na/ khog rgya yang de tsam gyis je cher bskyed dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ / ('brog khul ) 82 sdong po mang na rlung khog mi grangs mang na don 'grub/dpe shing sdong po ci tsam mang po yod na de tsam gyis bye rlung 'gog nus che ba de bzhin du/ don las la byed pa'i mi grangs ji tsam mang na de tsam gyis las don 'grub che ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas mang tshogs ni stobs shugs kyi 'byung khungs yin par ston pa'o/ /82ོ nang khul tshong mi rgyag dpon g.yog sho ma rgyag dpe dpon g.yog sho brgyab na thob 'or ji ltar byung rung mtha' 'bras bzang po mi yong ba de bzhin du/ don nang tshags tshong brgyab na khe gyong su la byung yang 'tsham po med ces dpe don sbyar ba'o/ /84 dpon ༄3 po'i kha yag don med yin/ nam ring po'i 366

rmi lam stong pa yin/ dpe nam ring po'i gnyid lam stong pa yin pa bzhin du/ dpon chen po'i skad cha yag po de tsho don la 'khyol thabs med ces dpe don sbyar nas/ dpon po'i khas len bzang bzang la yid ches bya mi nyan zhes bstan pa'o/ /〈5 dpon 'go gnyisakyi mi ser/ ri ngo gnyis kyi lug rdzi/dpe ri g.yas g.yon gnyis la khyab pa'i lug gi rdzi bo ni g.yas ri 'ded na g.yon rir mi slebs pa bzhin du/ bod rnying pa'i nang dpon 'go mi 'dra ba gnyis la khral 'ul rgyug dgos pa'i mi ser ni gcig gi bka' ltar bsgrubs na/ gcig gi thugs dang 'gal 'gro bas de las khag pa med ces dka' ngal dper 'os pa'i tshad du bstan pa'o/ /86 dpon btsan ru sde 'thor 'gro/ bo'u (me mda' )brgyab na ri dwags 'drog 'gro dpe me mda' brgyab na ri dwags rnams 'drog nas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du bros 'gro ba de bzhin du/dpon po btsan dbang che drags na mi sde tshang ma yul spangs nas 'thor 'gro ba dpe don sbyar nas sde 'bangs la btsan shed byed mi rung bar bstan pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )87 dpyid nyi ring por grang gsum dang dro gsum/ mi che ring por skyid gsum dang sdug gsum/ dpe dpyid dus kyi nyi ma ring por gangs char rlung 'tshub dang / nyi ma dro skyid sogs gnam gshis 'gyur ba sna tshogs yong ba de bzhin du/ don mi tshe ring po 'di la skabs re skyid po dang skabs 'gar sdug po sogs bde sdug sna tshogs yong 367

srid pa ni mi yul gyi chos nyid yin pas ya mtshan dang / ha las dgos don ci yang med ces dpe don sbyar nas bshad pa'o/ /88 pha gcig bu spun dgra ru langs/ sngas zhabs sha skal dug tu gyur/ dpe sngas 'og tu bcug bzhag pa'i sha skal de rul sungs kyis dug tu gyur pa bzhin du/ pha gcig pa'i bu spun de dgra ru langs pa zhes dpe don sbyar te 'ong mi srid pa'i bya ba thabs rdugs po blo yul las 'das pa zhig byung zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na de 'dra ba'i bya ba ngan pa rtsa ba nas byed mi nyan zhes kha ta byed pa la spyad kyang chog go /('brog khul )89 pha gcig rung bsam pa mi gcig zas gcig rung rmi lam mi gcig dper na mi gnyis sngas 'go gcig gi thog mgo bzhag nas gnyid nyal yang rmi lam mi 'dra ba so sor rmis pa bzhin du/ don pha gcig gi bu phrug yin rung bsam blo gcig pa yong mi srid ces dpe don sbyar nas mi rgyud ring lugs smra bar dgag pa rgyag pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/90 pho ngan chig la bskyar zlos/ rul ma'i rtsam pa nyis 'thagadape bud med le lo can gyis btags pa'i rtsam pa zhib mo mi yong bas bskyar du 'thag skyor byed dgos pa bzhin du/ don pho go ma chod kyi tshig la bskyar zlos yang bzlos byed pa zhes dpe don sbyar nas gtam gang shod rung / tshig nyung don gsal go brda 'phrod pa zhig bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /('brog khul )368

91 pho rab chig thog gnas/ 'phar ba rjes thog 'grodape gcan gzan 'phar ba ni rang gi rkang rjes kyi thog mi 'phyugs par 'gro ba bzhin du/ don pho rab cig yin na rang gis gang bshad pa'i tshig thog tu gnas dgos zhes kha dan don thog 'khyol dgos zer ba yin/(a mdo khul )92 pho e bden kha la chig bzhag mdzo e bzang rgyab la khal 'gel/ dpe mdzo yag nyes de rgyab la khal bkal nas 'ded na shes pa bzhin du/ don pho drang po yin min de kha nas bshad pa'i tshig thog la gnas dang mi gnas pa las gsal po shes thub ces kha dan tshig la gnas dgos zer ba yin/92 bu skyes par ming dang / chang 'dren par gtam/ dpe bu zhig skyes na ming 'dogs dgos pa bzhin du/ don gtam zhig shod par yang nges par chang 'dren dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te bod kyi sngar srol la gtam bzang ngan gang 'dra zhig shod pa'i skabs su'ang sngon la chang zhig 'dren pa'i yul goms gshis lugs yod pa de mtshon gyin yod/94 bu ngan pas pha shul mi zin/ rta ngan pas sga khog mi khengs/ dpe rta ngan chung gis rta bzang po'i sga'i khog mi khengs pa de bzhin du/ don bu ngan pas pha bzang po'i shul rjes zin mi thub ces dpe don sbyar nas bstan pa'o/ /95 bu mo skyid sar mi sdod/ ra ma bde sar mi 'gro/ dpe sgo phyugs ra ni lam bde sar mi 'gro ba g.yang gzar sogs tsub sa gar 369

yod du 'gro ba bzhin/ bu mo yang pha mas bkod sgrig byas pa'i khyim tshang skyid sar mi sdod zer ba 'di thog nas de snga gnyen sgrig rang dbang med pa las byung ba'i ngan 'bras de mtshon gyi yod/96 bya khwa tas nam 'phang mi chod/ bu ngan pas rang mgo mi thon/ dpe bya khwa tas mkha' dbyings mthon por nam 'phang gcod mi thub pa bzhin du/ don bu nyam zhan gyis spyi tshogs kyi thog rang mgo thon mi thub ces dpe don sbyar nas de lta bur rogs ston khrid gsum bya dgos pa shugs la bstan pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )97 bya mang dkyil du sgro btog mi mang dkyil du dma' phab/dpe don gnyis sbyar te kha gtad phyogs kyis bsam bzhin du brnyas bcos dang / dma' 'bebs nad mi theg pa zhig byas byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/98 byas pa la rjes dang / drud pa la shul/ dpe dngos po zhig drud pa la nges par drud shul zhig yong ba bzhin du/ don las ka gang zhig byas na'ang nges par byas pa'i rjes shig yod dgos zer ba lta bur spyod cing / skabs re las ka byas par rin dod gang yang rag ma byung zer ba la spyad kyang chog99 bla ma phal cher phyug po'i bu la 'khrungs/ me tog phal cher chu bo'i 'gram la skye/ dpe me tog gi rigs phal cher chu bo'i mtha' 'gram la skye ba bzhin du/ don bla ma'i sprul sku phal che ba ni rgyu nor phyug po yod pa'i khyim tshang gi bu la 'khrungs kyi 'dug ces dpe don sbyar nas 370

bod kyi bla sprul ngos 'dzin zer ba de phal cher rgyu nor la bltas nas byed kyin 'dug ces zur za byed pa'o/ /100 blo rtse gnyis kyis don mi 'grub/ khab rtse gnyis kyis chem bu mi yong / go bde ba'i dpe don de gnyis sbyar te 'gag rtsar thug pa'i don chen sgrub skabs blo rtse gcig sgril gyis sems thag bcad nas mtha' 'khyongs bya dgos pa las/ nem nur dang phyir bshol bya rgyu med zer bar spyod pa yin/101 dbul na dgra las gnyen sdang / chad na thur las gyen gzar/ dpe thang chad pa'i skabs su thur las kyang gyen gzar ba'i tshor ba 'byung ba bzhin du/ don nor gyis dbul ba'i dus su dgra las kyang gnyen sdang ba yong zhes dpe don sbyar te dbul zhing phongs na dgra bo'i zhe sdang zhi 'gro yang / gnyen nye tshos g.yar kyi re gsum gyis dogs nas sdang zug byed ces spyi tshogs kyi gnas lugs bshad pa'o/ /1༷2ོ dbyar drug pa'i shwa phos rwa la 'dzem/ dgun bcu pa'i wa mos gra la 'dzim/ dpe srog chags dud 'gro yin rung / rang nyid kyi dge mtshan rgyas pa'i dus so sor dogs gzon chen po byed kyi yod ces dper bstan nas mi dbang thang dang / longs spyod/ snyan grags bcas dar zhing 'dzoms pa'i dus su phyi nang gang sar dogs gzon chen po bya dgos pa las/ bag med lhod g.yeng rtsa ba nas byed mi rung zer ba lta bur spyad na 'tshams po yod/102 sbrul phar rgyag gi rnga ma 'ju dka'/ chig phar shor gyi 371

rnga ma sdud dka'/ dpe sbrul phar la rgyug 'gro ba'i mjug ma lag pas 'jus nas tshur 'then dka' ba de bzhin du/ don rang gi kha nas shor ba'i tshig gi gzhug gu de tshur bsdu rgyu dka' ba ste bsdu thabs med ces dpe don sbyar nas dus rgyun du kha nas bshad mi dgos pa'i tshig thal rigs mi shor ba'i goms gshis 'jags pa bya dgos par gdams pa'o/ / (a mdo khul ) 104 mar skogs mar gyis mi thul/ chos dred chos kyis mi thul/ dpe mar skogs la mar byugs nas ji tsam mnyed kyang dul rgyu med pa bzhin du/ don chos tshig kho nas dred pa la chos ji ltar bshad na yang / sems rgyud 'dul mi thub ces dpe don sbyar ba'o/ /105 mi skyid sar mi sdod/ ra bde sar mi 'gro/ dpe sems can ra ni lam bde sar mi 'gro bar brag ldebs g.yang gzar la 'gro ba bzhin du/ don mi rnams kyang skyid po yod sar yun ring sdod mi 'dod ces dpe don sbyar nas gtso bo mi la la skyid ma theg par de las lhag tsam zhig dgos 'dod byed ces par spyod pa yin/106 mi skyon 'don dgos/ shing skyon gzhog dgos/ dpe shing gi skyon gang du yod pa de gzhog nas thad ka 'drong po zhig yong thabs bya dgos pa bzhin du/ don mi'i skyon yang rang gzhan su la yod rung 'don thabs kyis dus thog sel dgos par bstan pa'o/ /107 mi skyon med 'dzam bu gling dang / shing 'dzer med rgya rdzong nags/ dpe shing 'dzer pa med pa srid pa'i nags rdzong du'ang 372

med pa de bzhin du/ don mi skyon rtsa ba nas med pa 'dzam gling na med ces dpe don sbyar te/ mi la skyon phra mo tsam yang med pa dgos pa'i re 'dun ni don dngos dang mi mthun par gdams pa'o/ /10ra mi go ba can la bshad pa/ shing yal ga can 'dzegs pa/ dpe shing yal ga mang po can la 'dzegs bde po yod pa de bzhin du/ don mi go shes can la rgyu rkyen shod sa yod ces dpe don sbyar te/gzhan gyis brjod pa'i gtam la rgyu mtshan yod med nyan shes bsam gzhigs bya dgos pa yin zhes gdams pa'o/ /109 mi rgas na dbang med/ rta rgas na gong med/ 'di ni spyi tshogs kyi tshul lugs la cung zad ma rangs pa'i sdom tshig cig yin rung / don la gnas tshul de ni dngos po'i chos nyid dang mthun pa zhig yin/110 mi rgas na yul dran/ bya rgas na tshang dran/ dpe bya rgas na rang gi tshang dran pa bzhin du/ mi lo rgas dus rang gi pha yul dran pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar ba'o/ /111 mi rgyu la mi dga' ba dang / khyi khrag la mi dga' ba/spyir na dpe khyi khrag la mi dga' ba med pa bzhin du/ don mi rnams kyang rgyu nor la mi dga' ba ha cang dkon pa'am/ yang na yong mi srid ces spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul la ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa'o/ /112 mi rgyu dang bral na sprang po/ mda' sgro dang bral na dbyug pa/ dpe mda' yi sgro rnams yongs rdzogs med par gyur na 373
