dbyug pa ste rgyug hreng zhig yin pa bzhin du/ don mi rgyu nor kun dang bral na sprang po rang chags zhes dpe don sbyar nas sprang po zer bar rgyu mtshan gzhan gang yang med ces rim pa mang ba'i spyi tshogs lam lugs la dmod pa'o/ /112 mi rgyad can gyi bu mo/ rta rgyad can gyi thor mo/ (rte'u mo ) dpe rta rgyud legs pa'i rte'u mo bzang po thon pa bzhin du/don mi rgyud legs pa'i bu mo mna' mar blangs na bu rgyud bzang po spel thub ces dpe don sbyar ba 'di ni rigs rgyud smra ba'i shugs rkyen phog pa mtshon zhing / sgo phyugs sogs rgyud bzang spel ba ni don dngos yin/(a mdo khul )114 mi brgyad la bsam blo brgyad dang / rkyang brgyad la rna 'byog bcu drug dpe ri dwags rkyang brgyad la rna 'byog bcu drug yod pa de bzhin du/ mi brgyad la bsam blo brgyad yod ces dpe don sbyar nas mi rnams so so'i gnas bab dang re 'dun mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis mi re la bsam tshul re yod pas mi sems gcig gyur zer ba ni yong dka' bar bstan pa'o/ /115 mi brgya sems gcig rta brgya 'gros gcig dpe rta brgya gom 'gros gcig pa 'grig pa bzhin du/ mi brgya blo sems gcig pa dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te tshang ma mthun sgril rdog rtsa gcig gyur yong ba bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /116 mi ngan gyi khog pa g.yos khengs/ dung dkar gyi khog 374

pa 'bus khengs/ dpe dung dkar po phyi dbyibs mdzes kyang khog pa ni 'bu yis khengs pa bzhin du/ don mi ngan 'dzum bag can gyi khog pa yang g.yo jus kyis khengs yod ces dpe don sbyar nas phyi'i rnam pa bzang po tsam la yid ches bya mi rung bar/ nang gi don snying bzang ngan legs par brtag dgos pa'o/ /117 mi ngo thang che ba rgya yin/ sha gong thang che ba chil yin/dpe sha rin gong mtho ba de tshil yod pa la brten nas byung ba bzhin du/don mi la cha mthong che ba de yang rgyu nor mang po yod pa la brten nas byung ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar ba ltar/ dbang yod na rgyu nor los kyang yong ba de yang tshud yod do/ /118 mi gcig la gcig brten/ rdza kha la lung brten/ de rdza khog gi kha la lung gnyis brten pa bzhin du/ don mi yang gcig la gcig brten te thad kur ram/ yang na gnyen la gnyen brgyud/grogs la grogs mched sogs kyi 'brel ba yod pa la zer ba yin/119 mi chung chung gis sde 'go mi zin/ rdo chung chung gis phur mgo mi non/ dpe rdo chung chung gis phur pa brdung na mi non pa de bzhin du/ don mi chung chung gis sde tsho pa'i 'go 'tsho bzung mi thub ces dpe don sbyar ba 'di ni spyi tshogs thog ming cha mthong che chung la bltos nas bshad pa'i goms gshis rnying pa gzhir bzung ba yin no/ / ('brog khul )120 mi gnyis bar nas rdza chag blo gnyis bar nas don 375

'phyugs/ dpe mi gnyis gcig gis gcig gis bzung snyam pa'i bar du gnyis mas glod nas rdza chag pa de bzhin du/ don la blo rtse gnyis kyi bar nas don dag 'phyugs 'gro ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar te don chen sgrub skabs blo rtse gcig gtad byed pa las/ e lo skyur lo rtsa ba nas bya mi rung bar gdams pa'o/ /121 mi chen sbung na g.yog po mi nyan/ gos chen thed na lhan pa mi nyan/ dpe gos chen rnying pa rtsab tor gyur na lhan pa'ang mi nyan pa de bzhin du/ mi go sa mthon po nas dbyungs na kho la goms 'dris dang / las myong gang yang med pa'i g.yog po'ang mi nyan zhes dpe don sbyar te spyi tshogs rnying pa'i dpon ngan las thang med pa la zur za byed pa'o/ /122 mi snying mi la gtad/ bya snying shing la gtad/ dpe bya snying ste bya'i blo gtad shing sdong la bcol ba bzhin du/ don mi snying ste mi yi blo gtad mi la bcol ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas blo gtad pa'i mi de nam yang phung du 'jug mi nyan par cis kyang blo thub pa bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /122 mi drang dgos/ lha mtshar dgos/ dpe lha sku bzhengs ba'i gtso bo'i dgos 'dun ni dbyibs legs mtshar sdug ldan pa zhig dgos pa bzhin du/ mi zhig byed pa'i gtso bo'i mtshan nyid drang bden tshad ma zhig dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas/ drang po mi byed pa de ni mi'i rigs kyi kun spyod tha shal zhig yin par bstan pa'o/ /376

124 mi nag med la nag rdo zur med la zur/ dpe rdo zur med la zur 'dug zer ba bzhin du/ mi nag med la nag 'dug ces ma nyes khag g.yogs 'gel gyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang /bzo rtsis byed pa'am/ bzos na mi 'grig ces pa sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'gre/125 mi mang nang na mkhas pa yod/ bye ma'i khrod na gser phye yod/ dpe bye ma'i khrod na gser phye yod pa de bzhin du/ don mi mang gi nang na gang dang gang la mkhas shing byang chub pa'i mi yod pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas shes rig dang nus rtsal mtha' dag gi 'byung khungs ni/ mi mang mang tshogs yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /126 mi mang chogs sar kha ma snga/ mgar ba'i go khar lag ma snga/ dpe mgar ba'i 'thab 'gram gyi dngos por lag pa 'chang mi rung ba ni des tshig nyen yod pa bzhin du/ don mi mang po tshogs sar don chen la yin min gyi kha tshig snga drags na nyen 'gan rang thog la 'khor nyen yod ces dpe don sbyar nas mi gzhan gyi zer 'gros la bltas nas shod dgos zer ba lta bu yin/127 mi zhim sman gyis nad ngan gso/ mi snyan gtam gyis don la phan/ dpe sman kha la zhim po med pa des lus kyi nad ngan rtsa nas sel ba bzhin du/ don rna bar snyan po med pa'i bden gtam gyis dngos don la phan thogs chen po yong ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas kha mkhas tshig snyan la dga' po bya mi rung bar/ don dngos la phan gnod 377

ji yong shes dgos par bstan pa'o/ /128 mi la mi dgos kha mchu/ shing la mi dgos 'dzer pa/dpe shing la mi dgos pa 'dzer pa yin pa bzhin du/ mi la mi dgos pa gyod dam kha mchu yin zhes dpe don sbyar te/ gtso bo don chung la 'grig thabs gtso bor byas te lab rgyu gleng rgyu mi yong ba bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /129 mi la blo dgos/ phag la sna dgos/ dpe phag pa yin na rang gi khyad chos gzhan la med pa'i 'khor lo lta bu'i sna dgos pa de bzhin du/ 'gro ba mi yin na srog chags gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos te blang 'dor tshul bzhin 'byed pa'i blo gros shig dgos pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas mis nges par du bsam blo gtong dgos par gdams pa'o/ /120 mi la mi kha med na shi ba yin/ shing la du ba med na rul ba yin/ mi la la gzhan gyis rang la mtho bshad dma' bshad byed kyi 'dug ces sems sdug byed pa la sems gso byed skabs spyad kyang chog pa yin zhing / dpe shing rul ba me la bsregs kyang du ba med pa bzhin du/ don mi ma shi bar du gang ltar mi kha yong ba de la ha las rgyu med ces bstan pa 'o/ /121 mi su la mi re med/ lam gang la mi 'gro med/ dpe lam gang zhig la yang 'gro mi dgos pa'i nges pa med pa de ba'in du/don mi su dang su yin rung nam zhig gi tshe kho la re mi dgos pa'i nges pa 378

med ces dpe don sbyar te mi su la'ang dgra 'khon rigs mi 'byung ba dang / phan 'gyur gyi 'brel ba rgya gang che 'dzugs dgos zhes gdams pa'o 122 mi bslu na chig gis bslu/ rta bslu na sgrog gis bslu/dpe rta sgrog gis bslu ba bzhin du/ don mi yang tshig snyan pos bslu ba yin zhes dpe don zung 'brel gyis bstan te/ mi tshos tshig 'jam gyis blo sna khrid pa la yid ches snga drags pa bya rgyu med ces gzab nan byed dgos par gdams pa'o/ ('brog khul )122 mis mi theg pa gtam/ chus mi theg pa rde'u/ dpe chu yis rde'u mi theg pa bzhin du/ don mis gtam ste sems la gzan pa'i skad cha theg mi thub ces dpe don sbyar nas mi la phog thug 'gro ba'i gtam rtsa ba nas bshad rgyu med par gdams pa'am/ skabs re rna bar mi 'bab pa'i skad cha bshad pa'i lan la thad kur spyod mkhan yang yod/124 mis mi za mna'/ khris mi za lcags/ dpe khyis lcags mi za ba bzhin du/ don mis gna' mi za zhes dpe don sbyar nas mna' bskyal ba la yid ches bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang /125—1 med pa la khyer shog dang / shi ba la longs shogadape shi zin pa'i mi la longs shog zer thabs ma mchis pa bzhin du/don med pa la khyer shog zer ba ni btsan gtam ya med cig min na gang yin zhes mang tshogs kyis dbang sgyur par ngo rgol byed par spyod pa yin/125— 2 rtsa yan la rdzogs dus med/ mi ngan la shi dus 379

med/ dpe zhing nang gi rtsa yan ji tsam btog kyang rdzogs rgyu med pa de bzhin du/ mi ngan ni dus tshod ji tsam song na'ang da dung shi rgyu med pa zhes spyi la gnod pa'i mi la dmod mo rgyag pa lta bur spyod pa yin/126 chig brgya phrag bshad na mdo dgos/ sga lhu bzhi sgrig na rgyun dgos/ dpe shing gi sga stod smad g.yas g.yon bcas lhu bzhi de gcig tu sgrig na sdom byed kyi rgyun bu dgos pa bzhin du/ don tshig brgya phrag mang po bshad pa yin na de la mdo tshig ste snying po 'di yin zhig dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas skad cha shod dus don snying gsal po dgos pa las tshig nyog mang po bshad mi nyan zhes ston pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )127 tshig stong bshad na mgo bo na/ me stong btang na dpral ba chig dpe bkol bya med pa'i me skong stong pa btang na mtha' skor mi rnams kyi dpral ba tshig pa las lus drod la mi phan pa bzhin du/don tshig nyog gi stong gtam bshad na nyan mkhan mgo bo mnar ba las don la phan pa med ces dpe don sbyar te/ skad cha stong bshad bya rgyu med ces gdams pa'o/ /128 chig thag thung na nyan bde/ yob thag thung na bzhon bde/ dpe rta sga'i yob thag thung na bzhon bde ba bzhin du/ don skad cha'i tshig thag ring po min pa thung na nyan bde ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar te/ pha rol por skad cha'i mdo don shod dgos zer ba'am/yang na rang nyid kyis skad cha rdog rdog cig shod kyi yin zer ba lta bu gang rung la spyad na chog380

129 chig rtsa ba can la go rgyu yod/ ba nu gzhol can la 'jo rgyu yod/ dpe ba mo nu ma 'jol ba can la 'o ma 'jo rgyu yod pa de bzhin du/ don tshig rtsa ba chen po can la go rgyu nges par yod ces dpe don sbyar nas mi yon tan can gyi gtam mam/ yang na don 'gag rtsar thug pa'i gtam sogs la go rgyu chen po yod pas nan tan gyis nyan nas go ba len dgos zhes ston pa'o/ / 140 mig shul na don rtsa med/ khab shul na skud pa med/dpe khab 'then pa'i shul na skud pa med tshe tshem bu yong thabs med pa de bzhin du/ tshig ji tsam bshad pa'i shul na don rtsa med na dus tshod chud zos stong bshad yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas don dag med pa'i skad cha stong pa nyan bshad byed mi rung zhes 'doms pa'o/ /141 che gcig gi bza' ya/ khal gcig gi do ya/ dpe sgo phyugs la khal 'gel dus do po cha gcig med na 'gel mi shes pa de bzhin du/ mi tshe gcig gi 'tsho ba skyel dus bza' zla gcig med thabs med pa'i gtan grogs ni gal chen por brtsi dgos par bstan pa'o/ /142 chong pas drang po mi shod/ rkun ma lam la mi 'gro/dpe rkun po rnams rang mnong ma bzod par mi gzhan dag 'gro sa'i brgya lam la mi 'gro ba bzhin du/ don tshong pa tshos khe bzang za dgos pas skad cha drang po shod mi srid ces tshong pa'i skad char yid ches bya rgyu med ces bstan pa'o/142 mdzub mo gcig gis gnam mi phig grog ma'i gcin 381

pas sa mi bang / dpe 'bu grog ma'i gcin pas sa gzhi sbong mi thub pa de bzhin du/ don mdzub mo gcig bsgrengs nas gnam 'big mi thub ces sbyar nas mi nyam chung gis zhu gtugs brgyab na yang bden pa bden thog tu 'khyol mi thub ces zer ba yin/144 mdzo pho rgas nas bshas ra/ mi pho gas nas khrims ra/dpe mdzo pho tshe gang rmo las sogs bskul mthar rgas nas bshas rar skyel ba bzhin/ don mi rgan 'chi khar khrims ra 'grim dgos byung zhes dpe don sbyar nas de rigs ni mi 'os mi 'tshams pa'i bya ba zhig yin par bstan pa'o/ /145 zas ngan gcig gis lus kyi stod smad dkrug mi ngan gcig gis yul gyi phu mda' dkrug dpe zas ngan gcig za nyes nas lus kyi nad gzhi slong ba bzhin du/ don mi ngan pa gcig gis yul sde kun dkrug srid ces dpe don sbyar nas 'phung dkrug slong mkhan gyi mi de ngan pa yin pas tshang mas dogs gzon dang zur 'bud bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /146 zas za na pho bas 'ju tshod/ gtam bshad na gdengs chod yod dgos/ pho bas mi 'ju ba'i zas zos na gzugs por nad gzhi bzo ba ltar/ gdengs med pa'i skad cha gang byung bshad na gyod gzhi bzo nyen yod ces bstan nas/ gtso bo skad cha shod dus khungs dang gdengs tshod yod med bsam zhib nan po bya dgos par gdams pa'o /382

147 rim zim char pas ri sul snyil/ kha mi grags sdod pas yod rgya 'phung / dpe char pa zim zim 'bab pa der mi rnams kyis do snang mi byed kyang / nam zhig ri bo snyil ba bzhin du/ mi kha mi grags par sdod mkhan la sus kyang dogs gzon mi byed pa des nyin gcig yod rgu thams cad 'phung la sbyor srid ces dpe don sbyar nas mi g.yo can de rigs la do snang byed dgos par bstan pa'o/ /148 zer tshad bden min/ btsos tshad sha min/ dpe btsos tshad tshang ma sha yin mi srid pa de bzhin du/ don mis zer tshad tshang ma bden pa ma yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas/ gtso bo mi gzhan gyis skad cha gang bshad la yid ches rtsa ba nas bya mi rung zhes gdams pa'o/ / (a mdo khul ) 149ོ bza' rgyu mang na nad yin/ bshad rgya mang na gyod yin/ zas za za mang drags na 'bras bu nad skye ba bzhin du/ gtam bshad bshad mang drags na mtha' 'bras gyod gzhi bzo ba yin zhes don med kyi skad cha mang po shod mi rung bar dpe yi sgo nas gdams pa'o/ /150 'a chad 'u thug sa zad gram thug dpe sa zad pa'i mtha' ma gram par thug pa bzhin du/ don da cha yod tshad tshang ma zad nas bya thabs gang yang med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/151 'u thug na gnyen dran/ thang chad na rta dran/ dpe lam thag ring por thang chad pa'i skabs su gzhi nas rta dran pa bzhin du/don dka' ngal phrad de 'u thug pa'i skabs su gzhi nas rang gi gnyen nye 383

ba dran pa zhes dpe don sbyar te rgyun ldan bde po skyid po byung dus dga' nye la do snang mi byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/152 khu thug na zhu sa dpon/ thang chad na g.yab sa rta/dpe rkang pa thang chad na zhon sa rta ma gtogs gzhan med pa ltar/don thabs shes gzhan med par 'u thug na zhu sa dpon po ma gtogs med ces dpe don sbyar te 'u thug na zhes pa des dpon por zhu dgos pa ni las kyi mtha' yin par shugs la bstan pa'o/ / ('brog khul )152 ya mon 'grim na rgyu dgos/ rgyu ma skyong na chil dgos/dpe sgo phyugs bsad pa'i rgyu ma skyong ba la tshil dgos pa de bzhin du/ya mon te khrims sar gtugs pa la rgyu dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te rgyu nor med na bden pa ji tsam yod kyang khrims sar 'gro thabs med ces bstan pa'i a mdo khul gyi gtam dpe zhig go /154 ya rabs ma rabs spyod pas shes/ skye yul gang yin skad kyis shes/ dpe mi zhig sa phyogs gang nas yin yul skad las shes pa bzhin du/ don ya rabs yin dang ma rabs yin de spyod pa la bltas na shes thub ces dpe don sbyar nas/ dus rtag tu kun spyod bzang po rgyun 'khyongs yong ba bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ /155 yun ring na bu mo ma dang 'khon/ za che na sbrang dkar zhe la rgyag dpe sbrang rtsi zhim mngar ldan yang zas drags na zhe log pa bzhin du/ don a ma byams skyong che rung 'grogs yun ring drags na rang gi bu mo dang 'khon pa'ang yong srid ces dpe don sbyar nas bya ba 384

gang yin yang tshad las 'das na ldog phyogs su 'gyur srid ces bstan pa'o /156 yul dpon dgra ru langs na 'gro rtsis/ bad gan mid khris na na shi rtsis/ dpe bad kun mid khris kyi nad phog na shi rtsis ma gtogs bya thabs med pa bzhin du/ don yul gyi dpon po rang gi dgrar langs na yul de nas 'gro rtsis bya rgyu las/ thabs gzhan med ces dpe don sbyar nas yul dpon 'khon na sa der chags sa med par bstan pa'o/ /157 yod po med skad che/ grod skam kob sgra che/ dper na/g.yag gi grod pa skam po kob sgra gzhan las che ba de bzhin du/ don rgyu nor mang po yod pa'i mi la la med pa'i sdug skad gzhan las che zhes dpe don sbyar nas ham 'dod tshim med kyi mi de rigs la 'phya dmod byed pa'o/ /15ra rwa gang mtho zhags pa bzed sa/ rgyu su che dpon pos sdigs sa/ dpe g.yag lug sogs rwa co gang mtho ba de zhags pa bzed sla ba bzhin du/ mang tshogs nang rgyu nor su mang ba de dpon ngan gyi mig gis sdigs sa zhig tu 'gyur 'gro ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas spyi tshogs rnying pa'i dpon ngan za rngams can gyi spyod pa la ther 'don byed pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )159 rang ma gtogs mi min/ ong do ma gtogs sha min/dpe smad khog gi sha rdig ma gtogs sha la mi brtsi ba bzhin du/ don 385

rang nyid gcig pu ma gtogs mir mi brtsi ba zhes dpe don sbyar nas don dngos dang rbad de 'gal ba'i lta stangs de 'dra 'dzin mkhan ni/mi rang shed kyis mig ldong ba'i glen rmongs mthar thug pa zhig yin par bstan pa'o/ /(khams khul )160 rang tshod rang dang / skye tshod shing / dpe shing gi skye tshod de shing gis byed pa de bzhin du/ don rang gi tshod de rang nyid kyis bzung dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas/ bya ba gang dang gang yin na'ang tshod 'dzin ran po bya dgos pa de ni mi su yin rung gal ha cang che ba zhig yin zhes ston pa'o/ /161 ri dkar dkar bzo mkhan kha ba/ nga 'di 'dra bzo mkhan nag mo/ dpe ri rnams dkar po bzo mkhan kha ba yin pa bzhin du/ nga 'di 'dra bzo mkhan nag mo ste bud med yin zhes dpe don sbyar ba de kho rang la legs nyes gang byas ma gsal yang phal cher nyams nyes byung zer ba 'dra bas de yin na pho mchog mo dman gyi bsam blo mtshon dpe zhig yin snyam/ 'on kyang skabs re bud med nyung shas kyis mi la mgo skor btang nas sprang po bzo mkhan yang med pa ma yin no/ /(khams khul ) 162 ri che na g.yang che/ khe che na nyen che/ dpe ri ji tsam mtho na g.yang de tsam gyis che ba bzhin du/ don bya ba gang yang khe bzang ji tsam chen po yod na nyen kha'ang de tsam gyi che ba yod ces dpe don sbyar nas khe mthong nas nyen mi mthong ba de 'dra bya mi nyan zhes sngon 386

brda gtong ba'o/ /162 ri chen po la 'dzegs sa/ mi chen po la zhu sa/ dpe ri chen po zhig yin na rgyab mdun g.yas g.yon gang 'os nas 'dzegs sa yod pa de bzhin du/ don mi chen po rnams la snga phyi'i 'byung rkyen dang rgyu mtshan zhib phra zhu sa yod ces dpe don sbyar nas dpon chen tshos 'bangs kyi bde sdug zhu rgyu gang yod gzab nan gyis nyan dgos par bstan pa'o/ /164 ri chen po'i skyibs/ mi chen po'i phag dpe ri chen po'i skyibs su char rlung gang gis kyang mi gnod pa'i brten sa yod pa ltar/ don mi chen po'i gam du'ang phyi nang gi dgra bo sus kyang 'tshe bar mi phod pa'i skyob srung gi brten yul yod ces dpe don sbyar nas spyi tshogs nang stobs shugs yod pa'i rgyab bdag cig la brten rgyu de gal chen po yin par bstan pa'o/ /165 rig pa gzhon dus slobs/ ba mo dgun nas gsos/dpe ba mo 'o ma 'jo rgyu dgos na dgun dus nas gso tshags gang dag bya dgos pa de bzhin du/ rang rigs shes rig byang tshad ldan pa zhig dgos na gzhon nu'i dus nas rig gnas slob sbyong la 'bad brtson bya dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas lo na chung dus nas shes yon slob brtson bya rgyu de gal che shos yin par ston pa'o/ /166 ring thung tshad na shes/ bden rdzun brtag na shes/dngos po ring thung ji tsam yod tshad len byas na shes pa bzhin du/387

don bden pa yin dang rdzun pa yin de brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas na gsal po shes thub ces dpe don sbyar nas brtag cing dpyad zhib bya rgyu de ni bya ba gang la'ang gal chen po yin par bstan pa'o/ /167— 1 lwa rkyang nang na drod med/ mi rkyang nang na skyid med/ dpe gos rkyang pa gyon pa'i lus la drod med pa de bzhin du/don mi hreng rkyang par sdod pa'i khyim nang du bde skyid med ces dpe don sbyar nas pho hreng ngam mo hreng gang yin rung gnyen sgrig byas na/ gzhi nas khyim tshang dro skyid ldan pa zhig yong srid ces bstan pa'o/ /167— 2 sha ldad kyin zo dang bcud yin/ chig bsam gyin shod dang gtam yin/ dpe sha za dus sos ldad bzhin du zo dang bcud 'byin pa bzhin du/ don skad cha shod dus bsam blo gtong bzhin gtong bzhin shod dang don yod pa'i gtam du 'gyur ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas gtso bo mno bsam legs par btang nas skad cha shod dgos pa de gal chen po yin par bstan pa'o/ /(a mdo khul )168 sha tsha ba'i gtam de snyan po med/ nad mkhris pa'i sman de zhim po medi/ dpe mkhris pa'i nad kyis mnar ba'i sman ni ro khag pa sogs zhim po med kyang nad la phan pa bzhin du/ don sha tsha che ba'i skad cha de rna bar rtsub pa sogs snyan po med rung / phugs nas rang la phan pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas mkhas mkhas snyan snyan la mgo ma 'khor bar don gyi phan gnod dbye shes pa bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o/ / 388

169 sha tshos la ma tshos zhim/ mi 'dris la ma 'dris yagadape sha tshos la ma tshos de bro ba zhim pa de bzhin du/ don mi yang 'dris la ma 'dris de phan thogs che ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas/ mi ma 'dris pas ni rogs ram byed mi srid la/ 'dris ha cang che drags pa'i mi des kyang dngos gnas kyi rogs ram byed pa'i nges pa med ces spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong dngos bshad pa'o/ /170 shing gis shing brtags na lha khang dang mchod khang /mi yis mi bkur na bla ma dang dpon po/ dpe shing rtseg shing gis btegs pa las lha khang dang mchod khang zhes grags pa chen po chags pa bzhin du/ don mi yis mi bstod nas bla ma 'di dang dpon po de zhes bzos pa las rang bzhin gyi grub pa 'ga' yang med ces dpe don sbyar nas bod rnying pa'i chos srid zung 'brel lam lugs kyi ngo bo ther 'don byed pa'o/ /171 shod mi shes phu bshad mdo bshad/ rgyug mi shes sga rngung 'phong rngung / dpe rta rgyug gtong mi shes mkhan gyis sga la rdung ba dang 'phong la rdung ba sogs 'tshab be 'tshub be byed pa bzhin du/ skad cha shod mi shes mkhan gyis phu nas bshad tsam dang mdo nas bshad tsam gyis gnad du mi 'khel zhes dpe don sbyar nas gtso bo skad cha shod dus dgos nges rgyas bsdus 'tshams la don snying gsal ston thub pa'i gra sgrig yag po byas te shod dgos pa bstan pa'o/ / (a mdo khul )172 bshad pa'i gtam 'phro gtsang dgos/ bzos pa'i 389

srubs ka dam dgos/ dpe dngos po gang yin rung bzos pa'i srubs ka ste sgrig kha dam po shul med pa lta bu zhig dgos pa bzhin du/ skad cha shod pa'i gtam mjug sgril skabs go don gtsang ma yong ba zhig dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas gtso bo gal che'i gros mol sogs byed skabs phar phyogs nas tshig 'ju tshig bsnyad sogs byed sa med pa 'jog mtshams gtsang ma zhig yong ba bya dgos par gdams pa'o/ / (mdo khams khul )172 sems kyi mdud pa grol/ rdza mgo'i sprug pa dwangs/dpe rdza ri'i rtse yi smug pa rim bzhin dwangs pa bzhin du/ don sems nang gi blo dogs mdud pa yongs su grol song zhes dpe don zung du 'brel nas bstan pa'o/ / ('brog khul )174 so med zas dang bral/ nor med gnyen dang bral/dpe so med rnams zas rdog zas dang rang shugs kyi bral ba bzhin du/don mi la rgyu nor med na gnyen bshes kyang 'khor mkhan med par rim bzhin bral 'gro ba mthong zhes spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul ngan pa la sting tshig bsgrags nas phongs pa rnams la rogs dang mgon bya dgos par bskul ba'o/ /175 bsam nas bshad na gtam yin/ ldad nas med na zas yin/ mi gzhan la skad cha shod skabs sngon la bsam blo legs par bskor te gzhi nas bshad na legs pa yin zhes dpe dang don sbyar nas gdams pa'o/ /176 bsam blo btang nas grung du/ ngal gso brgyab nas 390

mgyogs su/ dpe ngal gso brgyab nas mgyogs su 'gro ba bzhin du/don bsam blo btang nas snga tshig phyi 'gal gyi dran gtam gsar skyed 'di 'dra byed kyi 'dug ces dpe don sbyar te/ khrims kyi mdun sar skad cha gcig rang ma gtogs/ bsam blo btang nas bzo bcos brgyab mi chog zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o/ /177 bslab pa la rgan gzhon/ mchod rten la bang rim/dpe mchod rten la bang rim mtho dma' rim pa ltar yod pa bzhin du/don bslab pa ste las zhugs snga rting gi rgan gzhon go rim yod ces dpe don sbyar nas tshang ma ham pa su che lta bu'i rigs bya mi rung ba rang rtogs bya dgos par bstan pa'o/ /17〈 a lan med/ thug pa rdor med/ dpe thug pa la rdor med na bro ba kha rgyu med pa bzhin du/ don 'bod par a lan tsam mi ster ba bem po zhig 'dra zhes dpe don sbyar te/ mi gzhan gyis 'bod pa'am/ yang na skad cha 'dri ba sogs la nges par du sems rtsa 'khol pos brda lan zhu dgos par bstan pa'o/ /391

le tshanadrug pa/ bod kyi dmangasakhridagatam rgyudadam/lo rgyus bshad tshul sogs dang 'brel bayod pa'i gtam dpe 'ga' zhigagi 'byung khungs sam byung tshul so sor bshad pa/1 skugs pa'i lcang gcod/ ces pa'i go don ni/ byed stangs dang spyod stangs la bltas pa tsam gyis glen pa'i rang rtags mngon sum du ston pa'i skye bo de rigs la 'phya ba'i gtam dpe zhig yin pa dang /nga shi bas ma gtogs/ thong bu slong stangs de ltar ma red/ ces pa ni/mi zhig gis bya ba gang zhig byed par rtsom pa na/ byed stangs spyod lugs ji bzhin mi shes pa la/ ngas byas na de 'dra ma red zer ba'i skabs spyod pa'i kha mtshar gyi gtam dpe zhig yin/ bong bu bslangs pa'i dga' tshor med par/ gzhu gu bkog pa'i ya la/ zhes pa ni/phar rang nus gang yod bton nas rogs ram byas par yag byung zer rgyu med par/ cung zad ma 'grig pa byung na tshur le lan bda' ba de rigs la spyod pa'i gtam dpe rgyun du go rgyu yod pa zhig bcas yin/gong gsal gyi gtam dpe de gsum ni bod du dmangs khrod kyi ngag sgrung gcig yod pa las byung ba yin/ de yang 'di skad thos te/ sngar gyi 392

dus su mi glen pa zhig yod pa des/ shing sdong chen po zhig gi yal ga'i steng du 'dzegs te rtse mo'i phyogs su rang nyid bzhon nas/ rtsa ba'i phyogs der sta re gzhus te gcod kyin yod pa de las ‘ lkugs pa'i lcang gcod ’ ces grags shing / mi zhig lam de nas brgyud de 'gro bas mthong skabs glen pa de la/ khyod kyis 'di ltar bya mi rung / nam zhig shing gi yal ga de chad pa dang dus mtshungs khyod rang yang g.yang du lhung gi red ces kha ta byas par glen pa des/ g.yang du lhungs bar ci yod zer/ khos gad mo dang bcas/ g.yang du lhungs na shi yong zhes smras par/ glen pas/ shi bar ci yod zer/ sems bzang gi bslab bya byas kyang mi nyan par klan ka 'tshol stabs kho yang ci shod 'di shod ma byung bar/ shi na rting pa ser po chags kyi red ces bshad de mu mthud lam du zhugs so/ / ring por ma lon pa na shing gi yal ga de tshag sgra dang bcas chad de glen pa yang g.yang du lhungs/ stabs legs pa zhig la kho spang rtsa'i steng zags pas lus ma bsnad tsam byung / 'on kyang 'phongs sa la brdabs pa'i zug rngu ma bzod par spang thog tu yar rgyugs mar rgyugs byas mthar rim bzhin na zug zhi ba na/ gzhi nas da gan 'grul pa de'i skad cha dran nas myur bar rang gi rkang pa'i rting par blta skabs/ spang rtsi 'gos nas ser por gyur pa mthong dus da ni kho bo dngos 'brel 'chi zin 'dug snyam ste spang steng de gar nyal nas bsdad do/ / lam de nas bong bu 'ded pa'i mi zhig 'ongs pa na nye 'gram gyi 'dam chu'i nang glo bur du bong bu dims shing / mi des bong bu'i stod 393

nas 'then na smad 'dam du bying ba dang / smad nas bteg na stod dims shing kho'i stobs shugs kyis ma lcogs par rngul chu khrum khrum lhung ba mthong ngo / glen pa de ni shed shugs chen po yod mkhan zhig yin pas gad mo dgod bzhin du/ ‘6nga shi bas ma gtogs/ bong bu slong stangs de 'dra ma red/’nyaces smras par mi des/ khyed ma shi bar gtam de ltar smra bzhin mchis na/ nga la rogs pa zhig gyis dang zer/ glen pas kho la rkang mthil bstan nas ltos dang nga shi nas rting pa ser po chags mi 'dug gam zhes brjod par/ mi de yang rkang rjen mar spang gshongs brgyud nas 'ongs pas rang gi rkang mthil phar bstan nas/'di ni spang rtsis ser por gyur pa red ces bshad pas glen pa gzhi nas yid ches shing / yar langs te 'o na khyod rang bong bu'i stod nas 'then zhig ngas smad 'then chog zer nas bong bu'i mjug ma lag gnyis kyis dam por bzung ste shugs gang yod brgyab nas 'then pa na/bong bu skam sar bde blag ngang thon pa dang dus mtshungs gzhu gu chad nas glen pa'i lag par bzung yod pa red/ bdag po des/ khyod kyis nga'i bong gu'i gzhug gu bkog song bas skyin tshab 'jal dgos zhes rtsod pa las/ 66bong bu bslangs pa'i dga' tshor med par/ gzhug gu bkog pa'i ya la ’ zer ba'i gtam dpe de byung bar grags so/ /2 khron pa'i nang gi sbal pa/ zhes pa ni go rgya mthong rgya ha cang chung ba'i mi rang mthong nga rgyal chen po byed mkhan la spyod pa'i 'phya dmod kye gtam dpe zhig yin/ 'di'i byung tshul ni sngar snga mo tshong pa 394

phyug po zhig gi khyim du khron pa gcig yod pa'i nang rdzus skyes kyi sbal pa zhig gnas yod/ nam zhig tshong pa de yul gzhan du tshong rgyag par phyin te tshur log skabs tshong 'dus de nas rus sbal gcig nyos nas khyer yong / khyim du slebs rjes rus sbal de yang khron pa'i nang du glod skabs sbal pa des rus sbal la/ khyod gang nas 'ongs zhes dris par/khos nga mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po nas 'ongs pa yin zhes bshad/ sbal pas/mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po zer ba de che chung 'di tsam yod dam zhes rang gi lag pa gnyis kyi rtse gtugs pa'i nang khong gi tshad cig bstan par/rus sbal gyis des ga la tshad ces lan btab/ sbal pas 'o na 'di tsam yod dam/ 'di tsam yod dam zhes zer bzhin rang gi lag pa gnyis bar khyad je rgyang du thengs 'ga' shas brkyangs rung / rus sbal gyis dgod bzhin du des ga la tshad ces lan yang yang btab/ mthar sbal pa des/ 'o na khron pa 'di yongs rdzogs kyi rgya khyon tsam yod dam zhes dris par/ rus sbal gyis 'dis 'bum gyi cha yang mi lon zhes bshad pas/ sbal pa de ha las hang sangs nas snying dum bur gas te de mur 'chi ba red ces pa'i sgrung gtam de las mched pa yin no zhes grags so/ /2 glang sker bel (be'u )'dogs/ don 'grel/ bod rnying par zhing bran bdag pos zhing bran dbul phongs rnams bros byol du song ba slar bkug nas yul de'i khral pa che bar 'gan dkri rtsis sprod byed pa'i dpe ngan zhig yin/ spyi lo 1847rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me lug 395

lor rgyal rtse dang pa rnam sogs kyi khul sa mi zhib ba'er che na po zhig byas pa'i mthar/ gzhung rgyugs mi ser bros byo'/ so nga ba rnams yul 'gus thog khral tsho 'khos zhan rnams de ga'i nye 'dabs kyi sger chos lag la rtsis sprad de slad yul byol khral stong mi chog pa'i 'gan dkri byas nga/ de 0 / ‘ glang sker bel 'dogs ’ zhes yongs bsgrags byas pa 〈〈rgya' pad me lug zhib gzhung 〉〉zhes pa'i nang gsal yod/ de nas bzung sger khas so sos gzhung rgyugs mi ser de dag gi 'go 'dzin re bsko sa pa 'a4 nga ༈8 sde pa glang ’ zhes zer/ de la'ang khyab khongs che chung yod pas dper na/ rgyal rtse rdzong khongs glang chen drug dang glang chung bcu yod ba dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bar gnas mus yin no/ /4 rgyal po glang dar gyi dbu la rwa co 'dug 'dug la zhu sa mi 'dug cig tshang lags/ zhes pa'i gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs ni/dmangs khrod du gtam rgyud 'di 'dra zhig shod srol yod/ rgyal po glang dar ma'i dbu la rwa co thung thung gnyis skyes yod pa rgyun gtan dbu skra thor cog bcings pas sgrib nas mthong gi med/ glang dar dbu skra 'khru skabs skra g.yog zhu mkhan bu mo re dgos pa mang tshogs nang gi bu mo gzhon nu ma rnams rgyan g.yugs te su la babs pa de 'gro dgos/ skra g.yog rgyug skabs rwa co de mthong bar brten gzhan la bshad kyis dogs nas bu mo de gsod kyi yod/ thengs shig bu mo lo bcu drug lon pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba zhig yod pa de la rgyan babs te 'gro dgos byung / bu mo des skra g.yog rgyug skabs rang nyid da lta rang 'chi rgyu las 396

thar sa med pa shes nas yid ha cang skyo bas mig chu thigs pa gcig rgyal po'i snyan 'jog gi steng du lhung / phar gzigs pa na bu mo de mig chu lu chu rdol ba ltar 'byin pa la/ khyod ci'i phyir ngu gsungs par bdag da lta 'chi dgos par 'jigs nas ngu ba yin zhus/ bu mo de mdzes sdug lta na sdug pa'i khar/ rang gi bsam pa zol med par bshad pa la rgyal po snying rje nas/ khyod kyis nga'i mgo la rwa co 'dug ces su la'ang bshad mi chog da res khyod tshe thar du gtong ba yin gsungs nas glod pas mo shin tu dga'/ 'on kyang mos gsang ba de gzhan la shod 'dod chen po skyes rung / shod ma nus par mi med lung stong zhig tu phyin nas tsig tshang khung bu gcig la kha sbyar te/ 6 rgyal po glang dar gyi dbu la rwa co 'dug 'dug la zhu sa mi 'dug tsig tshang lags zhes skad chen pos bshad de rang gi snying nad sangs par byas/ lo phyi mar tsig tshang de nas smyug ma rkang gcig skyes/ de lug rdzi zhig gis bcad nas gling bu bzos par mi su 'dra zhig gis btang rung tshig la/ ‘4rgyal po glang dar gyi dbu 'a rwa co 'dug 'dus la zhu sa mi 'dug tsig tshang lags ’ zer ba de rang byung bas glang dar la rwa co yod pa tshang mas shes pa yin zer ba las dpe de byung ba'o/ /5 dngos grub mi dgos/ mdzog mgo glod rogs gnang /zhes pa'i gtam dpe 'di ni dper na mi zhig gis khyod kyis ma dngul g.yar na ngas tshong brgyab ste lo gcig la khe spogs ldab gcig lon pa byed thub ces bshad par yid ches kyis dngul 'bor chen zhig ma rtsar 397

btang ba na/ khos lam 'gro ma byung tshul gyis khe spo gas rim bzhin chung du gtong rogs zhes ka kor rgyun ma chad par shod pa'i mur lo gcig gi dus tshod 'das zin kyang / da dung dngul mthong rgyu med skabs bdag pos da cha khe spogs ma byung rung / rtsa ba'i ma dngul de phyir slog byed rogs zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs ni bod dmangs khrod du grags pa'i ‘6a khu ston pa'i sgrung ’ gi dum bu gcig yin/ de yang 'di skad thos te/ nyin gcig a khu ston pa lung pa zhig gi nang phyin par/ yul de'i mi mang rnams dbul zhing phongs la sdod khang gyang hrul 'ba' zhig las med na yang / grong sde de'i dbus su mi tshang chen po rgyal po'i pho brang lta bu 'og khang sgo phyugs kyis khengs shing / steng khang rmams rgyu nor gyis gang ba zhig yod pa mthong / rgyu mtshan 'dri skabs mi ser tshos lo hril por ngal rtsol byas pa'i 'bras bu tshang ma phyug bdag des sa bogs la bsdu ba ma zad/ da dung kho la bu lon mang po chad yod zer/ phyug po de ni rgyu nor 'a/ 'dod rngams tshad med pas sro/ga dang bsdos nas nor rdzas/ 'phel thabs byed mkhan zhig yin pa'ang gsal por thos te/ a khus mi de la bzo lta zhig bzo dgos bsam nas sprang po sprang rkyang gi chas/ sos hrul po gyon nas sgo 'i 'gram du phyin zhing / skad phra 'a/ ring ba'i smre ngag 'don bzhin bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu zhig gnang rogs zhes yang yang brjod pa na/dus tshod ring po song rjes phyug rgan des rab gsal nas mar bltas te/sngar thos ma myong ba'i skad ring 'then mkhan sprang slong khyod gang nas 398

'ongs zhes dris/ a khus phyag 'tshal nas/ bdag ni chags sa brten sa med pa'i rgyal khams bskor mkhan sprang 'khyams shig yin/bdag la lha yis lung bstan zhig byung bar yul 'di'i phu na rgyal po lta bu'i longs spyod ldan pa'i phyug bdag cig dang / rnam sras kyi grub thob chen po dngos grub rdo rje bya ba zhig bzhugs yod pas phyogs 'dir bskyod na dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal las grol thub ces gsungs byung / phyug bdag rgyal po lta bu ni khyed rang yin pa dngos su mjal thub pas lud bstan de dngos 'brel yin 'dug grub thob de yang mjal thub nges la yid ches byung / de ring bza' rgyu'i gsol ras zhig gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin zhes bshad/ phyug rgan de ni ngo bstod la ha cang dga' mkhan zhig yinapas kho rang rgyal po lta bu 'dug zer bar dga' spro skyes nas/a khu la rtsam pa sder ma gang dang / chang skyur rgyan chung gang byin par de dag za 'thung byas nas thugs rje che zhes zhus te phyir log go yul de'i zhing pa rgan rabs la 'dri zhib byas te rgyab ri'i ldebs na brag phug sgo gnyis yod pa'i nang phug gcig tu 'brel ba la blta zhib dang 'brel de la bar bcad rtsig pa zhig 'then thog bar skyar bug sgo chung chung gcig gtod/ gra sgrig rnams tshags su tshud pa byas te dus tshod zla ba gcig tsam song ba dang / nyin gcig a khus zhwa gos lham gsum gsar rkyang zhig brjes/ rta sngo nag rma bya 'dra ba gcig bzhon nas phyug rgan de'i drung du bskyod/ khos thog mar ngos ma chod kyang a khus sngar gyi gnas lugs bshad pas ngo shes te hang sangs/ a khus ngas dka' ba 399

tshad med spyad mthar grub thob dngos grub rdo rje zhal mjal ba ma zad/bdag la gang 'dod yid bzhin du 'byung ba'i dngos grub kyi bum pa zhig gnang byung bas da cha dbul phongs las rbad de grol thub par brten/de ring khyed kyi sar bcar nas bdag bkres skom gyis 'chi la thad kyi dus su khyed kyis rtsam pa sder ma gang gnang ba de dngos 'brel gser sder ma gang gnang ba las phan 'bras zhe ba byung stabs bka' drin che zhu bar 'ongs pa yin/ khyed rgyal po lta bur bdag sprang 'khyams shig gis dngos po'i legs skyes phul na/ khyed kyi mtshan snyan 'dzad rgyu las med/lhag bsam mtshon ched kha btags dkar gtsang 'di 'bul rgyu yin zhes brjod pas khos/ los yin los yin zer zhing / sne len gzab rgyas zhus thog dngos grub kyi bum pa de 'dra zhig rag na ci ma rung snyam pa'i ham 'dod skyes nas/ skad cha snyan po mang po bshad mthar grogs po khyed kyis grub thob de bdag dang thengs gcig mjal nas dngos grub zhu rgyu'i rogs ram zhig gnang rogs zer/ a khus de 'dra ga la yong /khong gis dngos grub 'dis khyod mi rabs nas mi rabs phyug po byed chog pas phyin chad nga 'tshol mi rung gsung ba ma zad/ dngos grub de rigs dbul po mthar lhungs ma gtogs gzhan la gnang mi srid ces khas ma blangs/ phyug rgan des/ khyed kyis nga la lam rgyus dang dngos grub zhu lugs rnams bslab na 'grig dngos grub ma gnang na'ang khyed la 'gan med ces u tshugs mthar skyel byas par/ a khus grub thob bzhugs sa ni ri 'di'i ldebs na yod/ yar lam shar phyogs kyi bye ma'i 400

lam ring 'di nas 'dzegs dgos/ brag phug che ba zhig yodwa pa de 'dzul nas sbug tu bskyod na bug sgo chung ngu gcig yod/ der phyag gsum 'tshal nas/ bdag ni dbul phongs mthar lhungs 'tsho thabs bral ba zhig yin pas/ grub thob chen pos tshe gang dbul phongs las thar ba'i dngos grub cig cis kyang gnang rogs zhes zhu dgos/dngos grub 'dod na lag pa srings shig gsungs 'ong bas de dus the tshom med par lag gnyis bug sgo'i nang ring por rkyong dgos/ dngos grub thob nas mar lam nub ngos kyi rdza ri gzar po nas babs dgos zhes bshad pas kho pa dga' mgu yi rangs kyis de nyin a khur gsol ston rgyas pa zhig bshams/ sang nyin nyi ma rtse shar la 'byor pa 'gro rgyu yin zhes bshad/ a khu rta bzhon te log khul byas/ sang zhogs tho rengs ma zin gong nas phyug bdag des sprang chas thig ral nyil nyil zhig spras/gdong la khru nag dang thal ba bsres te byugs/ mgo skra zing zing bzos te sprang 'khyams ya nga ba zhig tu brdzus nas lag tu ber rgyug cig thogs shing / ri bo de'i shar ngos bye ma'i lam nas 'dzegs phyin pas yang yang phyir nyil byed bzhin dka' tshegs chen pos yun ring 'gor/de'i ring la a khus spang lam brgyud nas myur bar 'dzegs te brag phug chung ba nas 'dzul te sngon la bug sgo'i nang du 'byor zhing / ngal gso brgyab ste bsdad/ nyi dros tsam la phyug rgan kho dbugs hal bzhin 'khyar 'khyor ngang brag phug che ba de'i nang du slebs/ lam seng bug sgor phyag gsum btsal te a khus bslabs pa ltar ngag skyor gyis dngos 401

grub gnang rogs zhes zhus par/ a khus skad gdangs 'dzer skad cig bton te/ las ngan gyi sems can snying re rje/ dngos grub 'dod na lag pa srings shig ces brjod pa na/ kho ni 'dod don 'grub song bsam nas lag pa gnyis ka dpung pa'i bar bug sgo'i nang brkyangs pa na/ a khus snga sa nas gra sgrig byas pa'i 'breng thag gi zhags 'gug lag gnyis la bskon nas dam por bsdams te/ khyod ni yul gyi phyug rgan mi mang gi rgyu nor yongs rdzogs bsdus nas kyang ma rgyags par/ da dung 'dod rngams tshod med kyis grub thob mngon shes can nga la'ang rdzun shod phod dam/ de ring ngas khyod thar par gtong gi min zhes skad shugs drag pos spyo ba na/ kho ni rab tu skrag nas/ dngos grub mi dgos mdzog mgo glod rogs gnang / zhes sdug skad shor ba zhes pa las gtam dpe de byung bar grags shing / a khu ston pas mi ngan de la/phyin chad mang tshogs kyi lag nas khab skud tsam yang bsdu mi chog pa'i mna' bsgags te tshe thar du btang ba'i skor gyi shod rgyun yod/6 brtag sgril ma red dngul sgril red/ jo bo ma red byams pa red/ dpe 'di 'byung khungs lo rgyus ni/ spyi lo 1904bod shing 'brug lor dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul dmag lha sar 'byor nye'i skabs/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa rgyal nang du nyen g.yol phebs bzhugs kyi ring skabs de'i dga' ldan khri pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan la rgyal tshab bsko bzhag gnang ba ltar de dus bla ma'i sprul sku ngos 'dzin brtag zhu dang / sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs mtho rim gsar bsko'i 402

'char gzhi phul rigs sogs la khong rang gis thag gcod mi gnang bar 'os ming rnams gzan sgril thog lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi jo bo rin po che'i spyan sngar brtag sgril 'bul gnang gis su phebs de rang la gtan 'gel bsko bzhag gnang gi yod pa red/ 'on kyang khong gi phyag mdzod byams pa chos bzang zer ba zhig yod pa de rim bzhin 'dod brngams dang dbang shed je cher gyur stabs/ kho pas the gtogs byed pa dang lkog rngan mang po blangs te skabs re 'os ming gnyis gsum gang yod tshang ma kho rang gi rogs ram byed yul de gcig pu'i ming bris te lkog tu gzan sgril nang bcug nas brtag sgril zhu ba sogs byed pa ma zad/ da dung kho pas snying grogs a ṇi zhig bsten nyar byed pa des kyang rjes su lkog nas kho par bkod jus btang ste kha lo sgyur ba sogs byung bar grags shing / skabs de dus lha sa'i mang tshogs tshos/ ‘ brtag sgril ma red dngul sgril red/ jo bo ma red byams pa red/ byams pa byams pa chos bzang red/ byams pa'i gzugs zhugs a ṇi red/’ ces sho lo ka gcig gis zur za byas pa las tshig rkang mdun ma de gnyis rjes su'ang lkog rngan zos te go ming thob thang sprod rung / phyi tshul du drang po drang bzhag yin khul byed mkhan gyi mi ngan la zur za byed pa'i gtam dper gyur pa yin zhes khungs ldan bgres rabs rim brgyud kyi zhal las thos so/ /7 ldan ma'i stong / zhes pa'i gtam dpe de'i go don ni spyi tshogs rnying pa'i mi ser gyi bu lon lta bu ji tsam bcal kyang gtsang dus 403

med pa'i chag sgo la spyod pa zhig yin/ de'i 'byung khungs kyang gling ge sar gyi sgrub gi bshad rgyun zhig la/ gling rje ge sar rgyal pos phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dgra sde rnams brtul zin pa'i mthar khong rang 'di nas sku tshe 'pho bar dgongs te/ ri bong zhig la sprul nas bka' blon ldan ma spyang khra'i mdun nas phar gshegs pa na/ ldan mas de ge sar gyi sprul pa yin snyam pa yid la ma shar bar mda' zhig 'phangs nas bsad pa yin zer/ de la brten nas ldan ma tshang gis mi rabs nas mi rabs bar 88ge sar rgyal po'i stong ’ zhes pa'i khral zhig lo ltar 'jal dgos par grags pa'i sgrung gtam de las byung ba yin/ de snga bod kyi khrims yig rnying pa'i nang tshan ‘6bsad pa stong gi zhal lce ’ zhes par yang / mi rab 'bring tha gsum la stong 'bab mtho dma' he bag chen po yod pa'i dpe 'dren skabs/ ‘ stod ya rtse rgyal po hor gyis bsad/ro dang gser gnyis mnyam 'gyogs byas/ smad ge sar rgyal po ldan mas bsad/ dus da dung stong la khyer dus med/minya(1) ces lung du drangs nas bla chen dang / dpon chen bsad na de'i stong ni gzhal thabs med zer ba'i sgrub byed du rtsis yod do/ /8 dpon rab gcig byed pa la/ g.yog rab gcig shes dgos/ zhes pa 'di ni bod dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe go don gting kho (tsu ) khrims yig zhal lce bcu drug dang / bcu gsum sogs nang 'a 4༵ 4 da/

zab ldan pa zhig yin/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog skad grags yod pa'i phag gru'i sde srid dang po tā si tu'i byang chub rgyal mtshan dgung lo gzhon nu'i skabs/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gdan sa chen por chos srid lugs gnyis kyi slob gnyer la byon zhing / sa skya'i bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba'i bka' ltar bla ma mnyam med pa'i sar brtag gnyis slob gsungs pa bzhin bzhugs nas dben gnas kha'u spang bzang du chos bar la phebs pa'i skabs/ gong gi gtam dpe dang 'brel ba yod pa'i lo rgyus dum bu zhig 〈〈tā si tu bka' 'bum 〉〉nang gsal ba 'di ltar/‘6bla ma mnyam med pas/ nga gcun pa'i ched du/ dbon po (1)thams cad g.yog ma 'khrid/ lto chu bkol ba dang / me shing sgrug pa/chu len pa thams cad ngo ma tshos byed dgos/ rang rang gi gci shing sgrug pa yan chad zhal ta las ma 'gal/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam na/sa skyar ya tshe ba'i gser dngul gyi 'gyed tshan can yod pa yin zer bas/dbon po tsho dang grwa pa thams cad sa skyar 'gyed len pa la song nga la e 'gro gsungs/ mi 'gro zhus pas de la mnyes/ nged rang dpon slob gnyis pos kha'u spang bzang du bzhugs pa la nyi ma ma shar bar dpon slob gnyis khas dpe bltas/ nyi ma shar ba dang bla ma pa nga la spyan cer mdzad kyi 'dug tsha ba bkol ran 'dug bsam nas tsha ba tsu 1bye dbon po zhes pa skabs de'i bod kyi bla dpon che rgu'i sku tsha dang bu phrug —ra —ra/ 405

skol du phyin pa dang / dud pa ches me ma 'bar bas/ bla ma pa bzhengs byung nas/ ngas me 'bud pa bslab kyi gsungs te/ lci ba sgyed po yin pas zur la phu/ gshag pa dpa' bo yin pas snol nas phu/sog ma ngan shing yin pas btegs nas 'bar ba yin gsungs/ me 'bud ma shes kyang a'u rtsi/ nga dpon byed pa yin zhus pas/ nyid dpon byed dam gsungs/ dpon byed zhus pas/ dpon rab cig byed na g.yog rab cig shes dgos/ dpon 'bring zhig byed na g.yo ga 'bring zhig shes dgos/ dpon tha ma la'ang g.yog tha ma zhig shes dgos pa yin/ g.yog la slob ma shes na dpon mi yong gsungs/ blo skyed cig der byung / da lta yan chad du bsams tsa na/ shin tu mad par 'dug’ ces rlangs kyi po ti bse ru rgyas pa lcags par ma'i ngos 127—130la gsal/9 'phan po bas dmag mi 'jon/ zhes pa'i gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung rkyen skor/ rgan rabs kyi gsung rgyun ltar na/ spyi lo 1240bod lcags byi lor/ hor jing gir rgyal rgyud go dan han gyis dmag dpon dor rta zer ba hor dmag khyon che dang bcas pa mdo smad dang / mdo stod brgyud bod du btang zhing / sa gnas so sor mgo btags pa rnams bde 'jags su bzhag pa dang / 'gog rgol byed mkhan rnams gtor pham gtong bzhin yong skabs/ 'phan po rgyal gtsug lag khang du de dus dge 'dun grangs 'bor che tsam yod stabs yul tsho yas mas kyi mi mang dang bcas pas hor dmag la bkag 'gog 406

dmag 'thab byas par/ hor dmag gis dgon pa'i mthar bskor thog me brgyab pa dang grwa pa mang po bsad pa'i skor 〈〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉〉du'ang / 64 rgyal lha khang bsregs/ so ston sogs rab byung lnga brgya bsad ces gsal ba ltar lo rgyus thog grags che ba'i pham nyes chen po de byung ba'i rjes su gtam dpe 'di byung ba yin zhes thos so 10 bong bu zhon nas/ bong bu 'chol ba/ 'di ni dbus pa tshos gtsang par 'phya ba'i kha mtshar gyi gtam rgyud las mched pa zhig yin/de yang sngar gtsang pa'i bong 'ded pa cig lha sar 'byor dus rtse pho brang mthong bas hang sangs te pho brang gi sge khung la grangs ka rgyag gin yong bar grangs ka yang yang nor nas ma thebs par lus/ glo bur du kho rang gi bong bu brlag dogs kyi bsam blo zhig 'khor nas mdun du 'gro bzhin pa'i bong bu rnams la grangs ka zhig rgyag dus bong bu gcig ma tshang ba lta bur mngon nas gang sar 'tshol du phyin/ mi thug rim bzhin la 64ske la rnga ma nag po btags pa'i bong bu zhig gzigs ma byung ngam ’’zhes 'dri bzhin phyin/ gang 'tshams song rjes zhing pa bgres song gcis thug par gong bzhin 'dri dus/ des ske la rnga ma nag po btags pa'i bong bu khyed rang gis zhon pa 'di ma red dam zhes bshad par gzhi nas kho rang gis zhon nga/'i bong bu de rnyed pa red ces pa las dpe de grabs zhes zer 11 bong bus gzig lpabs gyon pa/ zhes pa ni de snga yon 407

tan med pa'i bla ma dang / 'jon thang med pa'i dpon po sogs kyis phyi tshul du dar gos chen gyon te rdzig nyams ston pa la 'phya dmod byed pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/ de'i gtam rgyud dngos ni/ sngon yul zhig na mi g.yo sgyu che zhing le lo can zhig la sgo phyugs bong bu gcig yod pa de'i gso chas sgrub ma bgyid par/ kho la gzig gi pags pa zhig yod pa bong bu de la g.yogs nas ri 'dabs kyi zhing kha'i nang glod de lo tog za bcug pa na/ dang thog zhing pa rnams kyis gzig slebs 'dug ces phyogs der 'gro ma phod pas re zhig ci dgar zas rnyed na'ang / rim bzhin ston thog la gnod 'tshe chen po phog rkyen gzig gis ljang pa za ba'i dpe med ces gcig gis gcig sbran mthar yul mi mang pos rdo rub brgyab ste bsad skabs/ gzig lpags kyi 'og nas bong bu'i ro thon pa la brten nas gtam dpe de ltar chags shing / rang tshul rmar rjen du thon nas zhabs 'dren zhus pa la ‘4bong bu thon song nyazer ba'i gtam dpe yang de las 'phros pa yin no/ / dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe nge spyad nas 〈〈sa skya legs bshad 〉〉du'ang / ru ha cang g.yo sgyu mang drags na/ re zhig grub kyang mtha' mar brlag gzig lpags bkab pa'i bong bu yis/ lo tog zos mthar gzhan gyis bsad ’ ces g.yo sgyu'i bya ba mang drags na mthar thug 'phung bar 'gyur ba'i don dang sbyar nas gsungs yod cing / 'on kyang gtam dper spyod skabs go don de ngang mi 'dra ba gong du bshad pa ltar phyi rdzig nang stong ngam/ yang na phyi nang mi mtshungs pa sogs la go dgos pa'i khyad par yang shes dgos so༈ 408

12 bya gral byi so/ zhes pa'i gtam dpe 'di'i byung tshul ni dmangs khrod kyi gtam rgyud las/ sngon pha wang la bya khral bskul dus khos so bstan nas nga bya rigs min par byi ba'i rigs yin zhes bshad pa dang / yang kho la byi ba'i khral bskul dus nga byi ba min bya'i rigs yin zhes gshog pa lheb lheb brdabs pas mthar khral gnyis ka rgyug mi dgos pa byung ba yin zhes grags pa ltar dpe de byung zhing / mi mgo bde po la las thabs shes ngo gnyis ma spyad de gyong g.yo la khe bzang za thabs byed mkhan la gtam dpe 'di spyad nas sting tshig sgrog gin yod do/ / 12 bya brgya shar lta/ pha wang nub lta/ zhes pa'i gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs ni sngar gyi gtam rgyud cig la/ gna' snga mo bya rigs rnams kun tshogs te bya'i rgyal po gdam bsko bya skabs/ sang zhogs bya su zhig gis nyi ma shar ba sngon la mthong ba de la bya'i rgyal po bsko rgyur gros thag chod pa na/ sang nyin skya rengs 'char ma thag bya thams cad ri rtser 'dzoms shing / bya gzhan rnams kha shar la gtad nas nyi ma shar rgyur sgug nas bsdad pa na/ pha wang gis kha nub ngos kyi ri rtser gtad nas nyi 'od 'char rgyur bltas nas bsdad/ nyi ma'i 'od zer thog ma 'phros ma thag nus phyogs kyi ri rtser nyi mdangs ser lhag ger phog pa dang pha wang gis skad chen po zhig brgyab ste/ nyi ma dgos na ya gir 'dug ces bstan pa na bya thams cad kha nub la bltas so/ / pha wang gis de ni nyi mdangs ma gtogs nyi ma ngo ma ma red zer yong snyam 109

nas lam seng kha shar la slog ma thag nyi ma shar phyogs kyi ri rtse nas 'char bas yang khos skad de bas kyang che ba zhig brgyab ste/ ngo ma dgos na ya gir 'dug ces dngos su bsta na pa red zer ba las mched pa yin no / /14 byang mkhan a ma ltogs grir mi shi/ sems sdug gis shi/gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs ni/ de snga bod lo'i lo gsar tshes gnyis nyin gyi zhogs pa rtse pho brang bde yangs shar gyi thog kha nas/ rdo ring nang ma'i bar 'breng thag gi thog shing gi sga chung zhig sbo 'og tu btags te mgo bo thur du gtad nas 8 byang mkhan thag bzhud ces pa gtong srol yod pa de ni sde pa gtsang pa pham par byas te mthar sne'u rdzong gi rtse nas chur bskyur btang ba'i mtshon byed cig yin par grags shing /byang mkhan 'khri khungs ni gtsang khul shab gdong sna ba'i mi ser la 'khri ba ltar byang mkhan gyi khyim tshang la 8 byang chag’ rkang gcig gi sa zhing la phyi nang gi khral rigs gang yang mi 'khri bar bza' rgyu yod pas byang ra/khacha gyi a ma ltogs grir shi dogs med na yang / rang gi bu'i srog la nyen kha ha cang che ba'i sems nad sangs dus med pa des shi nyen yod ces pa las dpe de byung bar grags so/ /15 mar dkrog phul nas dgongs pa zhu/ zhes pa ni/ thog mar bya ba 'ig sgrub rgyur rang gis khas len byas na'ang / gnas tshul 'gyur ldog byung ba'am/ yang na bsam zhib nan tan byas pa'i mjug tu bsgrub rgyu'i bya ba de phyir bshol gyis mi bsgrub rgyu'i brda mtshon la spyod pa yin/ de yang dmangs khrod kyi ngag sgrung las 'di skad thos te/ snga 410

dus su ban de zhig la sgo phyugs ba mo gcig rang yod pa de brlags nas ri klung gang sar 'tshol du song song ba las ma rnyed cing / kho thang chad pa dang kha skom grod pa ltogs nas ci bya gtol med du gyur to/ mdun phyogs su blta skabs thag ring gi sa na mi tshang chen po zhig yod pa mthong bas de la kha gtad nas song ba las/ khyim tshang de'i sgo 'gram nas/u lags zhes skad brgyab nas bos pa na/ sge khung zhig nas a ma bag dro ba ske la lba ba chen po yod pa zhig gis bltas nas/ ci byed zer bar kho pa gang shod 'di shod med par/ lba bcos gnang e dgos zhes bshad/ khyim tshang de ni 'byor pa ldan pa zhig yin la/ a ma de yang dang dod che ba zhig yod stabs rab tu dga' ste/ lba bcos byed dgos yod/ em chi lags mgyogs po yar phebs rogs gnang zer nas nang du gdan drangs/ kho la bza' btung gi sne len gzab cing rgyas pa byas/ khos bza' btung la tshim par longs spyod bzhin du lba bcos kyi 'go 'dzugs stangs dang / lhag par mjug ji ltar bsdu rgyu'i skor la bsam blo yang yang btang / de nas a ma des/ lba bcos gnang bar yo chas gang dang gang dgos zer bar/ khos stabs bde po yin/ chu dkar yol gang dang / sbra snam lheb pa gcig byung na 'grig ces smras pa ltar de dag 'khyer yong / a ma de'i mgo bo kho rang gi pang du bzhag nas nyal bcug sbra tshal lteb pa de chu la sbangs te lba ba'i thog 'phur 'phur btang zhing yang yang chu la sbong gan 'phur brdar byas pa na/ lba ba'i mdog dmar skyar gyur zhing tsha zug je cher phyin bzod sran mi thub 411

tsam byung bas bud med des/ khyed kyis lba bcos ji tsam gnang myong ngam zhes dris par khos mang po byed ma myong / mi gnyis la byas pa yin zer bar mos/ khong tsho gang 'dra byung song ngam zhes dris nga ra khos/mi gcig ni shi song / gzhan de ni dgongs pa zhus song zer/ yang snying lba bcos byas nas drag pa gcig kyang byung med pas mo yang skrag ste/dgongs pa zhu na ci 'dra bya dgos zer bar khos/ las sla po yin/dgongs pa zhu dus mar dkrog gcig phul na de gas 'grig ces bshad/mos 'o na nga yang dgongs pa zhu rgyu yin zhes yar langs te kho la mar dkrog gcig phul nas dgongs pa zhus so zhes pa'i sgrung las mched pa yin zhing / skabs re sna mar dgrog 'bul rgyu yin zhes brjod mkhan yang yod de go don ni gcig mtshungs yin no/ /16 mi dkar por zhwa nag po/ dpe 'di lo rgyus thog sa skya 'phags pa rin po che sku gshegs khar nye gnas che mos/ dpon chen nam mkha' bzang pos bla ma 'phags par ngo log byed kyi 'dug ces yon gong ma hu be lir snyan phra zhus rkyen dmag sam gha dpung bcas bod du mngags te/ pa rnam bya rog rdzod phab nas dpon chen la srog khrims gcod skabs/ khong gis gos dkar gtsang zhig gi thog zhwa nag po gcig gyon nas gsod rar phyin tshul deb ther nang gsal yod pa de las mched skad/17 mi nag can yer pa'i brag phug na 'dug kyang / nga spyo thug la sger tshwa mi rgyag ces pa'i dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs ni dmangs 412

khrod kyi bshad srol la/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes btsan po glang dar mar lkog mda' 'phangs nas bkrongs pa'i rjes su/ gsang thabs sna tshogs spyad nas yer pa'i sgrub khang du bros te yibs bzhugs skabs/'ded mi rnams kyis rjes ma non par bzung ma thub kyang / yer pa'i ri steng du lug 'tsho ba'i rdzi bo zhig gis lha lung dpal rdor brel brel 'tshab 'tshub ngang ri gsham nas 'dzegs shing / brag phug nang 'dzul ba mthong ste ci yin dogs pa za nas myur bar brag phug nang phyin thogakhong gi brang khar lag pa sbyar skabs snying rtsa lug gu lding lding 'phag pa tshor yang cang mi smra bar phyir thon/ de nas btsan po gsod mkhan bros nas ma zin pa'i gtam thos dus/ khos/ ‘6mi nag can yer pa'i brag phug na 'dug kyang / nga spyi thug la sger tshwa mi rgyag ’ ces chig lab brgyab pa las mched pa yin zer ro/ /1ra mo ston phag mgo zhes pa ni/ zog brdzu can nam/bsnyon 'dzugs mkhan zer bar spyod pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin zhing /byed mi rung zhis pa'am/ min nam zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun te bsgyur na chog gtam dpe de'i 'byung khungs kyang 〈〈ro sgrung 〉〉gi le tshan 'ig las 'phros pa yin/ de yang 'di skad thos te/ gna' snga mo grong tsho chung ngu zhig na/ bud med grung po gcig la khyo bo le lo can sked ra gas kyang 'ching bar khyim nang kho nar nyal sdod pa zhig yod/ bud med nges/ pho khyo kha nyal na mda' mgo shor/ mda' mgo shor na dgra mgo langs/ dman bud med nyal na phang mgo shor/ phang mgo shor 413

na gyon gos hrul/ zer ba yin pas pho khyo kha phyir thon na nom pa yong srid pas de ring cis kyang phyir song dang zhes bskul ma byas pas/ kho khyim nas thon te ri gsham la 'gro ba'i dus/ 'brog pa skyas spos pa'i shul nas bya rog cig gis thur rdar zhig rnyed pa 'khyer nas 'phur yong ba ljid ma theg par lhungs pa kho'i mdun phyogs zags/ de bsgrugs te za zlas bshad pa de la rgyu mtshan 'dug snyam/ khyim du log nas za zla la/pho khyo kha phyi la thon na nom pa lon thag chod yin 'dug khyod kyis rta bzang po gcig dang / khyi bzang po zhig grabs gyis nga thag ring sar 'gro rgyu yin zhes bshad pa ltar mos chas rnams 'thus tshang bsgrigs zin pa dang / khos rta la bzhon/ khyi de khrid song ba las/ lung stong zhig tu slebs pa na wa mo gcig 'gro ba mthong bas de la khyi rbad cing /de'i rjes su rta rgyugs nas phyin/ wa mo de khung gcig tu 'dzul lo/kho der 'byor pa dang rta las babs te khyi de rta'i thur thag la btasas/zhwa mo phud de 'dzul khung gi kha bkag rang gi gos thung ma gtogs gyon chas rnams phud de sga thog bsdams/ rdo leb cig spyad nas wa chang brkos pa na/ wa mo de sdod ma phod par khung nas thon pas kho'i zhwa mo de mgo la thogs bzhin bros pa dang / de'i rjes su khyis 'ded pas rta yang mnyam du rgyugs nas la lung brgal ba na/ kho rang stod hreng mar lus/ da nam pa par bzhag rta dang gyon chas kyang med nga/ra yu la du log na ngo yang tsha snyam te/ rta khyi rgyugs sa'i phyogs su/ phyin/ la zhig/ 'dzegs pa'i la rtse nas mar blta skabs/ rgyal po'i pho brang chen po zhig 414

mthong de la kha gtad song ba na rim bzhin nyi ma nub cing sa yang rub/kho stod hreng ma yin pas 'khyags shing 'dar nas rgyal po'i phag tshang gi gyang la 'dzegs nas de nub phag pa dang mnyam du nyal bas dro bar byung yang / phag mo a ma zhig gis mchu 'bud yang yang brgyab ste nyal ma/ bcug pas de la khong khro chen po skyes/ sang zhogs nam langs nyi ma shar dus khos phag tshang gi rtsig srub nas phar blta dus/ rgyal po'i sras mo sgo ra'i nang 'cham bskor byas nas phar 'gro skabs ske nas g.yu zhig thag pa chad de zags pa mthong / khos de la bltas nas sdod skabs ba rdzi bas ba phyugs rnams chu 'thung bar 'ded yong zhing / ba mo zhig gis tag tag g.yu de'i steng du lci ba zhig btang ba mthong / khos mu mthud nas blta gin bsdad pa na/ yud tsam nas rgyal po'i bran mo zhig 'ongs te lci ba de yar bsgrugs nas gyang ldebs la sbyar nas lag pas bcag bcag 'ga' byas te phar song / khos lci sgor de la ngo rtags nan tan brgyab ste phag tshang nas phyir thon srang lam du zhugs so/ /tsha rting khar slebs dus mi mang po rug tshogs byed pa'i sar kho yang song /rgyal po'i blon po zhig gis skad chen pos/ da nang rgyal po'i sras mo'i mgul nas rgyal po'i bla g.yu 'od can bor brlag song 'dug pa su la rnyed kyang bya dga' blo 'dod gang ba zhig gnang rgyu yin zhes yang yang sgrog pa na/ khos mi tshogs kyi gseb nas thon te/ ngas mo 'debs shes pas phal cher rnyed thub/ 'on kyang bya dga' 'dod pa khengs pa zhig gnang e thub ces bshad par blon po des/ rgyal po'i bla g.yu rnyed 415

na/ bya dga' khyed kyis gang gsungs yongs rdzogs 'bul rgyu khas len zhu chog mo 'phya gnang rgyur dgos cha gang yod gsung rogs zer zheng /rgyal por yang snyan gseng zhus/ khos dgos char phag tshang nang gi phag mo a ma 'di'i mgo bo byung na de gas 'grig ces bshad/ de 'phral kho la dar zab kyi zhwa gos lham sogs cha tshang dang / phag mo de bsad pa'i mgo bo bcas sprad de rgyal po'i drung du khrid/ khos yul de'i mi tshang ma rgyal po'i sgo ra'i nang bskongs bcug phag mgo de la shing gi yu ba zhig bcos/ de dar tshon gyis dkris nas lag tu thogs te mi tshogs kyi khrod du phyin nas/ phag mgo mi la 'dzugs gin du kha nas/ 'di la med na 'di la yod zer bzhin bskor ba na/ phag mgo 'dzugs rgyur bsdad pa'i mi rnams su la khag btsugs yong snyam shin tu skrag mi tshogs rdzogs zin mtshams skya ldebs kyi lci ba rnams la de ltar brjod bzhin phag mgo btsugs mthar/ g.yu yod pa'i lci sgor de la phag mgo btsugs te/'di la yod ces mtshams bzhag nas lci sgor mar blangs pa'i nang nas rgyal po'i bla g.yu 'od can de blangs nas phul bas thams cad ha las te kho la mo ston phag mgo mngon shes can zhes snyan grags kun tu khyab/rgyal pos/ da bya dga' ci 'dod dris par/ khos wa zhwa gyon dang /khyi rta khrid bcas dgos zer/ de gang yin dris par/ sngar kho rang gi brlag song ba rnams cha tshang dgos zhes bshad pa rnams de bzhin du sprad/blon po 'khor dang bcas pas kho rang gi khyim du bskyal/ khyim thabs la sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams bshad pas mos rgyal po'i bla g.yu tsam btsal bar 416

bya dga' des ga la tshad zer nas/ yi ge zhig bris nas de snga'i dgos cha rnams ni rgyal po'i sku gegs sel byed kyi lto bcos yin/ bla g.yu btsal ba'i bya dga' rgyal po rang gis thugs rje ma chung ba zhig gnang dgos zhes bskur ba na/ rgyal blon rnams gros byas nas de los bden zer nas slar yang gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs pa'i rgyu nor dang /gnag rta lug gsum la sogs pa'i sgo phyugs bcas gnang bas khong gnyis dbul ba dang bral nas bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba la rol ba sogs kyi sgrung gtam de las byung ba yin no/ /19 mon yul rdor gcod/ ces pa 'di ni a mdo'i khul du grags pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/ dpe 'di'i yong stangs ni/ sngon lho phyogs mon gyi yul du chos dpe rdo rje gcod pa bris ma tshar gsum yod/rang rloms can gyi mi 'ga' zhig gis dpe de gsum gyi tshig sbyor mi 'dra bar mthong nas tshar gsum po de phan tshun zhib bsdur byed skabs tshar gnyis kyi tshig sbyor 'dra zhing / gcig shos de mi 'dra ba mang bas de nyid mi dag par bsams nas chu la bskyur ro/ / don dngos ni mi dag par bsam nas chu la bskyur ba de ni yang dag pa yin la/ dag pa yin par rtsis nas nyar ba de gnyis nang nor ba shin tu mang po yod/der brten gtam dpe 'di dper na yi ge sogs dag pa dang mi dag pa go ldog nas nor 'khrul rgyun 'byams su gyur pa'i don mtshon par byed pa'i dper 'dren pa yin no/ /20 ci ci ma mad kha mthun nas/ zhi mi'i ske la g.yer kha 417

btags/ zhes pa ni/ mi 'ga' shas lkog tu kha sgril nas/ zur 'bud byas song zer ba'am/ byas byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang /gtam dpe 'di yang sgrung gtam zhig las chad pa yin/ de yang 'di skad thos te/ sngon bas mtha' zhig na tsher phung chen pos khyab pa'i sa char byi ba mang po zhig 'tsho zhing gnas yod/ phyogs der byi la rgad po gcig 'khyams pa las kho ni na rgas rtsal shugs nyams nas/ byi'u dang byi ba sogs gsod pa'i nus pa med par lto chas rnyed dka' ba na/khos g.yo sgyu bshams nas sa khug cig tu mig tsu'i ste tsog bur yun ring bsdad pa'i nye 'dabs su byi ba mang po phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed kyang /khos nyams snang ci yang med par sgul tsam mi byed par gnas pa na/byi ba sems bzang ba zhig gis kho dang cung nye sar phyin nas/ khyed ci nyes sam zhes dris pa na/ khos nga ni zhi mi brgya la sgom chen gcig bya ba de yin/ nga skyes pa nas srog gcod ma myong la/ tshe gcig la sha za ma myong / zas ni la phug gi rtsa ba sogs kyis 'tsho ba yin zhes bshad/byi ba de yid ches la ma ches kyis phyir log nas byi ba gzhan rnams la bshad pas kho tshos nyams sad byas kyang / khos sgul tsam ma byas stabs yid ches nas byi ba mang po 'dus nas kho slob dpon du bskos/ nyin rer snga dro dang / nyin dgung / phyi dro bcas dus gsum la slob dpon der skor ba thengs re byed du bcug byi ba rnams star sgrig nas skor ba byed dus mjug shos de khos bzung nas zos pas nyin rer byi ba gsum re nyung du 'gro bar brten dus yun gang 'tshams song dus byi ba 418

rnams dogs pa skyes nas lkog tu gros byed skabs/ byi ba blo gsal ba ra 'bel zer ba zhig gis bdag gi mdzod phug na g.yer kha chung ngu zhig yod pa de slob dpon gyi ske la btags nas sgra byung na tshang mas blta dgos zer bar gros 'cham/ kho tshos g.yer kha de la thag lung zhig bcos te slob dpon la bdag cag gis mgul rgyan zhig 'bul rgyu yin zhes phul ba'i tshe khos spobs pa dang bcas ske brkyangs nas bdag gir blangs/ nyin de'i phyi dro skor ba bskor skabs byi ba rnams mjug rdzogs pa dang dus mnyam du g.yer kha'i sgra zhig sing zhes grags ma thag byi ba tshang mas phyir bltas slog pa'i skabs slob dpon gyi kha na byi ba mjug shos a 'bel zer ba de bzung yod pa mthong bas/ ra 'bel na re/64a 'bel de bzhin gshegs lugs kyis/ ra 'bel nga yang de ga'i rgyu/’ ('di yang gtam dper spyod pa thos )slob dpon ma bzhugs slob dpon gshegs/ zer zhing byi ba rnams tsher khung gi sa 'og tu 'dzul bas byi la g.yo sgyu can de yang ring por ma thogs pa ltogs grir 'chi'o zhes grags pa las chad pa yin no/ /21 wa skyes rgyal po wa la sdang / zhes pa ni mi rigs sam/pha yul/ rim gras/ las rigs sogs gang rung gcig pa yin pa'i mi la dbang 'dzin thob na/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rigs la gzhan las sdang zug che ba 'dug zer ba'i dpe la spyod pa yin/ gtam dpe 'di 'byung ba'i khungs kyang sgrung gtam zhig yin/ de yang 'di skad thos te/gna' snga mo wa skyes shig zas 'tshol ba'i don du gang sar nyul zhing 419

'khyams pa na/ nam zhig tshos mkhan gyi ram tshos zom gang bsnyal ba'i zom nang du lhungs/ 'gre ldog yang yang brgyab pa'i mthar de las thon pa na kho'i spu mdog zar ma'i me tog ltar sngo skya yid du 'ong ba zhig tu gyur/dus der gcan gzan rnams thams cad phyogs gcig tu 'dus te rgyal po bsko ba'i gros byed pa'i skabs/ kha cig na re/ sems can gzhan dang mi 'dra ba khyod kyi ming la ci zer zhes dris par/ nga ni srog chags dbyig bya ba de yin smras/ mdog bzang la ming yang snyan pas 'di rgyal por bsko na 'thad zer bar kha 'cham nas kho rgyal por mnga' gsol/seng gis de'i blon po byas te 'gro ba'i dus su seng ge la zhon te 'gro/kho khengs dregs nga rgyal je cher gyur zhing / khyad par rang gi rigs gcig pa'i wa rnams la shin tu sdang zhing gtses par byas pa na/ wa rnams lkog tu gros byas te rgyal po 'di spu mdog tsam las 'dra ba ni rang cag gi rigs dang 'dra bas tshod 'gam par bya'o zer/ srog chags wa'i rigs ni gal te gcig brgyal ba mthong na/ gzhan rnams kyang rang dbang med par brgyal ba yin pas tshes bco lnga'i nyin rang re rnams rgyal po'i gam du 'dus te brgyal bar bya zer 'cham mo/ / dus la babs pa na de ltar byas pa'i tshe kho yang rang tshugs ma thub par brgyal par gyur pas gcan gzan rnams kyis kho la dmod cing / seng ge la gnas lugs rnams bshad stabs de nyid du bsad par grags pa las mched pa yin/ 〈〈sa skya legs bshad 〉〉las kyang / 8 blun po bya ba la sbyar na/ don nyams rang yang nyams par 'gyur/ wa skyes rgyal por 420

bskos pa yis/ 'khor sdug rang yang bsad ces grags/’ zhes dmangs khrod kyi gtam rgyud de bed spyod gnang yod do/ /22 zha lur byung ba de/ chong 'dus su bskyal/ zhes pa de gtsang khul gyi gtam dpe zhig yin/ de'i 'byung stangs ni gtsang gi zha lu dgon par bu ston rin chen grub bzhugs pa'i skabs su snyan grags shin tu che bas phyogs mtha' dag nas bsnyen bkur zhu mkhan nyicha ltar 4sprin bzhin 'du bas/ dgon pa der ser mo ba smos ci tha na sprang po zhig phyin na'ang mchod sbyin gyi skal ba gya nom pa re tshang mar rag gin yod/ de dang nye ba'i tshong 'dus mgur mo ni skabs der tshong ra rgyas shing / ja chang longs spyod dang rgyan po 'gyed pa sogs 'khrug cha ha cang che bas skye bo phal mo che 'du 'dzi 'dod yon la g.yeng ste rang la ci bdog pa'i dngos zong rnams yud tsam la longs spyad zin gyi yod par brten gtam dpe de ltar byung bar grags so/ /2 2 ri bong cal 'drog ces pa ni gnas tshul dngos sam/rgyu mtshan ma rtogs pa dang / brtag dpyad zhib 'jug ci yang ma byas par mi gzhan gyis zer rjes su mtha' gcig tu 'brangs nas 'drog mgo langs pa'am/ hol rgyug byed pa la spyod pa yin zhing / ma byed zer ba'am/ yin srid zer ba sogs tshig grogs skabs bstun bsgyur dgos/ gtam dpe de'i 'byung khungs kyang sngar gyi gtam rgyud las/'di skad thos te/ sngon chu 'gram zhig na ri bong zhig rtsa za bzhin yod pa dang nye ba'i phyogs su/ shing gi yal ga zhig rlung gis bskul nas chu 421

la lhungs te cal zhes sgra grag pa na/ ri bong de shin tu skrag ste bros pa las/ ri bong gzhan rnams kyis ci 'dug zer/ khos cal slebs byung smras pas kun kyang skrag nas bros/ lam bar du wa skyes dang ce spyang la sogs pas dris par yang gong bzhin lan btab pas kun kyang bros/ de bzhin du spyang ki dang / dom dred/ stag gzig glang po che la sogs pas kyang dris par gong ltar smras pas thams cad bros/mthar seng ge dang 'phrad des dris par lan btab pas phar tsam bros te ri bong de la/ cal zhes pa ci zhig yin dris par/ des de 'byung yul bstan rgyu yod zer/ thams cad sngar gyi byung shul blta bar song bas na/ chu'i nang du shing gi yal ga zhig lhungs 'dug pa mthong bas/ri bong des/ 'di lags so zhes smras par grags pa'i gtam rgyud de las 'phros pa yin no/ /24 la mo dang dod pa'i rta pa/ zhes pa ni lha sa khul gyi gtam dpe zhig yin/ dga' ldan pho brang par bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang thob rjes lha ldan smon lam che mor rjes 'brel gtor rgyag sogs su bod sog gi 'go pa rnams la las tshan che chung dpags pa'i smon lam rta pa'i kha grangs gtan 'bebs kyi khral 'gel byas pa las/ dgon sde dang bla brang sogs chos phyogs par khral de bkal med/ 'on kyang la mo bla brang nas ma bskul dang blangs kyis smon lam rta pa bcu gsum gzab mchor dang bcas ru bstar nang zhugs su bcug sa gnas srid gzhung rnying pas smon lam rta pa'i tho gzhung 'god skabs go rim ltar dpon rigs so 422

so'i go ming dang rta pa'i kha grangs re re bzhin bkod pa'i nang sna la mo dang dod pa'i rta pa bcu gsum ’ zhes 'khod par brten de nas bzung lo ltar gtan 'jags kyi khral du gyur pa de las mched pa yin no/ / 25 sog po'i las la/ bsod nams chos 'phel mkhas/zhes dbus khul du grags pa'i gtam dpe 'di'i byung stangs ni/ tā la'i bla ma lnga pa'i skabs kyi sde srid dang po bsod nams chos 'phel la zer ba yin zhing / khong dang thog tā la'i bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i (sog po se chen chos khur gyi sras yin ) skabs kyi zhabs gras yin pa dang / skabs der kurma bka' brgyud pa'i rgyab rtsa gtsang pa sde pas byas te dge lugs par sdang zug 'go gnon tshabs chen byas rkyen nad ma theg par skyid shod sde pa bsod nams rnam rgyal sogs kyis sog po khal kha cho khur dpon po la skyabs bcol nas/ 1618bod sa rta lor sog dmag dang se 'bras kyi ser dmag sogs mnyam sdebs kyis gtsang pa sde par phar rgol byas kyang / gtsang dmag 'bor chen dbus su drangs stabs sog pos kyang 'phra ma zin par sog yul du phyir 'then byas skabs phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel dang / skyid shod sde pa g.yul rgyal sogs kyang sog dmag mnyam du bros phebs dgos byung ba bcas snga rjes su sog po dang 'brel 'dris che la sog skad kyang mkhyen pa dang / de rjes tā la'i bla ma lnga pa dang sog po o rod go shri khang mchod du 'brel zhing / go shri khang gis sog dmag thog ma khams su drangs te be ri dpon tshar bcad pa'i rjes/ phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel 423

gyis mi sna dge bsnyen don grub zer ba ched mngags kyis go shri khang la gtsang par dmag rgyag dgos zhes bskul ma btang bar brten sog dmag khams nas byang brgyud gzhis ka rtser drangs shing / de dus 'dam du phyag mdzod rang ngo phebs kyis 'thab jus skor go shri dang nang mol gnang ste dbus dmag 'du 'god sogs gnang / mthar dge sog g.yul las rgyal nas srid dbang tshur blangs rjes go shri khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis lo bcu grangs sde srid gnang ba sogs khong la sog po dang 'brel ba byed thabs kyi nyams myong dang thabs lam byang chub pa zhig yod pa'i skad grags chod par brten/ 8 sog po'i las 'a bsod nams chos 'phel mkhas nya zer ba'i dpe 'di de nas byung ba yin zhes rgan rabs kyi zhal las dngos su thos so/ /26 lha lung dpal rdor ri la bros kyang / rta pho'i zhabs rjes thang la lus/ zhes pa ni/ bya ba mi 'tshams pa zhig byas nas de 'gebs thabs byas na'ang / rjes shu'/ gyi ra sprod gsal po yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ gtam dpe de'i 'byung rtsa ni/ bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther mang po'i nang / btsan po glang dar mas bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs pa dang / de la brten nas lha lung dpal rdor gyis mda' 'phangs te btsan po bkrongs shing / rta dkar po la sol phye byugs pa dang / ber phyi nag nang dkar byas pa gyon nas skyid chu gtsang chur lteb nyal gyis brgal ber phyi nang slog ste yer par bros shing /brag phug nang bya phug ron glod nas thal rdul phab nas mi rnams rmongs 424

su bcug pa'i gtam rgyud bshad rgyun gsal ba ltar mtha' ma rdzun phug rdol 'a/ nye ba na/ mdo smad du bros pa bcas kyi lo rgyus las chad pa zhig yi na no/ /27 a khu ston pa/ sa nas sa la zags rgyu med/ gong du gsal ba ltar sngar sa gnas srid gzhung rnying pa'i skabs lo gsar tshes gnyis nyin ‘‘byang mkhan thag bzhud ’ ces rtsed srol de rjes su mgo rting slog nas thur du babs pa de rten 'brel mi legs zhes shing la gyen 'dzeg bya rgyur bsgyur/ lo ltar zhol rdo ring nang mar gdung shing ring po zhig btsugs par phyogs bzhir thag pa btags te byang mkhan pas shar phyogs kyi thag pa nas shing rtser 'dzegs pa dang / rtsal slob dge rgan la ‘4a khu ston pa ’ zer zhing / khos shing gi rtsa 'gram du langs bsdad nas byang mkhan par/ lha 'bod/ lha gsol dang / rgod po'i lding bskor/ pho rog gshog sgyur sogs rtsal rtsed 'di 'dra dang de 'dra byed dgos zhes bkod 'doms byed kyi yod/ kho pa sa thog tu phar 'phag tshur 'phag byed rung zags dogs kyi nyen kha gang yang med pa las dpe de mched par grags so/ /28 a khu med na med thabs med/ a khu yod na yod thabs med/ ces pa de ni mi mi shes rgu shes dang / mi dran rgu dran mang ba la la skabs re phan thogs pa dang / skabs re rtsod gzhi dang rnyod dra slong mkhan de 'drar spyod pa yin/ gtam dpe 'di yang gling ge sar sgrung nang gi a khu khro thung zer ba de las 'phros pa ste/ gling sgrung nang skabs 425

'gar mthu gtad/ gzor phan sogs dgos dus khrophung med na mi 'grig pa lta bu dang / yang skabs re dgra bor mgo sgur dang / nang gtam phyir skyel/ dgra dang ngan 'brel sogs byas nas dmag 'khrug la gnod pa tshabs chen skyel ba dang / nang khul la dkrug shing dbyen sbyor ram 'khrug rkyen slong ba sogs yod na mi 'grig pa lta bu sgrung gtam mang po'i nang yod pas gnas lugs de dang sbyar nas shod rgyun de byung ba yin no/ /29 a khus btang btang mang la/ shor shor mang / zhes pa ni rtag tu sbor shob kho na shod rgyur dga' ba'i mi/ ngas btang dang ngas 'jon zer na yang don dngos dang 'phrad dus 'jon thang ci yeng med mkhan gyi rigs la 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa zhig yin/ de'i 'byung khungs kyang bod dmangs khrod kyi rig rtsal gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi nang / a khu khro thung zer ba'i mi sna zhig yod/ khos nam yin rung rang la blo khog dang dpa' rtsal sogs gang min tshad yod tshul gyi kha pho chen po bshad yod kyang / don dngos la dgra bo dang dngos su thug dus rtag par pham bros sam/ zhabs 'dren zhus pa'i lo rgyus mang po 'khod yod pa de dang sbyar nas byung ba'i gtam dpe zhig yin/ de skor rang res ha lam gling ge sar gyi sgrung dpe gang zhig klog pa'am yang na nyan pa tsam gyis lam seng shes thub pas 'dir zhib cha'i mtshon tshul 'bri dgos don med pas de tsar/ gyis 'thus pa byas/20 a nes btsugs pa'i zam par/ a ne rang 'gro dgos/426

zhes pa'i gtam/ dpe 'di'i 'byung gzhi ni/ rje btsun mi la ras pa yum sras la yab sku ga'egs pa'i rjes su a khu dang / a nes sdug po yod tshad btang nas rgyu nor yongs rdzogs btsan bzung byas pa bcas la brten yum myang tsha skar rgyan gyis bka' mengags ltar mthu slob tu byon te/a khu g.yung rgyal gyi bu la mna' ma len skabs mthu mdzad nas mi mang po rdib 'og tu bkum pa dang / yul la ser ba 'bebs pa sogs gnang bar thugs 'byung nas mar pa lo tsā'i drung du dka' spyad tshogs bsags dpag med mdzad mthar gdams pa nod cing / sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad nas grub pa thob pa ma zad/ rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pa'i snyan grags kun tu khyab pa'i skabs a ne bdud mo stag 'gran yang rang gis nyes byas la 'gyod pa drag po skyes te/ rje btsun gang du bzhugs yod brtsad bcad de 'bul ba dang sbrags bzod gsol zhu bar 'ongs shing /rje btsun la stod drin gyi skyid phug bya bar bzhugs yod/ sgrub phug dang brag 'phrang gi bar du g.yang gzar pos chod pa la shing gdung leb rkang gcig gis zam pa zhig yod/ de dus rje btsun gyi sring mo pe ta mgon skyid kyang bsod snyoms byas nas byung ba'i bza' ma nyung zas shig bla mar 'bul du 'ongs nas de gar lhan du yod/ pe tas a ne yong ba mthong nas ngo shes gdung zam de tshur 'then pa na/ a nes brag 'phrang kha nas phyag 'tshal sngar byas nyes mtshang 'gyod bshags phul bar rje btsun yang der phebs te/ a ner khrel 'debs kyi mgur bzhes shing / pe tar zhal ta gnang nas gdung zam btsugs te mjal 'phrad dang bsnyen 427

bkur rnams bzhes nas gdams pa gnang ba sogs kyi lo rgyus zhib pa 〈〈mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur 〉〉mtsho sngon lcags par ma'i deb ngos 179—183bar du gsal ba ltar de dus pe tas snying tshim btab pa'i bshad srol ltar 66a ne 'gro ba'i zam pa/ a ne rang gis 'dzugs dgos/’ zer ba'am/ yang na ‘6a nes btsugs pa'i zam par/ a ne rang 'gro dgos ’ zhes pa'i dpe 'di dag byung bar grags so/ /21 yo rti'i sked pa bcag yong / zhes pa ni bod dbus khul dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe zhig tu snang / bong bu'i rti'ur o rti'u zer ba bod ljongs dbus khul gyi yul skad cig yin/ gtam dpe de ni bya ba gang zhig legs sgrub yong ba'i gdengs tshod dang cha rkyen sogs med bzhin du dngos su grub zin pa ltar byas nas zhib phra'i khog rtsis 'di 'dra dang / de 'dra zhes rgyag mkhan la 'phya bar spyod pa zhig yin/de yang dmangs khrod kyi sgrung gtam 'di 'dra zhig thos te/ snga dus dbul po pha bu gnyis la sgo phyugs bya de pho mo gnyis las gzhan ci yang med/ phas bshad par/ ngas bya mo 'di'i sgo nga rnams bsags nas bya phrug bsnyal/ de las bya mo mang rab cig thon na slar yang sgo nga bsnyal te sgo nga 'bor chen tshong 'dus su btsong nas dngul mang tsam gsog thub na/ bong mo yag po zhig nyo rgyu yin/ de la pha bong rtse gra zhig sbyor sprad byas na o rti'u yag po gcig skye nges yin/ zhes pa'i tshig mtshams der slebs dus/ bu chung des o rti'u yag po de la nga bzhon rgyu yin zhes dga' spro'i ngang bshad par/ pha rgan hang sangs te skad 428
shugs drag po dang bcas/ de 'dra byas na/ ‘ o rti'i sked pa bcag yong ’ zer bzhin bu la 'gram lcag tsha thag gcod cig gzhus par grags pa'i gtam rgyud de 'dra zhig las chad pa yin no/ / 429

mjug bsdu ba/bod mi rigs kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe rgya mtsho lta bu'i khrod nas bdag blo ku sha'i rtse mos blangs pa'i chu thigs tsam zhig gces btus bgyis thog de dag rigs mi 'dra ba le tshan lnga la phye ste gna' gtam mi re ngo rer tshig gam brjod don gyi 'grel bshad stabs bde re dang /bed spyod bya yul lam byed stangs kyi phyogs ston tsam re yang bris pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi dmangs sgrung dang / lo rgyus/ gtam rgyud kyi bshad tshul sogs dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gtam dpe khag cig gi 'byung khungs dngos sam/ yang na de'i yong stangs sogs rang gis mthong thos byung rigs rnams kyang yig thog thog ma'i phyogs sgrig gang thub bcas byas te/ dmangs srol rig gnas kyi bye brag thun mong ma yin pa 'di nyid mi rabs nas mi rabs su brgyud sprod kyi bya gzhag 'di'i thad la sman pa'i bya ba cung zad tsam zhig byed thub na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam bzang pos kun nas bslangs te gtam mdzod kyi deb chung 'di nyid brtsams pa lags/ 'on kyang rtsom zin mjug bskyar du zhib bsher bgyis skabs dbye ba 'byed phyogs dang / 'grel bshad rgyag stangs 'ga' zhig sogs gang ci'i thad la kho bo rang nyid kyis bltas na yang nor 'khrul dang / zhan cha/ mi 'dang ba ji snyed cig mthong bas 430

bsam thog don 'khel 'dod blo khengs pa zhig da dung byung mi 'dugarang nyid kyi re bsam de rang gis don thog tu skyel ma thub pa de la blo pham dang / yi mug chen po zhig skyes byung na'ang / zhib tu bsam skabs 66dka' ba spyod thengs gcig la sangs mi rgyas ’ zer ba'i dpe ltar brtsam bya zhig la cha mtshon na'ang de lta bu'i stes dbang stabs legs shig ga la yong srid pa gzhi nas ngos 'dzin thob cing / rang gi thog ma'i bsam blo gtong phyogs de ni ru shes byas mun rub/ 'dod pas nam langs ’ zer ba'i dpe ltar gyur 'dug snyam nas rang gi brtsam bya de legs grub cha tshang ba zhig ma byung ba'i rgyu rkyen la bsam zhib bgyis pa yin/ rgyu'i gtso bo ni kho bo rang rnam 'byed shes rab kyi dbang po rab tu rtul bas bstan bcos gsar du rtsom pa'i cha rkyen mi 'dang ba dang gcig bod kyi gtam dpe rgya che la gting zab pa 'di lta bur da phan rigs dbye ba dang / tshig don 'grel bshad/ bed spyod bya yul dang byed stangs la sogs yig thog 'khod pa'i dpe gzhi rigs rtsa ba nas med pa dang gnyis/ rang nyid bgrang bya bcu phrag bdun dang nyag ma bzhi'i thog son stabs dngos po'i chos nyid ltar mig dang / rna ba/ bsam blo'i dbang shes sogs nyams rgud du gyur pa dang gsum/ 'phral gyi rkyen ni bdag rang 'jig rten 'di dang ring por mi thogs pa kha 'bral rgyur mngon du phyogs pas tshe lhag a bra'i gzhu gu tsam 'di'i ring la brtsam bya 'di nyid kyi mjug sgril thub pa zhig e yong snyam pa'i sems 'tshab kyis ded nas zhib bsher bskyar bcos nan tan bya rgyu ma 'dang ba 431

dang bzhi bcas la thug 'dug snyam/ nor skyon gtso bo ni gtam dpe rigs 'byed stangs phar 'dres tshur 'dres mang ba dang / tha na gtam dpe 'ga' shas rigs gang gi khongs su'ang mi gtogs pa/ la la 'grel bshad rgyag stangs kyi dbang gis rigs gnyis sam gsum sogs gang du 'then rung chog pa lta bu/ lhag par 'grel bshad 'ga' zhig gnad du ma 'khel ba dang / gtam dpe'i sgyu rtsal yongs su rdzogs pa mtshon ma thub pa/ 'grel bshad dam dper brjod byas rigs phyogs re ba'i rang bzhin shas che ba la sogs pa de dang de 'dra'i nor 'khrul dang zhan cha mi nyung ba zhig mthong zhing / de dag gi khrod nas rang nus kyis chad mthud dang yo srong thub rigs rnams ‘6bong bu'i nang cha khrom la ma bton gong ’ du ‘6zhi mi'i gcin par thal ba 'gebs ’ pa'i dpe bzhin rang gi snyan grags la gnod pa phog dogs kyis bzo tsam bcos tsam byas te shul ngan mi mngon par bya ba'i thabs lam de yang rmong sa rgan bdag 'dra bar dgos pa che rigs ma mthong ba ma zad/ ma 'ongs pa'i blo gsal rnams la blo skyed gsar pa thon rgyur yang phan pa ma mchis par brten/ thengs 'dir kho bo rang gis rtsom sgrig thog ma byed ring ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa/ rang snang bden rloms dang tod rgyugs gya tshom la brten pa/ nan tan gyis zhib bsher dang bskyar bcos bya rgyu ma 'dang ba sogs la brten nas nor 'khrul dang ma 'grig pa yongs rdzogs thog ma'i gtan 'bebs ji ma ji bzhin rang babs su bzhag thog kho bo rang gis shes tshod kyi khrod nas bskyar bcos dgos 432

rigs cung gal che ba rnams ma deb kyi gtam dpe so so'i 'gor rtags ོ 'di 'dra ba re btab ste klog pa po rnams la rigs phye nor ram yang na 'grel bshad gang rung la nor 'khrul shor yod pa'i sngon brda zhig bkod yod cing / de dag so so'i nor bcos sam yang na gsal bshad bskyar ma rnams ma deb kyi go rim gzhir bzung bsgrigs pa'i 〈〈gtam mdzod kyi g.ya' sel 〉〉bya ba'i rang mtshang rang 'don gyi brjed byang zhig deb ther 'di rang gi gsham sdebs sbyar du 'god rgyu yin/ de ltar byas na yas mas bsdur nas dpyad zhib byed pa brgyud gang zhig nor ba yin pa dang / ji ltar nor ba/ nor ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin sogs tshang mas gsal rtogs thub rgyu ma zad/ dpyad bsdur dang dbye zhib kyi bya rim nang don gnyer can tshos bdag gis ma shes ma rig pa ste dper na/bod kyi gtam dpe'i rigs 'byed thabs de bas yang dag la don dngos dang mthun pa ji snyed cig 'tshol rnyed thub pa dang / kho bos byas pa'i tshig don gyi 'grel bshad dam bed spyod byed stangs skor sogs phal mo cher ma 'grig ma 'thus pa'i skyon cha ji lta ji snyed cig mchis rigs sel thub pa ni gdon mi za zhing / de bas lhag par du gal che ba zhig ni gom pa rim bgrod kyis rgya che la gting dpag dka' ba'i bod dmangs khrod du khyab pa'i gna' bo'i gtam dpe khri 'bum du ma gcig tu 'du ba dang /de dag gi ma tshang ba med pa'i go don zab mo rnams dang yang rtser son pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi kho lag yongs rdzogs bdag gir khong du chud cing /gzhan la spel nus pa'i phul byung gi ched las mkhas can du ma thon te 433
