dmangs khrod kyi gtam tshogs rig gnas 'di'i bang mdzod chen po'i sgo 'phar yangs por 'byed pa'i shes rig gser gyi lde mig cig dngos 'brel rnyed nas/ mthar thug yangs pa'i sa chen po'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi shes rig gi rgya mtsho chen por dal 'bab kyi klung rgyun gsar pa zhig 'dzam gling kun tu khyab spel thub pa'i re ba dang smon 'dun bzang po zhu ba lags so / /434

ཿgtam mdzod la bskyar zhib bgyisapa'igaya'asel/ gong du brtsams mjug bsgril ma thag pa'i gtam mdzod deb ther de'i nang bdag nyid rtsom pa po'i yon tshad kyis ma snyob pa spyi dang / bye brag rang snang hod rgyugs kyi dbang du song nas dgos nges kyi bsam zhib nan tan ma bgyis pa/ 'tshab 'tshub sla bcos dang mgyogs tsam tshar gang bzang byas pa sogs mdor na rtsom pa po zhig la ma mthar yang yod dgos pa'i tshul ldan gyi bsam blo'i spyod tshul bzang po ma tshang ba la brten nas skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig shor 'dug pa rang gis da lta shes tshor thub pa rnams kyi khrod nas/ cung zad gal gnad che ba khag cig mi 'chab mi sbed par rgya che'i gzigs pa4po dag gi spyan sngar bzod gsol zhu ba dang sbrags rang mtshang rang 'don gyis bskyar bcos gsal bshad zhu rgyu'i rtsa ba'i go rim ma deb kyi snga rting gzhir bzung rgyu dang / 'on kyang nang don gcig mtshungs kyi rigs sdebs gcig tu bsgrigs te slar yang zhib 'jug gi dpyad gzhir 'bul rgyu yin/dang po/ gtam dpe rigs mi 'dra ba lnga la phye ba de ni re zhig bdag rang gi thog ma'i rig dpyad dpe ston tsam las/ de la lung rigs kyi rgyab brten khungs 'pher ba zhig phar bzhag tshig sbyor gyi dbye ba tsam la'ang bsam zhib cung cha tshang ba byed thub mi 'dug pa 435

bcas la brten ma 'grig sa dang ma mthun sa ji snyed cig chags pa ni gor ma chag ste/ 'dir dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan pa 'ga' zhig zhu rgyur/1 da lta gsar du dran pa la mtshon rung dper na/ ka ba bzhin du drang dgos/ ka rdo bzhin du brtan dgos/zhes tshad ldan gyi mi'i mtshan nyid tshang dgos par ston pa'i gtam dpe 'dir dpe dang don gnyis ka yod la/ de yang mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgras dngos su zin cing /mtshungs chos drang ba dang brtan pa dngos su bstan pas 〈〈snyan gzhung 〉〉gi dbang du byas na ‘4chos dpe ’ lta bu 'di gras gong du kho bos phye ba'i gtam dpe rigs lnga po gang gi khongs su yang 'jug dka' bas rigs gsar pa zhig 'byed dgos par snang / 'on kyang bdag gis gong gsal le tshan bzhi pa'i ang grangs 20par/ kha khu byug bzhin du snyan/khog gzhu mo bzhin du 'khyog ces pa dang / yang le tshan de rang gi ang grangs 70par gyod mgo ri las che/ gyod gzhug chu las ring / zhes pa/de bzhin le tshan de'i ang grangs 102par/ ngan pa rgyags na shing lasartsub/ bzang po gud pa dar las 'jam/ zhes pa bcas bcug 'dug pa gong gi ‘4chos dpe ’ lta bu'i rigs su gtogs na yang le tshan de'i khongs su bris pa ni rbad de nor yod/ le tshan bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid brjod skabs/ 6 dpe sogs 'khyog brjod kyis ma bslad par phul du byung ba'i tshig sbyor gyis brjod don thad kur ston pa ’ zhes bstan bzhin du mtshungs gsal gyi sgras zin pa'i dpe rgyan mtshungs chos kyang dngos su 436

bstan pa'i gtam dpe 'di 'dra ba thad brjod kyi gras su phye ba 'di thog nas rmongs rgan kho bo'i zir thom gyi tshad gzhi ci 'dra zhig la lhungs yod pa gsal po mtshon mi 'dug gam/ 42 de bzhin yang gsar du dran pa zhig la/ dbyar pha ma 'dra ba de 'byams nas yong / dgun dgra bo 'drab de mchongs nas 'ongs/zhes nam zla'i rje mtshams la sbyar nas bshad pa'i gtam dpe mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgras zin kyang / dpe don gyi dngos po tsam bkod pa'i shugs las/ mtshungs chos dro skyid dang grang zug gis gtses pa sogs dngos su ma bstan na'ang 'dra bar bstan pa 〈〈snyan gzhung 〉〉lugs ltar byas na dngos dpe lta bu'i rigs 'di gras kyang le tshan lnga gang gi khongs su'ang 'jug dka' mod/ 'on kyang bdag gis le tshan bzhi pa'i ang grangs 48par/ khas me 'dra blangs/ thebs chu 'dra bcag zer ba dang / yang le tshan de range gi ang grangs 227par/ mi skyon gram pa'i rdo 'dra/ rang skyon ri bong rwa 'dra/zhes pa lta bu 'di rigs kyang brjod don thad kur ston pa'i gtam dpe'i grangs su bgrangs pa rgad po'i klad pa zo chun mkhyud mo ltar 'khor ba 'di rigs kyang slad phyin dpyad zhib kyis kha skong dang gsab snon gnang 'os mang po yod pa'i dpe mtshon tsam lags so/ /gnyis pa/ gtam dpe sna rigs lnga la phye khul byas pa de rang gi nang gses su'ang phar 'dres tshur 'dres kyi nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig byung 'dug pa tshang ma brjod kyis mi langs kyang / dpe mtshon 'ga' 437

zhig tsam drangs par/1 le tshan gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid brjod pa'i nang / ‘ bod gna' rabs pas dpe mang drangs nas don gcig mtshon par byed pa'i rtsom srol gyi rgyun ltar/ dpe nyis brtseg gis don gcig mtshon par byed pa'i gtam dpe'i gras zhes bdag rang gis bzos pa'i gtan 'bebs gsal po byas yod kyang / le tshan de'i ang grangs 17par/'khar rnga phyi nas rdung / dril bu nang nas dkrol/ zhes bcug pa de ni gcig phyi nas rdung ba dang / gcig nang nas rdung ba gnyis mi 'dra bas na go don yang gcig rang mtshon pa yong mi srid par/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nang zhing bran dbul phongs khyim tshang gi pa pha ni phyi nas khral dang 'u lag gis rdung zhing / a ma ni bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu med pas bu phrug chung chung tsho'i 'khyags ltogs kyi ngu 'bod drag pos nang nas rdung ste bzod glags med ces pa lta bur spyod 'os par mthong ba dang / de bzhin le tshan de rang gi ang grangs 126par/ ri sprug pas bzung ba nyil bar bsam/ stag bsil nyal brgyab pa shi snyam/ zhes pa'i 'grel par yang / 66nyen dogs gang yang mi dgos par blo g.yeng chen po byed pa dang / dngos 'brel gyi nyen kha drag po yod sar lhod g.yeng gi rnam 'gyur 'dzin gyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o ’ zhes 'khod pas rtsa 'grel gang gi thad nas kyang dpe nyis rtseg gis don gcig mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid dang yongs su 'gal bas 'di rigs le tshan dang po'i khongs spo dgos pa sogs de lta bu da dung yod srid par dpyad zhib 438

gnang rgyu'i snyan bskul gyi tshul du bris/2 'khrul gzhi mang ba zhig ni le tshan bzhi pa'i nang byung 'dug snyam pa dper na le tshan de'i ang grangs 61par/ mkhas pa mkhas par sdang / 'phyon ma 'phyon mar sdang / zhes pa dang / yang grangs 62par/ mkhas pas mkhas pa thos/ dpa' bos dpa' bo thos/zhes pa/ le tshan de rang gi ang grangs 94par/ rgyal po rgyal gzhis bzhag nas 'gro/ sprang po ber ka bzhag nas 'gro/ zhes pa/ yang le tshan de'i ang grangs 118par/ chu khar mnyan pas gang bshad/la khar jag pas gang bshad/ ces pa/ yang de ga'i yang grangs 157par/ stod gangs ri nyi mas mi bzhu/ bya rma bya dug gis mi 'chi/zhes pa/ de bzhin ang grangs 221par/ ri mtho na kha ba dbyar yang 'bab/ klung dma' na ljang pa dgun yang skye/ zer ba bcas 'di dag zhib tu dpyod skabs thad brjod kyi khongs su 'god pa'i 'os bab ma che zhing / de bas le tshan gnyis pa dpe nyis rtseg gis don gcig ston pa'i gras su bkod na rgyu mtshan ldan par mthong ste dper na de yang rim pa bzhin ang grangs 61pa'i 'grel par dpe nyis rtseg 'dis rim gras sam/ las rigs mtshungs pa rnams nang khul du phan tshun gcig gis gcig la zhe sdang dang / phrag dog gzhan las che zer ba lta bur spyod pa dang / yang ang 62pa'i 'grel pa ra rang nyid gang dang gang la dga' zhing byang chub pa'i las rigs de'i mi snas las rigs de dang de'i nang gi grags cam shes shing cha rgyus ldan pa yin zer ba lta bur spyong cing /439

ang 94pa'i 'grel par/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs yongs rdzogs 'byor stobs dang / dbang thang / snyan grags sogs che chung la ma ltos par mtha' dag 'chi ba'i dus su yod tshad shul du bzhag ste 'gro ba la khyad par med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ ang 118pa'i 'grel par dpe nyis rtseg 'dis rang rang la dmigs bsal sger gcod kyi khyad dbang yod pa'i sa char dbang bdag kho rang gis gang zhig bshad pa de dang len mi byed ka med zer ba lta bur spyod pa/ de bzhin yang grangs 157par 'grel bshad/ spyir btang du 'byung mi srid pa'i bya dngos de 'dra ba'i rigs la dgos med kyi sems nad dang dngangs skrag bya dgos don med zer ba lta bur spyod pa/ le tshan bzhi pa de rang gi ang grangs 221pa'i 'grel pa la dpe nyis rtseg 'dis phyi rol yul gyi dngos po'i rgyu rkyen dmigs bsal can 'dzoms pa la brten nas gzhan na med pa'i 'bras bu ngo mtshar dang ldan pa 'byung srid pa la ya mtshan rgyu ci yang med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i don 'grel bskyar bcos dang 'brel le tshan gnyis pa'i khongs su gnas spo bgyis na legs par snyam/3 da dung le tshan bzhi pa de'i khrod nas gtam dpe 'ga' zhig ni thad kur brjod pa'i rang bzhin las dpe don zung 'brel gyi mtshan nyid dang mthun che ba 'dra bas na le tshan lnga pa'i khongs su spo dgos pa 'dugadaper na le tshan bzhi pa'i ang grangs 219par bu bar pa dang / zhing tha zhing / zer ba de'i 'grel pa ra/ dpe sa zhing gi nang nas tha zhing 440

la so nam 'debs g.yog dang bdag gnyer gang ci'i thad shugs ma thub kyis lhod g.yeng du 'gyur 'gro ba ltar/ don bu bar pa la'ang bu rgan pa dang 'dra ba'i gtsigs mthong mi thob la/ yang bu tha chung dang 'dra ba'i gces skyong yang mi yong bas mthong chung lta bu zhig rang shugs su 'byung zhes spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul la sdom tshig bzhag pa'o zhes dang /yang le tshan de rang gi yang grangs 241par/ mi ngan pa'i dri ma/shing rlon pa'i du ba/ zhes pa de'i 'grel par/ dpe shing rlon pa me la bud na du ba rgyun mi 'chad par thul ba bzhin du/ don mi rgu spyod mkhan gyi ming grags pa ngan pa'i dri ma de dus nam yang sel mi thub ces dpe don sbyar te zhabs 'dren gyi spyod ngan rigs rtsa ba nas bya mi rung bar gdams pa'o zhes pa/ yang le tshan de'i ang grangs 256par/ser sna can la spun mi 'khor/ g.yo sgyu can la grogs mi 'khor/ zer ba'i 'grel pa la'ang / dpe mi g.yo sgyu kho na spyad de mgo skor gtong mkhan la mtha' ma mi su yang 'khor mi srid pa bzhin du/ don rgyu nor kho nar skam chags che drags pa'i mi la mthar thug rang nyid kyi spun nye 'brel su yang 'khor mkhan yong mi srid ces dpe don sbyar nas rgyu nor 'ba' zhig las bsam rgyu med pa'i tha shal gyi spyod tshul de rigs bya mi nyan par bstan pa'o zhes bya ba la sogs su bskyar bcos dang 'brel le tshan lnga pa dpe don zung sbrel gyi sgo nas don ston pa'i khongs su spo bsgyur byas na snyam pa'i dpyad gzhi tsam mo/ /71 de min le tshan gzhan gyi nang du'ang dbye ba 'byed nor de 441

rigs med pa ma yin te/ le tshan lnga par mtshon na de'i ang grangs 25par/ rgyal po chags pa'i rten dang / the'u rang 'khor ba'i yos/zhes pa de kho bos gcig dpe dang gcig don du 'grel nas dpe don zung 'brel gyi khongs su sgrig pa de nor 'dug ches gna' dus kyi gtam dpe 'dir rgyal po zer ba ni lha srin dregs pa sde brgyad kyi nang gses rgyal po zhes pa der go dgos pa'i rgyal btsan sogs chags par rten mkhar dang / bon lugs nas bshad pa'i the'u rang zer ba'i 'dre rigs de 'khor ba la yos khra ste nas 'bru rngod ma gtor dgos zhes dpe nyis rtseg gis bya dngos tshang mar rang rang la 'dzoms dgos pa'i cha rkyen re yod pa ste/ dper na sa zhing dang sgo phyugs med na zhing pa rnams chags med ces pa lta bur spyad na chog ces 'grel par bskyar bcos dang / yang le tshan lnga pa'i ang grangs 102par/ dbyar drug pa'i sha phos rwa la 'dzems/ dgun bcu wa mos gra la 'dzems/ zer ba 'di gnyis ka dpe yin stabs kho bos 'jug yul rbad de nor 'dug pas rtsa 'grel cha tshang bcas gtam dpe 'di gnyis le tshan gnyis pa dpe nyis rtseg gis don gcig ston pa'i khongs su spos na legs 'dra mthong / gzhan yang le tshan lnga pa de rang gi ang grangs 11par/ kha shor na phyir 'then byed thabs med/ lam nor na phyir log byed sa yod/ ces pa de ni yod dang med zer ba gnyis rgyab 'gal la brten dpe don zung du 'brel thabs med pas 'grel par bskyar bcos phran bu dang bcas le tshan bzhi pa thad brjod kyi khongs su spos na snyam pa ma zad/ da dung le tshan lnga 442

pa'i ang grangs 82par/ nang khul chong ma rgyag dpon g.yog sho ma rgyag ces pa de yang dpe don zung 'brel khongs bzhag pa mi 'os pas 'grel par/ nang khul tshong brgyab na phan tshun su la khe gyong byung na'ang 'tsham po med pa dang / de bzhin dpon po dang g.yog po sho brgyab na thob shor ci byung na yang mtha' 'bras bzang po mi 'byung bar bstan pa'o zhes bskyar bcos dang / de bzhin le tshan de rang gi ang grangs 149par/ bza' rgyu mang na nad yin/ bshad rgyu mang na gyod yin/zer ba de yang dpe dang don du bzhag na mi 'tsham par brten 'grel pa la/ zas za tshod ma ran pa zos drags na lus la nad 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pa dang / skad cha bshad rgyu mang drags na gyod dang kha mchu slong ba'i gzhi yin pas de rigs la dus rtag tu tshod 'dzin ran po zhig bya dgos par bstan pa'o zhes bskyar bcos bcas byas te gtam dpe gsum po 'di dag le tshan bzhi pa thad kur brjod pa'i khongs su spo shugs bgyis na legs pa lta bu dran par dpyad gzhi zhu/5 gzhan yang kho bos le tshan bzhi pa'i khongs bsgrigs pa'i yang 99par/ sgom chen ri la sdodakyang / bsod snyoms grong nas len/ zer ba de la bskyar du zhib skabs thad brjod kyi don snying mi ldan par dpe kho na bshad nas brjod don shugs la rtogs par byed pa'i gtam dpe yin pa ha cang gsal/ dper na khrims dpon zhig khrims khang gi khri thog tu drang tshugs sgam nan che mdog byed na yang / mtshan mo khyim nang du lkog rngan skyel mkhan la sne len hur thag byas nas 'tsho ba skyel gyin yod 443

zer ba lta bu sogs de rigs la spyad chog ces pa'i 'grel bshad bskyar bcos dang / de bzhin yang le tshan bzhi pa'i ang grangs 151par/rta gcig byung na/ sga gcig dgos/ zer ba de yang dpe bshad nas don go bar byed de/ mi la la'i 'dod pa nam yang tshim rgyu med pas 'dod yon longs spyod ji tsam chen po chags na/ da dung 'dod rngams kyang de tsam gyis je cher 'gro ba yin zer ba lta bu de 'drar spyod pa'i 'grel bshad la bskyar bcos phran bu byas te gtam dpe de gnyis chabs cig le tshan dang po ste/ dpe kho na ched du bshad de brjod don gang yin pa rang shugs su gsal bar ston pa'i gtam dpe'i khongs su spos na thad brjod las go don dang sgyu rtsal gang gi cha nas kyang lhag pa bu dang /de bzhin le tshan bzhi pa de rang gi yang grangs 27par/ kha che'i yul na gur kum ra mas za/ a mdo'i yul na byi tang mdzo mos za/ zhes pa de la'ang zhib tu bsam na thad brjod kyi rgyu mtshan gtan nas mi ldan par dpe nyis rtseg gis/ 'jig rten gyi khams ni mu mtha' med la gnas tshul yang mi 'dra ba he bag chen po yod pa bstan te/ brjod don dngos ni dper na deng sang rig gnas dar rgyas ha cang che ba'i grong khyer nang / slob grwa che mo mthar phyin pa'i slob thon slob mas kyang khyim tshang gzhan gyi bu rdzi'i bya ba gnyer gyin yod zer ba lta bur spyad na 'grig pa'i 'grel bskyar bcos dang 'brel le tshan gnyis pa'i khongs su bskyal na snyam pa bcas 'di dag kyang bskyar du dran nas dpyad bsdur gyi rgyu char bris pa lags so/ / 444

gsum pa/ gzhi rkang gong du gtam dpe re re bzhin la go don nam/ bed spyod bya yul sogs kyi 'grel bshad re ched du bkod yod kyang / 'ga' zhig gtam dpe'i go don dngos brjod ma thub pa dang /yang na rigs phye ba'i mtshan nyid dang mi mthun pa sogs kyi skyon cha'ang mi nyung ba zhig byung yo da/1 dpe mtshon tsam zhig drangs na le tshan dang po'i ang grangs 121par/ grong pa nye 'dod na/ gong lar cher rags rgyobs/ zer ba'i 'grel par/ ‘4 'dir khyim mtshes thog 'brel la brten rgyu dngos brlag shor dang / pho mo'i 'brel ba sogs kyi dogs gzhi dang rtsod gleng ma byung sngon 'gog bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin ’nyazhes 'khod 'dug 'grel bshad de ltar byas na dpe kho na bshad pa bas brjod don thad kur bshad pa'i mtshan nyid shas che bas le tshan bzhi pa'i khongs su 'jug 'os pa lta bu'i 'gal ba mngon/ 'on kyang dpe de spyod yul ni rgya che ste gnyen nye ba'am grogs po blo dkar sogs kyi dbar phar spyod tshur len gyi lhag chad rtsis rgyag rgyu'am/ yang na phan tshun rgyan gos nyer spyad sogs gyon res spyod res byas rigs rang rang gi dngos po de ngo nor med pa khungs so sor sprod pa sogs mdor na dga' nye'i dbar gtso bo dpal 'byor thad 'dra 'dres dang nyag nyog ma yin pa kha gsal khams dang yong ba byas na phan tshun dam gtsang 'cham mthun mtha' 'khyongs yong thub ces pa la sogs go don mang po ldan yod pa bcas le tshan ni dpe kho na brjod nas don shugs la ston pas dang po rang gi 445

khongs su gtogs pa yin snyam pa lta bu'o/ /2 'dir brgyab pa'i 'grel bshad mang po zhig ni gtam dpe so so'i phyogs re ba'am/ cha shas tsam mtshon pa las go don cha tshang ba ston thub med la/ gting zab pa dang gson shugs ldan pa/ ldog nas ston pa sogs ni de bas kyang 'grel bshad byed thub med/ dper na le tshan dang po'i yang grangs 122par/ grod pa 'grangs kyang /zhim blo mi bde/ zhes pa'i 'grel par/ 8‘rogs pa byas na'ang lhag bsam rnam dag dang kha zhe gnyis med cig byas ma byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin mi’zhes pa tsam las brjod thub med/ 'on kyang de ni rogs pa byed stangs kyi gnad don tsam du ma zad/ 'dod don zhig bsgrubs na'ang de'i phugs yul nyen kha che bas sems nad chags pa lta bu'am/ bya ba zhig mngags gdams byas pa de khas blangs kyang bshad stangs dang rnam 'gyur ha cang ngan pa bstan pa/ las ka chung rtsag cig re bcol byas pa ltar bsgrubs na yang byas yus de bas ldab mang pos che ba zhig yang bskor bskyar bskor gyis bshad byung zer ba sogs mdor na bsgrub bya'i don gang yin pa de grub na yang / de'i bya rim nang na gtad phyogs kyi byed pa mi bzang ba sogs kyis sems skyid po ma byung zhes pa mtshon byed cig yin pa sogs bsam tshul mtha' dag brjod kyis mi lang ba yang yang phrad pas kho bos 'dir 'grel bshad phal mo che zhig gi mjug tu 66zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin ’’zhes bris yod pa 'di la rgya che'i klog pa po rnam pa tshos de don rigs 'ded kyi go ba 'jug 446

sgo yangs shing rgya che ba zhig bzhes rgyu'i re ba yod/3 mdor na bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe mang che bar go don gyi 'grel bshad blo yid tshims pa zhig ci 'dra byas na'ang byed mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni bdag rang gi shes tshad kyis ma 'dang ba phud/de min bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig kyang yin pa de da lam rang nyid la bya ba ngo ma'i nang nas myong tshor zab mo zhig byung / de'i thad la bsam zhib yang yang byas pa brgyud go don rtogs thabs yag shos ni gtam dpe so so'i nang don dang 'brel ba 'tshams po yod pa'i lo rgyus kyi byung ba'am/ yang na dngos yod kyi don rkyen zhig dang sbyar nas 'grel bshad byed thabs spyad na go ba lon che shos yong ba 'dug snyam/dper na le tshan bzhi pa'i ang grangs 10par/ rkyen ngan grogs su shar ba/ zer ba de la kho bos 'grel bshad dam spyod yul 'u thug po de 'dra zhig las 'bri thub med/ gal te lo rgyus kyi byung ba zhig dang sbyar nas bshad na/ rje btsun mi la ras pa sku chung ngu'i dus yab grongs khar khong rang gi sku mched a khu a ne gnyis la bu mad rnams sdug tu mi 'jug pa'i zhal chems dang bcas bcol na yang / a khu a ne gnyis pos phyi nor nang rdzas yod rgu btsan bdag byas pa ma zad/ khong yum sras ming sring gsum la bzod glags med pa'i sdug po sna rgu btang /de la lan slog ched yum gyi bka' ltar dbus gtsang khul mthu sgrub tu byon zhing / a khu'i bu la bag ma len pa'i ston mo'i skabs su mthu 447

gtad kyis mi grangs sum cu so lnga khang pa log pa'i rdib 'og tu btang /yul du ser ba 'bebs pa sogs sdig las tshabs po che gnang bar thugs 'gyod tshad med pa 'khrungs nas lho brag tu rje mar pa lo tsā ba'i zhabs la gtugs/ sgrib sbyong bzod par dka' ba dpag tu med pa mdzad mthar gdams ngag zab mo gnang / yongs rdzogs blos btang gis sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad pas mthar sku tshe 'di nyid la zung 'jug gi go 'phangs brnyes thub pa de lta bu la 88rkyen ngan grogs su shar ba ’ zhes zer ba yin brjod na gtam dpe de la go ba gting zab tsam zhig lon thub bam snyam pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang yongs grags kyi gtam dpe 'ga' zhig sngon byon grags can mi snas don rkyen ci 'dra zhig la dmigs nas bed spyod gnang ba'i skor skabs de'i 'byung rkyen lo rgyus dgos nges mdor bsdus tsam drangs nas shes su 'jug rgyu de'ang gtam dper go ba gsal po lon pa'i bya thabs nus pa ldan pa zhig yin snyam/ dper na/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa'i yang srid brtsad 'tshol gyi skabs/ ching gong ma chan lung gis lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje ched gnyer bod du mngags gtong gnang zhing / sngar lam chos skyong rnams la zhus pa'i lung bstan yang gcig gyur ma byung ba sogs mdzad dka' gnang gtad chen po byung dus lcang skyas rdo ring paṇḍi ta la gsungs par/ ‘6rgyal ba'i mchog sprul gyi skor 'di rtsa ba che stabs rang cag rnams kyis blos ma 'khyud par mngon shes yod res chos skyong khag rnams spyan 'dren zhus kyang / long ba'i 'khar 448

ba lta bu bcas lung phebs tshang ma po ta la'i gser khrir sdebs gcig la bskyal bas ni ma mthus/ 'di mus rim 'gyangs su lus na ni sku gegs sogs ji yong cha mi rtogs pa'i khar/ gong ma chen pos kyang ji gsung mi shes pa bcas da gos paṇḍi ta 'di la chos skyong sku gsol zhig zhu dgos rgyu e yin ’ (1)zhes dgongs pa can gyi gsung de la bka' blon rdo ring gis 66 spyan 'dren ji tsam mdzad kyang lha 'dre khog zhugs ni phran la gtan nas mi yong / 'on kyang thugs rje che yul du rang gi bsam tshod mdzes lam du ma song ba zhu na/ rgyal ba'i yang srid skor 'di rtsa ba che stabs rgya nag gong ma chen pos kyang mda' la yid ma ches/ mdung la srang gang sprad de bkas mngags pa ni skyabs mgon chen po nyid las gzhan du ma mchis pa bcas des na gzhan zer rjes 'brang dang mdzes lam du ma song ba'i ye shes kyi gzigs pas dpyad de thag chod pa zhig mdzad phyin/ de don las mi 'gal ba'i zhabs gyur zhu 'os rnams ltos zos sgo khyi'i dpe ltar phran tshang mas bsam pa rnam dag zhu dgos gzhir bcas zhes zhu bar mdzad (2) ces go rgyu chen po yod pa'i lan 'bul gnang mdzad 'dug pa ltar dngos byung gi don rkyen dang 'brel yod kyi lo rgyus bcas gsal bgyis na der gsal ba'i gtam dpe'i go don je ( 1 ) 〈〈dga' bzhi ba'i mi rabs kyi byung brjod 〉〉si khron lcags par ma'i deb ngos/ 76—79( 2 ) 〈〈dga' bzhi ba'i mi rabs kyi byung brjod 〉〉si khron lcags par ma'i deb par ngos/ 78—79bar la gzigs/449

gsal du 'gyur thub pa lta bu 'di'ang dpe mtshon zhig yin/de bzhin dper na rang thag bcag na/ lte nad sangs zer ba'i gtam dpe 'di'i tshig 'grel gong du gsal ba ltar yang / don 'brel thad lo rgyus kyi bshad srol 'di 'dra zhig thos myong ste/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i smad cha'i nang skabs de'i srid skyong ra sgreng a chi thu ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang / bka' blon gtso bo bshad sgra dbang phyug rgyal po gnyis dbar dbang cha 'phrog res kyi 'gal ba zhig lhags rkyen srid skyong gis/ bshad sgra las zhabs gnas dbyungs kyis snye mo bya sgo gzhis kur tshul mthun gyis sdod dgos pa'i bka' bcad btang ba bzhin sdod mus skabs/ gor rgyal dzang ka bha dur dang yig 'grul byas pa'i klan ka zhig lhags rkyen srid skyong ra sgreng nas bka' phab don bzhin mda' dpon thon pa ba dmag dpung dang bcas snye mor ched gtong skabs/ shod 'gag nas bshad sgra'i byed 'dzol tshabs chen la mtha' 'doms nan po bya dgos pa'i bka' bsgyur dang / zhib cha bka' mngags spyi mkhan nas gnang rgyu zhes bshad cing /spyi khyab mkhan po ser smad rgyal dbang sprul sku blo bzang 'phrin las nas mda' dpon thon pa bar gang sar nan po bya dgos pa'i mngags cha yang yang byas pa'i mtha' bsdoms su/ mda' dpon sku zhabs 8 rang thag bcag na lte nad sangs ’ zer ba'i dpe zhig yod pa red dā zhes brjod nas don la bshad sgra bsad na rnyog dra yongs rdzogs thag chod kyi red ces brda gsal po bstan na yang / dngos su thug 'phrad skabs bshad 450

sgras snga phyi'i gnas lugs yong rkyen rnams 'jam bshad thabs mkhas byas rkyen thon pas gsod ma nus par skra bcad de rgyal byed dgon par btson 'jug byas pa'i skor rgan rabs kyi ngag rgyun las thos myong ba ltar de dag kyang gtam dpe go don zab bshad byas pa'i lo rgyus thog dngos su byung ba'i don rkyen zhig yin snyam mo/ /yang dper na mchod rten mgo gzhug log kyang / bang rim sked par gnas tsam zer ba'i gtam dpe de go don ci 'dra zhig la 'jug pa lam seng blo la 'char mi bde tsam lta bu yod mod/ 'on kyang 'di skor spyi lo 1947lor stag brag phyogs gtogs dang bcas pas srid dbang dang drag shugs spyad de ra sgreng phyogs gtogs gtor pham btang rjes skabs ra bla'i byas nyes zhes pa'i yig rigs khag cig lha sa'i bar skor nang khrom bsgrags 'grem ston byas song ba'i khongs/ sgyung gnas bla ma dang / mkhar rdo sprul sku sogs kyis stag brag bla ma lkog gsod bya rgyu'i skor gyi 'char gzhi bton par ra sgreng rin po ches gnang ba'i phyag bris shig gi nang du/ stag brag gi byed bab ngan pa rnams bgrangs pa'i mjug tu/ 'on te ra sgreng bla brang la mtshon na'ang 66mchod rten mgo gzhug log kyang / bang rim sked par gnas tsam ’’zhig yod par brten thal cha de rigs byed mi rung zhes zhal ta mdzad 'dug pa'i gtam dpe de da lta'ang gsal por blo la dran gyi 'dug de'i go don ni mchod rten mgo gzhug log pa zer ba ra sgreng rang de snga bod yongs la dbang sgyur ba nas/ da stag brag gis dbang sgyur bya yul du gyur pa la zer 451

zhing / 'on kyang bang rim sked par gnas tsam zhes pa ni dpal 'byor gyi thad sngon chad lo brgyad tsam ring rgyal tshab gnang skabs srid gzhung gi rdzong gzhis legs gras 'ga' zhig mchod gzhis su rtsa 'jags dang /byang rigs khyon yongs la sger sdom gyis bal tshong lo mang brgyab ste khe spogs tshad las brgal ba thob pa/ de min skyabs rten 'bul dngos kyi yong 'bab sogs phyogs gang ci nas bod gangs can 'dir mtshon na 'byor stobs ra sgreng bla brang la 'gran nus pa su yang med pa de la gsung ba bcas de ltar don dngos dang zung du sbrel nas bsam zhib byed skabs gzhi nas gtam dpe de la go ba don dang mthun pa zhig lon thub pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin byung nam mkha' dang / 'thim sa gzhi zhes pa'i gtam dpe 'di'i tshig 'grel ni nam mkha' las byung ba'i kha char rnams sa gzhi chen por 'thim zhing / sa rlangs sprin du gyur te slar yang kha char 'bab pa de nyid dper bzhag pa yin mod/ 'on kyang go don gang yin dang don gnad ci 'dra zhig bed spyod byed pa'i skor/ de snga lha klu'i lha lcam g.yang 'dzoms tshe ring zer ba'i bud med grags can des rang nyid kyi za zla lha klu'i gung 'jigs med rnam rgyal gzhon nu'i dus su grongs pa dang / kho rang gi bu phun tshogs rab rgyas bya ba yang lo na bcu bdun thog grongs pa/ rjes su ram pa'i bu phun tshogs rgyal po zer ba lha klu'i go mag tu bsus kyang ma 'grig par go log pa sogs rkyen ngan sne 'doms byung rkyen snye byung nam mkha' dang / 'thim sa gzhi'i dpe 452

bzhin lha klu'i 'dzin dbang yongs rdzogs tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum par rtsis 'bul zhus te khong nyid nam 'tsho'i ring 'tsho rten bab mtshungs gsol ras zhu rgyu ’ (1)zhes gsal ba ltar/ lha klu'i 'dzin dbang gang na ci yod tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa dang / sku phreng bcu gnyis pa gnyis kyi yab gzhis su snga phyir sa gnas srid gzhung nas gnang ba de da cha slar yang srid gzhung rang la phyir 'bul zhu rgyu zer ba'i go don yin pa don rkyen dngos dang sbrags nas 'grel bshad byed dus tshang mas go ba lon bde ba lta bu yin/gzhan yang dmangs khrod gtam dpe la la gnas tshul dmigs bsal can gyi 'og go don 'gyur ba chen po'am/ yang na rbad de go ldog tu 'gyur ba de 'dra'ang yod/ dper na spyi lo 1938lor bshad sgra nang khul kha ma dan par gyod gzhi thug skabs/ bka' shag nas phul ba'i 'char gzhir rgyal tshab ra sgreng gis bka' bcos gnang don 66 skal thob ma zur star kha kha gshag gtong 'os mchis min zhib dpyad 'char 'bul dgos rgyu ’ zhes gsal bar brten bshad sgra ma tshang nyen 'gan ma bzod par bka' zhib drang 'chun che ba zhig 'phral du bsko bzhag yong ba nas bden mtha' gsal ba'i rgyu rkyen zhus chog pa zhes nang bcar zhu skabs/ 66bka' blon bon shod kyis gsungs gsal/( 1 ) 〈〈bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs 〉〉'don thengs 14par ngos 79453

bka' bcad nang gsal zhib dpyad kyi 'char gzhi 'bul rgyu zhes pa de bka' shag nas thad kur skal thob skor 'char gzhi sbud tsam 'bul rgyu de rang red/ ngas spo'o 'gyel rmo'o slong byas pas ga la 'thus/ mgo bo'i dkyil du brgyab ste/ klad pa'i gzhung la 'gro ba zhig byas chog ces drang po bya rgyu yin pa'i tshul gyis don snying star kha kha gshag gtong rgyu yin zer ba'i go don yod pa red ’ (1)ces gsal ba ltar gtarma dpe 'di'i tshig 'grel ni bod mi rigs gna' bo'i goms srol lo gsar la lug mgo sreg ma btsos nas za skabs/ thog mar lug mgo phyed gshag gtong srol de dper bzhag ste mgo bo'i dkyil du gri brgyab ste klad pa'i gzhung ngam/la las sna'i gzhung la 'gro ba'ang zer srol yod de g.yas g.yon gnyis ka che chung ma shor ba zhes rgyun ldan gyi go don drang po drang bzhag bya rgyu zer bar spyod pa yin rung / skabs don 'di lta bu'i dus su ma zur gnyis skal thob star ka phyed gshag gtong rgyu zer ba'i ldog phyogs kyi go don zhig kyang shugs bstan yod pa sogs 'di rigs kyis mtshon gtam dpe du ma'i brjod don nam/ yang na go rgyu cha tshang gting zab cig rtogs par byed pa la de dang 'brel ba'i don rkyen zhib phra zhig dang sbyar te 'grel bshad byas na ma gtogs go ba lon dka' ba'i dpe mtshon skabs 'phral blo ngor 'char ba 'ga' shas tsam drangs pa bcas mdor na g.ya' ( 1 ) 〈〈bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs 〉〉'don thengs 14par ngos 100454

sel 'di'ang / gcig nas bdag rang gis gong du bgyis pa'i gtam dpe'i 'grel bshad mang po zhig 'thus sgo tshang min dang nor 'khrul ci rigs shig mthong bar brten rta ma chad gong nas babs na bzang zer ba'i dpe ltar gzhan gyi bka' bkyon ma phog pa'i gong du rang skyon rang brjod gang nus dang 'brel gzigs pa po rnams kyis dpyad zhib yo srong gnang rgyur bskul ma zhu ched dang / gnyis nas bod kyi dmangs khrod rig gnas kyi ya gyal gtam dpe'i sgyu rtsal la de bas phyogs yongs dang sgo kun nas zhib 'jug gzab nan gnang rin yod la/ gnang dgos nges kyi spyir btang ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal dang goms srol gyi khyad chos dpog dka' ji snyed cig ldan pa'i gsal 'debs kyi rgyur 'gyur du re ba'i sems kyis bris pa yin/ 455

mtha' 'jugagi re 'dun/gtam mdzod deb chung 'di yi 'go gleng gzhi nas/ mjug g.ya' sel brjod pa'i bar thog mtha' gzhung gsum gang gi thad du'ang da dung ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtog pa sogs kyi skyon dang nor 'khrul ci rigs pa zhig gnas yod pa gdon mi za bas lugs 'dir gzigs spyan yangs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis skyon sel dge spel la sman pa'i dgongs 'char lhug rtsol yong ba zhu rgyu dang bcas/ 456

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/mo/zomomacho (/lha༈45kha byang jus 'god pa/ kurma rdo rje tshe ring /zo/khrosnga// sbozokha byang yi ge bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/zo/khrodngha zalta༈yodape bsdur 'gan 'khur pa/ tshe ring mtsho mo/oṃ/1ma7༈ oṃ41yoyogatam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/chab spel tshe brtan phu) tshogs kyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas/mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gi rtsis 'khor nas bsgrigs/1997lo'i zla 8par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/1997lo'i zla 8par pe cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/deb rer sgor 13 00
